Sentiment tends to become more critical in comment discussions compared to original posts. Topic and aspect analyses show that sentiment is primarily associated with experience-based themes, with most variation occurring within cities rather than between regions. Together, these findings illustrate how discussion-based online data can complement traditional approaches to understanding public perceptions of cycling infrastructure in sustainable urban contexts.

title: ListK: Semantic ORDER BY and LIMIT K with Listwise Prompting
summary: Semantic operators abstract large language model (LLM) calls in SQL clauses. It is gaining traction as an easy method to analyze semi-structured, unstructured, and multimodal datasets. While a plethora of recent works optimize various semantic operators, existing methods for semantic ORDER BY (full sort) and LIMIT K (top-K) remain lackluster. Our ListK framework improves the latency of semantic ORDER BY ... LIMIT K at no cost to accuracy. Motivated by the recent advance in fine-tuned listwise rankers, we study several sorting algorithms that best combine partial listwise rankings. These include: 1) deterministic listwise tournament (LTTopK), 2) Las Vegas and embarrassingly parallel listwise multi-pivot quickselect/sort (LMPQSelect, LMPQSort), and 3) a basic Monte Carlo listwise tournament filter (LTFilter). Of these, listwise multi-pivot quickselect/sort are studied here for the first time. The full framework provides a query optimizer for combining the above physical operators based on the target recall to minimize latency. We provide theoretical analysis to easily tune parameters and provide cost estimates for query optimizers. ListK empirically dominates the Pareto frontier, halving latency at virtually no cost to recall and NDCG compared to prior art.

title: The Geometry of Coordinated Trajectories for Non-stop Flying Carriers Holding a Cable-Suspended Load
summary: This work considers the problem of using multiple aerial carriers to hold a cable-suspended load while remaining in periodic motion at all times. Using a novel differential geometric perspective, it is shown that the problem may be recast as that of finding an immersion of the unit circle into the smooth manifold of admissible configurations. Additionally, this manifold is shown to be path connected under a mild assumption on the attachment points of the carriers to the load. Based on these ideas, a family of simple linear solutions to the original problems is presented that overcomes the constraints of alternative solutions previously proposed in the literature. Simulation results demonstrate the flexibility of the theory in identifying suitable solutions.

title: Adaptive Anchor Policies for Efficient 4D Gaussian Streaming
summary: Dynamic scene reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting has enabled efficient streaming for real-time rendering and free-viewpoint video. However, most pipelines rely on fixed anchor selection such as Farthest Point Sampling (FPS), typically using 8,192 anchors regardless of scene complexity, which over-allocates computation under strict budgets. We propose Efficient Gaussian Streaming (EGS), a plug-in, budget-aware anchor sampler that replaces FPS with a reinforcement-learned policy while keeping the Gaussian streaming reconstruction backbone unchanged. The policy jointly selects an anchor budget and a subset of informative anchors under discrete constraints, balancing reconstruction quality and runtime using spatial features of the Gaussian representation. We evaluate EGS in two settings: fast rendering, which prioritizes runtime efficiency, and high-quality refinement, which enables additional optimization. Experiments on dynamic multi-view datasets show consistent improvements in the quality--efficiency trade-off over FPS sampling. On unseen data, in fast rendering at 256 anchors ($32\times$ fewer than 8,192), EGS improves PSNR by $+0.52$--$0.61$\,dB while running $1.29$--$1.35\times$ faster than IGS@8192 (N3DV and MeetingRoom). In high-quality refinement, EGS remains competitive with the full-anchor baseline at substantially lower anchor budgets. \emph{Code and pretrained checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.} \keywords{4D Gaussian Splatting \and 4D Gaussian Streaming \and Reinforcement Learning}

title: From Drop-off to Recovery: A Mechanistic Analysis of Segmentation in MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to pixel-level vision tasks, yet their intrinsic capacity for spatial understanding remains poorly understood. We investigate segmentation capacity through a layerwise linear probing evaluation across the entire MLLM pipeline: vision encoder, adapter, and LLM. We further conduct an intervention based attention knockout analysis to test whether cross-token attention progressively refines visual representations, and an evaluation of bidirectional attention among image tokens on spatial consistency. Our analysis reveals that the adapter introduces a segmentation representation drop-off, but LLM layers progressively recover through attention-mediated refinement, where correctly classified tokens steer misclassified neighbors toward the correct label. At early image token positions, this recovery is bounded by causal attention, which bidirectional attention among image tokens alleviates. These findings provide a mechanistic account of how MLLMs process visual information for segmentation, informing the design of future segmentation-capable models.

title: Visual SLAM with DEM Anchoring for Lunar Surface Navigation
summary: Future lunar missions will require autonomous rovers capable of traversing tens of kilometers across challenging terrain while maintaining accurate localization and producing globally consistent maps. However, the absence of global positioning systems, extreme illumination, and low-texture regolith make long-range navigation on the Moon particularly difficult, as visual-inertial odometry pipelines accumulate drift over extended traverses. To address this challenge, we present a stereo visual simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system that integrates learned feature detection and matching with global constraints from digital elevation models (DEMs). Our front-end employs learning-based feature extraction and matching to achieve robustness to illumination extremes and repetitive terrain, while the back-end incorporates DEM-derived height and surface-normal factors into a pose graph, providing absolute surface constraints that mitigate long-term drift. We validate our approach using both simulated lunar traverse data generated in Unreal Engine and real Moon/Mars analog data collected from Mt. Etna. Results demonstrate that DEM anchoring consistently reduces absolute trajectory error compared to baseline SLAM methods, lowering drift in long-range navigation even in repetitive or visually aliased terrain.

title: KANtize: Exploring Low-bit Quantization of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Efficient Inference
summary: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) have gained attention for their potential to outperform Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) in terms of parameter efficiency and interpretability. Unlike traditional MLPs, KANs use learnable non-linear activation functions, typically spline functions, expressed as linear combinations of basis splines (B-splines). B-spline coefficients serve as the model's learnable parameters. However, evaluating these spline functions increases computational complexity during inference. Conventional quantization reduces this complexity by lowering the numerical precision of parameters and activations. However, the impact of quantization on KANs, and especially its effectiveness in reducing computational complexity, is largely unexplored, particularly for quantization levels below 8 bits. The study investigates the impact of low-bit quantization on KANs and its impact on computational complexity and hardware efficiency. Results show that B-splines can be quantized to 2-3 bits with negligible loss in accuracy, significantly reducing computational complexity. Hence, we investigate the potential of using low-bit quantized precomputed tables as a replacement for the recursive B-spline algorithm. This approach aims to further reduce the computational complexity of KANs and enhance hardware efficiency while maintaining accuracy. For example, ResKAN18 achieves a 50x reduction in BitOps without loss of accuracy using low-bit-quantized B-spline tables. Additionally, precomputed 8-bit lookup tables improve GPU inference speedup by up to 2.9x, while on FPGA-based systolic-array accelerators, reducing B-spline table precision from 8 to 3 bits cuts resource usage by 36%, increases clock frequency by 50%, and enhances speedup by 1.24x. On a 28nm FD-SOI ASIC, reducing the B-spline bit-width from 16 to 3 bits achieves 72% area reduction and 50% higher maximum frequency.

title: Neuron-Level Emotion Control in Speech-Generative Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can produce expressive speech, yet reliable emotion control remains elusive: conversions often miss the target affect and may degrade linguistic fidelity through refusals, hallucinations, or paraphrase. We present, to our knowledge, the first neuron-level study of emotion control in speech-generative LALMs and demonstrate that compact emotion-sensitive neurons (ESNs) are causally actionable, enabling training-free emotion steering at inference time. ESNs are identified via success-filtered activation aggregation enforcing both emotion realization and content preservation. Across three LALMs (Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, MiniCPM-o 4.5, Kimi-Audio), ESN interventions yield emotion-specific gains that generalize to unseen speakers and are supported by automatic and human evaluation. Controllability depends on selector design, mask sparsity, filtering, and intervention strength. Our results establish a mechanistic framework for training-free emotion control in speech generation.

title: Full Stack Navigation, Mapping, and Planning for the Lunar Autonomy Challenge
comments: Published in the Proceedings of the ION GNSS+ 2025 conference
summary: We present a modular, full-stack autonomy system for lunar surface navigation and mapping developed for the Lunar Autonomy Challenge. Operating in a GNSS-denied, visually challenging environment, our pipeline integrates semantic segmentation, stereo visual odometry, pose graph SLAM with loop closures, and layered planning and control. We leverage lightweight learning-based perception models for real-time segmentation and feature tracking and use a factor-graph backend to maintain globally consistent localization. High-level waypoint planning is designed to promote mapping coverage while encouraging frequent loop closures, and local motion planning uses arc sampling with geometric obstacle checks for efficient, reactive control. We evaluate our approach in the competition's high-fidelity lunar simulator, demonstrating centimeter-level localization accuracy, high-fidelity map generation, and strong repeatability across random seeds and rock distributions. Our solution achieved first place in the final competition evaluation.
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the ION GNSS+ 2025 conference

title: Draft-and-Prune: Improving the Reliability of Auto-formalization for Logical Reasoning
summary: Auto-formalization (AF) translates natural-language reasoning problems into solver-executable programs, enabling symbolic solvers to perform sound logical deduction. In practice, however, AF pipelines are currently brittle: programs may fail to execute, or execute but encode incorrect semantics. While prior work largely mitigates syntactic failures via repairs based on solver feedback, reducing semantics failures remains a major bottleneck. We propose Draft-and-Prune (D&P), an inference-time framework that improves AF-based logical reasoning via diversity and verification. D&P first drafts multiple natural-language plans and conditions program generation on them. It further prunes executable but contradictory or ambiguous formalizations, and aggregates predictions from surviving paths via majority voting. Across four representative benchmarks (AR-LSAT, ProofWriter, PrOntoQA, LogicalDeduction), D&P substantially strengthens AF-based reasoning without extra supervision. On AR-LSAT, in the AF-only setting, D&P achieves 78.43% accuracy with GPT-4 and 78.00% accuracy with GPT-4o, significantly outperforming the strongest AF baselines MAD-LOGIC and CLOVER. D&P then attains near-ceiling performance on the other benchmarks, including 100% on PrOntoQA and LogicalDeduction.

title: Deployment and Evaluation of an EHR-integrated, Large Language Model-Powered Tool to Triage Surgical Patients
summary:
Surgical co-management (SCM) is an evidence-based model in which hospitalists jointly manage medically complex perioperative patients alongside surgical teams. Despite its clinical and financial value, SCM is limited by the need to manually identify eligible patients. To determine whether SCM triage can be automated, we conducted a prospective, unblinded study at Stanford Health Care in which an LLM-based, electronic health record (EHR)-integrated triage tool (SCM Navigator) provided SCM recommendations followed by physician review.
  Using pre-operative documentation, structured data, and clinical criteria for perioperative morbidity, SCM Navigator categorized patients as appropriate, not appropriate, or possibly appropriate for SCM. Faculty indicated their clinical judgment and provided free-text feedback when they disagreed. Sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value were measured using physician determinations as a reference. Free-text reasons were thematically categorized, and manual chart review was conducted on all false-negative cases and 30 randomly selected cases from the largest false-positive category. Since deployment, 6,193 cases have been triaged, of which 1,582 (23%) were recommended for hospitalist consultation. SCM Navigator displayed high sensitivity (0.94, 95% CI 0.91-0.96) and moderate specificity (0.74, 95% CI 0.71-0.77). Post-hoc chart review suggested most discrepancies reflect modifiable gaps in clinical criteria, institutional workflow, or physician practice variability rather than LLM misclassification, which accounted for 2 of 19 (11%) false-negative cases. These findings demonstrate that an LLM-powered, EHR-integrated, human-in-the-loop AI system can accurately and safely triage surgical patients for SCM, and that AI-enabled screening tools can augment and potentially automate time-intensive clinical workflows.

title: Neural Radiance Maps for Extraterrestrial Navigation and Path Planning
comments: Published in the Proceedings of the ION GNSS+ 2023 Conference
summary: Autonomous vehicles such as the Mars rovers currently lead the vanguard of surface exploration on extraterrestrial planets and moons. In order to accelerate the pace of exploration and science objectives, it is critical to plan safe and efficient paths for these vehicles. However, current rover autonomy is limited by a lack of global maps which can be easily constructed and stored for onboard re-planning. Recently, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have been introduced as a detailed 3D scene representation which can be trained from sparse 2D images and efficiently stored. We propose to use NeRFs to construct maps for online use in autonomous navigation, and present a planning framework which leverages the NeRF map to integrate local and global information. Our approach interpolates local cost observations across global regions using kernel ridge regression over terrain features extracted from the NeRF map, allowing the rover to re-route itself around untraversable areas discovered during online operation. We validate our approach in high-fidelity simulation and demonstrate lower cost and higher percentage success rate path planning compared to various baselines.
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the ION GNSS+ 2023 Conference

title: Actionable Guidance Outperforms Map and Compass Cues in Demanding Immersive VR Wayfinding
comments: AV and LMT contributed equally to this work
summary: Navigation aids are central to immersive virtual reality (VR) experiences that involve physical locomotion. Their effectiveness depends not only on how much spatial information they provide, but also on how directly that information supports movement decisions. We compared three common guidance techniques for immersive VR wayfinding: a directional arrow, a minimap, and a compass. In a controlled room-scale VR study with 42 participants completing 1008 trials, participants navigated to target landmarks in a time-pressured maze with reduced visibility and forced route replanning. Across behavioral and eye-tracking measures, arrow guidance produced the strongest navigation performance, minimap guidance yielded intermediate performance, and compass cues performed worst, suggesting that during immersive locomotion users benefit from guidance that can be interpreted rapidly while moving. These results suggest that in demanding immersive locomotion tasks, interfaces that translate spatial information directly into actionable movement cues can outperform richer but more interpretive spatial representations. Our findings highlight the importance of designing XR navigation interfaces that minimize the cognitive translation between spatial information and movement decisions.
comment: AV and LMT contributed equally to this work

title: LAAF: Logic-layer Automated Attack Framework A Systematic Red-Teaming Methodology for LPCI Vulnerabilities in Agentic Large Language Model Systems
summary: Agentic LLM systems equipped with persistent memory, RAG pipelines, and external tool connectors face a class of attacks - Logic-layer Prompt Control Injection (LPCI) - for which no automated red-teaming instrument existed. We present LAAF (Logic-layer Automated Attack Framework), the first automated red-teaming framework to combine an LPCI-specific technique taxonomy with stage-sequential seed escalation - two capabilities absent from existing tools: Garak lacks memory-persistence and cross-session triggering; PyRIT supports multi-turn testing but treats turns independently, without seeding each stage from the prior breakthrough. LAAF provides: (i) a 49-technique taxonomy spanning six attack categories (Encoding~11, Structural~8, Semantic~8, Layered~5, Trigger~12, Exfiltration~5; see Table 1), combinable across 5 variants per technique and 6 lifecycle stages, yielding a theoretical maximum of 2,822,400 unique payloads ($49 \times 5 \times 1{,}920 \times 6$; SHA-256 deduplicated at generation time); and (ii) a Persistent Stage Breaker (PSB) that drives payload mutation stage-by-stage: on each breakthrough, the PSB seeds the next stage with a mutated form of the winning payload, mirroring real adversarial escalation. Evaluation on five production LLM platforms across three independent runs demonstrates that LAAF achieves higher stage-breakthrough efficiency than single-technique random testing, with a mean aggregate breakthrough rate of 84\% (range 83--86\%) and platform-level rates stable within 17 percentage points across runs. Layered combinations and semantic reframing are the highest-effectiveness technique categories, with layered payloads outperforming encoding on well-defended platforms.

title: GigaWorld-Policy: An Efficient Action-Centered World--Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAM) initialized from pre-trained video generation backbones have demonstrated remarkable potential for robot policy learning. However, existing approaches face two critical bottlenecks that hinder performance and deployment. First, jointly reasoning over future visual dynamics and corresponding actions incurs substantial inference overhead. Second, joint modeling often entangles visual and motion representations, making motion prediction accuracy heavily dependent on the quality of future video forecasts. To address these issues, we introduce GigaWorld-Policy, an action-centered WAM that learns 2D pixel-action dynamics while enabling efficient action decoding, with optional video generation. Specifically, we formulate policy training into two coupled components: the model predicts future action sequences conditioned on the current observation, and simultaneously generates future videos conditioned on the predicted actions and the same observation. The policy is supervised by both action prediction and video generation, providing richer learning signals and encouraging physically plausible actions through visual-dynamics constraints. With a causal design that prevents future-video tokens from influencing action tokens, explicit future-video generation is optional at inference time, allowing faster action prediction during deployment. To support this paradigm, we curate a diverse, large-scale robot dataset to pre-train an action-centered video generation model, which is then adapted as the backbone for robot policy learning. Experimental results on real-world robotic platforms show that GigaWorld-Policy runs 9x faster than the leading WAM baseline, Motus, while improving task success rates by 7%. Moreover, compared with pi-0.5, GigaWorld-Policy improves performance by 95% on RoboTwin 2.0.

title: Graph-Native Cognitive Memory for AI Agents: Formal Belief Revision Semantics for Versioned Memory Architectures
summary: While individual components for AI agent memory exist in prior systems, their architectural synthesis and formal grounding remain underexplored. We present Kumiho, a graph-native cognitive memory architecture grounded in formal belief revision semantics. The structural primitives required for cognitive memory -- immutable revisions, mutable tag pointers, typed dependency edges, URI-based addressing -- are identical to those required for managing agent-produced work as versionable assets, enabling a unified graph-native architecture that serves both purposes. The central formal contribution is a correspondence between the AGM belief revision framework and the operational semantics of a property graph memory system, proving satisfaction of the basic AGM postulates (K*2--K*6) and Hansson's belief base postulates (Relevance, Core-Retainment). The architecture implements a dual-store model (Redis working memory, Neo4j long-term graph) with hybrid fulltext and vector retrieval. On LoCoMo (token-level F1), Kumiho achieves 0.565 overall F1 (n=1,986) including 97.5% adversarial refusal accuracy. On LoCoMo-Plus, a Level-2 cognitive memory benchmark testing implicit constraint recall, Kumiho achieves 93.3% judge accuracy (n=401); independent reproduction by the benchmark authors yielded results in the mid-80% range, still substantially outperforming all published baselines (best: Gemini 2.5 Pro, 45.7%). Three architectural innovations drive the results: prospective indexing (LLM-generated future-scenario implications indexed at write time), event extraction (structured causal events preserved in summaries), and client-side LLM reranking. The architecture is model-decoupled: switching the answer model from GPT-4o-mini (~88%) to GPT-4o (93.3%) improves end-to-end accuracy without pipeline changes, at a total evaluation cost of ~$14 for 401 entries.

title: On the Cone Effect and Modality Gap in Medical Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit a characteristic "cone effect" in which nonlinear encoders map embeddings into highly concentrated regions of the representation space, contributing to cross-modal separation known as the modality gap. While this phenomenon has been widely observed, its practical impact on supervised multimodal learning -particularly in medical domains- remains unclear. In this work, we introduce a lightweight post-hoc mechanism that keeps pretrained VLM encoders frozen while continuously controlling cross-modal separation through a single hyperparameter {λ}. This enables systematic analysis of how the modality gap affects downstream multimodal performance without expensive retraining. We evaluate generalist (CLIP, SigLIP) and medically specialized (BioMedCLIP, MedSigLIP) models across diverse medical and natural datasets in a supervised multimodal settings. Results consistently show that reducing excessive modality gap improves downstream performance, with medical datasets exhibiting stronger sensitivity to gap modulation; however, fully collapsing the gap is not always optimal, and intermediate, task-dependent separation yields the best results. These findings position the modality gap as a tunable property of multimodal representations rather than a quantity that should be universally minimized.

title: Binary Latent Protein Fitness Landscapes for Quantum Annealing Optimization
summary:
We propose Q-BIOLAT, a framework for modeling and optimizing protein fitness landscapes in binary latent spaces. Starting from protein sequences, we leverage pretrained protein language models to obtain continuous embeddings, which are then transformed into compact binary latent representations. In this space, protein fitness is approximated using a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model, enabling efficient combinatorial search via classical heuristics such as simulated annealing and genetic algorithms.
  On the ProteinGym benchmark, we demonstrate that Q-BIOLAT captures meaningful structure in protein fitness landscapes and enables the identification of high-fitness variants. Despite using a simple binarization scheme, our method consistently retrieves sequences whose nearest neighbors lie within the top fraction of the training fitness distribution, particularly under the strongest configurations. We further show that different optimization strategies exhibit distinct behaviors, with evolutionary search performing better in higher-dimensional latent spaces and local search remaining competitive in preserving realistic sequences.
  Beyond its empirical performance, Q-BIOLAT provides a natural bridge between protein representation learning and combinatorial optimization. By formulating protein fitness as a QUBO problem, our framework is directly compatible with emerging quantum annealing hardware, opening new directions for quantum-assisted protein engineering.
  Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/HySonLab/Q-BIOLAT

title: Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning for Patient-Independent ECG Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing a 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) from a reduced lead set is an ill-posed inverse problem due to anatomical variability. Standard deep learning methods often ignore underlying cardiac pathology losing vital morphology in precordial leads. We propose Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning, a framework that regularizes the latent space through a pathological manifold. Our architecture integrates high-fidelity time-domain waveforms with pathology-aware embeddings learned via supervised contrastive alignment. By maximizing mutual information between latent representations and clinical labels, the framework learns to filter anatomical "nuisance" variables. On the PTB-XL dataset, our method achieves approx. 76\% reduction in RMSE compared to state-of-the-art model in patient-independent setting. Cross-dataset evaluation on the PTB Diagnostic Database confirms superior generalization, bridging the gap between hardware portability and diagnostic-grade reconstruction.

title: Information Pathways in Online Science Communication: The Role of Platform Actors and News Media
comments: 16 pages, 15 figures. Accepted at The 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2026). Please cite accordingly
summary: Online discussions of science involve complex interactions among experts, news media, and social media users as they interpret and disseminate scientific findings. While prior work has examined these actors in isolation, their interplay in shaping science communication remains poorly understood. Using the COVID-19 pandemic as a case study, we analyze 1.24M tweets and 211k news articles that reference pandemic-related scientific papers. We find that the most influential Twitter accounts in this discourse are predominantly individuals with medical or research credentials. However, we also identify a coordinated network that disproportionately amplifies a small set of prominent credentialed experts who advance contrarian, anti-consensus positions on vaccines, lockdowns, and related topics. The papers promoted by these influential actors substantially overlap with those covered by news media, but with key differences: pro-consensus experts primarily engage with studies featured by mainstream and medical outlets, whereas contrarian experts align more closely with papers promoted by low-quality, pseudoscientific, or conspiratorial sources. Notably, news outlets tend to report on scientific studies after they have been highlighted by social media superspreaders. Together, these findings reveal multi-level pathways of information flow and coordinated amplification structures that shape science communication across social media and news, offering new insights into the dynamics of the broader information ecosystem.

title: Variational Rectification Inference for Learning with Noisy Labels
summary: Label noise has been broadly observed in real-world datasets. To mitigate the negative impact of overfitting to label noise for deep models, effective strategies (\textit{e.g.}, re-weighting, or loss rectification) have been broadly applied in prevailing approaches, which have been generally learned under the meta-learning scenario. Despite the robustness of noise achieved by the probabilistic meta-learning models, they usually suffer from model collapse that degenerates generalization performance. In this paper, we propose variational rectification inference (VRI) to formulate the adaptive rectification for loss functions as an amortized variational inference problem and derive the evidence lower bound under the meta-learning framework. Specifically, VRI is constructed as a hierarchical Bayes by treating the rectifying vector as a latent variable, which can rectify the loss of the noisy sample with the extra randomness regularization and is, therefore, more robust to label noise. To achieve the inference of the rectifying vector, we approximate its conditional posterior with an amortization meta-network. By introducing the variational term in VRI, the conditional posterior is estimated accurately and avoids collapsing to a Dirac delta function, which can significantly improve the generalization performance. The elaborated meta-network and prior network adhere to the smoothness assumption, enabling the generation of reliable rectification vectors. Given a set of clean meta-data, VRI can be efficiently meta-learned within the bi-level optimization programming. Besides, theoretical analysis guarantees that the meta-network can be efficiently learned with our algorithm. Comprehensive comparison experiments and analyses validate its effectiveness for robust learning with noisy labels, particularly in the presence of open-set noise.

title: Asymptotically ideal Disjunctive Hierarchical Secret Sharing Scheme with an Explicit Construction
summary: Disjunctive Hierarchical Secret Sharing (DHSS) scheme is a secret sharing scheme in which the set of all participants is partitioned into disjoint subsets. Each disjoint subset is said to be a level, and different levels have different degrees of trust and different thresholds. If the number of cooperating participants from a given level falls to meet its threshold, the shortfall can be compensated by participants from higher levels. Many ideal DHSS schemes have been proposed, but they often suffer from big share sizes. Conversely, existing non-ideal DHSS schemes achieve small share sizes, yet they fail to be both secure and asymptotically ideal simultaneously. In this work, we present an explicit construct of an asymptotically ideal DHSS scheme by using a polynomial, multiple linear homogeneous recurrence relations and one-way functions. Although our scheme has computational security and many public values, it has a small share size and the dealer is required polynomial time.

title: "Not Just Me and My To-Do List": Understanding Challenges of Task Management for Adults with ADHD and the Need for AI-Augmented Social Scaffolds
comments: This preprint is accepted to CSCW2026
summary: Adults with ADHD often face challenges with task management, not due to a lack of willpower, but because of emotional and relational misalignments between cognitive needs and normative infrastructures. Existing productivity tools, designed for neurotypical users, often assume consistent self-regulation and linear time, overlooking these differences. We conducted 22 semi-structured interviews with ADHD-identifying adults, exploring their challenges in task management and their coping mechanisms through socially and emotionally scaffolded strategies. Building on these insights, we conducted a follow-up speed dating study with 20 additional ADHD-identifying adults, focusing on 13 speculative design concepts that leverage AI for task support. Our findings reveal that task management among adults with ADHD is relationally and affectively co-constructed, rather than an isolated individual act. Overall, we provide (1) empirical insights into distributed and emotionally scaffolded task management practices, (2) design implications for socially-aware AI systems that support co-regulation and nonlinear attention rhythms, and (3)an analysis of user preferences for different AI design concepts, clarifying which features were most valued and why.

AI.title_translation: “不仅仅是我和我的待办事项清单”：理解ADHD成年人任务管理的挑战以及对AI增强型社交支架的需求
AI.tldr: ADHD成年人任务管理面临挑战，现有工具不适用。研究通过访谈和概念验证发现，任务管理是关系性和情感性共同构建的。论文提出了社交感知AI系统设计，以支持ADHD患者的任务管理。
AI.motivation: 患有ADHD的成年人在任务管理方面经常面临挑战，这并非由于缺乏意志力，而是因为认知需求与规范性基础设施之间存在情感和关系上的不匹配。现有为神经典型用户设计的生产力工具，假设用户具有一致的自我调节能力和线性时间观念，忽视了这些差异。
AI.method: 研究首先对22名ADHD成年人进行了半结构化访谈，探讨他们在任务管理中的挑战以及通过社交和情感支架策略应对机制。在此基础上，研究随后对20名额外的ADHD成年人进行了一项“快速约会”后续研究，重点关注13个利用AI进行任务支持的推测性设计概念。
AI.result: 研究发现，ADHD成年人的任务管理是关系性和情感性共同构建的，而非孤立的个体行为。研究提供了(1)关于分布式和情感支架任务管理实践的实证见解；(2)针对支持共同调节和非线性注意力节律的社交感知AI系统的设计启示；(3)对不同AI设计概念的用户偏好分析，阐明了哪些功能最有价值以及原因。
AI.conclusion: ADHD成年人的任务管理是多维度的，需要超越传统个体化工具的解决方案。AI增强的社交支架具有巨大潜力，可以支持ADHD患者的共同调节和非线性注意力节律，从而提供更有效、更具包容性的任务管理策略。

title: AppFlow: Memory Scheduling for Cold Launch of Large Apps on Mobile and Vehicle Systems
summary: GB-scale large apps like on-device LLMs and rich media editors are becoming the next-generation trend, but their heavy memory and I/O demands, especially during multitasking, cause devices to reclaim or kill processes, turning warm apps into cold launches. The challenge lies not in storing them, but in fast, accurate launching. For users, 1s is the usability cliff, yet our measurements show 86.6\% of GB-scale cold launches exceed it. Also, Android Vitals flags only $\geq$ 5s as slow, exposing a large satisfaction gap. Existing optimizations are designed in isolation and conflict. For example, preloading reduces I/O stalls but consumes scarce memory and is undone by reclamation, while reclamation and killing free memory but sacrifice background survivability, leading to repeated cold relaunches. Our key insight is that, although multitasking makes runtime behavior complex, each app's file access pattern remains predictable. The challenge lies in exploiting this predictability, i.e., preloading without exhausting memory, reclaiming without undoing gains, and killing selectively to preserve background survivability. We introduce AppFlow, a prediction-based system-wide scheduler that integrates a Selective File Preloader, an Adaptive Memory Reclaimer, and a Context-Aware Process Killer. Implemented across the Android framework and Linux kernel without app changes, AppFlow cuts GB-scale cold-launch latency by 66.5\% (e.g., 2s$\rightarrow$690ms) and sustains 95\% of launches within 1s over a 100-day test, significantly improving responsiveness and multitasking experience.

AI.title_translation: AppFlow：移动和车载系统中大型应用冷启动的内存调度
AI.tldr: AppFlow是一个系统级调度器，通过预测文件访问模式，优化内存预加载、回收和进程终止，将GB级大型应用冷启动延迟降低66.5%，并使95%的启动在1秒内完成。
AI.motivation: GB级大型应用（如设备端LLM和富媒体编辑器）的内存和I/O需求高，尤其在多任务处理时，导致设备回收或终止进程，使热应用变为冷启动。现有优化方案孤立且冲突，导致86.6%的GB级冷启动超过1秒的用户可用性阈值，而Android Vitals仅将≥5秒标记为慢，存在巨大用户满意度差距。
AI.method: AppFlow是一个基于预测的系统级调度器，集成了选择性文件预加载器、自适应内存回收器和上下文感知进程终止器。它利用应用文件访问模式的可预测性，在不耗尽内存的情况下进行预加载，在不撤销收益的情况下进行回收，并选择性终止进程以保持后台生存能力。该系统在Android框架和Linux内核中实现，无需修改应用。
AI.result: AppFlow将GB级冷启动延迟降低了66.5%（例如，从2秒降至690毫秒），并在100天测试中使95%的启动在1秒内完成，显著提高了响应速度和多任务处理体验。
AI.conclusion: AppFlow通过智能调度和预测，有效解决了大型应用冷启动延迟问题，显著提升了移动和车载系统的用户体验和多任务处理能力。

AI.keywords: 内存调度, 冷启动, 大型应用, 移动系统, AppFlow, 预测调度

title: Deanonymizing Bitcoin Transactions via Network Traffic Analysis with Semi-supervised Learning
summary:
Privacy protection mechanisms are a fundamental aspect of security in cryptocurrency systems, particularly in decentralized networks such as Bitcoin. Although Bitcoin addresses are not directly associated with real-world identities, this does not fully guarantee user privacy. Various deanonymization solutions have been proposed, with network layer deanonymization attacks being especially prominent. However, existing approaches often exhibit limitations such as low precision.
  In this paper, we propose \textit{NTSSL}, a novel and efficient transaction deanonymization method that integrates network traffic analysis with semi-supervised learning. We use unsupervised learning algorithms to generate pseudo-labels to achieve comparable performance with lower costs. Then, we introduce \textit{NTSSL+}, a cross-layer collaborative analysis integrating transaction clustering results to further improve accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate a substantial performance improvement, 1.6 times better than the existing approach using machining learning.

AI.title_translation: 通过网络流量分析和半监督学习对比特币交易进行去匿名化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为NTSSL的新型高效比特币交易去匿名化方法，结合网络流量分析和半监督学习，并通过NTSSL+进一步整合交易聚类结果以提高准确性，实验结果显示性能比现有方法提升1.6倍。
AI.motivation: 尽管比特币地址不直接关联真实身份，但用户隐私并未完全保障。现有的网络层去匿名化攻击方法存在精度低等局限性，因此需要一种更高效的交易去匿名化方法。
AI.method: 本文提出了NTSSL，一种结合网络流量分析和半监督学习的新型高效交易去匿名化方法。NTSSL利用无监督学习算法生成伪标签，以较低成本实现可比性能。此外，还引入了NTSSL+，通过整合交易聚类结果进行跨层协同分析，进一步提高准确性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，NTSSL和NTSSL+取得了显著的性能提升，比现有的机器学习方法提高了1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的NTSSL和NTSSL+方法有效提高了比特币交易的去匿名化精度，显著优于现有基于机器学习的方法。
AI.translation:
加密货币系统，尤其是比特币等去中心化网络中，隐私保护机制是安全的基本方面。尽管比特币地址不直接与现实世界的身份相关联，但这并不能完全保证用户隐私。各种去匿名化解决方案已被提出，其中网络层去匿名化攻击尤为突出。然而，现有方法通常表现出精度低等局限性。
在本文中，我们提出了NTSSL，一种结合网络流量分析和半监督学习的新型高效交易去匿名化方法。我们使用无监督学习算法生成伪标签，以较低成本实现可比性能。然后，我们引入了NTSSL+，一种整合交易聚类结果的跨层协同分析方法，以进一步提高准确性。实验结果表明，性能比现有机器学习方法提高了1.6倍。
AI.summary: 本文针对比特币隐私保护不足和现有去匿名化方法精度低的问题，提出了一种名为NTSSL的新型交易去匿名化方法。NTSSL结合网络流量分析与半监督学习，利用无监督学习生成伪标签以优化成本性能。在此基础上，NTSSL+通过整合交易聚类结果进行跨层协同分析，进一步提升了准确性。实验证明，该方法比现有机器学习方法性能提升1.6倍。
AI.keywords: 比特币, 去匿名化, 网络流量分析, 半监督学习, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种结合网络流量分析和半监督学习的创新方法来解决比特币交易的去匿名化问题，特别之处在于利用无监督学习生成伪标签以降低成本并保持性能。此外，NTSSL+的跨层协同分析进一步提升了准确性，这对于提升去匿名化攻击的有效性具有重要意义。其主要贡献在于提高了去匿名化攻击的精确度，为比特币隐私研究提供了新的视角。

title: LED: A Benchmark for Evaluating Layout Error Detection in Document Analysis
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have improved Document Layout Analysis (DLA), yet structural errors such as region merging, splitting, and omission remain persistent. Conventional overlap-based metrics (e.g., IoU, mAP) fail to capture such logical inconsistencies. To overcome this limitation, we propose Layout Error Detection (LED), a benchmark that evaluates structural reasoning in DLA predictions beyond surface-level accuracy. LED defines eight standardized error types (Missing, Hallucination, Size Error, Split, Merge, Overlap, Duplicate, and Misclassification) and provides quantitative rules and injection algorithms for realistic error simulation. Using these definitions, we construct LED-Dataset and design three evaluation tasks: document-level error detection, document-level error-type classification, and element-level error-type classification. Experiments with state-of-the-art multimodal models show that LED enables fine-grained and interpretable assessment of structural understanding, revealing clear weaknesses across modalities and architectures. Overall, LED establishes a unified and explainable benchmark for diagnosing the structural robustness and reasoning capability of document understanding models.

AI.title_translation: LED：文档分析中布局错误检测的评估基准
AI.tldr: 现有文档布局分析（DLA）模型在结构错误检测方面存在局限。本文提出了LED基准，定义了八种错误类型，并构建了数据集和评估任务，以诊断文档理解模型的结构鲁棒性和推理能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）和大型多模态模型（LMMs）改进了文档布局分析（DLA），但区域合并、拆分和遗漏等结构性错误依然存在。传统的基于重叠的度量（如IoU, mAP）未能捕捉此类逻辑不一致性。
AI.method: 提出了Layout Error Detection (LED) 基准，用于评估DLA预测中超越表面准确性的结构推理能力。LED定义了八种标准错误类型（缺失、幻觉、尺寸错误、拆分、合并、重叠、重复和误分类），并提供了量化规则和注入算法进行实际错误模拟。基于这些定义，构建了LED-Dataset并设计了三个评估任务：文档级错误检测、文档级错误类型分类和元素级错误类型分类。
AI.result: 对最先进的多模态模型进行的实验表明，LED能够对结构理解进行细粒度和可解释的评估，揭示了不同模态和架构的明显弱点。
AI.conclusion: LED为诊断文档理解模型的结构鲁棒性和推理能力建立了一个统一且可解释的基准。
AI.translation: 近期大型语言模型（LLMs）和大型多模态模型（LMMs）的进展改进了文档布局分析（DLA），但区域合并、拆分和遗漏等结构性错误依然存在。传统的基于重叠的度量（例如IoU、mAP）未能捕捉到此类逻辑不一致性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了布局错误检测（LED），一个用于评估DLA预测中超越表面准确性的结构推理能力的基准。LED定义了八种标准错误类型（缺失、幻觉、尺寸错误、拆分、合并、重叠、重复和误分类），并为实际错误模拟提供了量化规则和注入算法。利用这些定义，我们构建了LED数据集并设计了三个评估任务：文档级错误检测、文档级错误类型分类和元素级错误类型分类。对最先进的多模态模型进行的实验表明，LED能够对结构理解进行细粒度和可解释的评估，揭示了不同模态和架构的明显弱点。总的来说，LED为诊断文档理解模型的结构鲁棒性和推理能力建立了一个统一且可解释的基准。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有文档布局分析（DLA）模型在结构性错误检测方面的不足，提出了一个名为Layout Error Detection (LED) 的新基准。LED通过定义八种标准错误类型、提供错误注入算法和构建LED-Dataset，旨在超越传统的表面精度指标，评估DLA模型在结构推理方面的能力。实验证明LED能提供细粒度、可解释的评估，揭示了当前多模态模型的弱点，并为诊断模型结构鲁棒性提供了统一框架。
AI.keywords: 文档布局分析, 结构错误检测, 评估基准, 大型语言模型, 多模态模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入LED基准，填补了现有DLA评估方法在结构性错误检测方面的空白。它提出的标准化错误类型和错误注入机制对于推动文档理解领域的发展具有重要意义，尤其是在需要高精度结构化信息提取的场景中。其创新性在于从逻辑一致性而非单纯的几何重叠角度评估模型性能，有助于更深入地理解模型能力和局限。

title: Revisiting Vulnerability Patch Identification on Data in the Wild
summary: Attacks can exploit zero-day or one-day vulnerabilities that are not publicly disclosed. To detect these vulnerabilities, security researchers monitor development activities in open-source repositories to identify unreported security patches. The sheer volume of commits makes this task infeasible to accomplish manually. Consequently, security patch detectors commonly trained and evaluated on security patches linked from vulnerability reports in the National Vulnerability Database (NVD). In this study, we assess the effectiveness of these detectors when applied in-the-wild. Our results show that models trained on NVD-derived data show substantially decreased performance, with decreases in F1-score of up to 90\% when tested on in-the-wild security patches, rendering them impractical for real-world use. An analysis comparing security patches identified in-the-wild and commits linked from NVD reveals that they can be easily distinguished from each other. Security patches associated with NVD have different distribution of commit messages, vulnerability types, and composition of changes. These differences suggest that NVD may be unsuitable as the \textit{sole} source of data for training models to detect security patches. We find that constructing a dataset that combines security patches from NVD data with a small subset of manually identified security patches can improve model robustness.

AI.title_translation: 重新审视野外数据中的漏洞补丁识别
AI.tldr: 现有的漏洞补丁检测器在NVD数据上训练，但在实际应用中表现极差（F1分数下降90%）。研究发现NVD数据与野外补丁存在显著差异，NVD不应作为唯一训练数据源。结合NVD和少量手动识别的补丁可以提高模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 为了检测零日或一日漏洞，安全研究人员需要识别未报告的安全补丁。然而，手动完成这项任务因提交量巨大而不可行。当前安全补丁检测器主要在NVD数据上训练，但其在实际环境中的有效性尚不明确，因此需要评估并改进这些检测器在野外数据上的性能。
AI.method: 本研究评估了在国家漏洞数据库（NVD）中链接的漏洞报告数据上训练的安全补丁检测器在实际应用（in-the-wild）中的有效性。通过比较野外识别的安全补丁与NVD中链接的提交，分析了它们之间的差异。最后，提出并验证了将NVD数据与少量手动识别的安全补丁结合构建数据集以提高模型鲁棒性的方法。
AI.result: 在野外安全补丁上进行测试时，在NVD派生数据上训练的模型性能大幅下降，F1分数下降高达90%，使其不适用于实际使用。分析发现，野外识别的安全补丁与NVD中链接的提交之间存在明显差异，主要体现在提交信息、漏洞类型和变更构成上。将NVD数据与少量手动识别的安全补丁相结合构建数据集可以提高模型的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: NVD可能不适合作为训练安全补丁检测模型的唯一数据来源。为了提高模型的实际可用性，需要构建结合NVD数据和少量手动识别安全补丁的混合数据集，以增强模型的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 攻击可以利用未公开披露的零日或一日漏洞。为了检测这些漏洞，安全研究人员会监控开源存储库的开发活动，以识别未报告的安全补丁。然而，巨大的提交量使得手动完成这项任务不可行。因此，安全补丁检测器通常在国家漏洞数据库（NVD）中链接的漏洞报告所关联的安全补丁上进行训练和评估。在本研究中，我们评估了这些检测器在实际应用（in-the-wild）中的有效性。我们的结果表明，在NVD派生数据上训练的模型在野外安全补丁上进行测试时，性能大幅下降，F1分数下降高达90%，使其不适用于实际使用。对野外识别的安全补丁与NVD中链接的提交进行比较分析后发现，它们之间可以很容易区分开来。与NVD相关的安全补丁在提交信息、漏洞类型和变更构成上具有不同的分布。这些差异表明，NVD可能不适合作为训练模型检测安全补丁的唯一数据来源。我们发现，构建一个结合NVD数据和少量手动识别安全补丁的数据集可以提高模型的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究重新评估了在实际环境中识别漏洞补丁的挑战。现有的安全补丁检测器通常在NVD数据上训练，但研究发现这些模型在野外数据上的表现极差，F1分数可下降90%，不具备实际应用价值。通过对比分析，揭示了NVD链接的补丁与野外补丁在提交信息、漏洞类型和变更构成上存在显著差异，表明NVD不应作为唯一的训练数据源。研究提出并验证了通过结合NVD数据和少量手动识别的安全补丁来构建数据集，能够有效提高模型的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 漏洞补丁识别, NVD, 野外数据, 检测器性能, 数据集构建
AI.comments: 本文揭示了当前漏洞补丁检测模型在实际应用中的严重局限性，其创新点在于通过实证分析指出了NVD数据作为唯一训练源的不足，并明确了NVD数据与实际野外补丁之间的关键差异。这一发现对于未来构建更有效、更鲁棒的漏洞检测系统具有重要指导意义，强调了数据多样性和代表性的重要性。

title: ConfusionBench: An Expert-Validated Benchmark for Confusion Recognition and Localization in Educational Videos
summary: Recognizing and localizing student confusion from video is an important yet challenging problem in educational AI. Existing confusion datasets suffer from noisy labels, coarse temporal annotations, and limited expert validation, which hinder reliable fine-grained recognition and temporally grounded analysis. To address these limitations, we propose a practical multi-stage filtering pipeline that integrates two stages of model-assisted screening, researcher curation, and expert validation to build a higher-quality benchmark for confusion understanding. Based on this pipeline, we introduce ConfusionBench, a new benchmark for educational videos consisting of a balanced confusion recognition dataset and a video localization dataset. We further provide zero-shot baseline evaluations of a representative open-source model and a proprietary model on clip-level confusion recognition, long-video confusion localization tasks. Experimental results show that the proprietary model performs better overall but tends to over-predict transitional segments, while the open-source model is more conservative and more prone to missed detections. In addition, the proposed student confusion report visualization can support educational experts in making intervention decisions and adapting learning plans accordingly. All datasets and related materials will be made publicly available on our project page.

AI.title_translation: ConfusionBench：一个用于教育视频中困惑识别和定位的专家验证基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了ConfusionBench，一个通过多阶段过滤管道构建的、用于教育视频中学生困惑识别和定位的高质量基准数据集，并评估了两种模型的性能，旨在支持教育专家进行干预决策。
AI.motivation: 现有困惑数据集存在标签噪声、时间标注粗糙和专家验证有限等问题，阻碍了可靠的细粒度识别和时间定位分析。识别和定位教育视频中的学生困惑是一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个实用的多阶段过滤管道，该管道整合了两个阶段的模型辅助筛选、研究人员整理和专家验证，以构建更高质量的困惑理解基准。基于此管道，本文引入了ConfusionBench，一个包含平衡困惑识别数据集和视频定位数据集的新基准。此外，还提供了代表性开源模型和专有模型在剪辑级困惑识别和长视频困惑定位任务上的零样本基线评估。
AI.result: 专有模型总体表现更好，但倾向于过度预测过渡片段；开源模型更为保守，更容易出现漏检。提出的学生困惑报告可视化可以支持教育专家做出干预决策并相应调整学习计划。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了一个高质量的困惑识别和定位基准ConfusionBench，并通过实验评估了模型的性能，展示了其在支持教育专家决策方面的潜力。
AI.translation: 从视频中识别和定位学生的困惑是教育AI中一个重要但具有挑战性的问题。现有的困惑数据集存在标签噪声、粗糙的时间标注以及有限的专家验证等问题，这些都阻碍了可靠的细粒度识别和基于时间的分析。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种实用的多阶段过滤管道，该管道整合了两个阶段的模型辅助筛选、研究人员整理和专家验证，以构建一个更高质量的困惑理解基准。基于此管道，我们引入了ConfusionBench，一个用于教育视频的新基准，它包含一个平衡的困惑识别数据集和一个视频定位数据集。我们进一步提供了代表性开源模型和专有模型在剪辑级困惑识别、长视频困惑定位任务上的零样本基线评估。实验结果表明，专有模型总体表现更好，但倾向于过度预测过渡片段，而开源模型更为保守，更容易出现漏检。此外，所提出的学生困惑报告可视化可以支持教育专家做出干预决策并相应调整学习计划。所有数据集和相关材料将在我们的项目页面上公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文针对教育视频中学生困惑识别与定位现有数据集的局限性，提出了一种多阶段过滤管道，并基于此构建了专家验证的高质量基准数据集ConfusionBench。该基准包含平衡的困惑识别数据集和视频定位数据集。研究对开源模型和专有模型进行了零样本基线评估，发现专有模型性能更优但易过预测，开源模型保守易漏检。此外，提出的困惑报告可视化可辅助教育专家进行干预决策。
AI.keywords: 学生困惑识别, 教育视频, 困惑定位, 基准数据集, ConfusionBench
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个严格的多阶段过滤管道，结合了模型辅助筛选、人工整理和专家验证，从而构建了一个高质量、细粒度且经过专家验证的困惑识别与定位基准ConfusionBench。这对于推动教育AI领域在理解学生学习状态方面具有重要意义。其提供的可视化报告也能直接支持教育专家的实际应用。

title: Allocating Chores with Restricted Additive Costs: Achieving EFX, MMS, and Efficiency Simultaneously
summary: In a web-based review platform, papers from various research fields must be assigned to a group of reviewers. Each paper has an inherent cost, which represents the effort required for reading and evaluating it (e.g., the paper's length). Reviewers can bid on papers they are interested in, and if they are assigned a paper they have bid on, no cost is incurred. Otherwise, the inherent cost $c(e)$ for paper $e$ applies. We capture this with a model of restricted additive costs: every item $e$ has a cost $c(e)$, and each agent either incurs $0$ or $c(e)$ for $e$. In this work, we study how to allocate such chores fairly and efficiently. We propose an algorithm for computing allocations that are both EFX and MMS. Furthermore, we show that our algorithm achieves a $2$-approximation of the optimal social cost, and the approximation ratio is optimal. We also show that slightly weaker fairness guarantees can be obtained if one requires the algorithm to run in polynomial time.

AI.title_translation: 具有受限加性成本的家务分配：同时实现EFX、MMS和效率
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种算法，用于在具有受限加性成本模型中公平高效地分配任务，同时实现EFX和MMS，并达到最优的社会成本近似比。
AI.motivation: 在基于网络的评审平台中，论文需要分配给审稿人，论文有固有成本。审稿人对感兴趣的论文竞标则无成本，否则承担固有成本。研究旨在公平高效地分配这些任务。
AI.method: 提出了一种算法，用于计算同时满足EFX（无羡慕）和MMS（最大最小公平）的分配。
AI.result: 该算法实现了最优社会成本的2-近似，且此近似比是最优的。如果要求算法在多项式时间内运行，则可以获得稍弱的公平性保证。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一种在受限加性成本模型下同时实现EFX、MMS和高效率的分配算法，并证明了其性能和近似比的最优性。
AI.translation: 在一个基于网络的评审平台中，来自不同研究领域的论文必须分配给一组审稿人。每篇论文都有一个固有的成本，代表阅读和评估它所需的精力（例如，论文的长度）。审稿人可以对他们感兴趣的论文进行竞标，如果他们被分配到他们竞标的论文，则不产生任何成本。否则，论文 $e$ 的固有成本 $c(e)$ 适用。我们用受限加性成本模型来捕捉这一点：每个项目 $e$ 都有一个成本 $c(e)$，每个代理对 $e$ 要么产生 $0$ 成本，要么产生 $c(e)$ 成本。在这项工作中，我们研究如何公平有效地分配这些任务。我们提出了一种算法，用于计算同时满足EFX（无羡慕）和MMS（最大最小公平）的分配。此外，我们证明了我们的算法实现了最优社会成本的2-近似，并且该近似比是最优的。我们还表明，如果要求算法在多项式时间内运行，可以获得稍弱的公平性保证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在受限加性成本模型下如何公平高效地分配任务，其中任务具有固有成本，而代理对感兴趣的任务不产生成本。作者提出了一种算法，能够同时实现EFX（无羡慕）和MMS（最大最小公平）的分配，并证明该算法在社会成本方面达到了最优的2-近似比。研究还指出，在多项式时间约束下，可以获得稍弱的公平性保证。
AI.keywords: 公平分配, 受限加性成本, EFX, MMS, 社会成本近似
AI.comments: 该研究在公平分配领域具有重要意义，特别是在审稿分配等实际应用中。它创新性地提出了一个算法，在受限加性成本模型下同时解决了公平性（EFX, MMS）和效率（社会成本近似）问题，并给出了理论上的性能保证。其对最优近似比的证明是其亮点之一。

title: Network- and Device-Level Cyber Deception for Contested Environments Using RL and LLMs
summary: Cyber deception assists in increasing the attacker's budget in reconnaissance or any early phases of threat intrusions. In the past, numerous methods of cyber deception have been adopted, such as IP address randomization, the creation of honeypots and honeynets mimicking an actual set of services, and networks deployed within an enterprise or operational technology(OT) network. These types of strategies follow naive approaches of recreating services that are expensive and that need a lot of human intervention. The advent of cloud services and other automations of containerized applications, such as Kubernetes, makes cyber defense easier. Yet, there remains a lot of potential to improve the accuracy of these deception strategies and to make them cost-effective using artificial intelligence (AI)-based solutions by making the deception more dynamic. Hence, in this work, we review various AI-based solutions in building network- and device-level cyber deception methods in contested environments. Specifically, we focus on leveraging the fusion of large language models (LLMs) and reinforcement learning(RL) in optimally learning these cyber deception strategies and validating the efficacy of such strategies in some stealthy attacks against OT systems in the literature.

AI.title_translation: 使用强化学习和大型语言模型在竞争环境中进行网络和设备层面的网络欺骗
AI.tldr: 本文回顾了在竞争环境中利用AI（特别是强化学习和大型语言模型）实现网络和设备层面动态网络欺骗的各种解决方案，旨在提高欺骗策略的准确性和成本效益。
AI.motivation: 传统的网络欺骗方法（如IP地址随机化、蜜罐）成本高昂且需要大量人工干预，效率低下。尽管云计算等自动化技术使网络防御更容易，但仍有巨大潜力通过AI（特别是动态欺骗）来提高欺骗策略的准确性和成本效益。
AI.method: 本文回顾了在竞争环境中构建网络和设备层面网络欺骗方法的各种基于AI的解决方案。具体而言，重点是利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和强化学习（RL）的融合来优化学习这些网络欺骗策略，并讨论了此类策略在文献中针对OT系统隐蔽攻击的有效性验证。
AI.translation: 网络欺骗有助于增加攻击者在侦察或威胁入侵早期阶段的预算。过去，已经采用了许多网络欺骗方法，例如IP地址随机化、创建模仿实际服务集的蜜罐和蜜网，以及部署在企业或操作技术（OT）网络中的网络。这些类型的策略遵循重建服务的幼稚方法，这些方法成本高昂且需要大量人工干预。云计算服务和容器化应用程序（如Kubernetes）的其他自动化的出现使网络防御变得更容易。然而，仍有很大潜力通过使用基于人工智能（AI）的解决方案，使欺骗更具动态性，从而提高这些欺骗策略的准确性并使其具有成本效益。因此，在这项工作中，我们回顾了在竞争环境中构建网络和设备层面网络欺骗方法的各种基于AI的解决方案。具体而言，我们专注于利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和强化学习（RL）的融合来优化学习这些网络欺骗策略，并验证此类策略在文献中针对OT系统的一些隐蔽攻击中的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用人工智能，特别是大型语言模型（LLMs）和强化学习（RL）的结合，来改进网络和设备层面的网络欺骗策略。针对传统欺骗方法成本高、需人工干预的缺点，本研究回顾了AI驱动的动态欺骗解决方案，旨在提高欺骗策略的准确性和成本效益，并探讨其在对抗OT系统隐蔽攻击中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 网络欺骗, 大型语言模型, 强化学习, 操作技术, 网络安全
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其关注将大型语言模型（LLMs）和强化学习（RL）融合应用于网络欺骗领域，这代表了网络安全防御策略向更动态、更智能方向发展的趋势。这种结合有望解决传统欺骗方法在成本和效率上的不足，特别是在复杂且竞争激烈的网络环境中。然而，由于它是一篇综述性论文，其主要贡献在于理论整合和方向指引，而非提出新的具体技术或实验结果。未来的研究需要进一步验证这种融合在实际部署中的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: DANCE: Dynamic 3D CNN Pruning: Joint Frame, Channel, and Feature Adaptation for Energy Efficiency on the Edge
summary: Modern convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are workhorses for video and image processing, but fail to adapt to the computational complexity of input samples in a dynamic manner to minimize energy consumption. In this research, we propose DANCE, a fine-grained, input-aware, dynamic pruning framework for 3D CNNs to maximize power efficiency with negligible to zero impact on performance. In the proposed two-step approach, the first step is called activation variability amplification (AVA), and the 3D CNN model is retrained to increase the variance of the magnitude of neuron activations across the network in this step, facilitating pruning decisions across diverse CNN input scenarios. In the second step, called adaptive activation pruning (AAP), a lightweight activation controller network is trained to dynamically prune frames, channels, and features of 3D convolutional layers of the network (different for each layer), based on statistics of the outputs of the first layer of the network. Our method achieves substantial savings in multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations and memory accesses by introducing sparsity within convolutional layers. Hardware validation on the NVIDIA Jetson Nano GPU and the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 platform demonstrates respective speedups of 1.37X and 2.22X, achieving up to 1.47X higher energy efficiency compared to the state of the art.

AI.title_translation: DANCE: 动态3D CNN剪枝：联合帧、通道和特征自适应以实现边缘能效
AI.tldr: DANCE是一个动态剪枝框架，用于3D CNN，通过联合帧、通道和特征自适应，在边缘设备上显著提高能效，同时保持性能。
AI.motivation: 现代卷积神经网络（CNNs）在视频和图像处理中表现出色，但无法动态适应输入样本的计算复杂性以最小化能耗。
AI.method: 提出DANCE框架，该框架是一个细粒度、输入感知的动态剪枝框架，包含两步：第一步是激活变异性放大（AVA），通过重新训练3D CNN模型来增加网络中神经元激活幅度的方差，以促进在不同CNN输入场景下的剪枝决策。第二步是自适应激活剪枝（AAP），训练一个轻量级激活控制器网络，根据网络第一层输出的统计数据，动态剪枝3D卷积层的帧、通道和特征。该方法通过在卷积层内引入稀疏性来节省乘加（MAC）操作和内存访问。
AI.result: 该方法显著节省了乘加（MAC）操作和内存访问。在NVIDIA Jetson Nano GPU上实现了1.37倍的加速，在高通骁龙8 Gen 1平台上实现了2.22倍的加速。与现有技术相比，能效提高了高达1.47倍。
AI.conclusion: DANCE框架通过动态剪枝实现了3D CNN在边缘设备上的显著能效提升，且对性能影响可忽略不计。
AI.translation: 现代卷积神经网络（CNN）是视频和图像处理的主力，但无法动态适应输入样本的计算复杂性以最小化能耗。在这项研究中，我们提出了DANCE，一个用于3D CNN的细粒度、输入感知、动态剪枝框架，旨在以可忽略不计甚至零性能影响来最大化功耗效率。在所提出的两步方法中，第一步称为激活变异性放大（AVA），在此步骤中重新训练3D CNN模型以增加网络中神经元激活幅度的方差，从而促进在不同CNN输入场景下的剪枝决策。第二步称为自适应激活剪枝（AAP），训练一个轻量级激活控制器网络，根据网络第一层输出的统计数据，动态剪枝网络3D卷积层的帧、通道和特征（每个层不同）。我们的方法通过在卷积层内引入稀疏性，显著节省了乘加（MAC）操作和内存访问。在NVIDIA Jetson Nano GPU和高通骁龙8 Gen 1平台上的硬件验证表明，分别实现了1.37倍和2.22倍的加速，与现有技术相比，能效提高了高达1.47倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DANCE，一个针对3D CNN的动态剪枝框架，旨在解决现代CNN在边缘设备上能耗高且无法动态适应输入样本计算复杂性的问题。DANCE通过两步实现：首先是激活变异性放大（AVA），通过重训练增加神经元激活方差；其次是自适应激活剪枝（AAP），利用轻量级控制器网络动态剪枝帧、通道和特征。该方法显著减少了MAC操作和内存访问，并在硬件验证中展示了高达2.22倍的加速和1.47倍的能效提升，对性能影响微乎其微。
AI.keywords: 3D CNN, 动态剪枝, 能效, 边缘计算, 自适应
AI.comments: DANCE框架通过引入输入感知的动态剪枝机制，特别是在3D CNNs的帧、通道和特征维度上进行自适应调整，为边缘设备上的高效深度学习推理提供了创新解决方案。其两步法（AVA和AAP）设计巧妙，在不牺牲性能的前提下显著提升了能效，对于资源受限的边缘计算场景具有重要意义。

title: Classifier Pooling for Modern Ordinal Classification
summary: Ordinal data is widely prevalent in clinical and other domains, yet there is a lack of both modern, machine-learning based methods and publicly available software to address it. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic method of ordinal classification, which can apply any non-ordinal classification method in an ordinal fashion. We also provide an open-source implementation of these algorithms, in the form of a Python package. We apply these models on multiple real-world datasets to show their performance across domains. We show that they often outperform non-ordinal classification methods, especially when the number of datapoints is relatively small or when there are many classes of outcomes. This work, including the developed software, facilitates the use of modern, more powerful machine learning algorithms to handle ordinal data.

AI.title_translation: 用于现代有序分类的分类器池化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模型不可知论的有序分类方法，可以将任何非有序分类方法应用于有序数据，并提供开源实现。实验表明，该方法在小数据集或多类别结果时，通常优于非有序分类方法。
AI.motivation: 临床及其他领域中，有序数据普遍存在，但缺乏现代机器学习方法和公开可用的软件来处理。
AI.method: 提出了一种模型不可知论的有序分类方法，可以将任何非有序分类方法以有序方式应用。同时提供了这些算法的开源实现，以Python包的形式。
AI.result: 这些模型在多个真实世界数据集上表现良好，通常优于非有序分类方法，尤其是在数据点数量相对较少或结果类别较多时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作及其开发的软件促进了使用更强大的现代机器学习算法处理有序数据。
AI.translation: 有序数据在临床及其他领域中广泛存在，然而目前缺乏现代的、基于机器学习的方法以及公开可用的软件来处理它。在本文中，我们提出了一种模型不可知论的有序分类方法，该方法可以将任何非有序分类方法以有序方式应用。我们还以Python包的形式提供了这些算法的开源实现。我们将这些模型应用于多个真实世界数据集，以展示它们在不同领域的性能。我们表明，它们通常优于非有序分类方法，尤其是在数据点数量相对较少或结果类别较多时。这项工作，包括开发的软件，促进了使用现代、更强大的机器学习算法来处理有序数据。
AI.summary: 本文针对有序数据处理中缺乏现代机器学习方法和开源软件的问题，提出了一种模型不可知论的分类器池化方法，可以将现有非有序分类器应用于有序任务。研究提供了Python开源实现，并在多个真实数据集上验证了其性能，尤其是在数据量小或类别多时，该方法表现优于传统非有序分类器，从而推动了现代机器学习算法在有序数据分析中的应用。
AI.keywords: 有序分类, 分类器池化, 机器学习, 模型不可知论, Python包
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种模型不可知论的有序分类方法，使得任何非有序分类器都能应用于有序数据，极大地提升了处理有序数据的灵活性和可用性。开源软件的提供也降低了研究人员和实践者的使用门槛，具有较高的实用价值。特别指出在小数据集和多类别场景下的优越性，突出了其在特定挑战性问题上的潜力。

title: The 1/W Law: An Analytical Study of Context-Length Routing Topology and GPU Generation Gains for LLM Inference Energy Efficiency
summary:
How many tokens can a GPU inference cluster deliver per watt? Across deployments of identical hardware, the answer varies by 40x -- not because of software inefficiency, but because of the serving context window. We derive the 1/W law: tokens per watt halves every time the context window doubles. A larger context window shrinks the KV-cache concurrency limit while leaving GPU power draw roughly unchanged. At 64K context, an H100 holds 16 sequences in flight (tok/W = 1.5); at 4K context, the same H100 holds 256 sequences (tok/W = 17.6).
  Routing topology -- which determines the effective context window each GPU services -- is a more powerful energy lever than buying newer hardware. Working from published H100 power measurements, a calibrated logistic power model, and a roofline throughput model, we derive these results analytically using the inference-fleet-sim framework; no new hardware experiments were conducted. Two-pool context-length routing (FleetOpt) delivers roughly 2.5x better tok/W over a homogeneous fleet, while upgrading from H100 to B200 delivers roughly 1.7x. The gains are independent: combining FleetOpt with B200 yields 4.25x over the H100 homogeneous baseline. B200/H200 numbers are analytical projections (+-20% uncertainty); H100 results are calibrated to published measurements.
  For MoE models, active-parameter weight streaming adds a third lever. Qwen3-235B-A22B (22B active) reaches roughly 37.8 tok/W at 8K context on H100 -- 5.1x better than Llama-3.1-70B -- because decode time scales with activated weights, not total parameters. MoE dispatch overhead is excluded, so this is an upper bound.

AI.title_translation: 1/W 定律：上下文长度路由拓扑和 GPU 代际增益对 LLM 推理能效的分析研究
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了1/W定律，表明LLM推理的每瓦特令牌数随上下文窗口的增大而减半。它强调路由拓扑比硬件升级更能提高能效，并指出MoE模型通过活跃参数权重流式传输可进一步提升能效。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是理解和优化LLM推理集群的能效，特别是为什么在相同硬件上，每瓦特令牌数会有40倍的差异，并找出提高能效的关键因素。
AI.method: 该研究通过推导1/W定律，并使用推理集群模拟框架（inference-fleet-sim framework）进行分析，结合已发布的H100功耗测量数据、校准的逻辑功耗模型和屋顶吞吐量模型来得出结果。没有进行新的硬件实验。
AI.result: 1. 1/W 定律：每瓦特令牌数（tok/W）在上下文窗口每翻倍时减半。2. 在64K上下文时，H100每瓦特令牌数为1.5，而在4K上下文时，为17.6。3. 双池上下文长度路由（FleetOpt）比同构集群的tok/W提升约2.5倍。4. 从H100升级到B200的tok/W提升约1.7倍。5. 结合FleetOpt和B200可实现H100同构基线的4.25倍提升。6. MoE模型（如Qwen3-235B-A22B）在8K上下文的H100上达到约37.8 tok/W，比Llama-3.1-70B高5.1倍，因为解码时间与激活权重而非总参数量相关。
AI.conclusion: 上下文长度路由拓扑是提高LLM推理能效比硬件升级更强大的杠杆。MoE模型通过活跃参数权重流式传输提供了第三个能效提升途径。理解上下文窗口对KV缓存并发性的影响对优化能效至关重要。
AI.translation:
每瓦特GPU推理集群能提供多少令牌？在相同的硬件部署中，答案差异高达40倍——这并非由于软件效率低下，而是因为服务上下文窗口。我们推导出了1/W定律：每瓦特令牌数在上下文窗口每翻倍时减半。更大的上下文窗口会缩小KV缓存的并发限制，同时GPU功耗大致保持不变。在64K上下文时，H100可同时处理16个序列（tok/W = 1.5）；在4K上下文时，相同的H100可同时处理256个序列（tok/W = 17.6）。
路由拓扑——决定了每个GPU服务的有效上下文窗口——是一个比购买新硬件更强大的能效杠杆。我们根据已发布的H100功耗测量数据、校准的逻辑功耗模型和屋顶吞吐量模型，使用推理集群模拟框架分析得出这些结果；没有进行新的硬件实验。双池上下文长度路由（FleetOpt）比同构集群的tok/W提升约2.5倍，而从H100升级到B200的提升约1.7倍。这些增益是独立的：将FleetOpt与B200结合使用，相对于H100同构基线可实现4.25倍的提升。B200/H200的数据是分析预测（±20%不确定性）；H100结果已根据已发布测量数据进行校准。
对于MoE模型，活跃参数权重流式传输增加了第三个杠杆。Qwen3-235B-A22B（22B活跃参数）在H100上8K上下文时达到约37.8 tok/W——比Llama-3.1-70B高5.1倍——因为解码时间与激活权重而非总参数量相关。MoE调度开销被排除在外，因此这是一个上限。
AI.summary: 本研究提出并推导了LLM推理能效的“1/W定律”，指出每瓦特令牌数会随上下文窗口的增大而减半，主要原因是KV缓存并发限制。研究强调，通过上下文长度路由拓扑（如FleetOpt）优化服务策略，比单纯升级GPU硬件（如从H100到B200）能带来更显著的能效提升。结合路由优化和新硬件可实现更大增益。此外，对于MoE模型，活跃参数权重流式传输是提高能效的第三个关键因素。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 能效, 1/W定律, 上下文长度, 路由拓扑, MoE模型
AI.comments: 本文通过提出“1/W定律”并量化上下文长度对LLM推理能效的影响，提供了一个重要的分析框架。其创新之处在于强调了路由拓扑在能效优化中的关键作用，甚至超越了硬件升级。通过分析而非实验验证，提供了一个快速评估能效提升潜力的工具。局限性在于B200/H200数据为预测值，且MoE模型的分析排除了调度开销，因此是上限。

title: SEAL-Tag: Self-Tag Evidence Aggregation with Probabilistic Circuits for PII-Safe Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems introduce a critical vulnerability: contextual leakage, where adversaries exploit instruction-following to exfiltrate Personally Identifiable Information (PII) via adaptive extraction. Current defenses force a rigid trade-off between semantic utility and latency. We present SEAL-Tag, a privacy-preserving runtime environment that resolves this via a Verify-then-Route paradigm. SEAL-Tag introduces the SEAL-Probe protocol, transforming auditing into a structured tool-use operation where the model generates a verifiable PII-Evidence Table (PET) alongside its draft. To adjudicate this evidence, we employ a Probabilistic Circuit (PC) that enforces verifiable logical constraints for robust decision-making. To overcome the privacy "Cold Start" problem, we introduce the S0--S6 Anchored Synthesis Pipeline, generating high-fidelity, provenanced RAG interactions. We pair this with a Two-Stage Curriculum that first optimizes for entity detection before aligning the model to the rigorous audit protocol. Our evaluation demonstrates that SEAL-Tag establishes a new Pareto frontier, reducing adaptive leakage by over 8$\times$ while matching the utility and speed of unsafe baselines.

AI.title_translation: SEAL-Tag：基于概率电路的自标签证据聚合，用于PII安全的检索增强生成
AI.tldr: SEAL-Tag是一个保护隐私的运行时环境，通过“验证-然后-路由”范式和概率电路，显著减少了检索增强生成（RAG）系统中个人身份信息（PII）的泄露，同时保持了实用性和速度。
AI.motivation: 当前的检索增强生成（RAG）系统存在上下文泄露的严重漏洞，攻击者可以利用指令遵循来通过自适应提取窃取个人身份信息（PII）。现有防御措施在语义实用性和延迟之间存在僵硬的权衡。
AI.method: SEAL-Tag引入了“验证-然后-路由”范式，通过SEAL-Probe协议将审计转化为结构化的工具使用操作，模型生成可验证的PII-证据表（PET）。利用概率电路（PC）来裁决证据，强制执行可验证的逻辑约束。为解决隐私“冷启动”问题，引入了S0-S6锚定合成管道，生成高保真、有来源的RAG交互。此外，还采用了两阶段课程，首先优化实体检测，然后使模型与严格的审计协议对齐。
AI.result: SEAL-Tag建立了一个新的帕累托前沿，将自适应泄露减少了8倍以上，同时与不安全基线的实用性和速度相匹配。
AI.conclusion: SEAL-Tag通过其创新的隐私保护运行时环境和方法，成功解决了RAG系统中的PII泄露问题，并在隐私保护、实用性和速度之间实现了新的平衡。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统引入了一个关键漏洞：上下文泄露，攻击者利用指令遵循通过自适应提取窃取个人身份信息（PII）。当前的防御措施在语义实用性和延迟之间强制进行僵硬的权衡。我们提出了SEAL-Tag，一个保护隐私的运行时环境，通过“验证-然后-路由”范式解决了这个问题。SEAL-Tag引入了SEAL-Probe协议，将审计转化为结构化的工具使用操作，模型在生成草稿的同时生成一个可验证的PII-证据表（PET）。为了裁决这些证据，我们采用概率电路（PC），它强制执行可验证的逻辑约束以实现稳健的决策。为了克服隐私“冷启动”问题，我们引入了S0-S6锚定合成管道，生成高保真、有来源的RAG交互。我们将其与两阶段课程相结合，该课程首先优化实体检测，然后使模型与严格的审计协议对齐。我们的评估表明，SEAL-Tag建立了一个新的帕累托前沿，将自适应泄露减少了8倍以上，同时与不安全基线的实用性和速度相匹配。
AI.summary: SEAL-Tag是一个旨在解决检索增强生成（RAG）系统中个人身份信息（PII）泄露问题的隐私保护运行时环境。它采用“验证-然后-路由”范式，通过SEAL-Probe协议生成可验证的PII-证据表（PET），并利用概率电路（PC）进行证据裁决。为应对隐私“冷启动”问题，SEAL-Tag引入了S0-S6锚定合成管道和两阶段课程。实验结果表明，SEAL-Tag显著减少了自适应泄露，同时保持了与现有系统相当的实用性和速度。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 个人身份信息安全, 概率电路, 上下文泄露, 隐私保护
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法SEAL-Tag，通过结合“验证-然后-路由”范式、概率电路和数据合成管道，有效解决了RAG系统中的PII泄露问题，同时避免了传统方法在语义实用性和延迟之间的权衡。其创新之处在于将审计转化为结构化的工具使用操作，并通过概率电路进行严格的决策，为构建更安全的RAG系统提供了重要思路。

title: STLts-Div: Diversified Trace Synthesis from STL Specifications Using MILP (Extended Version)
summary: Modern cyber-physical systems are complex, and requirements are often written in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). Writing the right STL is difficult in practice; engineers benefit from concrete executions that illustrate what a specification actually admits. Trace synthesis addresses this need, but a single witness rarely suffices to understand intent or explore edge cases - diverse satisfying behaviors are far more informative. We introduce diversified trace synthesis: the automatic generation of sets of behaviorally diverse traces that satisfy a given STL formula. Building on a MILP encoding of STL and system model, we formalize three complementary diversification objectives - Boolean distance, random Boolean distance, and value distance - all captured by an objective function and solved iteratively. We implement these ideas in STLts-Div, a lightweight Python tool that integrates with Gurobi.

AI.title_translation: STLts-Div：使用MILP从STL规范中进行多样化轨迹合成（扩展版）
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了多样化轨迹合成方法，通过使用MILP从STL规范中自动生成行为多样化的轨迹集，以帮助工程师理解复杂的网络物理系统。
AI.motivation: 现代信息物理系统复杂，需求常以信号时序逻辑（STL）编写。工程师难以编写正确的STL，需要具体的执行轨迹来理解规范。单个轨迹不足以理解意图或探索边缘情况，而多样化的满足行为能提供更多信息。
AI.method: 引入多样化轨迹合成方法。基于STL和系统模型的MILP编码，形式化了布尔距离、随机布尔距离和值距离这三个互补的多样化目标。这些目标通过目标函数捕获并迭代求解。该方法在STLts-Div（一个与Gurobi集成的轻量级Python工具）中实现。
AI.result: 开发了STLts-Div，一个轻量级的Python工具，它与Gurobi集成，能够自动生成满足给定STL公式的行为多样化轨迹集。
AI.conclusion: 通过使用MILP进行多样化轨迹合成，并将其在STLts-Div工具中实现，可以有效地帮助工程师更好地理解复杂的STL规范，通过提供多样化的满足行为来探索系统意图和边缘情况。
AI.translation: 现代信息物理系统复杂，需求通常用信号时序逻辑（STL）编写。在实践中，编写正确的STL很困难；工程师受益于具体的执行，这些执行可以说明规范实际允许什么。轨迹合成解决了这一需求，但单个见证很少足以理解意图或探索边缘情况——多样化的满足行为信息量更大。我们引入了多样化轨迹合成：自动生成满足给定STL公式的行为多样化轨迹集。我们基于STL和系统模型的MILP编码，形式化了三个互补的多样化目标——布尔距离、随机布尔距离和值距离——所有这些都通过目标函数捕获并迭代求解。我们在STLts-Div中实现了这些想法，这是一个轻量级的Python工具，与Gurobi集成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种多样化轨迹合成方法，旨在自动生成满足信号时序逻辑（STL）规范的行为多样化轨迹集。针对理解网络物理系统中复杂STL需求的挑战，该方法利用STL和系统模型的MILP编码，并形式化了布尔距离、随机布尔距离和值距离三种多样化目标。这些目标通过一个目标函数捕获并迭代求解。该方法已在名为STLts-Div的轻量级Python工具中实现，并与Gurobi集成。
AI.keywords: STL, 轨迹合成, 多样化, MILP, 网络物理系统
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于使用MILP对STL规范进行多样化轨迹合成的正式化和实现，解决了工程师在理解复杂系统行为时仅依赖单一轨迹的局限性。通过迭代求解多种多样化目标，为工程师提供了更全面的系统行为视图，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Directing the Narrative: A Finetuning Method for Controlling Coherence and Style in Story Generation
summary: Story visualization requires generating sequential imagery that aligns semantically with evolving narratives while maintaining rigorous consistency in character identity and visual style. However, existing methodologies often struggle with subject inconsistency and identity drift, particularly when depicting complex interactions or extended narrative arcs. To address these challenges, we propose a cohesive two-stage framework designed for robust and consistent story generation. First, we introduce Group-Shared Attention (GSA), a mechanism that fosters intrinsic consistency by enabling lossless cross-sample information flow within attention layers. This allows the model to structurally encode identity correspondence across frames without relying on external encoders. Second, we leverage Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align generated outputs with human aesthetic and narrative standards. Unlike conventional methods that rely on conflicting auxiliary losses, our approach simultaneously enhances visual fidelity and identity preservation by learning from holistic preference data. Extensive evaluations on the ViStoryBench benchmark demonstrate that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art, significantly outperforming strong baselines with gains of +10.0 in Character Identity (CIDS) and +18.7 in Style Consistency (CSD), all while preserving high-fidelity generation.

AI.title_translation: 引导叙事：一种用于控制故事生成中连贯性和风格的微调方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段框架，结合了组共享注意力（GSA）和直接偏好优化（DPO），以解决故事可视化中角色身份不一致和风格漂移的问题，并在ViStoryBench基准测试中取得了最先进的成果，显著提高了角色身份和风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 故事可视化需要生成与叙事语义对齐的序列图像，并严格保持角色身份和视觉风格的一致性。然而，现有方法在描绘复杂交互或扩展叙事弧时，往往难以解决主体不一致和身份漂移的问题。
AI.method: 本文提出一个两阶段框架。首先，引入组共享注意力（GSA）机制，通过注意力层内的无损跨样本信息流来促进内在一致性，从而在不依赖外部编码器的情况下结构性地编码帧间的身份对应。其次，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）将生成输出与人类审美和叙事标准对齐，通过从整体偏好数据中学习，同时增强视觉保真度和身份保留。
AI.result: 在ViStoryBench基准测试中，该方法建立了新的最先进水平，显著优于强基线，在角色身份（CIDS）方面提高+10.0，在风格一致性（CSD）方面提高+18.7，同时保持了高保真生成。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段框架通过结合组共享注意力（GSA）和直接偏好优化（DPO），有效地解决了故事可视化中角色身份不一致和风格漂移的挑战，并在相关基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 故事可视化需要生成与不断演进的叙事语义对齐的序列图像，同时保持角色身份和视觉风格的严格一致性。然而，现有方法在处理主体不一致和身份漂移方面常常遇到困难，尤其是在描绘复杂交互或扩展叙事弧时。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个旨在实现鲁棒且一致的故事生成的内聚两阶段框架。首先，我们引入了组共享注意力（GSA），这是一种通过在注意力层内实现无损跨样本信息流来促进内在一致性的机制。这使得模型能够结构性地编码帧间的身份对应，而无需依赖外部编码器。其次，我们利用直接偏好优化（DPO）将生成的输出与人类审美和叙事标准对齐。与依赖冲突辅助损失的传统方法不同，我们的方法通过从整体偏好数据中学习，同时增强了视觉保真度和身份保留。在ViStoryBench基准测试上的广泛评估表明，我们的方法建立了新的最先进水平，显著优于强基线，在角色身份（CIDS）方面提高了+10.0，在风格一致性（CSD）方面提高了+18.7，同时保持了高保真生成。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的两阶段框架，用于解决故事可视化中角色身份不一致和视觉风格漂移的问题。该框架首先通过组共享注意力（GSA）机制实现帧间身份的内在一致性，然后利用直接偏好优化（DPO）将生成内容与人类偏好对齐，以同时提升视觉保真度和身份保留。实验结果表明，该方法在ViStoryBench基准测试中达到了最先进的性能，显著提高了角色身份和风格一致性。
AI.keywords: 故事生成, 连贯性, 风格控制, 组共享注意力, 直接偏好优化
AI.comments: 这项研究通过结合GSA和DPO，为故事生成领域提供了一个创新性的解决方案，特别是在处理角色身份和风格一致性方面。GSA通过内部机制解决了一致性问题，而DPO则通过学习人类偏好来优化输出，避免了传统方法中辅助损失的冲突。其在关键指标上的显著提升表明了该方法的有效性和重要性，对未来高质量故事可视化生成具有重要意义。

title: GUIDE: GenAI Units In Digital Design Education
summary: GenAI Units In Digital Design Education (GUIDE) is an open courseware repository with runnable Google Colab labs and other materials. We describe the repository's architecture and educational approach based on standardized teaching units comprising slides, short videos, runnable labs, and related papers. This organization enables consistency for both the students' learning experience and the reuse and grading by instructors. We demonstrate GUIDE in practice with three representative units: VeriThoughts for reasoning and formal-verification-backed RTL generation, enhanced LLM-aided testbench generation, and LLMPirate for IP Piracy. We also provide details for four example course instances (GUIDE4ChipDesign, Build your ASIC, GUIDE4HardwareSecurity, and Hardware Design) that assemble GUIDE units into full semester offerings, learning outcomes, and capstone projects, all based on proven materials. For example, the GUIDE4HardwareSecurity course includes a project on LLM-aided hardware Trojan insertion that has been successfully deployed in the classroom and in Cybersecurity Games and Conference (CSAW), a student competition and academic conference for cybersecurity. We also organized an NYU Cognichip Hackathon, engaging students across 24 international teams in AI-assisted RTL design workflows. The GUIDE repository is open for contributions and available at: https://github.com/FCHXWH823/LLM4ChipDesign.

AI.title_translation: GUIDE：数字设计教育中的生成式AI单元
AI.tldr: GUIDE是一个开放课件库，提供标准化教学单元，利用生成式AI辅助数字设计教育，并已在多个课程和活动中成功应用。
AI.motivation: 该论文旨在通过提供一个结构化、标准化的开放课件库，将生成式AI单元整合到数字设计教育中，以提高学生学习体验的一致性，并方便教师的重复使用和评分。
AI.method: GUIDE是一个开放课件库，其教育方法基于标准化的教学单元，这些单元包括幻灯片、短视频、可运行的Google Colab实验室和相关论文。这种组织方式确保了学生学习体验的一致性，并方便了教师的重复使用和评分。
AI.result: GUIDE通过三个代表性单元进行了实践演示，包括用于RTL生成和形式验证的VeriThoughts、增强的LLM辅助测试平台生成以及用于IP盗版的LLMPirate。它还被组装成四个示例学期课程，并成功部署在课堂、网络安全竞赛（CSAW）和纽约大学Cognichip黑客马拉松中，吸引了24个国际团队参与AI辅助RTL设计工作流程。
AI.conclusion: GUIDE提供了一个经过验证的开放课件库，用于将生成式AI整合到数字设计教育中，通过标准化的教学单元、实际演示和在各种学术环境及竞赛中的成功部署，有效支持了数字设计教育。
AI.translation: GenAI Units In Digital Design Education (GUIDE) 是一个开放课件库，包含可运行的 Google Colab 实验室和其他材料。我们描述了该存储库的架构和教育方法，其基于标准化的教学单元，包括幻灯片、短视频、可运行的实验室和相关论文。这种组织方式为学生的学习体验以及教师的重复使用和评分提供了 L 贯性。我们通过三个代表性单元展示了 GUIDE 的实践应用：VeriThoughts 用于推理和形式验证支持的 RTL 生成，增强的 LLM 辅助测试平台生成，以及用于 IP 盗版的 LLMPirate。我们还提供了四个示例课程实例（GUIDE4ChipDesign、Build your ASIC、GUIDE4HardwareSecurity 和 Hardware Design）的详细信息，这些课程将 GUIDE 单元组装成完整的学期课程、学习成果和毕业设计项目，所有这些都基于经过验证的材料。例如，GUIDE4HardwareSecurity 课程包含一个关于 LLM 辅助硬件木马植入的项目，该项目已成功部署在课堂和网络安全游戏与会议 (CSAW) 中，CSAW 是一个面向网络安全的学生竞赛和学术会议。我们还组织了纽约大学 Cognichip 黑客马拉松，吸引了来自 24 个国际团队的学生参与 AI 辅助 RTL 设计工作流程。GUIDE 存储库开放供贡献，可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/FCHXWH823/LLM4ChipDesign。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了GUIDE，一个用于将生成式AI整合到数字设计教育中的开放课件库。它以标准化教学单元为特色，包括幻灯片、视频、可运行的Google Colab实验室和论文，确保了学习的一致性并方便了教师的重复使用。GUIDE的有效性通过用于RTL生成和LLM辅助测试平台生成的单元以及其在完整学期课程中的整合，以及在CSAW和纽约大学Cognichip黑客马拉松等学术项目和竞赛中的成功部署得到了证明。该存储库开放供贡献。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 数字设计教育, 开放课件, LLM, 硬件安全
AI.comments: 该论文为将前沿的生成式AI技术整合到数字设计教育中提供了一个非常实用且及时的解决方案。开放课件库模型，结合标准化单元和可运行的实验室，解决了课程开发和可访问性方面的关键挑战。在各种课程、竞赛和黑客马拉松中的成功部署突显了其即时适用性和影响力。专注于RTL生成、测试平台生成和硬件安全等特定应用，强调了生成式AI在该领域的创新潜力。其开源性质进一步促进了社区参与和持续改进。

title: Efficient and Effective Table-Centric Table Union Search in Data Lakes
summary: In data lakes, information on the same subject is often fragmented across multiple tables. Table union search aims to find the top-k tables that can be unioned with a query table to extend it with more rows, without relying on metadata or ground-truth labels. Existing methods are mainly column-centric: they focus on modeling column unionability scores using column embeddings, which are then used throughout the search process for column matching, filtering, and aggregation. However, this overlooks holistic table-level semantics, which may result in suboptimal rankings and inefficiencies. We introduce TACTUS, a novel table-centric method for table union search. Unlike prior work that searches from columns to tables, we search in a table-first way and examine columns only in the final step. During offline processing, we directly generate table embeddings for holistic, table-level unionability scoring by designing table-level representation techniques, including positive table pair construction to simulate unionable tables, two-pronged negative table sampling to avoid latent positives and mine hard negatives to enhance representation quality, and attentive table encoding for effective embeddings. During online search, we first develop a table-centric adaptive candidate retrieval method that efficiently selects a compact, high-quality candidate pool by leveraging the distribution of table-level unionability scores induced by table embeddings. We then inspect columns only within this compact candidate set and design a dual-evidence reranking technique that integrates table-level and column-level scores to refine the final top-k results. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that TACTUS significantly improves result quality while being much faster than existing methods in both offline and online processing, often by an order of magnitude.

AI.title_translation: 数据湖中高效且有效的以表为中心的表联合搜索
AI.tldr: TACTUS是一种新的以表为中心的方法，用于在数据湖中进行表联合搜索，它通过生成表嵌入和分阶段搜索显著提高了效率和结果质量，解决了现有方法效率低下和忽略表级语义的问题。
AI.motivation: 在数据湖中，同一主题的信息通常分散在多个表中。现有的表联合搜索方法主要是以列为中心的，它们侧重于使用列嵌入来建模列的可联合性分数，但这忽略了整体的表级语义，可能导致次优的排名和效率低下。
AI.method: TACTUS提出了一种新颖的以表为中心的表联合搜索方法。在离线处理阶段，它通过设计表级表示技术（包括正向表对构建、双管齐下的负向表采样和注意力表编码）直接生成表嵌入以进行整体的表级联合性评分。在在线搜索阶段，它首先开发了一种以表为中心的自适应候选检索方法，通过利用表嵌入诱导的表级联合性分数分布，高效地选择紧凑、高质量的候选池。然后，仅在此紧凑的候选集中检查列，并设计了一种双重证据重新排名技术，该技术整合了表级和列级分数以优化最终的top-k结果。
AI.result: TACTUS在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，它显著提高了结果质量，并且在离线和在线处理中都比现有方法快得多，通常快一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: TACTUS通过其创新的以表为中心的方法，成功解决了数据湖中表联合搜索的效率和准确性问题，并显著优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 在数据湖中，同一主题的信息通常分散在多个表中。表联合搜索旨在找到可以与查询表联合以扩展更多行的top-k表，而不依赖于元数据或真实标签。现有方法主要是以列为中心的：它们侧重于使用列嵌入来建模列的可联合性分数，然后将这些分数用于搜索过程中的列匹配、过滤和聚合。然而，这忽略了整体的表级语义，可能导致次优的排名和效率低下。我们引入了TACTUS，一种新颖的以表为中心的表联合搜索方法。与以往从列到表进行搜索的工作不同，我们以表优先的方式进行搜索，并仅在最后一步检查列。在离线处理期间，我们通过设计表级表示技术，包括正向表对构建以模拟可联合表、双管齐下的负向表采样以避免潜在正例并挖掘难负例以增强表示质量，以及注意力表编码以获得有效的嵌入，直接生成表嵌入以进行整体的表级联合性评分。在在线搜索期间，我们首先开发了一种以表为中心的自适应候选检索方法，该方法通过利用表嵌入诱导的表级联合性分数分布，高效地选择紧凑、高质量的候选池。然后，我们仅在此紧凑的候选集中检查列，并设计了一种双重证据重新排名技术，该技术整合了表级和列级分数以优化最终的top-k结果。在真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明，TACTUS显著提高了结果质量，并且在离线和在线处理中都比现有方法快得多，通常快一个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TACTUS，一种在数据湖中进行高效且有效的表联合搜索的以表为中心的新方法。针对现有列中心方法忽视表级语义导致的低效和次优排名问题，TACTUS在离线阶段通过设计表级表示技术（如正负表采样和注意力编码）直接生成表嵌入。在线搜索阶段，它首先利用表嵌入进行自适应候选检索，快速筛选出高质量候选集，然后在该集合内结合表级和列级分数进行双重证据重排序以得到最终结果。实验证明，TACTUS在结果质量和处理速度上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 数据湖, 表联合搜索, 表嵌入, 以表为中心, 候选检索
AI.comments: TACTUS的创新之处在于其“以表为中心”的设计理念，这与现有“以列为中心”的方法形成了鲜明对比。通过引入表级嵌入和分阶段搜索策略，它有效地解决了传统方法在处理整体表语义时的不足，并显著提升了效率和准确性。这种从宏观到微观的搜索范式对于大规模数据湖中的表管理和集成具有重要意义。

title: ReSteer: Quantifying and Refining the Steerability of Multitask Robot Policies
summary: Despite strong multi-task pretraining, existing policies often exhibit poor task steerability. For example, a robot may fail to respond to a new instruction ``put the bowl in the sink" when moving towards the oven, executing ``close the oven", even though it can complete both tasks when executed separately. We propose ReSteer, a framework to quantify and improve task steerability in multitask robot policies. We conduct an exhaustive evaluation of state-of-the-art policies, revealing a common lack of steerability. We find that steerability is associated with limited overlap among training task trajectory distributions, and introduce a proxy metric to measure this overlap from policy behavior. Building on this insight, ReSteer improves steerability via three components: (i) a steerability estimator that identifies low-steerability states without full-rollout evaluation, (ii) a steerable data generator that synthesizes motion segments from these states, and (iii) a self-refinement pipeline that improves policy steerability using the generated data. In simulation on LIBERO, ReSteer improves steerability by 11\% over 18k rollouts. In real-world experiments, we show that improved steerability is critical for interactive use, enabling users to instruct robots to perform any task at any time. We hope this work motivates further study on quantifying steerability and data collection strategies for large robot policies.

AI.title_translation: ReSteer：量化并优化多任务机器人策略的可控性
AI.tldr: ReSteer框架通过量化并改进多任务机器人策略的可控性，解决了现有策略任务可控性差的问题，并在模拟和现实世界中展示了显著提升，使机器人能更好地响应用户指令。
AI.motivation: 尽管经过强大的多任务预训练，现有机器人策略通常表现出较差的任务可控性，即机器人难以在执行一个任务时响应新的指令并切换到另一个任务，即使它能独立完成这两个任务。
AI.method: 提出ReSteer框架，用于量化和改进多任务机器人策略的任务可控性。该方法首先对现有策略进行详尽评估，发现可控性差与训练任务轨迹分布之间有限的重叠相关，并引入一个代理指标来衡量这种重叠。ReSteer通过三个组件改进可控性：(i) 一个可控性估计器，无需完整推演即可识别低可控性状态；(ii) 一个可控数据生成器，从这些状态合成运动片段；(iii) 一个自优化流程，利用生成的数据改进策略可控性。
AI.result: 在LIBERO模拟环境中，ReSteer在18k次推演中将可控性提高了11%。在真实世界实验中，改进的可控性对于交互式使用至关重要，使用户能够随时指示机器人执行任何任务。
AI.conclusion: ReSteer显著提升了多任务机器人策略的可控性，使其在交互式使用中更有效。这项工作有望推动对大型机器人策略可控性量化和数据收集策略的进一步研究。
AI.translation: 尽管经过强大的多任务预训练，现有策略通常表现出较差的任务可控性。例如，当机器人正在向烤箱移动并执行“关闭烤箱”时，它可能无法响应新的指令“把碗放进水槽”，即使它能单独完成这两个任务。我们提出了ReSteer，一个用于量化和改进多任务机器人策略中任务可控性的框架。我们对最先进的策略进行了详尽评估，揭示了普遍缺乏可控性的问题。我们发现可控性与训练任务轨迹分布之间有限的重叠相关，并引入了一个代理指标来从策略行为中衡量这种重叠。基于这一见解，ReSteer通过三个组件改进了可控性：(i) 一个可控性估计器，无需完整推演评估即可识别低可控性状态；(ii) 一个可控数据生成器，从这些状态合成运动片段；(iii) 一个自优化流程，利用生成的数据改进策略可控性。在LIBERO模拟环境中，ReSteer在18k次推演中将可控性提高了11%。在真实世界实验中，我们展示了改进的可控性对于交互式使用至关重要，使用户能够随时指示机器人执行任何任务。我们希望这项工作能激励对大型机器人策略的可控性量化和数据收集策略的进一步研究。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ReSteer框架，旨在量化并改进多任务机器人策略的可控性。研究发现现有策略普遍缺乏可控性，且与训练任务轨迹分布重叠有限有关。ReSteer通过一个可控性估计器识别低可控性状态，一个可控数据生成器合成运动片段，以及一个自优化流程来提升策略可控性。实验结果显示，在模拟环境中可控性提升了11%，并在真实世界中验证了其对于交互式机器人应用的重要性。
AI.keywords: 机器人策略, 任务可控性, 多任务学习, 策略优化, 数据生成
AI.comments: ReSteer的创新在于提出了一个全面的框架来解决多任务机器人策略中普遍存在的任务可控性问题。通过识别训练任务轨迹分布重叠与可控性之间的关联，并设计了三个协同工作的组件（估计器、数据生成器和自优化流程），它为改进机器人与用户指令交互的能力提供了具体且有效的方法。这项工作对于推动可交互、泛化能力强的机器人策略发展具有重要意义。

title: WINFlowNets: Warm-up Integrated Networks Training of Generative Flow Networks for Robotics and Machine Fault Adaptation
summary: Generative Flow Networks for continuous scenarios (CFlowNets) have shown promise in solving sequential decision-making tasks by learning stochastic policies using a flow and a retrieval network. Despite their demonstrated efficiency compared to state-of-the-art Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms, their practical application in robotic control tasks is constrained by the reliance on pre-training the retrieval network. This dependency poses challenges in dynamic robotic environments, where pre-training data may not be readily available or representative of the current environment.
