To manage this complexity, we introduce a rigorous benchmarking framework by extending converse optimality to discrete-time, control-affine, nonlinear systems with noise. Our framework provides necessary and sufficient conditions, under which a prescribed value function and policy are optimal for constructed systems, enabling the systematic generation of benchmark families via homotopy variations and randomized parameters. We validate it by automatically constructing diverse environments, demonstrating our framework's capacity for a controlled and comprehensive evaluation across algorithms. By assessing standard methods against a ground-truth optimum, our work delivers a reproducible foundation for precise and rigorous RL benchmarking.

title: Real-Time Online Learning for Model Predictive Control using a Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Process Approximation
comments: to be published at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)
summary: Learning-based model predictive control (MPC) can enhance control performance by correcting for model inaccuracies, enabling more precise state trajectory predictions than traditional MPC. A common approach is to model unknown residual dynamics as a Gaussian process (GP), which leverages data and also provides an estimate of the associated uncertainty. However, the high computational cost of online learning poses a major challenge for real-time GP-MPC applications. This work presents an efficient implementation of an approximate spatio-temporal GP model, offering online learning at constant computational complexity. It is optimized for GP-MPC, where it enables improved control performance by learning more accurate system dynamics online in real-time, even for time-varying systems. The performance of the proposed method is demonstrated by simulations and hardware experiments in the exemplary application of autonomous miniature racing.
comment: to be published at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robotics & Automation (ICRA)

title: Hierarchical Decision-Making under Uncertainty: A Hybrid MDP and Chance-Constrained MPC Approach
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical decision-making framework for autonomous systems operating under uncertainty, demonstrated through autonomous driving as a representative application. Surrounding agents are modeled using Hybrid Markov Decision Processes (HMDPs) that jointly capture maneuver-level and dynamic-level uncertainties, enabling the multi-modal environmental prediction. The ego agent is modeled using a separate HMDP and integrated into a Model Predictive Control (MPC) framework that unifies maneuver selection with dynamic feasibility within a single optimization. A set of joint chance constraints serves as the bridge between environmental prediction and optimization, incorporating multi-modal environment predictions into the MPC formulation and ensuring safety across all plausible interaction scenarios. The proposed framework provides theoretical guarantees on recursive feasibility and asymptotic stability, and its benefits in terms of safety and efficiency are validated through comprehensive evaluations in highway and urban environments, together with comparisons against a rule-based baseline.

title: DSS-GAN: Directional State Space GAN with Mamba backbone for Class-Conditional Image Synthesis
summary: We present DSS-GAN, the first generative adversarial network to employ Mamba as a hierarchical generator backbone for noise-to-image synthesis. The central contribution is Directional Latent Routing (DLR), a novel conditioning mechanism that decomposes the latent vector into direction-specific subvectors, each jointly projected with a class embedding to produce a feature-wise affine modulation of the corresponding Mamba scan. Unlike conventional class conditioning that injects a global signal, DLR couples class identity and latent structure along distinct spatial axes of the feature map, applied consistently across all generative scales. DSS-GAN achieves improved FID, KID, and precision-recall scores compared to StyleGAN2-ADA across multiple tested datasets. Analysis of the latent space reveals that directional subvectors exhibit measurable specialization: perturbations along individual components produce structured, direction-correlated changes in the synthesized image.

title: VeriGrey: Greybox Agent Validation
summary:
Agentic AI has been a topic of great interest recently. A Large Language Model (LLM) agent involves one or more LLMs in the back-end. In the front end, it conducts autonomous decision-making by combining the LLM outputs with results obtained by invoking several external tools. The autonomous interactions with the external environment introduce critical security risks.
  In this paper, we present a grey-box approach to explore diverse behaviors and uncover security risks in LLM agents. Our approach VeriGrey uses the sequence of tools invoked as a feedback function to drive the testing process. This helps uncover infrequent but dangerous tool invocations that cause unexpected agent behavior. As mutation operators in the testing process, we mutate prompts to design pernicious injection prompts. This is carefully accomplished by linking the task of the agent to an injection task, so that the injection task becomes a necessary step of completing the agent functionality. Comparing our approach with a black-box baseline on the well-known AgentDojo benchmark, VeriGrey achieves 33% additional efficacy in finding indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities with a GPT-4.1 back-end.
  We also conduct real-world case studies with the widely used coding agent Gemini CLI, and the well-known OpenClaw personal assistant. VeriGrey finds prompts inducing several attack scenarios that could not be identified by black-box approaches. In OpenClaw, by constructing a conversation agent which employs mutational fuzz testing as needed, VeriGrey is able to discover malicious skill variants from 10 malicious skills (with 10/10= 100% success rate on the Kimi-K2.5 LLM backend, and 9/10= 90% success rate on Opus 4.6 LLM backend). This demonstrates the value of a dynamic approach like VeriGrey to test agents, and to eventually lead to an agent assurance framework.

title: Defending the power grid by segmenting the EV charging cyber infrastructure
summary: This paper examines defending the power grid against load-altering attacks using electric vehicle charging. It proposes to preventively segment the cyber infrastructure that charging station operators (CSOs) use to communicate with and control their charging stations, thereby limiting the impact of successful cyber-attacks. Using real German charging station data and a reconstructed transmission grid model, a threat analysis shows that without segmentation, the successful hack of just two CSOs can overload two transmission grid branches, exceeding the N-1 security margin and necessitating defense measures. A novel defense design problem is then formulated that minimizes the number of imposed segmentations while bounding the number of branch overloads under worst-case attacks. The resulting IP-MILP bi-level problem can be solved with an exact column and constraint generation algorithm and with heuristics for fast computation on large-scale instances. For the near-real-world Germany case, the applicability of the heuristics is demonstrated and validated under relevant load and dispatch scenarios. It is found that the simple scheme of segmenting CSOs evenly by their installed capacity leads to only 23% more segments compared to the heuristic optimization result, suggesting potential relevance as a regulatory measure.

title: Automated Grammar-based Algebraic Multigrid Design With Evolutionary Algorithms
summary: Although multigrid is asymptotically optimal for solving many important partial differential equations, its efficiency relies heavily on the careful selection of the individual algorithmic components. In contrast to recent approaches that can optimize certain multigrid components using deep learning techniques, we adopt a complementary strategy, employing evolutionary algorithms to construct efficient multigrid cycles from proven algorithmic building blocks. Here, we will present its application to generate efficient algebraic multigrid methods with so-called \emph{flexible cycling}, that is, level-specific smoothing sequences and non-recursive cycling patterns. The search space with such non-standard cycles is intractable to navigate manually, and is generated using genetic programming (GP) guided by context-free grammars. Numerical experiments with the linear algebra library, \emph{hypre}, demonstrate the potential of these non-standard GP cycles to improve multigrid performance both as a solver and a preconditioner.

title: Who's Sense is This? Possibility for Impacting Human Insights in AI-assisted Sensemaking
comments: Accepted by CHI 26 Workshop on Sensemaking and AI 2026: Uses, Behaviors, Design, and Recommendations
summary: Sensemaking is an important preceding step for activities like consensus building and decision-making. When groups of people make sense of large amounts of information, their understanding gradually evolves from vague to clear. During this process when reaching a conclusion is still premature, if people are presented with others' insights, they may be directed to focus on that specific perspective without adequate verification. We argue that similar phenomena may also exist in AI-assisted sensemaking, in which AI will usually be the one that presents insight prematurely when users' understandings are still vague and ill-formed. In this paper, we raised three questions that are worth deliberation before exploiting AI to assist in collaborative sensemaking in practice, and discussed possible reasons that may lead users to opt for insights from AI.
comment: Accepted by CHI 26 Workshop on Sensemaking and AI 2026: Uses, Behaviors, Design, and Recommendations

title: Part-Aware Open-Vocabulary 3D Affordance Grounding via Prototypical Semantic and Geometric Alignment
summary: Grounding natural language questions to functionally relevant regions in 3D objects -- termed language-driven 3D affordance grounding -- is essential for embodied intelligence and human-AI interaction. Existing methods, while progressing from label-based to language-driven approaches, still face challenges in open-vocabulary generalization, fine-grained geometric alignment, and part-level semantic consistency. To address these issues, we propose a novel two-stage cross-modal framework that enhances both semantic and geometric representations for open-vocabulary 3D affordance grounding. In the first stage, large language models generate part-aware instructions to recover missing semantics, enabling the model to link semantically similar affordances. In the second stage, we introduce two key components: Affordance Prototype Aggregation (APA), which captures cross-object geometric consistency for each affordance, and Intra-Object Relational Modeling (IORM), which refines geometric differentiation within objects to support precise semantic alignment. We validate the effectiveness of our method through extensive experiments on a newly introduced benchmark, as well as two existing benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance in comparison with existing methods.

title: Requirements Volatility in Software Architecture Design: An Exploratory Case Study
comments: International Conference on Software and System Process 2017
summary: Requirements volatility is a major issue in software (SW) development, causing problems such as project delays and cost overruns. Even though there is a considerable amount of research related to requirement volatility, the majority of it is inclined toward project management aspects. The relationship between SW architecture design and requirements volatility has not been researched widely, even though changing requirements may for example lead to higher defect density during testing. An exploratory case study was conducted to study how requirements volatility affects SW architecture design. Fifteen semi-structured, thematic interviews were conducted in the case company, which provides the selection of software products for business customers and consumers. The research revealed the factors, such as requirements uncertainty and dynamic business environment, causing requirements volatility in the case company. The study identified the challenges that requirements volatility posed to SW architecture design, including scheduling and architectural technical debt. In addition, this study discusses means of mitigating the factors that cause requirements volatility and addressing the challenges posed by requirements volatility. SW architects are strongly influenced by requirement volatility. Thus understanding the factors causing requirements volatility as well as means to mitigate the challenges has high industrial relevance.
comment: International Conference on Software and System Process 2017

title: Anchoring and Rescaling Attention for Semantically Coherent Inbetweening
comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026; Code is released at https://github.com/teunchoi/TGI
summary: Generative inbetweening (GI) seeks to synthesize realistic intermediate frames between the first and last keyframes beyond mere interpolation. As sequences become sparser and motions larger, previous GI models struggle with inconsistent frames with unstable pacing and semantic misalignment. Since GI involves fixed endpoints and numerous plausible paths, this task requires additional guidance gained from the keyframes and text to specify the intended path. Thus, we give semantic and temporal guidance from the keyframes and text onto each intermediate frame through Keyframe-anchored Attention Bias. We also better enforce frame consistency with Rescaled Temporal RoPE, which allows self-attention to attend to keyframes more faithfully. TGI-Bench, the first benchmark specifically designed for text-conditioned GI evaluation, enables challenge-targeted evaluation to analyze GI models. Without additional training, our method achieves state-of-the-art frame consistency, semantic fidelity, and pace stability for both short and long sequences across diverse challenges.
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026; Code is released at https://github.com/teunchoi/TGI

title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of autonomous-driving policies requires interactive simulation beyond log replay. However, existing generative world models often degrade in closed loop due to (i) history-free initialization that mismatches policy inputs, (ii) multi-step sampling latency that violates real-time budgets, and (iii) compounding kinematic infeasibility over long horizons. We propose VectorWorld, a streaming world model that incrementally generates ego-centric $64 \mathrm{m}\times 64\mathrm{m}$ lane--agent vector-graph tiles during rollout. VectorWorld aligns initialization with history-conditioned policies by producing a policy-compatible interaction state via a motion-aware gated VAE. It enables real-time outpainting via solver-free one-step masked completion with an edge-gated relational DiT trained with interval-conditioned MeanFlow and JVP-based large-step supervision. To stabilize long-horizon rollouts, we introduce $Δ$Sim, a physics-aligned non-ego (NPC) policy with hybrid discrete--continuous actions and differentiable kinematic logit shaping. On Waymo open motion and nuPlan, VectorWorld improves map-structure fidelity and initialization validity, and supports stable, real-time $1\mathrm{km}+$ closed-loop rollouts (\href{https://github.com/jiangchaokang/VectorWorld}{code}).

title: REAL: Robust Extreme Agility via Spatio-Temporal Policy Learning and Physics-Guided Filtering
summary: Extreme legged parkour demands rapid terrain assessment and precise foot placement under highly dynamic conditions. While recent learning-based systems achieve impressive agility, they remain fundamentally fragile to perceptual degradation, where even brief visual noise or latency can cause catastrophic failure. To overcome this, we propose Robust Extreme Agility Learning (REAL), an end-to-end framework for reliable parkour under sensory corruption. Instead of relying on perfectly clean perception, REAL tightly couples vision, proprioceptive history, and temporal memory. We distill a cross-modal teacher policy into a deployable student equipped with a FiLM-modulated Mamba backbone to actively filter visual noise and build short-term terrain memory actively. Furthermore, a physics-guided Bayesian state estimator enforces rigid-body consistency during high-impact maneuvers. Validated on a Unitree Go2 quadruped, REAL successfully traverses extreme obstacles even with a 1-meter visual blind zone, while strictly satisfying real-time control constraints with a bounded 13.1 ms inference time.

title: Interpretable Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning with Rectified Target-Domain Local Alignment
summary: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Learning (CDFSL) adapts models trained with large-scale general data (source domain) to downstream target domains with only scarce training data, where the research on vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) is still in the early stages. Typical downstream domains, such as medical diagnosis, require fine-grained visual cues for interpretable recognition, but we find that current fine-tuned CLIP models can hardly focus on these cues, albeit they can roughly focus on important regions in source domains. Although current works have demonstrated CLIP's shortcomings in capturing local subtle patterns, in this paper, we find that the domain gap and scarce training data further exacerbate such shortcomings, much more than that of holistic patterns, which we call the local misalignment problem in CLIP-based CDFSL. To address this problem, due to the lack of supervision in aligning local visual features and text semantics, we turn to self-supervision information. Inspired by the translation task, we propose the CC-CDFSL method with cycle consistency, which translates local visual features into text features and then translates them back into visual features (and vice versa), and constrains the original features close to the translated back features. To reduce the noise imported by richer information in the visual modality, we further propose a Semantic Anchor mechanism, which first augments visual features to provide a larger corpus for the text-to-image mapping, and then shrinks the image features to filter out irrelevant image-to-text mapping. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks, backbones, and fine-tuning methods show we can (1) effectively improve the local vision-language alignment, (2) enhance the interpretability of learned patterns and model decisions by visualizing patches, and (3) achieve state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于修正目标域局部对齐的可解释跨域小样本学习
AI.tldr: 跨域小样本学习（CDFSL）中，CLIP模型在目标域的局部视觉-语言对齐存在问题，尤其是在细粒度识别上。本文提出CC-CDFSL方法，利用循环一致性和语义锚机制来解决局部错位问题，从而提高对齐度、可解释性并达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 跨域小样本学习（CDFSL）需要将大规模通用数据训练的模型适应到只有少量训练数据的下游目标域。当前的CLIP微调模型难以关注细粒度视觉线索，尤其是在医学诊断等需要可解释识别的典型下游领域。本文发现，域差距和稀缺训练数据进一步加剧了CLIP在捕获局部细微模式方面的不足，这被称为CLIP-based CDFSL中的局部错位问题。
AI.method: 为了解决局部错位问题，本文提出了一种名为CC-CDFSL的方法，该方法利用循环一致性。它将局部视觉特征翻译成文本特征，然后再翻译回视觉特征（反之亦然），并约束原始特征与翻译回的特征保持接近。为了减少视觉模态中丰富信息带来的噪声，进一步提出了语义锚机制，该机制首先增强视觉特征以提供更大的语料库用于文本到图像的映射，然后缩小图像特征以过滤掉不相关的图像到文本映射。
AI.result: (1) 有效提高了局部视觉-语言对齐。(2) 通过可视化补丁增强了学习模式和模型决策的可解释性。(3) 实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过提出的CC-CDFSL方法和语义锚机制，成功解决了CLIP-based CDFSL中由域差距和数据稀缺导致的局部视觉-语言错位问题，显著提升了模型的局部对齐能力和可解释性，并取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 跨域小样本学习（CDFSL）将用大规模通用数据（源域）训练的模型适应到只有少量训练数据（目标域）的下游领域，而视觉-语言模型（例如CLIP）的研究仍处于早期阶段。典型的下游领域，如医学诊断，需要细粒度视觉线索进行可解释识别，但我们发现当前的微调CLIP模型很难关注这些线索，尽管它们在源域中可以粗略地关注重要区域。尽管当前的工作已经证明了CLIP在捕获局部细微模式方面的不足，但本文发现域差距和稀缺训练数据进一步加剧了这种不足，远甚于整体模式，我们称之为CLIP-based CDFSL中的局部错位问题。为了解决这个问题，由于缺乏对齐局部视觉特征和文本语义的监督，我们转向了自监督信息。受翻译任务的启发，我们提出了具有循环一致性的CC-CDFSL方法，该方法将局部视觉特征翻译成文本特征，然后将其翻译回视觉特征（反之亦然），并约束原始特征与翻译回的特征保持接近。为了减少视觉模态中丰富信息带来的噪声，我们进一步提出了语义锚机制，该机制首先增强视觉特征以提供更大的语料库用于文本到图像的映射，然后缩小图像特征以过滤掉不相关的图像到文本映射。在各种基准、骨干网络和微调方法上进行的广泛实验表明，我们能够（1）有效提高局部视觉-语言对齐，（2）通过可视化补丁增强学习模式和模型决策的可解释性，以及（3）实现最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对跨域小样本学习（CDFSL）中CLIP模型在目标域面临的局部视觉-语言错位问题进行了研究。作者发现域差距和数据稀缺会严重影响CLIP在细粒度视觉线索上的对齐能力。为解决此问题，论文提出CC-CDFSL方法，通过循环一致性进行局部视觉特征与文本特征的相互翻译及约束。同时，引入语义锚机制以减少视觉模态噪声，优化文本到图像和图像到文本的映射。实验证明，该方法能有效提升局部对齐、增强模型可解释性，并达到先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 跨域小样本学习, 可解释性, 局部对齐, CLIP, 循环一致性
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了利用循环一致性和语义锚机制来解决CLIP在跨域小样本学习中局部视觉-语言对齐的难题。其对局部错位问题的深入分析和自监督解决方案具有重要意义，尤其在需要高可解释性的细粒度识别领域展现了潜力。通过提升模型对局部细节的关注和可视化能力，该研究为可解释AI在实际应用中的推广提供了坚实的基础。

title: From Symbol to Meaning: Ontological and Philosophical Reflections on Large Language Models in Information Systems Engineering
comments: This paper constitutes a substantially extended version of a conference article to be published in the proceedings of the International Conference on Enterprise Information Systems ICEIS 2026
summary: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) represents a turning point in the theoretical foundations of Information Systems Engineering. Beyond their technical significance, LLMs challenge the ontological, epistemological, and semiotic assumptions that have long structured our understanding of in-formation, representation, and knowledge. This article proposes an integrative reflection on how LLMs reconfigure the relationships among language, meaning, and system design, suggesting that their emergence demands a re-examination of the conceptual foundations of contemporary information systems. Sketching on philosophical traditions from Peirce to Heidegger and Floridi, we investigate how the logic of generative models both extends and destabilises classical notions of ontology and signification. The discussion emphasises the necessity of grounding LLM-based systems in transparent, ethically coherent frameworks that respect the integrity of human-centred knowledge processes. Ultimately, the paper argues that LLMs should be understood not merely as tools for automation but as epistemic agents that reshape the philosophical and semiotic foundations of information systems engineering.
comment: This paper constitutes a substantially extended version of a conference article to be published in the proceedings of the International Conference on Enterprise Information Systems ICEIS 2026

AI.title_translation: 从符号到意义：信息系统工程中大型语言模型的本体论与哲学反思
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型挑战信息系统工程的理论基础，需要重新审视其本体论、认识论和符号学假设，并将其理解为重塑信息系统工程哲学基础的认知主体。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的出现是信息系统工程理论基础的转折点，它们挑战了长期以来构成我们对信息、表征和知识理解的本体论、认识论和符号学假设。因此，本文旨在对大型语言模型如何重构语言、意义和系统设计之间的关系进行整合性反思，并呼吁重新审视当代信息系统的概念基础。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种整合性的反思方法，通过借鉴从皮尔士到海德格尔和弗洛里迪的哲学传统，探讨生成模型逻辑如何扩展和动摇本体论和符号学的经典概念。
AI.result: 大型语言模型重新配置了语言、意义和系统设计之间的关系；它们的生成逻辑既扩展也动摇了本体论和符号学的经典概念。
AI.conclusion: 论文最终认为，大型语言模型不应仅仅被理解为自动化工具，而应被理解为重塑信息系统工程哲学和符号学基础的认知主体，并且需要将基于LLM的系统建立在透明、伦理一致的框架中，尊重以人为中心的知识过程的完整性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现代表了信息系统工程理论基础的一个转折点。除了其技术意义外，LLMs挑战了长期以来构建我们对信息、表征和知识理解的本体论、认识论和符号学假设。本文提出了一种整合性反思，探讨LLMs如何重构语言、意义和系统设计之间的关系，并表明它们的出现要求重新审视当代信息系统的概念基础。通过借鉴从皮尔士到海德格尔和弗洛里迪的哲学传统，我们研究了生成模型的逻辑如何既扩展又动摇了本体论和符号学的经典概念。讨论强调了将基于LLM的系统建立在透明、伦理一致的框架中的必要性，这些框架尊重以人为中心的知识过程的完整性。最终，论文认为LLMs不应仅仅被理解为自动化工具，而应被理解为重塑信息系统工程哲学和符号学基础的认知主体。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）对信息系统工程理论基础的深远影响。作者认为，LLMs不仅具有技术意义，更挑战了信息、表征和知识的本体论、认识论和符号学假设。通过借鉴哲学传统，论文分析了LLMs如何重构语言、意义与系统设计关系，并指出其生成逻辑扩展并动摇了经典本体论概念。文章强调需将LLM系统置于透明且符合伦理的框架中，最终主张将LLMs视为重塑信息系统工程哲学和符号学基础的认知主体，而非单纯的自动化工具。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 信息系统工程, 本体论, 哲学反思, 符号学
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于它超越了大型语言模型的技术层面，深入探讨了其在信息系统工程领域的哲学、本体论和符号学影响。它提供了一个重要的视角，提醒我们关注LLM带来的概念性挑战，并强调在设计和部署这些系统时，必须考虑伦理和以人为中心的知识过程的完整性。这对于指导未来LLM相关研究和应用具有重要意义。

title: FINER: MLLMs Hallucinate under Fine-grained Negative Queries
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with hallucinations, particularly with fine-grained queries, a challenge underrepresented by existing benchmarks that focus on coarse image-related questions. We introduce FIne-grained NEgative queRies (FINER), alongside two benchmarks: FINER-CompreCap and FINER-DOCCI. Using FINER, we analyze hallucinations across four settings: multi-object, multi-attribute, multi-relation, and ``what'' questions. Our benchmarks reveal that MLLMs hallucinate when fine-grained mismatches co-occur with genuinely present elements in the image. To address this, we propose FINER-Tuning, leveraging Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on FINER-inspired data. Finetuning four frontier MLLMs with FINER-Tuning yields up to 24.2\% gains (InternVL3.5-14B) on hallucinations from our benchmarks, while simultaneously improving performance on eight existing hallucination suites, and enhancing general multimodal capabilities across six benchmarks. Code, benchmark, and models are available at \href{https://explainableml.github.io/finer-project/}{https://explainableml.github.io/finer-project/}.

AI.title_translation: FINER：多模态大语言模型在细粒度负面查询下产生幻觉
AI.tldr: 现有基准未充分评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度查询下的幻觉问题。本文提出了FINER基准和FINER-Tuning方法，有效减少了MLLMs的幻觉并提升了多模态能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准未能充分评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度查询下的幻觉问题，特别是当细粒度不匹配与图像中真实存在的元素共同出现时，这一挑战在现有基准中未被充分体现。
AI.method: 引入了细粒度负面查询（FINER）以及两个新基准：FINER-CompreCap和FINER-DOCCI。通过FINER，分析了多对象、多属性、多关系和“什么”问题四种设置下的幻觉现象。为解决幻觉问题，提出了FINER-Tuning，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）在FINER启发的数据上对前沿MLLMs进行微调。
AI.result: FINER基准揭示了当细粒度不匹配与图像中真实存在的元素共同出现时，MLLMs会产生幻觉。使用FINER-Tuning对四个前沿MLLMs进行微调，在本文基准上的幻觉问题上取得了高达24.2%的性能提升（InternVL3.5-14B），同时改善了八个现有幻觉评估套件的性能，并增强了六个基准上的通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: FINER框架及其FINER-Tuning方法有效地揭示并缓解了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度负面查询下的幻觉问题，显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和通用多模态能力。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）存在幻觉问题，尤其是在细粒度查询下，而现有基准主要关注粗粒度的图像相关问题，未能充分体现这一挑战。我们引入了细粒度负面查询（FINER）以及两个基准：FINER-CompreCap和FINER-DOCCI。通过FINER，我们分析了多对象、多属性、多关系和“什么”问题四种设置下的幻觉。我们的基准揭示，当细粒度不匹配与图像中真实存在的元素共同出现时，MLLMs会产生幻觉。为解决这一问题，我们提出了FINER-Tuning，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）在FINER启发的数据上进行微调。使用FINER-Tuning对四个前沿MLLMs进行微调，在我们的基准上，幻觉问题上取得了高达24.2%的提升（InternVL3.5-14B），同时改善了八个现有幻觉评估套件的性能，并增强了六个基准上的通用多模态能力。代码、基准和模型可在https://explainableml.github.io/finer-project/ 获取。
AI.summary: 本文关注多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在细粒度负面查询下的幻觉问题，指出现有基准在此方面的不足。作者提出了FINER框架和两个新基准（FINER-CompreCap、FINER-DOCCI），并分析了MLLMs在细粒度不匹配与图像中真实元素共存时产生幻觉的现象。为解决此问题，论文提出FINER-Tuning方法，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）对模型进行微调。实验结果表明，FINER-Tuning显著减少了MLLMs在细粒度查询下的幻觉，并在多个现有幻觉评估和通用多模态基准上均有提升。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型, 幻觉, 细粒度查询, FINER, 直接偏好优化
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入细粒度负面查询和相应的基准，填补了现有幻态评估的空白，更深入地揭示了MLLMs产生幻觉的复杂机制。FINER-Tuning方法结合DPO，不仅有效缓解了细粒度幻觉，还展现了对模型通用能力的积极影响，具有重要的实践意义和创新性。

title: On the generic information capacity of relational schemas with a single binary relation
summary: We consider database schemas consisting of a single binary relation, with key constraints and inclusion dependencies. Over this space of 20 schemas, we completely characterize when one schema is generically dominated by another schema. Generic dominance, a classical notion for measuring information capacity, expresses that every instance of a schema can be uniquely represented in the dominating schema, through application of a deterministic, generic data transformation. Our investigation is motivated both by current interest in schema design for graph databases, as well as by intrinsic scientific interest. We also consider the ternary case, but without inclusion dependencies, and discuss how the notions change in the presence of object identifiers.

AI.title_translation: 关于具有单一二元关系的关係模式的通用信息容量
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在键约束和包含依赖下，具有单一二元关系的关係模式的通用信息容量，并完整刻画了一个模式何时被另一个模式通用支配，同时考虑了图数据库和三元情况。
AI.motivation: 研究动机来自于当前对图数据库模式设计的兴趣以及内在的科学兴趣。
AI.method: 本文研究了包含单一二元关系、键约束和包含依赖的数据库模式，并在20种模式空间中完全刻画了一个模式何时被另一个模式通用支配。通用支配通过确定性的通用数据转换，将一个模式的每个实例唯一地表示在支配模式中。还考虑了没有包含依赖的三元情况，并讨论了在存在对象标识符时概念如何变化。
AI.result: 在20种模式空间中，本文完全刻画了一个模式何时被另一个模式通用支配。
AI.conclusion: 本文完全刻画了在具有键约束和包含依赖的单一二元关系模式中，一个模式何时被另一个模式通用支配。
AI.translation: 我们考虑由单个二元关系组成的数据库模式，带有键约束和包含依赖。在20种模式的这个空间中，我们完全刻画了一个模式何时被另一个模式通用支配。通用支配是一种衡量信息容量的经典概念，它表示通过应用确定性的通用数据转换，一个模式的每个实例都可以在支配模式中唯一地表示。我们的研究动机既来自于当前对图数据库模式设计的兴趣，也来自于内在的科学兴趣。我们还考虑了三元情况，但没有包含依赖，并讨论了在存在对象标识符时这些概念如何变化。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在具有键约束和包含依赖的单一二元关系数据库模式中，模式间的通用信息容量。在20种模式的空间内，文章完整刻画了通用支配的条件，即一个模式的实例如何通过确定性转换唯一地表示在另一个模式中。研究动机源于图数据库模式设计和科学兴趣，并简要探讨了三元情况和对象标识符的影响。
AI.keywords: 通用信息容量, 关係模式, 二元关系, 键约束, 通用支配
AI.comments: 本文对具有单一二元关系的关係模式的通用信息容量进行了全面刻画，为信息容量的理论理解做出了重要贡献。其与图数据库模式设计的关联性表明了潜在的实际应用价值，尽管核心是理论研究。对三元情况和对象标识符的讨论为未来的研究方向提供了启发。

title: Physical Layer Security in Finite Blocklength Massive IoT with Randomly Located Eavesdroppers
summary: This paper analyzes the physical layer security performance of massive uplink Internet of Things (IoT) networks operating under the finite blocklength (FBL) regime. IoT devices and base stations (BS) are modeled using a stochastic geometry approach, while an eavesdropper is placed at a random location around the transmitting device. This system model captures security risks common in dense IoT deployments. Analytical expressions for the secure success probability, secrecy outage probability and secrecy throughput are derived to characterize how stochastic interference, fading and eavesdropper spatial uncertainty interact with FBL constraints in short packet uplink transmissions. Numerical results illustrate key system behavior under different network and channel conditions.

AI.title_translation: 有限块长度大规模物联网中随机位置窃听者的物理层安全
AI.tldr: 本文分析了有限块长度大规模物联网上行链路网络中，考虑随机位置窃听者的物理层安全性能。
AI.motivation: 为了捕捉密集物联网部署中常见的安全风险，并分析有限块长度下大规模物联网上行链路的物理层安全性能。
AI.method: 该研究使用随机几何方法对物联网设备和基站进行建模，并假设窃听者随机放置在传输设备周围。通过推导安全成功概率、保密中断概率和保密吞吐量的解析表达式来表征系统性能。
AI.result: 推导了表征随机干扰、衰落和窃听者空间不确定性与FBL约束在短包上行传输中相互作用的解析表达式。数值结果说明了在不同网络和信道条件下的关键系统行为。
AI.translation: 本文分析了在有限块长度（FBL）机制下运行的大规模上行物联网（IoT）网络的物理层安全性能。物联网设备和基站（BS）使用随机几何方法建模，而窃听者则随机放置在传输设备周围。该系统模型捕获了密集物联网部署中常见的安全风险。推导了安全成功概率、保密中断概率和保密吞吐量的解析表达式，以表征随机干扰、衰落和窃听者空间不确定性如何与短包上行传输中的FBL约束相互作用。数值结果说明了在不同网络和信道条件下的关键系统行为。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限块长度（FBL）机制下大规模上行物联网（IoT）网络的物理层安全性能。通过随机几何方法对物联网设备、基站和随机位置的窃听者进行建模，以捕捉密集IoT部署中的安全风险。论文推导了安全成功概率、保密中断概率和保密吞吐量的解析表达式，用以分析随机干扰、衰落、窃听者空间不确定性与FBL约束在短包传输中的相互作用。数值结果进一步阐明了系统在不同网络和信道条件下的关键行为。
AI.keywords: 物理层安全, 有限块长度, 大规模物联网, 随机几何, 窃听者
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合随机几何和有限块长度分析，为大规模物联网的物理层安全提供了深入的理论洞察，尤其关注了短包传输和窃听者的空间不确定性，这对于未来安全物联网系统的设计具有重要意义。

title: Halo: Domain-Aware Query Optimization for Long-Context Question Answering
summary:
Long-context question answering (QA) over lengthy documents is critical for applications such as financial analysis, legal review, and scientific research. Current approaches, such as processing entire documents via a single LLM call or retrieving relevant chunks via RAG have two drawbacks: First, as context size increases, response quality can degrade, impacting accuracy. Second, iteratively processing hundreds of input documents can incur prohibitively high costs in API calls. To improve response quality and reduce the number of iterations needed to get the desired response, users tend to add domain knowledge to their prompts. However, existing systems fail to systematically capture and use this knowledge to guide query processing. Domain knowledge is treated as prompt tokens alongside the document: the LLM may or may not follow it, there is no reduction in computational cost, and when outputs are incorrect, users must manually iterate.
  We present Halo, a long-context QA framework that automatically extracts domain knowledge from user prompts and applies it as executable operators across a multi-stage query execution pipeline. Halo identifies three common forms of domain knowledge - where in the document to look, what content to ignore, and how to verify the answer - and applies each at the pipeline stage where it is most effective: pruning the document before chunk selection, filtering irrelevant chunks before inference, and ranking candidate responses after generation. To handle imprecise or invalid domain knowledge, Halo includes a fallback mechanism that detects low-quality operators at runtime and selectively disables them. Our evaluation across finance, literature, and scientific datasets shows that Halo achieves up to 13% higher accuracy and 4.8x lower cost compared to baselines, and enables a lightweight open-source model to approach frontier LLM accuracy at 78x lower cost.

AI.title_translation: Halo: 领域感知查询优化，用于长上下文问答
AI.tldr: Halo是一个长上下文问答框架，它自动从用户提示中提取领域知识，并将其作为可执行操作符应用于多阶段查询执行管道，从而提高准确性并显著降低成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的长上下文问答方法在处理长文档时存在响应质量下降和API调用成本高昂的问题。用户虽会添加领域知识来改善，但现有系统未能系统地捕获和利用这些知识来指导查询处理，导致LLM不一定遵循、计算成本无降低且需要手动迭代。
AI.method: Halo框架自动从用户提示中提取领域知识，并将其作为可执行操作符应用于多阶段查询执行管道。它识别并利用三种领域知识：文档中查找的位置（在块选择前修剪文档）、要忽略的内容（在推理前过滤不相关块）和如何验证答案（在生成后对候选响应进行排名）。此外，Halo包含一个回退机制，用于处理不精确或无效的领域知识，通过运行时检测并选择性禁用低质量操作符。
AI.result: 在金融、文学和科学数据集上的评估显示，Halo的准确性比基线提高了13%，成本降低了4.8倍。它还使轻量级开源模型能够以78倍的成本优势接近前沿LLM的准确性。
AI.conclusion: Halo通过自动提取和应用领域知识，显著提高了长上下文问答的准确性，并大幅降低了成本，即使是轻量级模型也能达到接近前沿LLM的性能。
AI.translation:
长上下文问答（QA）在处理冗长文档时对于金融分析、法律审查和科学研究等应用至关重要。当前的方法，如通过单个大型语言模型（LLM）调用处理整个文档或通过检索增强生成（RAG）检索相关块，存在两个缺点：首先，随着上下文大小的增加，响应质量会下降，影响准确性。其次，迭代处理数百个输入文档可能会导致过高的API调用成本。为了提高响应质量并减少获得所需响应所需的迭代次数，用户倾向于在提示中添加领域知识。然而，现有系统未能系统地捕获和使用这些知识来指导查询处理。领域知识被视为与文档一起的提示令牌：LLM可能遵循也可能不遵循它，计算成本没有降低，并且当输出不正确时，用户必须手动迭代。
我们提出了Halo，一个长上下文问答框架，它自动从用户提示中提取领域知识，并将其作为可执行操作符应用于多阶段查询执行管道。Halo识别了三种常见的领域知识形式——在文档中查找的位置、要忽略的内容以及如何验证答案——并将其分别应用于最有效的管道阶段：在块选择之前修剪文档、在推理之前过滤不相关块以及在生成之后对候选响应进行排名。为了处理不精确或无效的领域知识，Halo包含一个回退机制，该机制在运行时检测低质量操作符并选择性地禁用它们。我们对金融、文学和科学数据集的评估表明，与基线相比，Halo的准确性提高了13%，成本降低了4.8倍，并使轻量级开源模型能够以78倍的成本优势接近前沿LLM的准确性。
AI.summary: Halo是一个创新的长上下文问答框架，旨在解决现有方法在处理长文档时响应质量下降和成本高昂的问题。它通过自动从用户提示中提取领域知识，并将其智能地应用于多阶段查询执行管道（包括文档修剪、块过滤和答案排名）来优化查询。此外，Halo还具备处理不精确领域知识的回退机制。实验证明，Halo显著提高了问答准确性并大幅降低了计算成本，甚至使小型模型也能达到高性能。
AI.keywords: 长上下文问答, 领域知识, 查询优化, 多阶段管道, 成本效率
AI.comments: Halo的创新之处在于系统地将领域知识转化为可执行操作符，并将其集成到多阶段查询管道中，而不是仅仅作为LLM的提示令牌。这种方法不仅提高了准确性，还显著降低了计算成本，尤其是在使用轻量级模型时展现出强大的潜力，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。回退机制的设计也增加了系统的鲁棒性。

title: AgentVLN: Towards Agentic Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to ground complex natural-language instructions into long-horizon navigation in unseen environments. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer strong 2D semantic understanding, current VLN systems remain constrained by limited spatial perception, 2D-3D representation mismatch, and monocular scale ambiguity. In this paper, we propose AgentVLN, a novel and efficient embodied navigation framework that can be deployed on edge computing platforms. We formulate VLN as a Partially Observable Semi-Markov Decision Process (POSMDP) and introduce a VLM-as-Brain paradigm that decouples high-level semantic reasoning from perception and planning via a plug-and-play skill library. To resolve multi-level representation inconsistency, we design a cross-space representation mapping that projects perception-layer 3D topological waypoints into the image plane, yielding pixel-aligned visual prompts for the VLM. Building on this bridge, we integrate a context-aware self-correction and active exploration strategy to recover from occlusions and suppress error accumulation over long trajectories. To further address the spatial ambiguity of instructions in unstructured environments, we propose a Query-Driven Perceptual Chain-of-Thought (QD-PCoT) scheme, enabling the agent with the metacognitive ability to actively seek geometric depth information. Finally, we construct AgentVLN-Instruct, a large-scale instruction-tuning dataset with dynamic stage routing conditioned on target visibility. Extensive experiments show that AgentVLN consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods (SOTA) on long-horizon VLN benchmarks, offering a practical paradigm for lightweight deployment of next-generation embodied navigation models. Code: https://github.com/Allenxinn/AgentVLN.

AI.title_translation: AgentVLN：迈向具身视觉与语言导航
AI.tldr: AgentVLN提出了一种新颖高效的具身导航框架，通过将VLM作为大脑，解决现有VLN系统在空间感知、2D-3D表示不匹配和单目尺度模糊性方面的限制，并在长距离VLN基准测试中超越了现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉与语言导航（VLN）系统受限于空间感知能力不足、2D-3D表示不匹配以及单目尺度模糊性，尽管视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了强大的2D语义理解能力。
AI.method: AgentVLN将VLN建模为部分可观察半马尔可夫决策过程（POSMDP），并引入了“VLM即大脑”范式，通过可插拔技能库解耦了高级语义推理与感知规划。为解决多级表示不一致性，设计了跨空间表示映射，将感知层3D拓扑路点投影到图像平面，为VLM生成像素对齐的视觉提示。在此基础上，集成了上下文感知自校正和主动探索策略。为解决非结构化环境中指令的空间模糊性，提出了查询驱动感知思维链（QD-PCoT）方案。最后，构建了大规模指令微调数据集AgentVLN-Instruct。
AI.result: AgentVLN在长距离VLN基准测试中持续超越了现有的最先进方法（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: AgentVLN为下一代具身导航模型的轻量级部署提供了一个实用的范式。
AI.translation: 视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体将复杂的自然语言指令，在未知环境中转化为长距离导航。尽管视觉语言模型（VLMs）提供了强大的2D语义理解能力，但当前的VLN系统仍受限于有限的空间感知、2D-3D表示不匹配以及单目尺度模糊性。在本文中，我们提出了AgentVLN，一个新颖高效的具身导航框架，可部署在边缘计算平台上。我们将VLN建模为部分可观察半马尔可夫决策过程（POSMDP），并引入了“VLM即大脑”范式，通过可插拔技能库将高级语义推理与感知和规划解耦。为解决多级表示不一致性，我们设计了跨空间表示映射，将感知层3D拓扑路点投影到图像平面，为VLM生成像素对齐的视觉提示。在此基础上，我们集成了上下文感知自校正和主动探索策略，以从遮挡中恢复并抑制长轨迹上的误差累积。为进一步解决非结构化环境中指令的空间模糊性，我们提出了查询驱动感知思维链（QD-PCoT）方案，使智能体具备主动寻求几何深度信息的元认知能力。最后，我们构建了AgentVLN-Instruct，一个大规模的指令微调数据集，其动态阶段路由以目标可见性为条件。广泛的实验表明，AgentVLN在长距离VLN基准测试中持续超越了现有的最先进方法（SOTA），为下一代具身导航模型的轻量级部署提供了一个实用的范式。代码：https://github.com/Allenxinn/AgentVLN。
AI.summary: AgentVLN是一个针对视觉与语言导航（VLN）任务提出的新型高效具身导航框架，旨在解决现有系统在空间感知、2D-3D表示不匹配和单目尺度模糊性方面的局限。该框架将VLN视为部分可观察半马尔可夫决策过程，并采用“VLM即大脑”范式，通过技能库实现语义推理与感知规划的解耦。通过跨空间表示映射、上下文感知自校正、主动探索策略以及查询驱动感知思维链（QD-PCoT），AgentVLN有效处理多级表示不一致性和指令空间模糊性。结合大规模指令微调数据集AgentVLN-Instruct，该方法在长距离VLN基准测试中表现优异，为轻量级部署下一代具身导航模型提供了实用方案。
AI.keywords: 视觉与语言导航, 具身智能体, VLM, 边缘计算, 查询驱动感知思维链
AI.comments: AgentVLN的创新点在于其“VLM即大脑”范式，通过解耦高级语义推理与感知规划，并结合跨空间表示映射和上下文感知自校正策略，有效解决了VLN中的关键挑战。特别是QD-PCoT方案，赋予智能体主动获取几何深度信息的能力，增强了在复杂环境中的导航鲁棒性。该框架的边缘计算平台部署潜力以及在长距离VLN任务上的SOTA表现，预示着其在实际具身AI应用中的重要价值。

title: Few-Step Diffusion Sampling Through Instance-Aware Discretizations
summary: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-fidelity data by simulating paths defined by Ordinary or Stochastic Differential Equations (ODEs/SDEs), starting from a tractable prior distribution. The probability flow ODE formulation enables the use of advanced numerical solvers to accelerate sampling. Orthogonal yet vital to solver design is the discretization strategy. While early approaches employed handcrafted heuristics and recent methods adopt optimization-based techniques, most existing strategies enforce a globally shared timestep schedule across all samples. This uniform treatment fails to account for instance-specific complexity in the generative process, potentially limiting performance. Motivated by controlled experiments on synthetic data, which reveals the suboptimality of global schedules under instance-specific dynamics, we propose an instance-aware discretization framework. Our method learns to adapt timestep allocations based on input-dependent priors, extending gradient-based discretization search to the conditional generative setting. Empirical results across diverse settings, including synthetic data, pixel-space diffusion, latent-space images and video flow matching models, demonstrate that our method consistently improves generation quality with marginal tuning cost compared to training and negligible inference overhead.

AI.title_translation: 通过实例感知离散化实现少步扩散采样
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种实例感知离散化框架，通过学习根据输入相关先验调整时间步分配，从而在扩散和流匹配模型中以更少的采样步骤提高生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散和流匹配模型在采样时采用全局共享的时间步调度，未能考虑到生成过程中实例特定的复杂性，这可能限制性能。受合成数据受控实验的启发，该实验揭示了在实例特定动态下全局调度的次优性。
AI.method: 我们提出了一个实例感知离散化框架。该方法学习根据输入相关的先验调整时间步分配，并将基于梯度的离散化搜索扩展到条件生成设置。
AI.result: 在包括合成数据、像素空间扩散、潜在空间图像和视频流匹配模型在内的多种设置中，我们的方法与训练相比，以边际的调优成本持续提高了生成质量，并且推理开销可以忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过实例感知离散化，我们可以显著提高扩散和流匹配模型的生成质量，同时保持低推理开销和训练成本。
AI.translation: 扩散和流匹配模型通过模拟由常微分方程（ODE）或随机微分方程（SDE）定义的路径，从可处理的先验分布开始生成高保真数据。概率流ODE公式使得可以使用先进的数值求解器来加速采样。与求解器设计正交但至关重要的是离散化策略。虽然早期方法采用手工启发式方法，近期方法采用基于优化的技术，但大多数现有策略强制在所有样本中实施全局共享的时间步调度。这种统一处理未能考虑到生成过程中实例特定的复杂性，可能限制性能。受合成数据受控实验的启发（该实验揭示了在实例特定动态下全局调度的次优性），我们提出了一个实例感知离散化框架。我们的方法学习根据输入相关的先验调整时间步分配，将基于梯度的离散化搜索扩展到条件生成设置。在包括合成数据、像素空间扩散、潜在空间图像和视频流匹配模型在内的多种设置中，经验结果表明，与训练相比，我们的方法以边际的调优成本持续提高了生成质量，并且推理开销可以忽略不计。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种实例感知离散化框架，用于改进扩散和流匹配模型的采样效率和生成质量。传统方法采用全局共享的时间步调度，未能适应实例特有的复杂性。通过学习根据输入相关先验动态调整时间步分配，该方法将基于梯度的离散化搜索扩展到条件生成设置。实验证明，与现有方法相比，该框架在多种数据类型上以极低的调优和推理成本显著提升了生成质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 流匹配, 实例感知离散化, 采样加速, 生成质量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了实例感知的离散化策略，解决了现有扩散模型中全局时间步调度无法适应实例特定复杂性的问题。通过将离散化搜索扩展到条件生成设置，并利用输入相关先验来动态调整时间步，显著提高了生成质量，同时保持了较低的计算成本。这对于加速高保真数据生成具有重要意义。

title: Consistency-Driven Dual LSTM Models for Kinematic Control of a Wearable Soft Robotic Arm
summary: In this paper, we introduce a consistency-driven dual LSTM framework for accurately learning both the forward and inverse kinematics of a pneumatically actuated soft robotic arm integrated into a wearable device. This approach effectively captures the nonlinear and hysteretic behaviors of soft pneumatic actuators while addressing the one-to-many mapping challenge between actuation inputs and end-effector positions. By incorporating a cycle consistency loss, we enhance physical realism and improve the stability of inverse predictions. Extensive experiments-including trajectory tracking, ablation studies, and wearable demonstrations-confirm the effectiveness of our method. Results indicate that the inclusion of the consistency loss significantly boosts prediction accuracy and promotes physical consistency over conventional approaches. Moreover, the wearable soft robotic arm demonstrates strong human-robot collaboration capabilities and adaptability in everyday tasks such as object handover, obstacle-aware pick-and-place, and drawer operation. This work underscores the promising potential of learning-based kinematic models for human-centric, wearable robotic systems.

AI.title_translation: 一致性驱动的双LSTM模型用于可穿戴软机械臂的运动学控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于一致性驱动的双LSTM框架，用于学习可穿戴软机械臂的正向和逆向运动学，有效处理非线性和滞后行为，并通过循环一致性损失提高预测精度和稳定性，实验证明其在人机协作和日常任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决气动软执行器的非线性和滞后行为，以及驱动输入与末端执行器位置之间的一对多映射挑战，从而实现可穿戴软机械臂的精确运动学控制。
AI.method: 引入一个一致性驱动的双LSTM框架，用于学习气动软机械臂的正向和逆向运动学。该方法通过结合循环一致性损失来增强物理真实性并提高逆向预测的稳定性。
AI.result: 实验证明，引入一致性损失显著提高了预测精度，并促进了比传统方法更高的物理一致性。可穿戴软机械臂在物体递送、避障抓取放置和抽屉操作等日常任务中表现出强大的人机协作能力和适应性。
AI.conclusion: 学习型运动学模型在以人为中心的可穿戴机器人系统方面具有广阔前景。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们介绍了一种一致性驱动的双LSTM框架，用于精确学习集成到可穿戴设备中的气动软机械臂的正向和逆向运动学。这种方法有效地捕捉了软气动执行器的非线性和滞后行为，同时解决了驱动输入和末端执行器位置之间的一对多映射挑战。通过引入循环一致性损失，我们增强了物理真实性并提高了逆向预测的稳定性。广泛的实验——包括轨迹跟踪、消融研究和可穿戴演示——证实了我们方法的有效性。结果表明，包含一致性损失显著提高了预测精度，并促进了比传统方法更高的物理一致性。此外，可穿戴软机械臂在物体递送、避障抓取放置和抽屉操作等日常任务中展示出强大的人机协作能力和适应性。这项工作强调了学习型运动学模型在以人为中心的可穿戴机器人系统方面的巨大潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于一致性驱动的双LSTM框架，用于解决可穿戴气动软机械臂的运动学控制问题。该框架能有效处理软执行器的非线性和滞后特性，并通过引入循环一致性损失，提高了正向和逆向运动学学习的准确性和预测稳定性。实验结果表明，该方法在提升预测精度和物理一致性方面优于传统方法，并展示了可穿戴软机械臂在人机协作和日常任务中的良好适应性。
AI.keywords: 软机械臂, 运动学控制, LSTM, 一致性损失, 可穿戴机器人
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个一致性驱动的双LSTM框架，并引入了循环一致性损失，以解决软机器人运动学中的非线性和一对多映射问题。这种方法显著提高了软机械臂的预测精度和物理一致性，对于推动以人为中心的可穿戴机器人系统的发展具有重要意义。其在日常任务中的演示也展现了实际应用潜力。

title: Post-Training Local LLM Agents for Linux Privilege Escalation with Verifiable Rewards
summary: LLM agents are increasingly relevant to research domains such as vulnerability discovery. Yet, the strongest systems remain closed and cloud-only, making them resource-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and unsuitable for work involving proprietary code or sensitive data. Consequently, there is an urgent need for small, local models that can perform security tasks under strict resource budgets, but methods for developing them remain underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by proposing a two-stage post-training pipeline. We focus on the problem of Linux privilege escalation, where success is automatically verifiable and the task requires multi-step interactive reasoning. Using an experimental setup that prevents data leakage, we post-train a 4B model in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on traces from procedurally generated privilege-escalation environments, followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. On a held-out benchmark of 12 Linux privilege-escalation scenarios, supervised fine-tuning alone more than doubles the baseline success rate at 20 rounds, and reinforcement learning further lifts our resulting model, PrivEsc-LLM, to 95.8%, nearly matching Claude Opus 4.6 at 97.5%. At the same time, the expected inference cost per successful escalation is reduced by over 100x.

AI.title_translation: 用于Linux权限提升的后训练本地LLM代理，具有可验证奖励
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段后训练方法，用于开发小型、本地的LLM代理，以在资源有限的情况下执行Linux权限提升任务，并在性能上接近大型云模型，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的最强LLM系统是封闭且仅限云端的，资源密集、难以复现，且不适用于涉及专有代码或敏感数据的任务。因此，迫切需要小型、本地模型能够在严格的资源预算下执行安全任务，但相关开发方法尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段后训练管道。第一阶段是在程序生成的权限提升环境的轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）。第二阶段是使用可验证奖励进行强化学习（RL）。实验设置旨在防止数据泄露，并使用一个4B模型进行训练。
AI.result: 在20轮测试中，仅SFT就将基线成功率提高了一倍以上。经过RL进一步训练后，最终模型PrivEsc-LLM在12个Linux权限提升场景的基准测试中达到了95.8%的成功率，接近Claude Opus 4.6的97.5%。同时，每次成功提升的预期推理成本降低了100倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 通过两阶段的后训练方法，可以开发出在Linux权限提升任务中表现出色的小型本地LLM代理，其性能接近大型云模型，并在成本效益上具有显著优势。
AI.translation: LLM代理在漏洞发现等研究领域中日益重要。然而，最强大的系统仍然是封闭且仅限云端的，这使得它们资源密集、难以复现，并且不适用于涉及专有代码或敏感数据的工作。因此，迫切需要小型、本地模型能够在严格的资源预算下执行安全任务，但开发它们的方法仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们通过提出一个两阶段的后训练流程来解决这一差距。我们专注于Linux权限提升问题，其中成功是可自动验证的，并且任务需要多步交互式推理。我们使用一个防止数据泄露的实验设置，分两个阶段对一个4B模型进行后训练：首先在程序生成的权限提升环境的轨迹上进行监督微调，然后使用可验证奖励进行强化学习。在12个Linux权限提升场景的保留基准测试中，仅监督微调就在20轮测试中将基线成功率提高了一倍以上，而强化学习进一步将我们的模型PrivEsc-LLM提升至95.8%，几乎与Claude Opus 4.6的97.5%持平。同时，每次成功提升的预期推理成本降低了100倍以上。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种两阶段的后训练流程，用于开发小型、本地的LLM代理，以解决Linux权限提升问题。该方法结合了在程序生成环境轨迹上的监督微调和基于可验证奖励的强化学习。实验结果表明，该模型（PrivEsc-LLM）在性能上接近大型云模型（如Claude Opus 4.6），成功率达到95.8%，同时将推理成本降低了100多倍，证明了小型本地模型在资源受限的安全任务中的潜力。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 权限提升, 后训练, 监督微调, 强化学习
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新在于提出了一种有效的两阶段后训练管道，使得小型本地LLM代理能够在复杂的安全任务（如Linux权限提升）中达到接近大型云模型的性能，同时大幅降低了资源消耗和成本。这对于需要在本地处理敏感数据或受资源限制的环境中部署LLM代理具有重要意义，解决了当前LLM应用中“封闭、云端、资源密集”的痛点。

title: DeepCORO-CLIP: A Multi-View Foundation Model for Comprehensive Coronary Angiography Video-Text Analysis and External Validation
summary: Coronary angiography is the reference standard for evaluating coronary artery disease, yet visual interpretation remains variable between readers. Existing artificial intelligence methods typically analyze single frames or projections and focus mainly on stenosis, limiting comprehensive coronary assessment. We present DeepCORO-CLIP, a multi-view foundation model trained with video-text contrastive learning on 203,808 angiography videos from 28,117 patients across 32,473 studies at the Montreal Heart Institute and externally validated on 4,249 studies from the University of California, San Francisco. DeepCORO-CLIP integrates multiple projections with attention-based pooling for study-level assessment across diagnostic, prognostic, and disease progression tasks. For significant stenosis detection, the model achieved an AUROC of 0.888 internally and 0.89 on external validation. Mean absolute error against core laboratory quantitative coronary angiography was 13.6%, lower than clinical reports at 19.0%. The model also performed strongly for chronic total occlusion, intracoronary thrombus, and coronary calcification detection. Transfer learning enabled prediction of one-year major adverse cardiovascular events with AUROC 0.79 and estimation of left ventricular ejection fraction with mean absolute error 7.3%. Embeddings also captured disease progression across serial examinations. With a mean inference time of 4.2 seconds in hospital deployment, DeepCORO-CLIP provides a foundation for automated coronary angiography interpretation at the point of care. Code, sample data, model weights, and deployment infrastructure are publicly released.

AI.title_translation: DeepCORO-CLIP：一个用于全面冠状动脉造影视频文本分析和外部验证的多视图基础模型
AI.tldr: DeepCORO-CLIP是一个多视图基础模型，通过视频-文本对比学习对大量冠状动脉造影视频进行训练，实现了对冠状动脉疾病的全面评估，并在多项任务上表现出色，包括狭窄检测、预后预测和疾病进展跟踪，且已在临床部署中验证其效率。
AI.motivation: 冠状动脉造影是评估冠状动脉疾病的参考标准，但人工判读存在变异性。现有AI方法通常只分析单帧或单投影，且主要关注狭窄，限制了全面的冠状动脉评估。
AI.method: 提出DeepCORO-CLIP，一个多视图基础模型，通过视频-文本对比学习在203,808个造影视频上进行训练。该模型整合多个投影，并使用基于注意力的池化进行研究级别的评估，以完成诊断、预后和疾病进展任务。
AI.result: 在显著狭窄检测中，内部AUROC为0.888，外部验证AUROC为0.89。与核心实验室定量冠状动脉造影的平均绝对误差为13.6%，低于临床报告的19.0%。在慢性完全闭塞、冠状动脉内血栓和冠状动脉钙化检测中表现良好。迁移学习使得一年主要不良心血管事件的预测AUROC达到0.79，左心室射血分数估计的平均绝对误差为7.3%。嵌入还捕捉到连续检查中的疾病进展。平均推理时间为4.2秒。
AI.conclusion: DeepCORO-CLIP为在护理点实现自动化冠状动脉造影判读提供了一个基础。其代码、样本数据、模型权重和部署基础设施已公开发布。
AI.translation: 冠状动脉造影是评估冠状动脉疾病的参考标准，但视觉判读在不同判读人之间存在差异。现有的S人工智能方法通常分析单帧或单投影，并且主要关注狭窄，这限制了全面的冠状动脉评估。我们提出了DeepCORO-CLIP，这是一个多视图基础模型，通过视频-文本对比学习，在蒙特利尔心脏研究所的28,117名患者的32,473项研究中，对203,808个造影视频进行了训练，并在加州大学旧金山分校的4,249项研究中进行了外部验证。DeepCORO-CLIP通过基于注意力的池化整合多个投影，以进行诊断、预后和疾病进展任务的研究级别评估。对于显著狭窄检测，该模型在内部实现了0.888的AUROC，在外部验证中实现了0.89的AUROC。与核心实验室定量冠状动脉造影的平均绝对误差为13.6%，低于临床报告的19.0%。该模型在慢性完全闭塞、冠状动脉内血栓和冠状动脉钙化检测方面也表现出色。迁移学习使得一年主要不良心血管事件的预测AUROC达到0.79，左心室射血分数估计的平均绝对误差为7.3%。嵌入还捕捉到连续检查中的疾病进展。DeepCORO-CLIP在医院部署中的平均推理时间为4.2秒，为护理点的自动化冠状动脉造影判读提供了一个基础。代码、样本数据、模型权重和部署基础设施已公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeepCORO-CLIP，一个创新的多视图基础模型，利用视频-文本对比学习对大规模冠状动脉造影视频进行训练。该模型旨在克服传统AI方法在全面评估冠状动脉疾病方面的局限性，通过整合多投影和注意力机制，实现了对狭窄检测、慢性完全闭塞、血栓、钙化以及预后（MACE）和左心室射血分数（LVEF）预测的综合评估。模型在内部和外部验证中均表现出优异性能，且推理速度快，为临床护理点自动化冠状动脉造影判读奠定了基础，并公开了相关资源。
AI.keywords: 冠状动脉造影, 基础模型, 视频-文本分析, 多视图, 深度学习
AI.comments: DeepCORO-CLIP的创新之处在于其作为首个多视图基础模型，将视频-文本对比学习应用于冠状动脉造影分析，实现了从单一病变检测到全面疾病评估和预后预测的飞跃。其大规模数据集训练和严格的外部验证增强了模型的泛化能力和临床实用性。快速的推理时间和资源的公开进一步提升了其在临床部署中的潜力和对未来研究的推动作用。

title: Adaptive Guidance for Retrieval-Augmented Masked Diffusion Models
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves factual grounding by incorporating external knowledge into language model generation. However, when retrieved context is noisy, unreliable, or inconsistent with the model's parametric knowledge, it introduces retrieval-prior conflicts that can degrade generation quality. While this problem has been studied in autoregressive language models, it remains largely unexplored in diffusion-based language models, where the iterative denoising process introduces unique challenges for integrating retrieved context. In this work, we propose Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Masked Diffusion (ARAM), a training-free adaptive guidance framework for Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) in RAG settings. ARAM dynamically calibrates the guidance scale during denoising according to the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) of the distributional shift induced by retrieved context. Intuitively, the model strengthens guidance when the retrieved context provides reliable corrective evidence and suppresses it when the contextual signal is noisy or non-supportive. Extensive experiments on multiple knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks show that ARAM improves overall QA performance over competitive RAG baselines.

AI.title_translation: 检索增强型掩码扩散模型的自适应引导
AI.tldr: 本文提出ARAM，一个无需训练的自适应引导框架，用于解决检索增强型掩码扩散模型中由噪声检索上下文引起的检索-先验冲突，通过动态调整引导强度，显著提高了知识密集型问答任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）在语言模型中引入外部知识以提高事实基础，但当检索到的上下文嘈杂、不可靠或与模型参数知识不一致时，会引入检索-先验冲突，从而降低生成质量。这个问题在自回归语言模型中已有研究，但在扩散型语言模型中，由于迭代去噪过程，其整合检索上下文面临独特的挑战，因此仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 本文提出了自适应检索增强型掩码扩散（ARAM），一个在RAG设置下用于掩码扩散模型（MDM）的无需训练的自适应引导框架。ARAM根据检索上下文引起的分布偏移的信噪比（SNR），在去噪过程中动态校准引导强度。直观上，当检索上下文提供可靠的修正证据时，模型会增强引导；当上下文信号嘈杂或不支持时，则会抑制引导。
AI.result: 在多个知识密集型问答基准上的大量实验表明，ARAM在整体问答性能上优于有竞争力的RAG基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的ARAM框架通过自适应引导策略，有效地解决了检索增强型掩码扩散模型中由噪声检索上下文引起的检索-先验冲突问题，显著提高了知识密集型问答任务的性能。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识整合到语言模型生成中来改善事实基础。然而，当检索到的上下文嘈杂、不可靠或与模型的参数知识不一致时，会引入检索-先验冲突，从而降低生成质量。虽然这个问题已在自回归语言模型中得到研究，但在基于扩散的语言模型中，由于迭代去噪过程引入了整合检索上下文的独特挑战，因此在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了自适应检索增强型掩码扩散（ARAM），一个在RAG设置下用于掩码扩散模型（MDM）的无需训练的自适应引导框架。ARAM根据检索上下文引起的分布偏移的信噪比（SNR），在去噪过程中动态校准引导强度。直观上，当检索上下文提供可靠的修正证据时，模型会增强引导；当上下文信号嘈杂或不支持时，则会抑制引导。在多个知识密集型问答基准上的大量实验表明，ARAM在整体问答性能上优于有竞争力的RAG基线模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对检索增强生成（RAG）中检索上下文噪声导致的生成质量下降问题，特别是在扩散型语言模型中，提出了一个名为ARAM的无需训练的自适应引导框架。ARAM通过根据检索上下文引起的分布偏移的信噪比（SNR）动态调整引导强度，来解决检索-先验冲突。实验结果表明，ARAM在知识密集型问答任务上显著优于现有RAG基线模型。
AI.keywords: 自适应引导, 检索增强生成, 掩码扩散模型, 信噪比, 知识问答
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于首次将自适应引导机制引入到检索增强型掩码扩散模型中，以解决RAG设置下的检索-先验冲突问题。其提出的ARAM框架无需训练，通过动态调整引导强度，有效地利用了检索上下文的可靠信息，并抑制了噪声影响，这对于提升扩散模型在知识密集型任务中的性能具有重要意义。

title: Illumination-Aware Contactless Fingerprint Spoof Detection via Paired Flash-Non-Flash Imaging
comments: Accepted at IWBF 2026 (14th International Workshop on Biometrics and Forensics)
summary: Contactless fingerprint recognition enables hygienic and convenient biometric authentication but poses new challenges for spoof detection due to the absence of physical contact and traditional liveness cues. Most existing methods rely on single-image acquisition and appearance-based features, which often generalize poorly across devices, capture conditions, and spoof materials. In this work, we study paired flash-non-flash contactless fingerprint acquisition as a lightweight active sensing mechanism for spoof detection. Through a preliminary empirical analysis, we show that flash illumination accentuates material- and structure-dependent properties, including ridge visibility, subsurface scattering, micro-geometry, and surface oils, while non-flash images provide a baseline appearance context. We analyze lighting-induced differences using interpretable metrics such as inter-channel correlation, specular reflection characteristics, texture realism, and differential imaging. These complementary features help discriminate genuine fingerprints from printed, digital, and molded presentation attacks. We further examine the limitations of paired acquisition, including sensitivity to imaging settings, dataset scale, and emerging high-fidelity spoofs. Our findings demonstrate the potential of illumination-aware analysis to improve robustness and interpretability in contactless fingerprint presentation attack detection, motivating future work on paired acquisition and physics-informed feature design. Code is available in the repository.
comment: Accepted at IWBF 2026 (14th International Workshop on Biometrics and Forensics)

AI.title_translation: 基于成对闪光-非闪光成像的照明感知非接触式指纹欺骗检测
AI.tldr: 通过成对闪光-非闪光成像，利用照明差异来检测非接触式指纹欺骗，提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 非接触式指纹识别虽然卫生便捷，但由于缺乏物理接触和传统活体线索，给欺骗检测带来了新挑战。大多数现有方法依赖于单图像采集和基于外观的特征，泛化能力差。
AI.method: 该研究采用成对闪光-非闪光非接触式指纹采集作为轻量级主动感知机制。通过分析闪光引起的差异，使用可解释的度量，如通道间相关性、镜面反射特性、纹理真实性和差分成像。
AI.result: 初步实证分析表明，闪光照明能突出材料和结构依赖的特性，而非闪光图像提供基线外观。这些互补特征有助于区分真实指纹与打印、数字和模制演示攻击。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，照明感知分析在非接触式指纹演示攻击检测中具有提高鲁棒性和可解释性的潜力，并鼓励未来在成对采集和物理信息特征设计方面的工作。
AI.translation: 非接触式指纹识别实现了卫生便捷的生物特征认证，但由于缺乏物理接触和传统的活体线索，给欺骗检测带来了新的挑战。大多数现有方法依赖于单图像采集和基于外观的特征，这往往在设备、捕获条件和欺骗材料之间泛化能力较差。在这项工作中，我们研究了成对闪光-非闪光非接触式指纹采集作为一种轻量级的主动感知机制，用于欺骗检测。通过初步的实证分析，我们表明闪光照明突出了材料和结构相关的特性，包括指纹脊可见度、亚表面散射、微几何结构和表面油脂，而非闪光图像则提供了基线外观背景。我们使用可解释的度量（如通道间相关性、镜面反射特性、纹理真实性和差分成像）来分析照明引起的差异。这些互补特征有助于区分真实指纹与打印、数字和模制演示攻击。我们进一步检查了成对采集的局限性，包括对成像设置、数据集规模和新兴高保真欺骗的敏感性。我们的研究结果证明了照明感知分析在提高非接触式指纹演示攻击检测的鲁棒性和可解释性方面的潜力，从而激励了未来在成对采集和物理信息特征设计方面的工作。代码可在存储库中找到。
AI.summary: 本文通过提出一种利用成对闪光-非闪光成像的新方法，解决了非接触式指纹识别中的欺骗检测挑战。该方法通过分析闪光照明与非闪光图像相比所强化的材料和结构相关特性的差异，提取互补特征，如通道间相关性和镜面反射。这种方法能有效区分真实指纹与各种演示攻击，展示了非接触式指纹欺骗检测中更高的鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.keywords: 非接触式指纹, 欺骗检测, 闪光-非闪光成像, 照明感知, 演示攻击检测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于使用成对闪光-非闪光成像作为一种主动感知机制，以揭示材料相关的特性，超越了传统的单图像外观特征方法。这种方法提高了非接触式指纹欺骗检测的鲁棒性和可解释性，对生物识别系统的可靠性至关重要。论文也指出了局限性，包括对成像设置、数据集规模和新兴高保真欺骗的敏感性。

title: WeatherReasonSeg: A Benchmark for Weather-Aware Reasoning Segmentation in Visual Language Models
summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in reasoning-based segmentation. However, current benchmarks are primarily constructed from high-quality images captured under idealized conditions. This raises a critical question: when visual cues are severely degraded by adverse weather conditions such as rain, snow, or fog, can VLMs sustain reliable reasoning segmentation capabilities? In response to this challenge, we introduce WeatherReasonSeg, a benchmark designed to evaluate VLM performance in reasoning-based segmentation under adverse weather conditions. It consists of two complementary components. First, we construct a controllable reasoning dataset by applying synthetic weather with varying severity levels to existing segmentation datasets, enabling fine-grained robustness analysis. Second, to capture real-world complexity, we curate a real-world adverse-weather reasoning segmentation dataset with semantically consistent queries generated via mask-guided LLM prompting. We further broaden the evaluation scope across five reasoning dimensions, including functionality, application scenarios, structural attributes, interactions, and requirement matching. Extensive experiments across diverse VLMs reveal two key findings: (1) VLM performance degrades monotonically with increasing weather severity, and (2) different weather types induce distinct vulnerability patterns. We hope WeatherReasonSeg will serve as a foundation for advancing robust, weather-aware reasoning.

AI.title_translation: WeatherReasonSeg：一个用于视觉语言模型中天气感知推理分割的基准
AI.tldr: WeatherReasonSeg是一个新基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在恶劣天气条件下进行推理分割的性能，发现模型性能随天气恶劣程度增加而单调下降，且不同天气类型导致不同的脆弱性模式。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在推理分割方面表现出色，但其基准主要基于理想条件下的高质量图像。当视觉线索因恶劣天气（如雨、雪、雾）严重退化时，视觉语言模型能否保持可靠的推理分割能力是一个关键问题。
AI.method: 引入WeatherReasonSeg基准，包含两个互补部分：1) 通过对现有分割数据集应用不同严重程度的合成天气，构建可控推理数据集；2) 策划一个真实世界的恶劣天气推理分割数据集，并通过掩码引导的LLM提示生成语义一致的查询。此外，将评估范围扩展到功能、应用场景、结构属性、交互和需求匹配五个推理维度。
AI.result: 广泛的实验揭示了两个关键发现：1) 视觉语言模型性能随天气恶劣程度的增加而单调下降；2) 不同的天气类型会引发独特的脆弱性模式。
AI.conclusion: WeatherReasonSeg有望成为推动鲁棒、天气感知推理的基础。
AI.translation: 现有视觉语言模型（VLMs）在基于推理的分割方面表现出令人印象深刻的性能。然而，当前的基准主要由在理想条件下捕获的高质量图像构建。这引出了一个关键问题：当视觉线索因雨、雪或雾等恶劣天气条件而严重退化时，VLMs能否保持可靠的推理分割能力？为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了WeatherReasonSeg，这是一个旨在评估VLM在恶劣天气条件下基于推理的分割性能的基准。它由两个互补的组成部分。首先，我们通过对现有分割数据集应用不同严重程度的合成天气来构建一个可控的推理数据集，从而实现细粒度的鲁棒性分析。其次，为了捕捉真实世界的复杂性，我们策划了一个真实世界的恶劣天气推理分割数据集，其中通过掩码引导的LLM提示生成语义一致的查询。我们进一步将评估范围扩展到五个推理维度，包括功能性、应用场景、结构属性、交互和需求匹配。对各种VLM进行的广泛实验揭示了两个关键发现：(1) VLM性能随天气严重程度的增加而单调下降，并且(2) 不同的天气类型会引发独特的脆弱性模式。我们希望WeatherReasonSeg将成为推进鲁棒、天气感知推理的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了WeatherReasonSeg，一个用于评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）在恶劣天气条件下进行推理分割的基准。该基准包含一个通过合成天气生成的可控数据集和一个真实世界的恶劣天气数据集，并涵盖功能、应用场景等五个推理维度。实验结果表明，VLMs的性能随天气恶劣程度增加而下降，且不同天气类型导致不同的脆弱性模式。该工作旨在推动鲁棒、天气感知推理的发展。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 推理分割, 恶劣天气, 基准, WeatherReasonSeg
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于首次系统地关注视觉语言模型在恶劣天气条件下的推理分割能力，填补了现有基准的空白。通过结合合成和真实世界数据，并细致地分析不同天气类型和严重程度的影响，为未来开发更鲁棒的VLM提供了重要工具和见解。其重要性在于强调了模型在非理想条件下的实用性挑战，并为模型在现实世界部署的可靠性评估奠定了基础。

title: Sensi: Learn One Thing at a Time -- Curriculum-Based Test-Time Learning for LLM Game Agents
comments: Preprint. 18 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Independent research. Code and Colab demo coming soon on GitHub
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents deployed in unknown environments must learn task structure at test time, but current approaches require thousands of interactions to form useful hypotheses. We present Sensi, an LLM agent architecture for the ARC-AGI-3 game-playing challenge that introduces structured test-time learning through three mechanisms: (1) a two-player architecture separating perception from action, (2) a curriculum-based learning system managed by an external state machine, and (3) a database-as-control-plane that makes the agents context window programmatically steerable. We further introduce an LLM-as-judge component with dynamically generated evaluation rubrics to determine when the agent has learned enough about one topic to advance to the next. We report results across two iterations: Sensi v1 solves 2 game levels using the two-player architecture alone, while Sensi v2 adds curriculum learning and solves 0 levels - but completes its entire learning curriculum in approximately 32 action attempts, achieving 50-94x greater sample efficiency than comparable systems that require 1600-3000 attempts. We precisely diagnose the failure mode as a self-consistent hallucination cascade originating in the perception layer, demonstrating that the architectural bottleneck has shifted from learning efficiency to perceptual grounding - a more tractable problem.

AI.title_translation: Sensi：一次只学一件事——基于课程的LLM游戏代理测试时学习
AI.tldr: Sensi是一个LLM游戏代理架构，通过课程学习和结构化方法，显著提高了测试时学习的样本效率，并诊断出感知幻觉是其主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 部署在未知环境中的大型语言模型（LLM）代理需要在测试时学习任务结构，但现有方法需要数千次交互才能形成有用的假设，效率低下。
AI.method: Sensi是一个LLM代理架构，专为ARC-AGI-3游戏挑战设计，引入了结构化的测试时学习。它包含三个机制：1) 分离感知和行动的双玩家架构；2) 由外部状态机管理的基于课程的学习系统；3) 将数据库作为控制平面，使代理的上下文窗口可编程控制。此外，还引入了一个带有动态生成评估标准的LLM作为评判组件，以确定代理何时已充分学习一个主题并可进入下一个。
AI.result: Sensi v1仅使用双玩家架构解决了2个游戏关卡。Sensi v2增加了课程学习但解决了0个关卡，但在大约32次行动尝试中完成了整个学习课程，比需要1600-3000次尝试的同类系统样本效率提高了50-94倍。失败模式被精确诊断为源于感知层的自洽幻觉级联。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论是，Sensi将LLM代理的架构瓶颈从学习效率转移到了感知基础（perceptual grounding），这是一个更易处理的问题，尽管Sensi v2未能解决游戏关卡，但其在学习效率上取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理部署在未知环境中时，必须在测试时学习任务结构，但当前方法需要数千次交互才能形成有用的假设。我们提出了Sensi，这是一个用于ARC-AGI-3游戏挑战的LLM代理架构，它通过三种机制引入了结构化的测试时学习：(1) 分离感知和行动的双玩家架构；(2) 由外部状态机管理的基于课程的学习系统；(3) 将数据库作为控制平面，使代理的上下文窗口可编程控制。我们进一步引入了一个带有动态生成评估标准的LLM作为评判组件，以确定代理何时已充分学习一个主题并可进入下一个。我们报告了两轮迭代的结果：Sensi v1仅使用双玩家架构解决了2个游戏关卡，而Sensi v2增加了课程学习但解决了0个关卡——但它在大约32次行动尝试中完成了整个学习课程，比需要1600-3000次尝试的同类系统样本效率提高了50-94倍。我们精确诊断出失败模式是源于感知层的自洽幻觉级联，这表明架构瓶颈已从学习效率转移到感知基础——一个更易处理的问题。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Sensi，一个用于ARC-AGI-3游戏挑战的LLM代理架构，旨在提高未知环境中LLM代理的测试时学习效率。Sensi采用双玩家架构、基于课程的学习系统和数据库作为控制平面。此外，它还引入了LLM作为评判组件进行动态评估。尽管Sensi v2未能解决游戏关卡，但其在样本效率上取得了显著提升，比现有系统高出50-94倍，并在32次尝试内完成学习课程。研究诊断出失败模式是感知层的幻觉级联，指出瓶颈已从学习效率转向感知基础。
AI.keywords: LLM代理, 测试时学习, 课程学习, 样本效率, 感知幻觉
AI.comments: Sensi的创新之处在于其结构化的测试时学习方法，特别是引入了课程学习和LLM作为评判的机制，显著提升了LLM代理在未知环境中学习的样本效率。其发现感知幻觉而非学习效率是当前瓶颈，为未来的研究指明了方向，使得问题变得更易于解决。尽管Sensi v2未能成功解决更多关卡，但其对学习效率的提升和对失败模式的精确诊断具有重要意义。

title: Does YOLO Really Need to See Every Training Image in Every Epoch?
summary: YOLO detectors are known for their fast inference speed, yet training them remains unexpectedly time-consuming due to their exhaustive pipeline that processes every training image in every epoch, even when many images have already been sufficiently learned. This stands in clear contrast to the efficiency suggested by the ``You Only Look Once'' philosophy. This naturally raises an important question: \textit{Does YOLO really need to see every training image in every epoch?} To explore this, we propose an Anti-Forgetting Sampling Strategy (AFSS) that dynamically determines which images should be used and which can be skipped during each epoch, allowing the detector to learn more effectively and efficiently. Specifically, AFSS measures the learning sufficiency of each training image as the minimum of its detection recall and precision, and dynamically categorizes training images into easy, medium, or hard levels accordingly. Easy training images are sparsely resampled during training in a continuous review manner, with priority given to those that have not been used for a long time to reduce redundancy and prevent forgetting. Moderate training images are partially selected, prioritizing recently unused ones and randomly choosing the rest from unselected images to ensure coverage and prevent forgetting. Hard training images are fully sampled in every epoch to ensure sufficient learning. The learning sufficiency of each training image is periodically updated, enabling detectors to adaptively shift its focus toward the informative training images over time while progressively discarding redundant ones. On widely used natural image detection benchmarks (MS COCO 2017 and PASCAL VOC 2007) and remote sensing detection datasets (DOTA-v1.0 and DIOR-R), AFSS achieves more than $1.43\times$ training speedup for YOLO-series detectors while also improving accuracy.

AI.title_translation: YOLO真的需要在每个epoch中查看每个训练图像吗？
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种抗遗忘采样策略（AFSS），通过动态选择训练图像，显著加快了YOLO检测器的训练速度并提高了准确性。
AI.motivation: YOLO检测器训练耗时，因为它在每个epoch中处理所有训练图像，即使许多图像已被充分学习，这与“You Only Look Once”的效率理念相悖。
AI.method: 本文提出抗遗忘采样策略（AFSS）。该策略通过检测召回率和精确度的最小值来衡量每个训练图像的学习充分性，并将其动态分类为简单、中等或困难级别。简单图像被稀疏重采样，优先选择长时间未使用的图像以减少冗余和防止遗忘；中等图像部分选择，优先选择最近未使用的图像并随机选择其余部分以确保覆盖和防止遗忘；困难图像在每个epoch中完全采样以确保充分学习。每个训练图像的学习充分性定期更新，使检测器能够自适应地将焦点转移到信息丰富的图像上，同时逐渐丢弃冗余图像。
AI.result: 在MS COCO 2017、PASCAL VOC 2007、DOTA-v1.0和DIOR-R等数据集上，AFSS使YOLO系列检测器的训练速度提高了1.43倍以上，同时提高了准确性。
AI.conclusion: AFSS通过动态、自适应的图像采样策略，有效解决了YOLO训练耗时的问题，显著提升了训练效率和模型准确性。
AI.translation: YOLO检测器以其快速推理速度而闻名，但其训练却出乎意料地耗时，原因在于其详尽的管道在每个epoch中处理每个训练图像，即使许多图像已经得到了充分学习。这与“You Only Look Once”的效率理念形成了鲜明对比。这自然引出了一个重要问题：YOLO真的需要在每个epoch中查看每个训练图像吗？为了探索这一点，我们提出了一种抗遗忘采样策略（AFSS），该策略动态确定在每个epoch中应使用哪些图像以及可以跳过哪些图像，从而使检测器能够更有效、更高效地学习。具体来说，AFSS将每个训练图像的学习充分性衡量为其检测召回率和精确度的最小值，并据此将训练图像动态分为简单、中等或困难级别。简单训练图像在训练期间以连续回顾的方式稀疏重采样，优先选择长时间未使用的图像，以减少冗余并防止遗忘。中等训练图像被部分选择，优先选择最近未使用的图像，并从未选择的图像中随机选择其余部分，以确保覆盖范围并防止遗忘。困难训练图像在每个epoch中完全采样以确保充分学习。每个训练图像的学习充分性定期更新，使检测器能够随着时间的推移自适应地将其注意力转移到信息丰富的训练图像上，同时逐渐丢弃冗余图像。在广泛使用的自然图像检测基准（MS COCO 2017和PASCAL VOC 2007）和遥感检测数据集（DOTA-v1.0和DIOR-R）上，AFSS使YOLO系列检测器的训练速度提高了1.43倍以上，同时还提高了准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为抗遗忘采样策略（AFSS）的新方法，旨在解决YOLO检测器训练耗时的问题。AFSS通过评估图像的学习充分性，将其分为简单、中等和困难级别，并对不同级别的图像采用动态采样策略。实验结果表明，AFSS显著加快了YOLO系列检测器的训练速度并提高了准确性。
AI.keywords: YOLO, 训练加速, 采样策略, 目标检测, 学习充分性
AI.comments: 本文创新性地解决了YOLO训练中冗余图像处理导致效率低下的问题，通过动态采样策略，不仅提升了训练速度，还意外地提高了模型准确性，这对于资源受限或需要快速迭代的模型开发具有重要意义。该方法通过量化学习充分性并实施分级采样，有效平衡了学习效率与防止遗忘的需求。

title: Flow Matching Policy with Entropy Regularization
summary: Diffusion-based policies have gained significant popularity in Reinforcement Learning (RL) due to their ability to represent complex, non-Gaussian distributions. Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE)-based diffusion policies often rely on indirect entropy control due to the intractability of the exact entropy, while also suffering from computationally prohibitive policy gradients through the iterative denoising chain. To overcome these issues, we propose Flow Matching Policy with Entropy Regularization (FMER), an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE)-based online RL framework. FMER parameterizes the policy via flow matching and samples actions along a straight probability path, motivated by optimal transport. FMER leverages the model's generative nature to construct an advantage-weighted target velocity field from a candidate set, steering policy updates toward high-value regions. By deriving a tractable entropy objective, FMER enables principled maximum-entropy optimization for enhanced exploration. Experiments on sparse multi-goal FrankaKitchen benchmarks demonstrate that FMER outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while remaining competitive on standard MuJoco benchmarks. Moreover, FMER reduces training time by 7x compared to heavy diffusion baselines (QVPO) and 10-15% relative to efficient variants.

AI.title_translation: 流匹配策略与熵正则化
AI.tldr: 提出FMER，一种基于ODE的在线RL框架，通过流匹配和可处理的熵目标克服了扩散策略的计算和熵控制问题，并在多目标任务中表现优异且训练时间更短。
AI.motivation: 现有基于SDE的扩散策略在强化学习中存在两个主要问题：1. 由于精确熵难以处理，导致熵控制是间接的。2. 通过迭代去噪链计算策略梯度，计算成本过高。
AI.method: 本文提出了流匹配策略与熵正则化（FMER），这是一种基于常微分方程（ODE）的在线强化学习框架。FMER通过流匹配来参数化策略，并受最优传输启发，沿着一条直线概率路径采样动作。它利用模型的生成性质，从候选集中构建一个优势加权的 G目标速度场，从而引导策略更新朝向高价值区域。FMER还推导了一个可处理的熵目标，实现了原则性的最大熵优化，以增强探索能力。
AI.result: 在稀疏多目标FrankKitchen基准测试中，FMER的性能优于最先进的方法。在标准MuJoCo基准测试中，FMER保持竞争力。与“重型”扩散基线（QVPO）相比，FMER的训练时间减少了7倍。与高效变体相比，训练时间相对减少了10-15%。
AI.conclusion: FMER通过其基于ODE的流匹配和可处理的熵正则化，成功解决了现有扩散策略的计算效率和熵控制挑战。它在特定任务中超越了现有技术，并显著缩短了训练时间，同时保持了性能，从而为在线强化学习提供了一种有效且高效的新方法。
AI.translation: 基于扩散的策略因其表示复杂非高斯分布的能力而在强化学习（RL）中获得了显著的普及。基于随机微分方程（SDE）的扩散策略由于精确熵的难以处理性，通常依赖于间接的熵控制，同时还面临通过迭代去噪链计算策略梯度导致计算成本过高的问题。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了带熵正则化的流匹配策略（FMER），这是一种基于常微分方程（ODE）的在线RL框架。FMER通过流匹配参数化策略，并受最优传输启发，沿着一条直线概率路径采样动作。FMER利用模型的生成性质，从候选集中构建一个优势加权的 G目标速度场，从而引导策略更新朝向高价值区域。通过推导一个可处理的熵目标，FMER实现了原则性的最大熵优化，以增强探索能力。在稀疏多目标FrankKitchen基准测试上的实验表明，FMER的性能优于最先进的方法，同时在标准MuJoCo基准测试上保持竞争力。此外，与“重型”扩散基线（QVPO）相比，FMER的训练时间减少了7倍，与高效变体相比，相对减少了10-15%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为流匹配策略与熵正则化（FMER）的在线强化学习框架，旨在解决现有基于SDE的扩散策略在熵控制和计算效率方面的局限性。FMER采用基于ODE的流匹配来参数化策略，并利用可处理的熵目标实现最大熵优化以增强探索。实验结果表明，FMER在稀疏多目标任务中超越了现有SOTA方法，并在标准基准上保持竞争力，同时显著减少了训练时间。
AI.keywords: 流匹配, 熵正则化, 强化学习, ODE, 扩散策略
AI.comments: FMER的创新之处在于将流匹配技术与熵正则化相结合，构建了一个基于ODE的在线RL框架，有效解决了SDE扩散策略在计算效率和精确熵控制方面的挑战。通过引入可处理的熵目标和优势加权目标速度场，FMER不仅提升了探索能力，还在特定复杂任务中展现出卓越的性能和显著的训练时间优势，这对于推动RL在实际应用中的落地具有重要意义。

title: On maximal positive invariant set computation for rank-deficient linear systems
summary:
The maximal positively invariant (MPI) set is obtained through a backward reachability procedure involving the iterative computation and intersection of predecessor sets under state and input constraints.
  However, standard static feedback synthesis may place some of the closed-loop eigenvalues at zero, leading to rank-deficient dynamics. This affects the MPI computation by inducing projections onto lower-dimensional subspaces during intermediate steps. By exploiting the Schur decomposition, we explicitly address this singular case and propose a robust algorithm that computes the MPI set in both polyhedral and constrained-zonotope representations.

AI.title_translation: 关于秩亏线性系统的最大正不变集计算
AI.tldr: 针对秩亏线性系统，提出一种鲁棒算法来计算最大正不变集，解决了标准方法中由于零特征值导致的投影问题。
AI.motivation: 标准静态反馈综合可能导致闭环特征值为零，从而产生秩亏动力学。这会在中间步骤中导致投影到低维子空间，影响最大正不变集（MPI）的计算。
AI.method: 通过利用舒尔分解（Schur decomposition），明确解决秩亏线性系统中的奇异情况。
AI.result: 提出了一种鲁棒算法，可以在多面体和约束zonotope表示中计算最大正不变集。
AI.conclusion: 该算法能够鲁棒地计算秩亏线性系统的最大正不变集，并支持多面体和约束zonotope表示，有效解决了零特征值引起的计算挑战。
AI.translation: 最大正不变集（MPI）是通过逆向可达性过程获得的，该过程涉及在状态和输入约束下迭代计算和交集前驱集。然而，标准静态反馈综合可能将一些闭环特征值置于零，导致秩亏动力学。这通过在中间步骤中诱导投影到低维子空间来影响MPI计算。通过利用舒尔分解，我们明确解决了这种奇异情况，并提出了一种鲁棒算法，可以在多面体和约束zonotope表示中计算MPI集。
AI.summary: 最大正不变集（MPI）的计算在秩亏线性系统中面临挑战，因为零特征值会导致中间计算中出现低维投影。本文通过利用舒尔分解，提出了一种鲁棒算法来解决这一问题，该算法能够计算多面体和约束zonotope表示下的MPI集。
AI.keywords: 最大正不变集, 秩亏系统, 舒尔分解, 鲁棒算法, 集合计算
AI.comments: 该论文针对秩亏线性系统中的最大正不变集计算问题，通过引入舒尔分解来解决奇异情况，提出了一种鲁棒算法。其创新点在于明确处理了零特征值导致的投影问题，并支持多种集合表示，对控制系统理论与应用具有重要意义。

title: Objective Mispricing Detection for Shortlisting Undervalued Football Players via Market Dynamics and News Signals
summary:
We present a practical, reproducible framework for identifying undervalued football players grounded in objective mispricing. Instead of relying on subjective expert labels, we estimate an expected market value from structured data (historical market dynamics, biographical and contract features, transfer history) and compare it to the observed valuation to define mispricing. We then assess whether news-derived Natural Language Processing (NLP) features (i.e., sentiment statistics and semantic embeddings from football articles) complement market signals for shortlisting undervalued players.
  Using a chronological (leakage-aware) evaluation, gradient-boosted regression explains a large share of the variance in log-transformed market value. For undervaluation shortlisting, ROC-AUC-based ablations show that market dynamics are the primary signal, while NLP features provide consistent, secondary gains that improve robustness and interpretability. SHAP analyses suggest the dominance of market trends and age, with news-derived volatility cues amplifying signals in high-uncertainty regimes. The proposed pipeline is designed for decision support in scouting workflows, emphasizing ranking/shortlisting over hard classification thresholds, and includes a concise reproducibility and ethics statement.

AI.title_translation: 通过市场动态和新闻信号对被低估足球运动员进行客观错价检测与短名单筛选
AI.tldr: 研究开发了一个客观框架，结合历史市场数据和新闻NLP信号，来识别被低估的足球运动员。市场数据是主要因素，新闻信号提供辅助增益，最终用于侦察决策支持。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立一个基于客观错价的、可复现的框架，用于识别被低估的足球运动员，以替代依赖主观专家标签的方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个框架，通过结构化数据（历史市场动态、传记/合同特征、转会历史）估计预期市场价值，并与观察到的估值进行比较来定义错价。然后，使用源自足球文章的情绪统计和语义嵌入的自然语言处理（NLP）特征来评估其对短名单的补充作用。评估采用时间顺序（避免泄漏）方法，并使用梯度提升回归模型。最后通过ROC-AUC消融实验和SHAP分析来评估不同信号源的贡献。
AI.result: 梯度提升回归模型解释了对数转换市场价值的大部分方差。在短名单评估中，市场动态是主要信号，而NLP特征提供了持续的次要增益，提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。SHAP分析显示市场趋势和年龄占据主导地位，新闻驱动的波动性线索在不确定性高的情境下放大了信号。
AI.conclusion: 提出的管道旨在支持侦察工作流程中的决策，强调基于排名的短名单而非硬性分类阈值，并包含了可复现性和伦理声明。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个基于客观错价的、实用且可复现的框架，用于识别被低估的足球运动员。我们不依赖于主观的专家标签，而是从结构化数据（历史市场动态、传记和合同特征、转会历史）中估计预期的市场价值，并将其与观察到的估值进行比较以定义错价。然后，我们评估了新闻衍生的自然语言处理（NLP）特征（即来自足球文章的情感统计和语义嵌入）是否能补充市场信号，用于被低估球员的短名单筛选。使用时间顺序的（避免泄漏的）评估，梯度提升回归解释了对数转换市场价值的很大一部分方差。对于错价短名单筛选，基于ROC-AUC的消融实验表明，市场动态是主要信号，而NLP特征提供了持续的次要增益，提高了鲁棒性和可解释性。SHAP分析表明市场趋势和年龄占主导地位，新闻衍生的波动性线索在不确定性高的情境下放大了信号。提出的管道旨在支持侦察工作流程中的决策，强调排名/短名单而非硬分类阈值，并包含简洁的可复现性和伦理声明。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种客观识别被低估足球运动员的框架，该框架通过结构化数据（市场动态、合同信息等）估计预期市场价值，并与观测价值对比来量化错价。研究进一步评估了新闻NLP特征（如情感和语义嵌入）对该短名单过程的补充效果。结果表明，市场动态是主要预测因子，而新闻信号提供了稳健的次要增益，整个流程侧重于排名和决策支持。
AI.keywords: 足球运动员, 价值低估, 市场动态, 新闻信号, 梯度提升回归
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个结合市场动态和新闻信号的客观定价模型，用于识别被低估的足球运动员，并且采用了时间顺序的评估方法以避免信息泄漏。其重要性在于为足球人才发掘提供了可复现的、数据驱动的决策支持工具。限制在于其结果的普适性可能受限于所使用的数据集和特定联赛的特点。

title: Can Blindfolded LLMs Still Trade? An Anonymization-First Framework for Portfolio Optimization
comments: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Advances in Financial AI (FinAI). 18 pages, 7 figures
summary: For LLM trading agents to be genuinely trustworthy, they must demonstrate understanding of market dynamics rather than exploitation of memorized ticker associations. Building responsible multi-agent systems demands rigorous signal validation: proving that predictions reflect legitimate patterns, not pre-trained recall. We address two sources of spurious performance: memorization bias from ticker-specific pre-training, and survivorship bias from flawed backtesting. Our approach is to blindfold the agents--anonymizing all identifiers--and verify whether meaningful signals persist. BlindTrade anonymizes tickers and company names, and four LLM agents output scores along with reasoning. We construct a GNN graph from reasoning embeddings and trade using PPO-DSR policy. On 2025 YTD (through 2025-08-01), we achieved Sharpe 1.40 +/- 0.22 across 20 seeds and validated signal legitimacy through negative control experiments. To assess robustness beyond a single OOS window, we additionally evaluate an extended period (2024--2025), revealing market-regime dependency: the policy excels in volatile conditions but shows reduced alpha in trending bull markets.
comment: Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Advances in Financial AI (FinAI). 18 pages, 7 figures

AI.title_translation: 蒙眼的LLM还能交易吗？一个面向匿名化的投资组合优化框架
AI.tldr: 为了测试LLM交易代理是否真的懂市场而非死记硬背，我们发明了BlindTrade，把股票代码都隐藏了。结果发现，即使看不见代码，模型仍然能做出好交易（夏普1.40），证明了信号的有效性，但也发现它在不同市场环境下表现不一。
AI.motivation: 确保LLM交易代理是真正可信赖的，它们需要证明对市场动态的理解，而不是利用预训练中记忆的股票代码关联。解决由股票代码预训练和有缺陷的回测引起的虚假性能来源（记忆偏差和幸存者偏差）。
AI.method: 提出BlindTrade框架，匿名化股票代码和公司名称，让四个LLM代理输出评分和推理。使用一个GNN图从推理嵌入中构建，并采用PPO-DSR策略进行交易。通过负控制实验验证信号合法性。
AI.result: 在2025年初至今（截至2025-08-01）的测试中，在20个种子下实现了1.40 +/- 0.22的夏普比率，并通过负控制实验验证了信号的合法性。在2024-2025年的扩展评估中，发现该策略在波动条件下表现出色，但在趋势性牛市中阿尔法有所下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了经过匿名化处理后，LLM代理仍然能够产生有意义的信号，验证了信号的合法性，但同时也揭示了策略的性能对市场机制（如牛市趋势）存在依赖性。
AI.translation: 为了使LLM交易代理真正值得信赖，它们必须证明对市场动态的理解，而不是利用记忆中的股票代码关联。构建负责任的多智能体系统需要严格的信号验证：证明预测反映了合法的模式，而不是预训练的记忆。我们解决了两个虚假性能的来源：来自股票代码特定预训练的记忆偏差，以及来自有缺陷的回测的幸存者偏差。我们的方法是“蒙眼”代理——匿名化所有标识符——并验证是否有有意义的信号持续存在。BlindTrade匿名化股票代码和公司名称，四个LLM代理输出分数以及推理。我们从推理嵌入中构建一个GNN图，并使用PPO-DSR策略进行交易。在2025年初至今（截至2025-08-01）的测试中，我们在20个种子下实现了1.40 +/- 0.22的夏普比率，并通过负控制实验验证了信号的合法性。为了评估超越单个样本外窗口的稳健性，我们还评估了扩展时期（2024-2025年），揭示了市场机制依赖性：该策略在波动条件下表现出色，但在趋势性牛市中表现出的阿尔法有所下降。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了BlindTrade框架，通过匿名化股票代码和公司名称来“蒙眼”LLM交易代理，以验证其性能是否源于对市场动态的真正理解，而非记忆偏差或幸存者偏差。研究使用GNN和PPO-DSR策略进行投资组合优化，并在2025年YTD期间取得了1.40的夏普比率，证明了信号的合法性，同时也发现策略性能对市场波动性有依赖性。
AI.keywords: LLM交易代理, 盲法交易, 信号验证, 记忆偏差, 投资组合优化
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了“蒙眼”机制（BlindTrade）来解决LLM交易代理中的记忆偏差和幸存者偏差问题，通过匿名化来验证模型是否真正理解市场动态而非仅仅依赖记忆。重要性在于提升了LLM在金融领域的可靠性和可信度。局限性可能在于其对特定市场时期（如波动性市场）的性能依赖。

title: Learning Transferable Temporal Primitives for Video Reasoning via Synthetic Videos
summary: The transition from image to video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to shift from recognizing static patterns to reasoning over temporal dynamics such as motion trajectories, speed changes, and state transitions. Yet current post-training methods fall short due to two critical limitations: (1) existing datasets often lack temporal-centricity, where answers can be inferred from isolated keyframes rather than requiring holistic temporal integration; and (2) training data generated by proprietary models contains systematic errors in fundamental temporal perception, such as confusing motion directions or misjudging speeds. We introduce SynRL, a post-training framework that teaches models temporal primitives, the fundamental building blocks of temporal understanding including direction, speed, and state tracking. Our key insight is that these abstract primitives, learned from programmatically generated synthetic videos, transfer effectively to real-world scenarios. We decompose temporal understanding into short-term perceptual primitives (speed, direction) and long-term cognitive primitives, constructing 7.7K CoT and 7K RL samples with ground-truth frame-level annotations through code-based video generation. Despite training on simple geometric shapes, SynRL achieves substantial improvements across 15 benchmarks spanning temporal grounding, complex reasoning, and general video understanding. Remarkably, our 7.7K synthetic CoT samples outperform Video-R1 with 165K real-world samples. We attribute this to fundamental temporal skills, such as tracking frame by frame changes and comparing velocity, that transfer effectively from abstract synthetic patterns to complex real-world scenarios. This establishes a new paradigm for video post-training: video temporal learning through carefully designed synthetic data provides a more cost efficient scaling path.

AI.title_translation: 学习可迁移的时间基元以通过合成视频进行视频推理
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SynRL的后训练框架，通过合成视频学习时间基元（如方向、速度、状态跟踪），以提高视频推理能力。实验证明，即使只在简单的几何形状上训练，SynRL也能在多个基准测试中取得显著提升，并且其合成数据比真实数据更有效。
AI.motivation: 当前的视频理解模型在处理时间动态方面存在不足，主要由于现有数据集缺乏时间中心性，以及生成模型中的系统性时间感知错误。因此，需要一种新的方法来教授模型时间基元。
AI.method: 提出SynRL框架，通过程序化生成的合成视频来学习时间基元。将时间理解分解为短期感知基元（速度、方向）和长期认知基元，构建了包含7.7K CoT和7K RL样本的视频数据集，并提供逐帧标注。
AI.result: SynRL在15个跨越时间定位、复杂推理和通用视频理解的基准测试中取得了显著改进。其中，7.7K合成CoT样本的性能优于使用165K真实样本的Video-R1。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的合成数据进行视频时间学习，可以更有效地扩展视频模型的能力，为视频后训练提供了一个新的范式。
AI.translation: 从图像到视频理解的转变需要视觉语言模型（VLMs）从识别静态模式转向推理时间动态，如运动轨迹、速度变化和状态转换。然而，当前的后训练方法由于两个关键限制而效果不佳：（1）现有数据集通常缺乏时间中心性，答案可以从孤立的关键帧推断出来，而不需要整体的时间整合；（2）专有模型生成的训练数据包含基础时间感知方面的系统性错误，例如混淆运动方向或误判速度。我们引入了SynRL，一个后训练框架，用于教授模型时间基元，这是时间理解的基本组成部分，包括方向、速度和状态跟踪。我们的关键见解是，这些从程序化生成的合成视频中学到的抽象基元能够有效地迁移到现实世界场景。我们将时间理解分解为短期感知基元（速度、方向）和长期认知基元，通过基于代码的视频生成构建了7.7K CoT和7K RL样本，并带有地面真实逐帧标注。尽管只在简单的几何形状上进行训练，SynRL在涵盖时间定位、复杂推理和通用视频理解的15个基准测试中取得了显著的改进。值得注意的是，我们的7.7K合成CoT样本的性能优于使用165K真实样本的Video-R1。我们将此归因于基础的时间技能，例如跟踪逐帧变化和比较速度，这些技能可以有效地从抽象的合成模式迁移到复杂的现实世界场景。这建立了一个视频后训练的新范例：通过精心设计的合成数据进行视频时间学习，提供了更具成本效益的扩展路径。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为SynRL的后训练框架，旨在解决当前视频理解模型在处理时间动态方面的不足。SynRL通过程序化生成的合成视频来学习时间基元，如方向、速度和状态跟踪。研究发现，即使只在简单的几何形状上训练，这些从合成数据中学到的抽象时间基元也能有效地迁移到现实世界场景，并在多个视频理解任务中取得显著性能提升，甚至优于使用大量真实数据的模型。
AI.keywords: 时间基元,视频推理,合成视频,后训练,迁移学习
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个非常有前景的方法来解决视频理解中的时间推理挑战。通过利用合成数据来学习基础的时间基元，该方法不仅提高了模型的性能，而且可能比依赖大规模真实世界数据集更具成本效益。其关键贡献在于识别出抽象时间基元的可迁移性，并展示了其在各种视频理解任务中的有效性。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的合成场景和更多样化的时间基元，以及研究模型在不同领域间的迁移能力。

title: MALLES: A Multi-agent LLMs-based Economic Sandbox with Consumer Preference Alignment
summary: In the real economy, modern decision-making is fundamentally challenged by high-dimensional, multimodal environments, which are further complicated by agent heterogeneity and combinatorial data sparsity. This paper introduces a Multi-Agent Large Language Model-based Economic Sandbox (MALLES), leveraging the inherent generalization capabilities of large-sacle models to establish a unified simulation framework applicable to cross-domain and cross-category scenarios. Central to our approach is a preference learning paradigm in which LLMs are economically aligned via post-training on extensive, heterogeneous transaction records across diverse product categories. This methodology enables the models to internalize and transfer latent consumer preference patterns, thereby mitigating the data sparsity issues prevalent in individual categories. To enhance simulation stability, we implement a mean-field mechanism designed to model the dynamic interactions between the product environment and customer populations, effectively stabilizing sampling processes within high-dimensional decision spaces. Furthermore, we propose a multi-agent discussion framework wherein specialized agents collaboratively process extensive product information. This architecture distributes cognitive load to alleviate single-agent attention bottlenecks and captures critical decision factors through structured dialogue. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves significant improvements in product selection accuracy, purchase quantity prediction, and simulation stability compared to existing economic and financial LLM simulation baselines.
