Experimental results demonstrate that MagicWorld improves motion realism and alleviates error accumulation during long-horizon interactions.

title: WPT: World-to-Policy Transfer via Online World Model Distillation
summary: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in world models, which primarily aim to capture the spatio-temporal correlations between an agent's actions and the evolving environment. However, existing approaches often suffer from tight runtime coupling or depend on offline reward signals, resulting in substantial inference overhead or hindering end-to-end optimization. To overcome these limitations, we introduce WPT, a World-to-Policy Transfer training paradigm that enables online distillation under the guidance of an end-to-end world model. Specifically, we develop a trainable reward model that infuses world knowledge into a teacher policy by aligning candidate trajectories with the future dynamics predicted by the world model. Subsequently, we propose policy distillation and world reward distillation to transfer the teacher's reasoning ability into a lightweight student policy, enhancing planning performance while preserving real-time deployability. Extensive experiments on both open-loop and closed-loop benchmarks show that our WPT achieves state-of-the-art performance with a simple policy architecture: it attains a 0.11 collision rate (open-loop) and achieves a 79.23 driving score (closed-loop) surpassing both world-model-based and imitation-learning methods in accuracy and safety. Moreover, the student sustains up to 4.9x faster inference, while retaining most of the gains.

title: Dynamic-ICP: Doppler-Aware Iterative Closest Point Registration for Dynamic Scenes
summary: Reliable odometry in highly dynamic environments remains challenging when it relies on ICP-based registration: ICP assumes near-static scenes and degrades in repetitive or low-texture geometry. We introduce Dynamic-ICP, a Doppler-aware registration framework. The method (i) estimates ego motion from per-point Doppler velocity via robust regression and builds a velocity filter, (ii) clusters dynamic objects and reconstructs object-wise translational velocities from ego-compensated radial measurements, (iii) predicts dynamic points with a constant-velocity model, and (iv) aligns scans using a compact objective that combines point-to-plane geometry residual with a translation-invariant, rotation-only Doppler residual. The approach requires no external sensors or sensor-vehicle calibration and operates directly on FMCW LiDAR range and Doppler velocities. We evaluate Dynamic-ICP on three datasets-HeRCULES, HeLiPR, AevaScenes-focusing on highly dynamic scenes. Dynamic-ICP consistently improves rotational stability and translation accuracy over the state-of-the-art methods. Our approach is also simple to integrate into existing pipelines, runs in real time, and provides a lightweight solution for robust registration in dynamic environments. To encourage further research, the code is available at: https://github.com/JMUWRobotics/Dynamic-ICP.

title: Optimal preconditioning techniques for finite volume approximation of three-dimensional conservative space-fractional diffusion equations
comments: Revised version with updated funding information
summary: A Crank-Nicolson finite volume approximation for three-dimensional conservative space-fractional diffusion equation results in large and dense three-level Toeplitz discrete linear systems. Preconditioned Krylov subspace methods with sine transform-based preconditioners are developed to solve these systems, including the preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) method for the symmetric case and the preconditioned generalized minimal residual (PGMRES) method for the non-symmetric case. Moreover, we provide detailed analysis of the convergence of these Krylov subspace methods. Specifically, for the symmetric case, we prove the spectra of the preconditioned matrices are uniformly bounded in the open interval (1/2, 3/2), which results in a linear convergence rate of the PCG method. For the non-symmetric case, we demonstrate that the PGMRES method also achieves a linear convergence rate independent of discretization stepsizes from the residual point of view. These results imply that the iteration counts of the PCG and PGMRES methods are uniformly bounded and independent of the matrix sizes. Numerical experiments in both symmetric and non-symmetric cases in two- and three-dimensions are conducted to confirm the optimal performance of the proposed preconditioned Krylov subspace methods.
comment: Revised version with updated funding information

title: SO-Bench: A Structural Output Evaluation of Multimodal LLMs
comments: v3 preprint. Added the link to the public benchmark
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world, agentic settings where outputs must not only be correct, but also conform to predefined data schemas. Despite recent progress in structured generation in textual domain, there is still no benchmark that systematically evaluates schema-grounded information extraction and reasoning over visual inputs. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive study of visual structural output capabilities for MLLMs with our carefully designed SO-Bench benchmark. Covering four visual domains, including UI screens, natural images, documents, and charts, SO-Bench is built from over 6.5K diverse JSON schemas and 1.8K curated image-schema pairs with human-verified quality. Benchmarking experiments on open-sourced and frontier proprietary models reveal persistent gaps in predicting accurate, schema compliant outputs, highlighting the need for better multimodal structured reasoning. Beyond benchmarking, we further conduct training experiments to largely improve the model's structured output capability. We make the benchmark and evaluation publicly available at https://github.com/apple/ml-sobench
comment: v3 preprint. Added the link to the public benchmark

title: SimScale: Learning to Drive via Real-World Simulation at Scale
comments: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page: https://opendrivelab.com/SimScale
summary: Achieving fully autonomous driving systems requires learning rational decisions in a wide span of scenarios, including safety-critical and out-of-distribution ones. However, such cases are underrepresented in real-world corpus collected by human experts. To complement for the lack of data diversity, we introduce a novel and scalable simulation framework capable of synthesizing massive unseen states upon existing driving logs. Our pipeline utilizes advanced neural rendering with a reactive environment to generate high-fidelity multi-view observations controlled by the perturbed ego trajectory. Furthermore, we develop a pseudo-expert trajectory generation mechanism for these newly simulated states to provide action supervision. Upon the synthesized data, we find that a simple co-training strategy on both real-world and simulated samples can lead to significant improvements in both robustness and generalization for various planning methods on challenging real-world benchmarks, up to +8.6 EPDMS on navhard and +2.9 on navtest. More importantly, such policy improvement scales smoothly by increasing simulation data only, even without extra real-world data streaming in. We further reveal several crucial findings of such a sim-real learning system, which we term SimScale, including the design of pseudo-experts and the scaling properties for different policy architectures. Simulation data and code have been released at https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/SimScale.
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. Project page: https://opendrivelab.com/SimScale

title: Aligning Probabilistic Beliefs under Informative Missingness: LLM Steerability in Clinical Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for clinical reasoning tasks, which inherently require eliciting calibrated probabilistic beliefs based on available evidence. However, real-world clinical data are frequently incomplete, with missingness patterns often informative of patient prognosis; for example, ordering a rare laboratory test reflects a clinician's latent suspicion. In this work, we investigate whether LLMs can be steered to leverage this informative missingness for prognostic inference. To evaluate how well LLMs align their verbalized probabilistic beliefs with an underlying target distribution, we analyze three common prompt-based interventions: explicit serialization, instruction steering, and in-context learning. We introduce a bias-variance decomposition of the log-loss to clarify the mechanisms driving gains in predictive performance. Using a real-world intensive care testbed, we find that while explicit structural steering and in-context learning can improve probabilistic alignment, the models do not natively leverage informative missingness without careful interventions.

title: Provably Safe Model Updates
comments: 12 pages, 9 figures. This work has been accepted for publication at SaTML 2026. The final version will be available on IEEE Xplore
summary: Safety-critical environments are inherently dynamic. Distribution shifts, emerging vulnerabilities, and evolving requirements demand continuous updates to machine learning models. Yet even benign parameter updates can have unintended consequences, such as catastrophic forgetting in classical models or alignment drift in foundation models. Existing heuristic approaches (e.g., regularization, parameter isolation) can mitigate these effects but cannot certify that updated models continue to satisfy required performance specifications. We address this problem by introducing a framework for provably safe model updates. Our approach first formalizes the problem as computing the largest locally invariant domain (LID): a connected region in parameter space where all points are certified to satisfy a given specification. While exact maximal LID computation is intractable, we show that relaxing the problem to parameterized abstract domains (orthotopes, zonotopes) yields a tractable primal-dual formulation. This enables efficient certification of updates - independent of the data or algorithm used - by projecting them onto the safe domain. Our formulation further allows computation of multiple approximately optimal LIDs, incorporation of regularization-inspired biases, and use of lookahead data buffers. Across continual learning and foundation model fine-tuning benchmarks, our method matches or exceeds heuristic baselines for avoiding forgetting while providing formal safety guarantees.
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures. This work has been accepted for publication at SaTML 2026. The final version will be available on IEEE Xplore

title: TALO: Pushing 3D Vision Foundation Models Towards Globally Consistent Online Reconstruction
summary: 3D vision foundation models have shown strong generalization in reconstructing key 3D attributes from uncalibrated images through a single feed-forward pass. However, when deployed in online settings such as driving scenarios, predictions are made over temporal windows, making it non-trivial to maintain consistency across time. Recent strategies align consecutive predictions by solving global transformation, yet our analysis reveals their fundamental limitations in assumption validity, local alignment scope, and robustness under noisy geometry. In this work, we propose a higher-DOF and long-term alignment framework based on Thin Plate Spline, leveraging globally propagated control points to correct spatially varying inconsistencies. In addition, we adopt a point-agnostic submap registration design that is inherently robust to noisy geometry predictions. The proposed framework is fully plug-and-play, compatible with diverse 3D foundation models and camera configurations (e.g., monocular or surround-view). Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently yields more coherent geometry and lower trajectory errors across multiple datasets, backbone models, and camera setups, highlighting its robustness and generality. Code is available at https://github.com/Xian-Bei/TALO.

title: Efficient Cross-Domain Offline Reinforcement Learning with Dynamics- and Value-Aligned Data Filtering
summary: Cross-domain offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to train a well-performing agent in the target environment, leveraging both a limited target domain dataset and a source domain dataset with (possibly) sufficient data coverage. Due to the underlying dynamics misalignment between source and target domains, naively merging the two datasets may incur inferior performance. Recent advances address this issue by selectively leveraging source domain samples whose dynamics align well with the target domain. However, our work demonstrates that dynamics alignment alone is insufficient, by examining the limitations of prior frameworks and deriving a new target domain sub-optimality bound for the policy learned on the source domain. More importantly, our theory underscores an additional need for \textit{value alignment}, i.e., selecting high-quality, high-value samples from the source domain, a critical dimension overlooked by existing works. Motivated by such theoretical insight, we propose \textbf{\underline{D}}ynamics- and \textbf{\underline{V}}alue-aligned \textbf{\underline{D}}ata \textbf{\underline{F}}iltering (DVDF) method, a novel unified cross-domain RL framework that selectively incorporates source domain samples exhibiting strong alignment in \textit{both dynamics and values}. We empirically study a range of dynamics shift scenarios, including kinematic and morphology shifts, and evaluate DVDF on various tasks and datasets, even in the challenging setting where the target domain dataset contains an extremely limited amount of data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DVDF consistently outperforms strong baselines with significant improvements.

title: Vision to Geometry: 3D Spatial Memory for Sequential Embodied MLLM Reasoning and Exploration
summary: Embodied agents are expected to assist humans by actively exploring unknown environments and reasoning about spatial contexts. When deployed in real life, agents often face sequential tasks where each new task follows the completion of the previous one and may include infeasible objectives, such as searching for non-existent objects. However, most existing research focuses on isolated goals, overlooking the core challenge of sequential tasks: the ability to reuse spatial knowledge accumulated from previous explorations to guide subsequent reasoning and exploration. In this work, we investigate this underexplored yet practically significant embodied AI challenge. Specifically, we propose 3DSPMR, a 3D SPatial Memory Reasoning framework that utilizes Field-of-View (FoV) coverage as an explicit geometric prior. By integrating FoV-based constraints, 3DSPMR significantly enhances an agent's memory, reasoning, and exploration capabilities across sequential tasks. To facilitate research in this area, we further introduce SEER-Bench, a novel Sequential Embodied Exploration and Reasoning Benchmark that spans two foundational tasks: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) and Embodied Multi-modal Navigation (EMN). SEER-Bench uniquely incorporates both feasible and infeasible tasks to provide a rigorous and comprehensive evaluation of agent performance. Extensive experiments verify that 3DSPMR achieves substantial performance gains on both sequential EQA and EMN tasks.

title: Rabble-Rousers in the New King's Court: Algorithmic Effects on Account Visibility in Pre-X Twitter
comments: 14 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at The 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2026). Please cite accordingly
summary: Algorithmic effects on social media platforms have come under recent scrutiny, with several studies reporting that right-leaning accounts tend to receive more exposure. In this paper, we expand upon this body of work using data collected from user feeds after Twitter's change of ownership but before its re-branding to X. We replicate findings from prior work regarding the increased exposure of right-leaning accounts to wider audiences in algorithmically curated compared to reverse-chronological feeds, and, crucially, we further unpack this effect to illuminate what correlated (and did not correlate) with these differences. Our results reveal that right-leaning accounts benefited not necessarily due to their political affiliation, but likely because they behaved in ways associated with algorithmic rewards; namely, posting more agitating content and receiving attention from the platform's owner, Elon Musk, who was the most central network account. We also demonstrate that legacy-verified accounts, like businesses and government officials, received less exposure in the algorithmic feed compared to non-verified or Twitter Blue-verified accounts. We discuss implications of these findings for the intersection between behavioral incentives for algorithmic reach and the health of online discourse.
comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at The 20th International AAAI Conference on Web and Social Media (ICWSM 2026). Please cite accordingly

title: TxSum: User-Centered Ethereum Transaction Understanding with Micro-Level Semantic Grounding
summary: Understanding the economic intent of Ethereum transactions is critical for user safety, yet current tools expose only raw on-chain data or surface-level intent, leading to widespread "blind signing" (approving transactions without understanding them). Through interviews with 16 Web3 users, we find that effective explanations should be structured, risk-aware, and grounded at the token-flow level. Motivated by these findings, we formulate TxSum, a new user-centered NLP task for Ethereum transaction understanding, and construct a dataset of 187 complex Ethereum transactions annotated with transaction-level summaries and token flow-level semantic labels. We further introduce MATEX, a grounded multi-agent framework for high-stakes transaction explanation. It selectively retrieves external knowledge under uncertainty and audits explanations against raw traces to improve token-flow-level factual consistency. MATEX achieves the strongest overall explanation quality, especially on micro-level factuality and intent quality. It improves user comprehension on complex transactions from 52.9% to 76.5% over the strongest baseline and raises malicious-transaction rejection from 36.0% to 88.0%, while maintaining a low false-rejection rate on benign transactions.

title: PubTables-v2: A new large-scale dataset for full-page and multi-page table extraction
summary: Table extraction (TE) is a key challenge in visual document understanding. Traditional approaches detect tables first, then recognize their structure. Recently, interest has surged in developing methods, such as vision-language models (VLMs), that can extract tables directly in their full page or document context. However, progress has been difficult to demonstrate due to a lack of annotated data. To address this, we create a new large-scale dataset, PubTables-v2. PubTables-v2 supports a number of challenging table extraction tasks. Notably, it is the first large-scale benchmark for multi-page table structure recognition. We evaluate several smaller specialized VLMs to establish baseline performance on these tasks. As we show, multi-page table recognition is a key gap in current models' capabilities. Interestingly, we show that introducing an image classifier that predicts when to merge tables across pages can significantly improve performance. Data, code, and models will be released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/kensho/PubTables-v2.

title: KeyframeFace: Language-Driven Facial Animation via Semantic Keyframes
summary: Facial animation is a core component for creating digital characters in Computer Graphics (CG) industry. A typical production workflow relies on sparse, semantically meaningful keyframes to precisely control facial expressions. Enabling such animation directly from natural-language descriptions could significantly improve content creation efficiency and accessibility. However, most existing methods adopt a text-to-continuous-frames paradigm, directly regressing dense facial motion trajectories from language. This formulation entangles high-level semantic intent with low-level motion, lacks explicit semantic control structure, and limits precise editing and interpretability. Inspired by the keyframe paradigm in animation production, we propose KeyframeFace, a framework for semantic facial animation from language via interpretable keyframes. Instead of predicting dense motion trajectories, our method represents animation as a sequence of semantically meaningful keyframes in an interpretable ARKit-based facial control space. A language-driven model leverages large language model (LLM) priors to generate keyframes that align with contextual text descriptions and emotion cues. To support this formulation, we construct a multimodal dataset comprising 2,100 expression scripts paired with monocular videos, per-frame ARKit coefficients, and manually annotated semantic keyframes. Experiments show that incorporating semantic keyframe supervision and language priors significantly improves expression fidelity and semantic alignment compared to methods that do not use facial action semantics.

AI.title_translation: KeyframeFace：通过语义关键帧实现语言驱动的面部动画
AI.tldr: KeyframeFace是一个通过语言和语义关键帧生成面部动画的框架，它解决了现有文本到连续帧方法缺乏语义控制和可编辑性的问题。该方法利用ARKit控制空间中的语义关键帧和LLM先验，并通过实验证明其在表情保真度和语义对齐方面优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 计算机图形学中数字角色的面部动画是核心组成部分，但现有文本到连续帧的方法将高级语义意图与低级运动纠缠，缺乏明确的语义控制结构，限制了精确编辑和可解释性。因此，需要一种能够直接从自然语言描述驱动面部动画，并提供语义控制和可解释性的方法。
AI.method: 提出KeyframeFace框架，通过可解释的语义关键帧从语言生成面部动画。该方法不预测密集的运动轨迹，而是将动画表示为ARKit面部控制空间中一系列语义有意义的关键帧。一个语言驱动模型利用大型语言模型（LLM）先验知识，生成与上下文文本描述和情感线索对齐的关键帧。为支持此，构建了一个包含2,100个表情脚本、单目视频、每帧ARKit系数和手动标注语义关键帧的多模态数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，与不使用面部动作语义的方法相比，结合语义关键帧监督和语言先验显著提高了表情保真度和语义对齐。
AI.conclusion: KeyframeFace通过引入语义关键帧和语言先验，为语言驱动的面部动画提供了一种更精确、可控和语义对齐的解决方案，克服了传统文本到连续帧方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 面部动画是计算机图形（CG）行业中创建数字角色的核心组成部分。典型的生产工作流程依赖于稀疏、具有语义意义的关键帧来精确控制面部表情。直接从自然语言描述实现此类动画可以显著提高内容创作效率和可访问性。然而，大多数现有方法采用文本到连续帧的范式，直接从语言中回归密集的面部运动轨迹。这种方法将高级语义意图与低级运动纠缠在一起，缺乏明确的语义控制结构，并限制了精确编辑和可解释性。受动画制作中关键帧范式的启发，我们提出了KeyframeFace，一个通过可解释关键帧实现语言驱动语义面部动画的框架。我们的方法不是预测密集的运动轨迹，而是将动画表示为可解释的基于ARKit的面部控制空间中的一系列语义有意义的关键帧。一个语言驱动模型利用大型语言模型（LLM）先验知识来生成与上下文文本描述和情感线索对齐的关键帧。为了支持这种方法，我们构建了一个多模态数据集，包含2,100个表情脚本，并配有单目视频、每帧ARKit系数和手动标注的语义关键帧。实验表明，与不使用面部动作语义的方法相比，结合语义关键帧监督和语言先验显著提高了表情保真度和语义对齐。
AI.summary: KeyframeFace是一个创新的框架，它通过语言驱动的语义关键帧实现面部动画，解决了现有文本到连续帧方法在语义控制和可编辑性方面的不足。该方法将动画表示为ARKit控制空间中的语义关键帧序列，并利用LLM先验生成与语言描述和情感线索一致的关键帧。为支持此，团队构建了一个包含详细标注的多模态数据集。实验结果证明，KeyframeFace在表情保真度和语义对齐方面显著优于不利用面部动作语义的方法。
AI.keywords: 面部动画, 语言驱动, 语义关键帧, ARKit, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入语义关键帧和LLM先验，为语言驱动的面部动画提供了一种更具可控性和可解释性的新范式。其创新点在于将高层语义意图与低层运动解耦，并利用关键帧思想赋能精确编辑。构建的多模态数据集也为该领域的研究提供了宝贵资源。该方法有望大幅提升CG内容创作的效率和质量。

title: Aion: Towards Hierarchical 4D Scene Graphs with Temporal Flow Dynamics
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments requires spatial representations that capture both semantic structure and temporal evolution. 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) provide hierarchical multi-resolution abstractions that encode geometry and semantics, but existing extensions toward dynamics largely focus on individual objects or agents. In parallel, Maps of Dynamics (MoDs) model typical motion patterns and temporal regularities, yet are usually tied to grid-based discretizations that lack semantic awareness and do not scale well to large environments. In this paper we introduce Aion, a framework that embeds temporal flow dynamics directly within a hierarchical 3DSG, effectively incorporating the temporal dimension. Aion employs a graph-based sparse MoD representation to capture motion flows over arbitrary time intervals and attaches them to navigational nodes in the scene graph, yielding more interpretable and scalable predictions that improve planning and interaction in complex dynamic environments. We provide the code at https://github.com/IacopomC/aion

AI.title_translation: Aion：迈向具有时间流动力学的分层4D场景图
AI.tldr: Aion是一个将时间流动力学直接嵌入分层3D场景图的框架，通过图基稀疏动态图表示来改进动态环境中可解释且可扩展的规划和交互。
AI.motivation: 在动态环境中自主导航需要同时捕获语义结构和时间演变的表示。现有的3D场景图（3DSGs）在动态方面主要关注个体对象，而动态地图（MoDs）虽然模拟运动模式，但通常受限于网格化离散，缺乏语义感知且在大环境中可扩展性差。
AI.method: Aion框架将时间流动力学直接嵌入到分层3D场景图（3DSG）中。它采用基于图的稀疏动态图（MoD）表示来捕捉任意时间间隔内的运动流，并将其附加到场景图中的导航节点。
AI.result: 产生更具可解释性和可扩展性的预测，从而改善在复杂动态环境中的规划和交互。

AI.translation: 在动态环境中进行自主导航需要能够捕捉语义结构和时间演变的几何表示。3D场景图（3DSGs）提供了编码几何和语义的分层多分辨率抽象，但现有对动态的扩展主要集中在个体对象或代理。与此同时，动态地图（MoDs）模拟典型的运动模式和时间规律，但通常受限于基于网格的离散化，缺乏语义感知，并且在大环境中扩展性不佳。在本文中，我们引入了Aion，一个将时间流动力学直接嵌入到分层3DSG中的框架，有效地整合了时间维度。Aion采用基于图的稀疏MoD表示来捕捉任意时间间隔内的运动流，并将其附加到场景图中的导航节点，从而产生更具可解释性和可扩展性的预测，改善在复杂动态环境中的规划和交互。我们提供了代码，网址为https://github.com/IacopomC/aion。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Aion，一个将时间流动力学直接整合到分层3D场景图（3DSG）中的框架，以解决动态环境中自主导航对同时捕捉语义和时间演变表示的需求。Aion通过采用图基稀疏动态图（MoD）表示来捕捉运动流并将其附加到场景图的导航节点，从而提供更具可解释性和可扩展性的预测，进而改善复杂动态环境中的规划和交互。
AI.keywords: 4D场景图, 时间流动力学, 3D场景图, 动态地图, 自主导航
AI.comments: Aion的创新之处在于将时间流动力学直接整合到分层3D场景图这一现有强大的空间表示中，解决了传统3DSG在处理动态方面的局限性以及MoD在语义感知和可扩展性上的不足。这种方法有望为自主导航和人机交互提供更鲁棒和智能的解决方案。

title: TechImage-Bench: Rubric-Based Evaluation for Technical Image Generation
summary: We study technical image generation, where a model must synthesize information-dense, scientifically precise illustrations from detailed descriptions rather than merely produce visually plausible pictures. To quantify the progress, we introduce TechImage-Bench, a rubric-based benchmark that targets biology schematics, engineering/patent drawings, and general technical illustrations. For 654 figures collected from real textbooks and technical reports, we construct detailed image instructions and a hierarchy of rubrics that decompose correctness into 6,076 criteria and 44,131 binary checks. Rubrics are derived from surrounding text and reference figures using large multimodal models, and are evaluated by an automated LMM-based judge with a principled penalty scheme that aggregates sub-question outcomes into interpretable criterion scores. We benchmark several representative text-to-image models on TechImage-Bench and find that, despite strong open-domain performance, the best base model reaches only 0.801 rubric accuracy and 0.576 criterion score overall, revealing substantial gaps in fine-grained scientific fidelity. Finally, we show that the same rubrics provide actionable supervision: feeding failed checks back into an editing model for iterative refinement boosts a strong generator from 0.660 to 0.865 in rubric accuracy and from 0.382 to 0.697 in criterion score. TechImage-Bench thus offers both a rigorous diagnostic for technical image generation and a scalable signal for improving specification-faithful scientific illustrations.

AI.title_translation: TechImage-Bench: 基于评分标准的科技图像生成评估
AI.tldr: TechImage-Bench是一个基于评分标准的基准，用于评估科技图像生成模型，发现现有模型在科学精确性方面存在显著差距，但通过迭代细化，评分标准可以有效提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型在生成信息密集、科学精确的科技图像方面存在挑战，需要一个量化评估工具来衡量进展并提供改进方向。
AI.method: 研究引入了TechImage-Bench，一个针对生物示意图、工程/专利图和通用科技插图的基于评分标准的基准。该基准包含从教科书和技术报告中收集的654张图，构建了详细的图像指令和包含6,076个标准和44,131个二元检查的评分标准。评分标准通过大型多模态模型从文本和参考图中提取，并由自动化的LMM法官进行评估。同时，研究展示了如何将失败的检查反馈给编辑模型进行迭代细化。
AI.result: 基准测试发现，尽管在开放领域表现强劲，但最佳基础模型在TechImage-Bench上的评分标准准确率仅达到0.801，整体标准得分仅为0.576，揭示了在精细科学保真度方面的巨大差距。然而，将失败的检查反馈给编辑模型进行迭代细化，可以将生成器的评分标准准确率从0.660提升到0.865，标准得分从0.382提升到0.697。
AI.conclusion: TechImage-Bench为科技图像生成提供了一个严格的诊断工具，并为改进符合规范的科学插图提供了可扩展的信号。
AI.translation: 我们研究了科技图像生成，其中模型必须根据详细描述合成信息密集、科学精确的插图，而不仅仅是生成视觉上合理图片。为了量化进展，我们引入了TechImage-Bench，一个基于评分标准的基准，目标是生物示意图、工程/专利图和通用科技插图。对于从真实教科书和技术报告中收集的654张图，我们构建了详细的图像指令和评分标准层次结构，将正确性分解为6,076个标准和44,131个二元检查。评分标准是使用大型多模态模型从周围文本和参考图中提取的，并由一个自动化的基于LMM的法官进行评估，该法官采用原则性的惩罚方案，将子问题结果汇总为可解释的标准分数。我们使用TechImage-Bench对几个代表性的文本到图像模型进行了基准测试，发现尽管在开放领域表现强劲，但最佳基础模型在评分标准准确率上仅达到0.801，整体标准得分仅为0.576，揭示了在精细科学保真度方面的巨大差距。最后，我们表明相同的评分标准提供了可操作的监督：将失败的检查反馈给编辑模型进行迭代细化，可以将一个强大的生成器的评分标准准确率从0.660提升到0.865，标准得分从0.382提升到0.697。因此，TechImage-Bench既为科技图像生成提供了严格的诊断工具，也为改进符合规范的科学插图提供了可扩展的信号。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了TechImage-Bench，一个用于评估科技图像生成模型的新型基准。该基准通过构建详细的评分标准（包含6,076个标准和44,131个二元检查），旨在量化模型在生成信息密集、科学精确插图方面的能力。实验发现，现有文本到图像模型在科学保真度方面存在显著不足，但通过将评分标准的失败检查反馈给编辑模型进行迭代细化，可以大幅提升生成质量。TechImage-Bench不仅提供了一个严格的诊断工具，也为提升科技图像生成质量提供了有效的监督信号。
AI.keywords: 科技图像生成, 评分标准评估, TechImage-Bench, 大型多模态模型, 迭代细化
AI.comments: TechImage-Bench的创新之处在于其细致入微的基于评分标准的评估体系，将科技图像的正确性分解为大量的具体标准，这远超现有视觉评估方法。通过LMM自动法官进行评估，并将其作为迭代改进的反馈信号，为提升模型在专业领域图像生成中的科学精确性提供了开创性的思路。这对于推动AI在科学传播和工程设计等领域的应用具有重要意义。

title: The Moralization Corpus: Frame-Based Annotation and Analysis of Moralizing Speech Acts across Diverse Text Genres
summary: Moralizations - arguments that invoke moral values to justify demands or positions - are a yet underexplored form of persuasive communication. We present the Moralization Corpus, a novel multi-genre dataset designed to analyze how moral values are strategically used in argumentative discourse. Moralizations are pragmatically complex and often implicit, posing significant challenges for both human annotators and NLP systems. We develop a frame-based annotation scheme that captures the constitutive elements of moralizations - moral values, demands, and discourse protagonists - and apply it to a diverse set of German texts, including political debates, news articles, and online discussions. The corpus enables fine-grained analysis of moralizing language across communicative formats and domains. We further evaluate several large language models (LLMs) under varied prompting conditions for the task of moralization detection and moralization component extraction and compare it to human annotations in order to investigate the challenges of automatic and manual analysis of moralizations. Results show that detailed prompt instructions has a greater effect than few-shot or explanation-based prompting, and that moralization remains a highly subjective and context-sensitive task. We release all data, annotation guidelines, and code to foster future interdisciplinary research on moral discourse and moral reasoning in NLP.

AI.title_translation: 道德化语料库：基于框架的跨文本类型道德化言语行为标注与分析
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个多类型道德化语料库，开发了基于框架的标注方案，并评估了大型语言模型在道德化检测和成分提取方面的表现，发现详细的提示说明比少量示例或基于解释的提示更有效，且道德化任务具有高度主观性和语境敏感性。
AI.motivation: 道德化是一种未被充分探索的说服性沟通形式，本研究旨在分析道德价值观如何在议论性语篇中被策略性地使用，并解决其在人工标注和自然语言处理系统中的复杂性和隐性挑战。
AI.method: 本研究构建了一个新颖的多类型数据集——道德化语料库，并开发了一种基于框架的标注方案，用于捕捉道德化言语行为的构成要素（道德价值观、要求和语篇主角）。该方案应用于政治辩论、新闻文章和在线讨论等多种德语文本。此外，研究还评估了多个大型语言模型在不同提示条件下进行道德化检测和成分提取任务的表现，并与人工标注进行了比较。
AI.result: 结果表明，详细的提示说明比少量示例或基于解释的提示对大型语言模型的效果更大。同时，研究发现道德化仍然是一项高度主观和语境敏感的任务。
AI.conclusion: 本研究发布了道德化语料库、标注指南和代码，以促进未来在自然语言处理领域中关于道德语篇和道德推理的跨学科研究。道德化任务的高度主观性和语境敏感性是未来研究需要进一步解决的挑战。
AI.translation: 道德化——援引道德价值观以证明要求或立场合理性的论证——是一种尚未被充分探索的说服性沟通形式。我们提出了道德化语料库，这是一个新颖的多类型数据集，旨在分析道德价值观如何在议论性语篇中被策略性地使用。道德化在语用学上是复杂的，且通常是隐含的，这对人类标注者和自然语言处理系统都构成了重大挑战。我们开发了一种基于框架的标注方案，捕捉道德化的构成要素——道德价值观、要求和语篇主角——并将其应用于一系列多样化的德语文本，包括政治辩论、新闻文章和在线讨论。该语料库能够对跨沟通形式和领域的道德化语言进行细粒度分析。我们进一步评估了几个大型语言模型（LLM）在不同提示条件下进行道德化检测和道德化成分提取任务的表现，并将其与人类标注进行比较，以调查道德化自动和手动分析的挑战。结果表明，详细的提示说明比少量示例或基于解释的提示具有更大的效果，并且道德化仍然是一项高度主观和语境敏感的任务。我们发布了所有数据、标注指南和代码，以促进未来在自然语言处理领域中关于道德语篇和道德推理的跨学科研究。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了“道德化语料库”，一个用于分析议论性语篇中道德价值观策略性使用的多类型数据集。研究开发了一种基于框架的标注方案来捕捉道德化行为的核心要素，并将其应用于多样化的德语文本。通过评估大型语言模型在道德化检测和成分提取方面的表现，研究发现详细的提示说明效果显著优于其他提示方法，并强调了道德化任务的主观性和语境敏感性。所有数据和资源均已发布，以支持未来的跨学科研究。
AI.keywords: 道德化语料库, 框架标注, 道德化言语行为, 大型语言模型, 说服性沟通
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于构建了一个全新的多类型道德化语料库和一套基于框架的精细标注方案，为理解和分析道德化言语行为提供了宝贵的资源。通过评估大型语言模型，揭示了当前AI在处理高度主观和语境敏感的道德化任务时面临的挑战，并为未来的模型优化和提示工程提供了方向。该工作对自然语言处理中道德语篇和道德推理的研究具有重要推动作用。

title: Stepwise Think-Critique: A Unified Framework for Robust and Interpretable LLM Reasoning
summary: Human beings solve complex problems through critical thinking, where reasoning and evaluation are intertwined to converge toward correct solutions. However, most existing large language models (LLMs) treat the reasoning and verification as separate processes: they either generate reasoning without explicit self-checking or rely on external verifiers to detect errors post hoc. The former lacks immediate feedback, while the latter increases system complexity and hinders synchronized learning. Motivated by human critical thinking, we propose Stepwise Think-Critique (STC), a unified and end-to-end trainable framework that interleaves reasoning and self-critique at every intermediate step within a single model. STC is trained with a hybrid reinforcement learning objective that integrates reasoning rewards and critique-consistency rewards, thereby jointly optimizing solution correctness and reliability of self-evaluation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that STC demonstrates strong critical-thinking capabilities and produces more interpretable reasoning traces, representing a step toward LLMs with built-in critical thinking.

AI.title_translation: 逐步思考-批判：一个用于鲁棒和可解释LLM推理的统一框架
AI.tldr: 提出Stepwise Think-Critique (STC) 框架，通过在LLM推理过程中交错推理和自我批判，实现更鲁棒和可解释的推理，模拟人类批判性思维。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM的推理和验证过程分离，要么缺乏即时反馈，要么增加了系统复杂性。人类通过批判性思维解决问题，推理和评估交织在一起。因此，需要一个统一的框架来整合推理和自我批判，以提高LLM的推理能力和可解释性。
AI.method: 提出Stepwise Think-Critique (STC)，一个统一的、端到端可训练的框架。它在单个模型中，在每个中间步骤交错进行推理和自我批判。STC使用混合强化学习目标进行训练，该目标整合了推理奖励和批判一致性奖励，共同优化解决方案的正确性和自我评估的可靠性。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试中，STC展示了强大的批判性思维能力，并产生了更可解释的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: STC代表着LLM内置批判性思维的一步，能够实现鲁棒和可解释的推理。
AI.translation: 人类通过批判性思维解决复杂问题，其中推理和评估相互交织，以趋向正确的解决方案。然而，大多数现有的大型语言模型（LLM）将推理和验证视为独立的过程：它们要么在没有明确自我检查的情况下生成推理，要么依赖外部验证器事后检测错误。前者缺乏即时反馈，而后者增加了系统复杂性并阻碍了同步学习。受人类批判性思维的启发，我们提出了逐步思考-批判（Stepwise Think-Critique, STC），这是一个统一的、端到端可训练的框架，它在单个模型中的每个中间步骤交错进行推理和自我批判。STC通过混合强化学习目标进行训练，该目标整合了推理奖励和批判一致性奖励，从而共同优化解决方案的正确性和自我评估的可靠性。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，STC展示了强大的批判性思维能力，并产生了更可解释的推理轨迹，代表着LLM内置批判性思维迈出了一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了逐步思考-批判（Stepwise Think-Critique, STC）框架，旨在解决现有大型语言模型（LLM）推理和验证过程分离的问题。受人类批判性思维启发，STC在一个统一的、端到端可训练的模型中，于每个中间推理步骤中交错进行推理和自我批判。该框架通过整合推理奖励和批判一致性奖励的混合强化学习目标进行训练，以同时优化解决方案的正确性和自我评估的可靠性。实验结果表明，STC在数学推理任务上展现出强大的批判性思维能力，并生成了更具可解释性的推理过程，为构建具备内在批判性思维的LLM奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 批判性思维, 强化学习, 推理, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的统一框架Stepwise Think-Critique (STC)，通过在LLM推理过程中引入交错的自我批判机制，有效地解决了现有LLM推理与验证分离的问题。其创新点在于将人类批判性思维融入到模型设计中，并采用混合强化学习目标进行端到端训练，使得模型能够同时优化推理的正确性和自我评估的可靠性。这对于提升LLM的鲁棒性和可解释性具有重要意义，是LLM迈向更高级智能的关键一步。

title: Generative Refocusing: Flexible Defocus Control from a Single Image
summary: Depth-of-field control is essential in photography, but achieving perfect focus often requires multiple attempts or specialized equipment. Single-image refocusing is still difficult. It involves recovering sharp content and creating realistic bokeh. Current methods have significant drawbacks. They require all-in-focus inputs, rely on synthetic data from simulators, and have limited control over the aperture. We introduce Generative Refocusing, a two-step process that uses DeblurNet to recover all-in-focus images from diverse inputs and BokehNet to create controllable bokeh. This method combines synthetic and real bokeh images to achieve precise control while preserving authentic optical characteristics. Our experiments show we achieve top performance in defocus deblurring, bokeh synthesis, and refocusing benchmarks. Additionally, our Generative Refocusing allows custom aperture shapes. Project page: https://generative-refocusing.github.io/

AI.title_translation: 生成式重聚焦：从单张图像实现灵活的散焦控制
AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了“生成式重聚焦”，一种从单张图像实现灵活散焦控制的两步法，通过DeblurNet恢复全聚焦图像，并用BokehNet创建可控的散景，解决了现有方法在散景合成和光圈控制方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 景深控制在摄影中至关重要，但实现完美聚焦通常需要多次尝试或专业设备。单图像重聚焦仍然面临挑战，需要恢复清晰内容并创建逼真的散景。现有方法存在显著缺点，如需要全聚焦输入、依赖模拟器合成数据以及对光圈控制有限。
AI.method: 该方法引入了“生成式重聚焦”，这是一个两步过程。首先，使用DeblurNet从不同输入中恢复全聚焦图像。其次，使用BokehNet创建可控散景。该方法结合了合成和真实散景图像，以实现精确控制，同时保留真实光学特性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在散焦去模糊、散景合成和重聚焦基准测试中取得了顶尖性能。此外，“生成式重聚焦”还允许自定义光圈形状。
AI.conclusion: 该论文成功提出了“生成式重聚焦”方法，有效解决了单图像重聚焦的难题，实现了从单张图像进行灵活的景深控制，并在多个基准测试中表现出色，同时支持自定义光圈形状。
AI.translation: 景深控制在摄影中至关重要，但实现完美聚焦通常需要多次尝试或专业设备。单图像重聚焦仍然困难。它涉及恢复清晰内容并创建逼真的散景。现有方法存在显著缺点。它们需要全聚焦输入，依赖模拟器中的合成数据，并且对光圈的控制有限。我们引入了生成式重聚焦，这是一个两步过程，使用DeblurNet从各种输入中恢复全聚焦图像，并使用BokehNet创建可控散景。该方法结合了合成和真实散景图像，以实现精确控制，同时保留真实的光学特性。我们的实验表明，我们在散焦去模糊、散景合成和重聚焦基准测试中取得了顶尖性能。此外，我们的生成式重聚焦允许自定义光圈形状。项目页面：https://generative-refocusing.github.io/
AI.summary: 该论文提出了“生成式重聚焦”框架，旨在从单张图像实现灵活的景深控制。该方法通过DeblurNet恢复全聚焦图像，再利用BokehNet生成可控的逼真散景，解决了传统单图像重聚焦的挑战以及现有方法在数据依赖和光圈控制上的局限性。实验证明，该方法在去模糊、散景合成和重聚焦任务中表现优异，并支持自定义光圈形状。
AI.keywords: 生成式重聚焦, 散焦控制, 单图像, 散景合成, 景深
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其两步走的方法，将去模糊和散景合成解耦，并结合了真实与合成数据以增强真实感和控制力。其能够从单张图像实现灵活的景深控制，并支持自定义光圈形状，对计算摄影领域具有重要意义。这解决了摄影中一个长期存在的挑战，并为后期编辑提供了强大的工具。

title: Adaptive Accountability in Networked MAS: Tracing and Mitigating Emergent Norms at Scale
summary: Large-scale networked multi-agent systems increasingly underpin critical infrastructure, yet their collective behavior can drift toward undesirable emergent norms such as collusion, resource hoarding, and implicit unfairness. We present the Adaptive Accountability Framework (AAF), an end-to-end runtime layer that (i) records cryptographically verifiable interaction provenance, (ii) detects distributional change points in streaming traces, (iii) attributes responsibility via a causal influence graph, and (iv) applies cost-bounded interventions-reward shaping and targeted policy patching-to steer the system back toward compliant behavior. We establish a bounded-compromise guarantee: if the expected cost of intervention exceeds an adversary's expected payoff, the long-run fraction of compromised interactions converges to a value strictly below one. We evaluate AAF in a large-scale factorial simulation suite (87,480 runs across two tasks; up to 100 agents plus a 500-agent scaling sweep; full and partial observability; Byzantine rates up to 10%; 10 seeds per regime). Across 324 regimes, AAF lowers the executed compromise ratio relative to a Proximal Policy Optimization baseline in 96% of regimes (median relative reduction 11.9%) while preserving social welfare (median change 0.4%). Under adversarial injections, AAF detects norm violations with a median delay of 71 steps (interquartile range 39-177) and achieves a mean top-ranked attribution accuracy of 0.97 at 10% Byzantine rate.

AI.title_translation: 网络化多智能体系统中的自适应问责制：大规模追踪和缓解涌现规范
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了自适应问责框架（AAF），一个运行时层，用于在大规模网络化多智能体系统中记录交互证据、检测行为变化、归因责任并通过干预措施（如奖励塑造和策略修补）来缓解诸如串通、资源囤积和隐式不公平等不良涌现规范，从而使系统恢复到合规行为。AAF在模拟中显著降低了妥协率并保持了社会福利。
AI.motivation: 大型网络化多智能体系统日益支撑关键基础设施，但其集体行为可能趋向于不良的涌现规范，例如串通、资源囤积和隐式不公平。
AI.method: 提出了自适应问责框架（AAF），一个端到端运行时层，它包括：(i) 记录加密可验证的交互证据；(ii) 检测流式追踪中的分布变化点；(iii) 通过因果影响图归因责任；(iv) 应用成本受限的干预措施——奖励塑造和有针对性的策略修补——以引导系统回到合规行为。该框架还建立了一个有界妥协保证。
AI.result: AAF在96%的测试方案中相对于Proximal Policy Optimization基线降低了已执行的妥协率（中位数相对减少11.9%），同时保持了社会福利（中位数变化0.4%）。在对抗性注入下，AAF检测规范违规的中位数延迟为71步，在10%的拜占庭率下实现了0.97的平均最高排名归因准确率。
AI.conclusion: 自适应问责框架（AAF）能够有效地在大规模网络化多智能体系统中追踪、检测和缓解不良的涌现规范，显著降低系统妥协率并保持社会福利，即使在对抗性环境下也能准确归因责任。
AI.translation: 大型网络化多智能体系统日益支撑关键基础设施，但其集体行为可能趋向于不良的涌现规范，例如串通、资源囤积和隐式不公平。我们提出了自适应问责框架（AAF），一个端到端运行时层，它（i）记录加密可验证的交互证据，（ii）检测流式追踪中的分布变化点，（iii）通过因果影响图归因责任，以及（iv）应用成本受限的干预措施——奖励塑造和有针对性的策略修补——以引导系统回到合规行为。我们建立了一个有界妥协保证：如果干预的预期成本超过对手的预期收益，那么受损交互的长期比例将收敛到一个严格小于1的值。我们在一个大规模因子模拟套件中评估了AAF（两个任务共87,480次运行；多达100个智能体加上500个智能体扩展扫描；完全和部分可观测性；拜占庭率高达10%；每个方案10个种子）。在324个方案中，AAF在96%的方案中相对于Proximal Policy Optimization基线降低了已执行的妥协率（中位数相对减少11.9%），同时保持了社会福利（中位数变化0.4%）。在对抗性注入下，AAF检测规范违规的中位数延迟为71步（四分位距39-177），并在10%的拜占庭率下实现了0.97的平均最高排名归因准确率。
AI.summary: 本文提出自适应问责框架（AAF），旨在解决大规模网络化多智能体系统中出现的串通、资源囤积等不良涌现规范问题。AAF通过记录可验证的交互证据、检测行为变化、利用因果图归因责任，并采用奖励塑造和策略修补等干预措施，将系统引导回合规状态。实验证明，AAF能有效降低系统妥协率，保持社会福利，并能准确检测和归因规范违规。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 自适应问责制, 涌现规范, 行为检测, 干预措施
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个端到端的运行时框架AAF，它不仅能够追踪和检测大规模多智能体系统中的不良行为，还能通过主动干预措施进行缓解，并提供了有界妥协保证。其对大规模模拟的详尽评估也增强了结果的可信度。该框架对于维护关键基础设施中多智能体系统的稳定性和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: A Comedy of Estimators: On KL Regularization in RL Training of LLMs
summary: The reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) can be substantially improved by training them with reinforcement learning (RL). The RL objective for LLM training involves a regularization term, which is the reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the trained policy and the reference policy. Since computing the KL divergence exactly is intractable, various estimators are used in practice to estimate it from on-policy samples. Despite its wide adoption, including in several open-source libraries, there is no systematic study analyzing the numerous ways of incorporating KL estimators in the objective and their effect on the downstream performance of RL-trained models. Recent works show that prevailing practices for incorporating KL regularization do not provide correct gradients for stated objectives, creating a discrepancy between the objective and its implementation. In this paper, we further analyze these practices and study the gradients of several estimators configurations, revealing how design choices shape gradient bias. We substantiate these findings with empirical observations by RL fine-tuning \texttt{Qwen2.5-7B}, \texttt{Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct} and \texttt{Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507} with different configurations and evaluating their performance on both in- and out-of-distribution tasks. Through our analysis, we observe that, in on-policy settings: (1) estimator configurations with biased gradients can result in training instabilities; and (2) using estimator configurations resulting in unbiased gradients leads to better performance on in-domain as well as out-of-domain tasks. We also investigate the performance resulting from different KL configurations in off-policy settings and observe that KL regularization can help stabilize off-policy RL training resulting from asynchronous setups.

AI.title_translation: 估计器喜剧：关于LLM强化学习训练中的KL正则化
AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了LLM强化学习训练中KL正则化估计器的不同配置及其对模型性能和梯度偏差的影响，发现无偏梯度估计器能带来更好的性能和训练稳定性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的推理性能可以通过强化学习（RL）训练显著提高。RL训练目标中包含一个反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度正则化项，但由于精确计算KL散度是不可行的，实践中使用了各种估计器。然而，目前缺乏对这些KL估计器纳入目标函数的方式及其对RL训练模型下游性能影响的系统研究。现有研究表明，普遍的KL正则化实践未能为既定目标提供正确的梯度，导致目标与实现之间存在差异。
AI.method: 本文进一步分析了现有的实践，并研究了几种估计器配置的梯度，揭示了设计选择如何影响梯度偏差。通过对Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507进行RL微调，使用不同的配置并在域内和域外任务上评估其性能，本文证实了这些发现。此外，还研究了离策略设置中不同KL配置的性能。
AI.result: 在同策略（on-policy）设置中，观察到：(1) 具有偏置梯度的估计器配置可能导致训练不稳定；(2) 使用导致无偏梯度的估计器配置可以获得更好的域内和域外任务性能。在离策略（off-policy）设置中，观察到KL正则化有助于稳定异步设置导致的离策略RL训练。
AI.conclusion: 本文的分析和实证结果表明，在LLM的RL训练中，KL正则化估计器的设计选择对梯度偏差、训练稳定性和模型性能有显著影响。特别是在同策略设置中，使用导致无偏梯度的估计器配置对于实现更好的模型性能和训练稳定性至关重要。此外，KL正则化在离策略设置中也能帮助稳定训练。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的推理性能可以通过强化学习（RL）训练得到显著提升。LLM训练的RL目标包含一个正则化项，即训练策略与参考策略之间的反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度。由于精确计算KL散度是不可行的，实践中使用了各种估计器从同策略样本中对其进行估计。尽管KL估计器被广泛采用，包括在多个开源库中，但目前还没有系统研究分析将KL估计器纳入目标函数的多种方式及其对RL训练模型下游性能的影响。最近的工作表明，普遍的KL正则化实践未能为既定目标提供正确的梯度，从而在目标与实现之间造成差异。在本文中，我们进一步分析了这些实践，并研究了几种估计器配置的梯度，揭示了设计选择如何影响梯度偏差。我们通过对Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507进行RL微调，使用不同的配置并在域内和域外任务上评估其性能来证实这些发现。通过我们的分析，我们观察到，在同策略设置中：(1) 具有偏置梯度的估计器配置可能导致训练不稳定；(2) 使用导致无偏梯度的估计器配置可以获得更好的域内和域外任务性能。我们还研究了离策略设置中不同KL配置的性能，并观察到KL正则化有助于稳定异步设置导致的离策略RL训练。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）训练中KL正则化估计器的影响。研究发现，由于KL散度难以精确计算，实践中使用的估计器及其配置对梯度偏差、训练稳定性和模型性能至关重要。通过分析梯度并对Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507进行实证微调，作者发现具有偏置梯度的估计器会导致训练不稳定，而无偏梯度的估计器配置在同策略任务中能带来更好的域内和域外性能。此外，KL正则化在离策略异步设置中也有助于稳定训练。
AI.keywords: KL正则化, 强化学习, 大型语言模型, 梯度偏差, 估计器
AI.comments: 这篇论文深入探讨了LLM强化学习训练中一个被忽视但至关重要的细节：KL正则化估计器的选择和配置。其创新性在于系统地分析了不同估计器配置如何影响梯度偏差，并进一步证实了这些偏差对训练稳定性和最终模型性能的影响。这一研究填补了现有实践与理论理解之间的空白，对于优化LLM的RL训练具有重要的指导意义，特别是强调了无偏梯度估计器在同策略设置中的重要性。论文的局限性可能在于其主要关注了特定LLM模型和任务，但其核心发现对于更广泛的RLHF应用具有普适性。

title: Computing Pure-Strategy Nash Equilibria in a Two-Party Policy Competition: Existence and Algorithmic Approaches
comments: A full version of the extended abstract in AAMAS 2026
summary: We formulate two-party policy competition as a two-player non-cooperative game, generalizing Lin et al.'s work (2021). Each party selects a real-valued policy vector as its strategy from a compact subset of Euclidean space, and a voter's utility for a policy is given by the inner product with their preference vector. To capture the uncertainty in the competition, we assume that a policy's winning probability increases monotonically with its total utility across all voters, and we formalize this via an affine isotonic function. A player's payoff is defined as the expected utility received by its supporters. In this work, we first test and validate the isotonicity hypothesis through voting simulations. Next, we prove the existence of a pure-strategy Nash equilibrium (PSNE) in both one- and multi-dimensional settings. Although we construct a counterexample demonstrating the game's non-monotonicity, our experiments show that a decentralized gradient-based algorithm typically converges rapidly to an approximate PSNE. Finally, we present a grid-based search algorithm that finds an $ε$-approximate PSNE of the game in time polynomial in the input size and $1/ε$.

AI.title_translation: 两党政策竞争中纯策略纳什均衡的计算：存在性与算法方法
AI.tldr: 本文将两党政策竞争建模为非合作博弈，证明了纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE）的存在性，并提出了基于梯度和基于网格的算法来寻找近似PSNE。
AI.motivation: 为了推广Lin等人（2021）的工作，并将两党政策竞争中的不确定性建模为非合作博弈，旨在找到纯策略纳什均衡。
AI.method: 将两党政策竞争公式化为双人非合作博弈，定义政策获胜概率和玩家收益。通过投票模拟验证等渗性假设。证明一维和多维设置中纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE）的存在性。开发去中心化梯度算法和基于网格的搜索算法来寻找近似PSNE。
AI.result: 通过投票模拟验证了等渗性假设。证明了在一维和多维设置中纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE）的存在性。博弈被证明是非单调的，但去中心化梯度算法通常能迅速收敛到近似PSNE。基于网格的搜索算法能在多项式时间内找到ε-近似PSNE。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将两党政策竞争建模为博弈，证明了PSNE的存在性，并提供了有效的算法方法（基于梯度和基于网格）来寻找近似PSNE，尽管博弈是非单调的。
AI.translation: 我们将两党政策竞争表述为一个双人非合作博弈，推广了Lin等人（2021）的工作。每个政党从欧几里得空间的一个紧凑子集中选择一个实值政策向量作为其策略，选民对一项政策的效用由其偏好向量的内积给出。为了捕捉竞争中的不确定性，我们假设一项政策的获胜概率随着其在所有选民中的总效用单调增加，并通过一个仿射等渗函数将其形式化。玩家的收益被定义为其支持者获得的预期效用。在这项工作中，我们首先通过投票模拟测试并验证了等渗性假设。接下来，我们证明了在一维和多维设置中纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE）的存在性。尽管我们构建了一个反例来证明博弈的非单调性，但我们的实验表明，一个去中心化的基于梯度的算法通常能迅速收敛到一个近似的PSNE。最后，我们提出了一种基于网格的搜索算法，该算法能在输入规模和1/ε的多项式时间内找到博弈的ε-近似PSNE。
AI.summary: 本文将两党政策竞争建模为双人非合作博弈，扩展了现有工作。它定义了政策获胜概率和玩家收益，并通过模拟验证了等渗性假设。论文证明了纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE）在一维和多维环境中的存在性。尽管证明了博弈的非单调性，作者们展示了一个去中心化的基于梯度的算法能够快速收敛到近似PSNE，并提出了一个基于网格的搜索算法，该算法能在多项式时间内找到ε-近似PSNE。
AI.keywords: 两党政策竞争, 纳什均衡, 博弈论, 算法方法, 等渗函数
AI.comments: 本文通过形式化建模两党政策竞争，证明纳什均衡的存在性并提供实用的算法解决方案，做出了重要贡献。等渗性假设的验证以及两种不同算法（梯度法追求速度，网格法提供保证）的开发是其主要优势。尽管博弈存在非单调性，但梯度法仍能实现收敛，这是一个值得注意的见解。

title: VL-RouterBench: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Model Routing
summary: Multi-model routing has evolved from an engineering technique into essential infrastructure, yet existing work lacks a systematic, reproducible benchmark for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs). We present VL-RouterBench to assess the overall capability of VLM routing systems systematically. The benchmark is grounded in raw inference and scoring logs from VLMs and constructs quality and cost matrices over sample-model pairs. In scale, VL-RouterBench covers 14 datasets across 3 task groups, totaling 30,540 samples, and includes 15 open-source models and 2 API models, yielding 519,180 sample-model pairs and a total input-output token volume of 34,494,977. The evaluation protocol jointly measures average accuracy, average cost, and throughput, and builds a ranking score from the harmonic mean of normalized cost and accuracy to enable comparison across router configurations and cost budgets. On this benchmark, we evaluate 10 routing methods and baselines and observe a significant routability gain, while the best current routers still show a clear gap to the ideal Oracle, indicating considerable room for improvement in router architecture through finer visual cues and modeling of textual structure. We will open-source the complete data construction and evaluation toolchain to promote comparability, reproducibility, and practical deployment in multimodal routing research.

AI.title_translation: VL-RouterBench：一个视觉-语言模型路由基准
AI.tldr: VL-RouterBench是一个评估视觉-语言模型(VLM)路由系统的基准。它基于VLM的推理和评分日志构建，涵盖14个数据集、15个开源模型和2个API模型，共519,180个样本-模型对。评估协议同时测量平均准确度、平均成本和吞吐量。结果显示路由方法有显著提升，但与理想的Oracle仍有差距，表明路由架构有改进空间。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型(VLM)路由工作缺乏系统性、可复现的基准来评估。多模型路由已从工程技术演变为必要基础设施，因此需要一个全面的评估工具。
AI.method: VL-RouterBench通过以下方式评估VLM路由系统：1. 基于VLM的原始推理和评分日志构建质量和成本矩阵。2. 涵盖14个数据集（3个任务组，30,540个样本）、15个开源模型和2个API模型，总计519,180个样本-模型对。3. 评估协议联合测量平均准确度、平均成本和吞吐量。4. 通过归一化成本和准确度的调和平均值构建排名分数，以比较不同的路由器配置和成本预算。5. 评估了10种路由方法和基线。
AI.result: 在VL-RouterBench基准上，评估的10种路由方法和基线显示出显著的路由增益。然而，目前最好的路由器与理想的Oracle之间仍存在明显差距。这表明在通过更精细的视觉线索和文本结构建模改进路由器架构方面仍有很大的提升空间。
AI.conclusion: VL-RouterBench提供了一个系统性、可复现的基准来评估视觉-语言模型路由系统。尽管当前的路由方法取得了显著进展，但与理想性能之间仍有差距，这为未来的路由器架构改进提供了明确的方向，特别是在利用更精细的视觉和文本信息方面。
AI.translation: 多模型路由已从一种工程技术演变为必要的基础设施，然而现有工作缺乏一个系统性、可复现的基准来评估视觉-语言模型（VLMs）。我们提出了VL-RouterBench，以系统地评估VLM路由系统的整体能力。该基准以VLM的原始推理和评分日志为基础，构建了样本-模型对的质量和成本矩阵。在规模上，VL-RouterBench涵盖了3个任务组的14个数据集，共计30,540个样本，包括15个开源模型和2个API模型，产生了519,180个样本-模型对，总输入-输出token量为34,494,977。评估协议联合测量平均准确度、平均成本和吞吐量，并从归一化成本和准确度的调和平均值构建排名分数，以实现跨路由器配置和成本预算的比较。在此基准上，我们评估了10种路由方法和基线，并观察到显著的路由增益，而目前最好的路由器与理想的Oracle之间仍存在明显差距，这表明通过更精细的视觉线索和文本结构建模，路由器架构仍有相当大的改进空间。我们将开源完整的数据构建和评估工具链，以促进多模态路由研究中的可比性、可复现性和实际部署。
AI.summary: VL-RouterBench是一个新的基准，旨在系统地评估视觉-语言模型(VLM)路由系统。它通过分析VLM的推理和评分日志，构建了包含14个数据集、15个开源和2个API模型的大规模样本-模型对数据集。该基准通过联合测量准确度、成本和吞吐量来评估路由性能，并引入排名分数进行比较。初步评估发现，现有路由方法虽有显著提升，但与理想性能仍有差距，提示未来可从视觉线索和文本结构建模方面改进路由器架构。该项目将开源其数据和工具链以促进研究。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型路由, 基准, 多模型路由, VLM, 评估
AI.comments: VL-RouterBench的创新之处在于它首次提供了一个系统性、可复现的大规模基准，用于评估VLM路由系统，填补了现有研究的空白。其基于真实推理日志和多维度评估协议（准确度、成本、吞吐量）的设计，使其在实际部署中具有重要价值。该基准的发布及其开源计划，将极大地推动多模态路由研究的进展和标准化。论文指出的与理想Oracle的差距，也为未来的研究指明了明确的方向。

title: NashOpt - A Python Library for Computing Generalized Nash Equilibria
summary: NashOpt is an open-source Python library for computing and designing generalized Nash equilibria (GNEs) in noncooperative games with shared constraints and real-valued decision variables. The library exploits the joint Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of all players to handle both general nonlinear GNEs and linear-quadratic games, including their variational versions. Nonlinear games are solved via nonlinear least-squares formulations, relying on JAX for automatic differentiation. Linear-quadratic GNEs are reformulated as mixed-integer linear programs, enabling efficient computation of multiple equilibria. The framework also supports inverse-game and Stackelberg game-design problems. The capabilities of NashOpt are demonstrated through several examples, including noncooperative game-theoretic control problems of linear quadratic regulation and model predictive control. The library is available at https://github.com/bemporad/nashopt

AI.title_translation: NashOpt - 一个用于计算广义纳什均衡的 Python 库
AI.tldr: NashOpt 是一个开源 Python 库，用于计算和设计具有共享约束和实值决策变量的非合作博弈中的广义纳什均衡（GNEs）。它利用KKT条件，通过非线性最小二乘或混合整数线性规划解决不同类型的GNEs，并支持逆博弈和Stackelberg博弈设计问题。
AI.motivation: 在具有共享约束和实值决策变量的非合作博弈中，计算和设计广义纳什均衡（GNEs）是一个复杂的问题。NashOpt 的创建旨在提供一个高效、开源的 Python 库来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: NashOpt 利用所有参与者的联合 Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) 条件来处理一般的非线性 GNEs 和线性二次博弈。非线性博弈通过非线性最小二乘公式求解，并依赖 JAX 进行自动微分。线性二次 GNEs 则被重新表述为混合整数线性规划，以实现多个均衡的有效计算。该框架还支持逆博弈和 Stackelberg 博弈设计问题。
AI.result: NashOpt 能够计算和设计非合作博弈中的广义纳什均衡，包括非线性 GNEs 和线性二次博弈。它支持通过非线性最小二乘（JAX）或混合整数线性规划（MILP）解决不同类型的博弈。该库还支持逆博弈和 Stackelberg 博弈设计问题，并已通过线性二次调节和模型预测控制等非合作博弈论控制问题进行了功能演示。
AI.conclusion: NashOpt 提供了一个全面的、开源的 Python 库，用于高效计算和设计具有共享约束和实值决策变量的非合作博弈中的广义纳什均衡，为博弈论控制问题提供了实用工具。
