title: CellSecInspector: Safeguarding Cellular Networks via Automated Security Analysis on Specifications
summary: The complexity, interdependence, and rapid evolution of 3GPP specifications present fundamental challenges for ensuring the security of modern cellular networks. Manual reviews and existing automated approaches, which often depend on rule-based parsing or small sets of manually crafted security requirements, fail to capture deep semantic dependencies, cross-sentence/clause relationships, and evolving specification behaviors. In this work, we present CellSecInspector, an automated framework for security analysis of 3GPP specifications. CellSecInspector extracts structured state-condition-action (SCA) representations, models mobile network procedures with comprehensive function chains, systematically validates them against 9 foundational security properties under 4 adversarial scenarios, and automatically generates test cases. This end-to-end approach enables the automated discovery of vulnerabilities without relying on manually predefined security requirements or rules. Applying CellSecInspector to the well-studied 5G and 4G NAS and RRC specifications and selected sections of TS 23.501 and TS 24.229, it discovers 43 vulnerabilities, 7 of which are previously unreported. Our findings show that CellSecInspector is a scalable, adaptive, and effective solution to assess 3GPP specifications for safeguarding operational and next-generation cellular networks.

AI.title_translation: CellSecInspector: 通过规范自动化安全分析保护蜂窝网络
AI.tldr: CellSecInspector是一个自动化框架，用于对3GPP规范进行安全分析，能够发现蜂窝网络中的漏洞，包括以前未报告的漏洞。
AI.motivation: 3GPP规范的复杂性、相互依赖性和快速演进给确保现代蜂窝网络安全带来了根本性挑战。现有的手动审查和自动化方法无法捕捉深层语义依赖、跨语句/子句关系和不断演进的规范行为。
AI.method: CellSecInspector通过以下步骤工作：1. 提取结构化的状态-条件-动作（SCA）表示。2. 使用全面的功能链建模移动网络过程。3. 根据4种对抗场景下的9个基础安全属性系统地验证这些过程。4. 自动生成测试用例。该方法无需手动预定义安全要求或规则即可发现漏洞。
AI.result: 将CellSecInspector应用于5G和4G NAS和RRC规范以及TS 23.501和TS 24.229的选定部分，发现了43个漏洞，其中7个是以前未报告的。
AI.conclusion: CellSecInspector是一个可扩展、自适应且有效的解决方案，可用于评估3GPP规范，以保护现有和下一代蜂窝网络。
AI.translation: 3GPP规范的复杂性、相互依赖性和快速演进给确保现代蜂窝网络安全带来了根本性挑战。手动审查和现有的自动化方法，通常依赖于基于规则的解析或少量手动编制的安全要求，未能捕捉深层语义依赖、跨语句/子句关系以及不断演进的规范行为。在这项工作中，我们提出了CellSecInspector，一个用于3GPP规范安全分析的自动化框架。CellSecInspector提取结构化的状态-条件-动作（SCA）表示，用全面的功能链建模移动网络过程，在4种对抗场景下根据9个基础安全属性系统地验证它们，并自动生成测试用例。这种端到端的方法无需依赖手动预定义的安全要求或规则即可实现漏洞的自动化发现。将CellSecInspector应用于经过充分研究的5G和4G NAS和RRC规范以及TS 23.501和TS 24.229的选定部分，它发现了43个漏洞，其中7个是以前未报告的。我们的研究结果表明，CellSecInspector是一个可扩展、自适应且有效的解决方案，可用于评估3GPP规范，以保护运行中的和下一代蜂窝网络。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了CellSecInspector，一个用于对3GPP规范进行自动化安全分析的框架。该框架通过提取结构化的状态-条件-动作表示、建模移动网络过程、根据安全属性进行验证并自动生成测试用例，解决了传统方法无法处理复杂规范和深层语义依赖的问题。CellSecInspector在应用于5G和4G规范时，成功发现了43个漏洞，包括7个此前未报告的漏洞，证明了其在保护蜂窝网络方面的有效性、可扩展性和适应性。
AI.keywords: 蜂窝网络安全, 3GPP规范, 自动化安全分析, 漏洞发现, CellSecInspector
AI.comments: CellSecInspector的创新之处在于其端到端的自动化方法，能够克服传统规则基方法在处理复杂、动态演进的3GPP规范时的局限性。它通过系统地建模和验证网络过程，无需手动预设安全规则即可发现深层漏洞，这对于保障未来蜂窝网络的安全至关重要。发现的新漏洞也凸显了其作为一种强大安全分析工具的实用价值。

title: Evaluating Feature Dependent Noise in Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Learning from Preferences in Reinforcement Learning (PbRL) has gained attention recently, as it serves as a natural fit for complicated tasks where the reward function is not easily available. However, preferences often come with uncertainty and noise if they are not from perfect teachers. Much prior literature aimed to detect noise, but with limited types of noise and most being uniformly distributed with no connection to observations. In this work, we formalize the notion of targeted feature-dependent noise and propose several variants like trajectory feature noise, trajectory similarity noise, margin dependent noise, and Language Model noise. We evaluate feature-dependent noise, where noise is correlated with certain features in complex continuous control tasks from DMControl and Meta-world. Our experiments show that in some feature-dependent noise settings, the state-of-the-art noise-robust PbRL method's learning performance is significantly deteriorated, while PbRL method with no explicit denoising can surprisingly outperform noise-robust PbRL in the majority of settings. We also find language models' noise exhibits similar characteristics to feature-dependent noise, thereby simulating realistic humans and call for further study in learning with feature-dependent noise robustly.

AI.title_translation: 评估基于偏好的强化学习中特征相关噪声
AI.tldr: 本文形式化并评估了基于偏好的强化学习中的特征相关噪声，发现现有去噪方法在某些情况下表现不佳，并指出语言模型噪声与特征相关噪声有相似之处，呼吁进一步研究。
AI.motivation: 基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）适用于奖励函数难以获取的复杂任务。然而，偏好数据常带有不确定性和噪声，且现有研究主要关注均匀分布的噪声，忽略了与观测相关的特征依赖噪声。
AI.method: 本文形式化了目标特征依赖噪声的概念，并提出了轨迹特征噪声、轨迹相似性噪声、裕度依赖噪声和语言模型噪声等变体。研究在DMControl和Meta-world的复杂连续控制任务中评估了特征依赖噪声。
AI.result: 实验表明，在某些特征依赖噪声设置下，最先进的噪声鲁棒PbRL方法的学习性能显著下降；而在大多数情况下，没有明确去噪的PbRL方法反而能超越噪声鲁棒PbRL方法。此外，语言模型的噪声表现出与特征依赖噪声相似的特征。
AI.conclusion: 特征依赖噪声对现有噪声鲁棒的基于偏好的强化学习方法构成挑战，甚至可能被无明确去噪的方法超越。语言模型噪声的相似性表明了其在模拟真实人类偏好中的潜力，并呼吁对特征依赖噪声的鲁棒学习进行进一步研究。
AI.translation: 基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）最近受到关注，因为它非常适合奖励函数不易获得的复杂任务。然而，如果偏好不是来自完美的教师，它们通常会伴随着不确定性和噪声。许多先前的文献旨在检测噪声，但类型有限，并且大多是均匀分布的，与观测结果没有关联。在这项工作中，我们形式化了目标特征依赖噪声的概念，并提出了几种变体，如轨迹特征噪声、轨迹相似性噪声、裕度依赖噪声和语言模型噪声。我们评估了特征依赖噪声，其中噪声与DMControl和Meta-world的复杂连续控制任务中的某些特征相关。我们的实验表明，在某些特征依赖噪声设置中，最先进的噪声鲁棒PbRL方法的学习性能显著下降，而没有明确去噪的PbRL方法在大多数设置中出人意料地表现优于噪声鲁棒PbRL。我们还发现语言模型的噪声表现出与特征依赖噪声相似的特征，从而模拟了真实人类，并呼吁进一步研究在具有特征依赖噪声的情况下进行鲁棒学习。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）中一种新型噪声——特征依赖噪声。针对以往研究忽视与观测相关的非均匀噪声的问题，作者形式化了特征依赖噪声的概念，并提出了多种具体形式。通过在连续控制任务中的实验，发现现有噪声鲁棒的PbRL方法在面对特征依赖噪声时性能显著下降，甚至不如未明确去噪的方法。研究还指出语言模型噪声与特征依赖噪声具有相似特性，强调了未来在鲁棒处理此类噪声方面的研究需求。
AI.keywords: 基于偏好的强化学习, 特征依赖噪声, 噪声鲁棒性, 语言模型噪声, 连续控制任务
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了特征依赖噪声的概念，并揭示了其对现有基于偏好强化学习方法，特别是噪声鲁棒方法，的潜在挑战。研究结果令人惊讶地表明，在某些情况下，简单的PbRL方法可能优于复杂的去噪方法，这为该领域的研究方向提供了新的思考。将语言模型噪声与特征依赖噪声联系起来，也为模拟更真实的人类偏好提供了有价值的见解。

title: From Chat Control to Robot Control: Implications of the Chat Control Proposal for Human-Robot Interaction
summary: This paper explores how a recent European Union proposal, the so-called Chat Control, which creates regulatory incentives for providers to implement content detection and communication scanning, could transform the foundations of human-robot interaction (HRI). As robots increasingly act as interpersonal communication channels in care, education, and telepresence, they convey not only speech but also gesture, emotion, and contextual cues. We argue that extending digital surveillance laws to such embodied systems would entail continuous monitoring, embedding observation into the very design of everyday robots. This regulation blurs the line between protection and control, turning companions into potential informants. At the same time, monitoring mechanisms that undermine end-to-end encryption function as de facto backdoors, expanding the attack surface and allowing adversaries to exploit legally induced monitoring infrastructures. This creates a paradox of safety through insecurity: systems introduced to protect users may instead compromise their privacy, autonomy, and trust. This work does not aim to predict the future, but to raise awareness and help prevent certain futures from materialising.

AI.title_translation: 从聊天控制到机器人控制：聊天控制提案对人机交互的影响
AI.tldr: 欧盟的“聊天控制”提案可能将数字监控法律扩展到机器人系统，导致机器人被持续监控，侵犯用户隐私、自主权和信任，并增加安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探讨欧盟“聊天控制”提案如何改变人机交互的基础，并提高人们对该提案可能带来的负面影响的认识，以防止其成为现实。
AI.method: 本文通过论证和分析，探讨欧盟“聊天控制”提案对人机交互的潜在影响，特别是其如何将数字监控扩展到具身系统，并分析其对隐私、自主权和安全的影响。
AI.result: 提案将数字监控扩展到机器人，导致机器人持续监控，模糊保护与控制界限，将伙伴变为潜在告密者。同时，监控机制削弱端到端加密，增加攻击面，形成通过不安全实现安全的悖论，可能损害用户隐私、自主权和信任。
AI.conclusion: 本文旨在提高人们对“聊天控制”提案可能导致机器人被持续监控的认识，并帮助防止这种未来成为现实，而非预测未来。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了欧盟最近提出的所谓“聊天控制”提案如何改变人机交互（HRI）的基础，该提案旨在通过监管激励措施促使服务提供商实施内容检测和通信扫描。随着机器人在护理、教育和远程呈现中越来越多地充当人际沟通渠道，它们不仅传递语音，还传递手势、情感和上下文线索。我们认为，将数字监控法律扩展到此类具身系统将导致持续监控，并将观察嵌入到日常机器人的设计中。这项法规模糊了保护与控制之间的界限，将伙伴变成了潜在的告密者。与此同时，破坏端到端加密的监控机制实际上充当了后门，扩大了攻击面，并允许对手利用合法诱导的监控基础设施。这创造了一个通过不安全实现安全的悖论：旨在保护用户的系统反而可能损害他们的隐私、自主权和信任。这项工作并非旨在预测未来，而是旨在提高认识并帮助防止某些未来成为现实。
AI.summary: 本文分析了欧盟“聊天控制”提案对人机交互（HRI）的潜在影响。该提案旨在通过内容检测和通信扫描来监管数字通信，但将其扩展到机器人系统将导致机器人被持续监控，模糊了保护与控制的界限，并可能将机器人变为“告密者”。此外，这种监控机制可能削弱端到端加密，增加安全漏洞，形成一个“通过不安全实现安全”的悖论，最终损害用户的隐私、自主权和信任。论文旨在提高公众对这些潜在风险的认识，以防止此类未来发生。
AI.keywords: 聊天控制, 人机交互, 隐私, 机器人监控, 欧盟提案
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一个非常及时和重要的伦理与安全问题，即在智能机器人日益普及的背景下，如何平衡监管需求与用户隐私和安全。其创新之处在于将“聊天控制”这一针对数字通信的提案，延伸到具身机器人系统，揭示了可能被忽视的深层影响。重要性在于它呼吁社会和政策制定者在技术发展初期就审慎考虑潜在的负面后果，具有前瞻性。

title: Enhancing Moral Diagnosis and Correction in Large Language Models
summary: Identifying specific moral errors in an input and generating appropriate corrections require moral sensitivity in large language models (LLMs), which is fundamental for developing their moral performance, yet a challenging task. This study leverages a pragmatic inference-based approach to enhance both the moral diagnosis and corrections of models. Crucially, our method generalizes across a diverse set of different tasks, including moral reasoning, toxic language detection, social bias detection, and jailbreaks, despite substantial differences in their semantic formulations. To enable such generalization, the study also introduces a unifying variable, pragmatic inference load, which captures the degree of pragmatic reasoning required across tasks. Experimental results show that our approach enables LLMs to produce high-quality diagnostic outputs of moral errors, make effective corrections, and consistently outperform a range of baseline methods. Further analyses reveal that these improvements do not arise from heuristic-based response patterns, but from learned inferential processes, highlighting the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.title_translation: 增强大型语言模型的道德诊断与纠正能力
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于语用推理的方法，以提高大型语言模型在道德诊断和纠正方面的表现，并在多种任务中实现了泛化和优于基线模型的结果。
AI.motivation: 识别输入中的具体道德错误并生成适当的纠正需要大型语言模型（LLMs）具备道德敏感性，这对于开发其道德表现至关重要，但也是一项具有挑战性的任务。
AI.method: 本研究利用一种基于语用推理的方法来增强模型的道德诊断和纠正能力。该方法通过引入一个统一变量“语用推理负荷”（pragmatic inference load）来捕捉跨任务所需的语用推理程度，从而在道德推理、有害语言检测、社会偏见检测和越狱等多种任务中实现泛化。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法使LLMs能够产生高质量的道德错误诊断输出，进行有效的纠正，并始终优于一系列基线方法。进一步分析揭示，这些改进并非源于基于启发式的响应模式，而是源于学习到的推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的基于语用推理的方法能够有效增强大型语言模型的道德诊断和纠正能力，且其改进源于学习到的推理过程，而非启发式响应模式。
AI.translation: 识别输入中的具体道德错误并生成适当的纠正需要大型语言模型（LLMs）具备道德敏感性，这对于开发其道德表现至关重要，但也是一项具有挑战性的任务。本研究利用一种基于语用推理的方法来增强模型的道德诊断和纠正能力。至关重要的是，我们的方法能够泛化到一系列不同的任务，包括道德推理、有害语言检测、社会偏见检测和越狱，尽管它们在语义表述上存在显著差异。为了实现这种泛化，本研究还引入了一个统一变量——语用推理负荷，它捕捉了跨任务所需的语用推理程度。实验结果表明，我们的方法使LLMs能够产生高质量的道德错误诊断输出，进行有效的纠正，并始终优于一系列基线方法。进一步分析揭示，这些改进并非源于基于启发式的响应模式，而是源于学习到的推理过程，突显了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决大型语言模型在道德诊断和纠正方面的挑战，提出了一种基于语用推理的方法。该方法通过引入“语用推理负荷”变量，成功地在多种道德相关任务中实现泛化，并显著提高了LLMs识别道德错误和进行有效纠正的能力。实验证明，该方法优于基线模型，且其性能提升源于学习到的推理过程。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 道德诊断, 道德纠正, 语用推理, 泛化
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于其提出的基于语用推理的方法和“语用推理负荷”这一统一变量，使得大型语言模型能够更好地理解和处理复杂的道德问题，并在不同任务中实现泛化。这对于提升LLMs的道德性能具有重要意义。

title: EpiQAL: Benchmarking Large Language Models in Epidemiological Question Answering for Enhanced Alignment and Reasoning
summary: Reliable epidemiological reasoning requires synthesizing study evidence to infer disease burden, transmission dynamics, and intervention effects at the population level. Existing medical question answering benchmarks primarily emphasize clinical knowledge or patient-level reasoning, yet few systematically evaluate evidence-grounded epidemiological inference. We present EpiQAL, the first diagnostic benchmark for epidemiological question answering across diverse diseases, comprising three subsets built from open-access literature. The three subsets progressively test factual recall, multi-step inference, and conclusion reconstruction under incomplete information, and are constructed through a quality-controlled pipeline combining taxonomy guidance, multi-model verification, and difficulty screening. Experiments on fourteen models spanning open-source and proprietary systems reveal that current LLMs show limited performance on epidemiological reasoning, with multi-step inference posing the greatest challenge. Model rankings shift across subsets, and scale alone does not predict success. Chain-of-Thought prompting benefits multi-step inference but yields mixed results elsewhere. EpiQAL provides fine-grained diagnostic signals for evidence-grounding, inferential reasoning, and conclusion reconstruction.

AI.title_translation: EpiQAL：在流行病学问答中基准测试大型语言模型以增强对齐和推理
AI.tldr: EpiQAL是一个新的诊断基准，用于评估大型语言模型在流行病学问答中的表现。研究发现，当前LLM在流行病学推理方面表现有限，尤其是多步推理，且模型规模并非成功的唯一预测因素。
AI.motivation: 可靠的流行病学推理需要综合研究证据来推断疾病负担、传播动态和干预效果。然而，现有医学问答基准主要侧重于临床知识或患者层面推理，缺乏对基于证据的流行病学推断的系统评估。因此，本研究旨在开发一个专门的基准来评估大型语言模型在流行病学问答中的能力。
AI.method: 本研究提出了EpiQAL，这是第一个用于流行病学问答的诊断基准，涵盖多种疾病。EpiQAL包含三个子集，分别用于测试事实回忆、多步推理和不完全信息下的结论重构。该基准通过结合分类学指导、多模型验证和难度筛选的质量控制管道构建。研究对十四个大型语言模型（包括开源和专有系统）进行了实验，并评估了Chain-of-Thought提示对性能的影响。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前的大型语言模型在流行病学推理方面表现有限，其中多步推理构成了最大的挑战。模型排名在不同子集之间发生变化，并且仅凭模型规模并不能预测成功。Chain-of-Thought提示对多步推理有益，但在其他方面结果不一。EpiQAL提供了用于证据基础、推断推理和结论重构的细粒度诊断信号。
AI.conclusion: EpiQAL基准揭示了当前大型语言模型在流行病学推理，特别是多步推理方面的局限性。这表明需要进一步研究和开发，以增强LLM在这一关键专业领域的对齐和推理能力。
AI.translation: 可靠的流行病学推理需要综合研究证据来推断人口层面的疾病负担、传播动态和干预效果。现有的医学问答基准主要强调临床知识或患者层面推理，但很少系统地评估基于证据的流行病学推断。我们提出了EpiQAL，这是第一个用于流行病学问答的诊断基准，涵盖多种疾病，由三个从开放获取文献构建的子集组成。这三个子集逐步测试事实回忆、多步推理和不完全信息下的结论重构，并通过结合分类学指导、多模型验证和难度筛选的质量控制管道构建。对包括开源和专有系统在内的十四个模型进行的实验表明，当前的大型语言模型在流行病学推理方面的表现有限，其中多步推理构成了最大的挑战。模型排名在不同子集之间发生变化，并且仅凭规模并不能预测成功。思维链提示对多步推理有益，但在其他方面结果不一。EpiQAL为证据基础、推断推理和结论重构提供了细粒度的诊断信号。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了EpiQAL，一个专门用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在流行病学问答和推理能力上的诊断性基准。该基准包含三个子集，旨在测试LLM在事实回忆、多步推理和不完全信息下结论重构方面的表现。通过对十四个LLM进行实验，研究发现现有LLM在流行病学推理方面表现有限，尤其是在处理多步推理时面临显著挑战，且模型规模并非决定成功的唯一因素。EpiQAL为评估LLM在流行病学推理中的证据基础、推断能力和结论重构提供了细致的诊断信息。
AI.keywords: 流行病学问答, 大型语言模型, 基准测试, 推理, EpiQAL
AI.comments: EpiQAL的创新之处在于填补了现有医学问答基准在流行病学推理评估方面的空白，为LLM在这一专业领域的诊断性评估提供了重要工具。它通过设计不同难度和推理类型的子集，能够细致地揭示LLM的优势与不足。这项工作对于推动LLM在专业领域，特别是复杂推理任务中的发展具有重要意义。

title: Linear-Time $(1+\varepsilon)$-Approximation Algorithms for Two-Line-Center Problems
comments: An extended abstract of this paper will appear in the Proceedings of SoCG 2026
summary: Given a set $S$ of $n$ points in the plane, we study the two-line-center problem: finding two lines that minimize the maximum distance from each point in $S$ to its closest line. We present a $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the two-line-center problem that runs in $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$ time, which improves the previously best $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$-time algorithm. We also consider three variants of this problem, in which the orientations of the two lines are restricted: (1) the orientation of one of the two lines is fixed, (2) the orientations of both lines are fixed, and (3) the two lines are required to be parallel. For each of these three variants, we give the first $(1+\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm that runs in linear time. In particular, for the variant where the orientation of one of the two lines is fixed, we also give an improved exact algorithm that runs in $O(n \log n)$ time and show that it is optimal.
comment: An extended abstract of this paper will appear in the Proceedings of SoCG 2026

AI.title_translation: 线性时间 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法解决双线中心问题
AI.tldr: 本文为双线中心问题及其多个变体提出了改进的线性时间 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，显著提高了计算效率。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决平面点集 $S$ 的双线中心问题，即找到两条线，使 $S$ 中每个点到其最近线的最大距离最小化。
AI.method: 提出针对双线中心问题的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$。对于三个线方向受限的变体（一条线方向固定、两条线方向都固定、两条线平行），首次给出了线性时间 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。对于一条线方向固定的变体，还提供了一个改进的 $O(n \log n)$ 精确算法并证明其最优性。
AI.result: 将双线中心问题的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法的运行时间从 $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$ 改进到 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$。首次为三个线方向受限的变体提供了线性时间 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。对于一条线方向固定的变体，还给出了改进的 $O(n \log n)$ 精确算法，并证明其是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 本文为双线中心问题及其多个变体提供了显著更快的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，包括首次实现的线性时间算法，并通过改进的精确算法进一步完善了对特定变体的理解。
AI.translation: 给定平面上 $n$ 个点组成的集合 $S$，我们研究双线中心问题：找到两条线，使得 $S$ 中每个点到其最近线的最大距离最小化。我们提出了一个针对双线中心问题的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，其运行时间为 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$，这改进了之前最佳的 $O(n\log n + ({n}/{\varepsilon^2}) \log ({1}/{\varepsilon}) + (1/\varepsilon^3)\log ({1}/{\varepsilon}))$-时间算法。我们还考虑了该问题的三个变体，其中两条线的方向受到限制：(1) 两条线中的一条线的方向是固定的，(2) 两条线的方向都是固定的，以及 (3) 要求两条线是平行的。对于这三个变体中的每一个，我们都给出了第一个运行时间为线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。特别是，对于其中一条线的方向固定的变体，我们还给出了一个改进的精确算法，其运行时间为 $O(n \log n)$，并证明其是最优的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了平面双线中心问题及其三个方向受限的变体。作者提出了一个改进的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法，将主问题的运行时间显著优化至 $O((n/\varepsilon) \log (1/\varepsilon))$。此外，对于所有三个变体，首次实现了线性时间的 $(1+\varepsilon)$-近似算法。对于其中一个变体，还提供了一个最优的 $O(n \log n)$ 精确算法。
AI.keywords: 双线中心问题, 近似算法, 线性时间, 计算几何, 优化
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于为双线中心问题及其变体提供了显著更高效的近似算法。特别是，对于多个变体实现了首次的线性时间近似，这在计算几何领域是一个重要的进展。对现有算法的复杂性改进也很有价值。

title: RADAR: Retrieval-Augmented Detector with Adversarial Refinement for Robust Fake News Detection
summary: To efficiently combat the spread of LLM-generated misinformation, we present RADAR, a Retrieval-Augmented Detector with Adversarial Refinement for robust fake news detection. Our approach employs a generator that rewrites real articles with factual perturbations, paired with a lightweight detector that verifies claims using dense passage retrieval. To enable effective co-evolution, we introduce verbal adversarial feedback (VAF). Rather than relying on scalar rewards, VAF issues structured natural-language critiques; these guide the generator toward more sophisticated evasion attempts, compelling the detector to adapt and improve. On a fake news detection benchmark, RADAR consistently outperforms strong retrieval-augmented trainable baselines, as well as general-purpose LLMs with retrieval. Further analysis shows that detector-side retrieval yields the largest gains, while VAF and few-shot demonstrations provide complementary benefits. RADAR also transfers better to fake news generated by an unseen external attacker, indicating improved robustness beyond the co-evolved training setting.

AI.title_translation: RADAR：用于鲁棒虚假新闻检测的检索增强型检测器与对抗性精炼
AI.tldr: RADAR通过一个生成器和利用密集检索的检测器来检测虚假新闻，并通过“口头对抗反馈”（VAF）机制进行对抗性训练，使检测器更鲁棒，并在测试中超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 为了有效对抗大型语言模型（LLM）生成的信息误传（虚假新闻）的传播。
AI.method: RADAR采用一个生成器来用事实扰动重写真实文章，并使用一个轻量级检测器，通过密集段落检索来验证声明。核心是引入了口头对抗反馈（VAF），它提供结构化的自然语言批评来指导生成器进行更复杂的逃避尝试，从而迫使检测器适应和改进。
AI.result: RADAR在基准测试中持续优于强大的检索增强型可训练基线和使用检索的通用LLM。分析表明，检测器侧的检索带来了最大的性能提升，而VAF和少样本演示提供了互补的益处。
AI.conclusion: RADAR在虚假新闻检测基准测试中表现优于强有力的检索增强型可训练基线和使用检索的通用LLM。此外，它对未见过的外部攻击者生成的虚假新闻具有更好的泛化能力，表明其鲁棒性得到了提升。
AI.translation: 为了有效对抗大型语言模型生成的虚假信息传播，我们提出了RADAR，一种用于鲁棒虚假新闻检测的检索增强型检测器，具有对抗性精炼能力。我们的方法采用一个生成器，用事实扰动重写真实文章，并搭配一个通过密集段落检索来验证声明的轻量级检测器。为了实现有效的协同演化，我们引入了口头对抗反馈（VAF）。VAF不依赖于标量奖励，而是发出结构化的自然语言批评；这些批评引导生成器进行更复杂的逃避尝试，迫使检测器进行适应和改进。在虚假新闻检测基准测试中，RADAR持续优于强大的检索增强型可训练基线以及使用检索的通用LLM。进一步的分析表明，检测器侧的检索带来了最大的增益，而VAF和少样本演示提供了互补的益处。RADAR对未见过的外部攻击者生成的虚假新闻的泛化能力也更好，表明其鲁棒性超越了协同演化训练环境。
AI.summary: RADAR是一种用于鲁棒虚假新闻检测的检索增强型检测器，它采用生成器重写文章并结合密集段落检索的检测器进行验证。其关键创新是引入了口头对抗反馈（VAF），通过结构化语言批评实现生成器和检测器的协同演化，从而显著提高了检测模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 检索增强检测, 对抗性精炼, 虚假新闻检测, 检索, 口头对抗反馈
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了“口头对抗反馈”（VAF）机制，它使用结构化的自然语言批评而非标量奖励来指导生成器，从而实现了更精细的对抗训练。其重要性在于提高了虚假新闻检测模型的鲁棒性，特别是在面对未知攻击者生成的内容时。限制是抽象中未明确说明具体的模型架构细节或实验设置的深度。

title: CircuitLM: A Multi-Agent LLM-Aided Design Framework for Generating Circuit Schematics from Natural Language Prompts
summary: Generating accurate circuit schematics from high-level natural language descriptions remains a persistent challenge in electronic design automation (EDA), as large language models (LLMs) frequently hallucinate components, violate strict physical constraints, and produce non-machine-readable outputs. To address this, we present CircuitLM, a multi-agent pipeline that translates user prompts into structured, visually interpretable $\texttt{CircuitJSON}$ schematics. The framework mitigates hallucination and ensures physical viability by grounding generation in a curated, embedding-powered component knowledge base through five sequential stages: (i) component identification, (ii) canonical pinout retrieval, (iii) chain-of-thought reasoning, (iv) JSON schematic synthesis, and (v) interactive force-directed visualization. We evaluate the system on a dataset of 100 unique circuit-design prompts using five state-of-the-art LLMs. To systematically assess performance, we deploy a rigorous dual-layered evaluation methodology: a deterministic Electrical Rule Checking (ERC) engine categorizes topological faults by strict severity (Critical, Major, Minor, Warning), while an LLM-as-a-judge meta-evaluator identifies complex, context-aware design flaws that bypass standard rule-based checkers. Ultimately, this work demonstrates how targeted retrieval combined with deterministic and semantic verification can bridge natural language to structurally viable, schematic-ready hardware and safe circuit prototyping. Our code and data will be made public.

AI.title_translation: CircuitLM：一种由多智能体LLM辅助设计的框架，用于从自然语言提示生成电路原理图
AI.tldr: CircuitLM是一个创新的多智能体LLM框架，通过结合组件知识库检索和严格的电气/语义验证，成功地将自然语言描述转化为物理上可行的、机器可读的电路原理图（CircuitJSON），克服了传统LLM在EDA中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在从高层次自然语言描述生成准确的电路原理图时，经常出现组件幻觉、违反严格的物理约束以及产生非机器可读的输出，这是一个在电子设计自动化（EDA）中持续存在的挑战。
AI.method: CircuitLM是一个多智能体管道，包含五个顺序阶段：（i）组件识别，（ii）规范引脚检索，（iii）链式思考推理，（iv）JSON原理图合成，（v）交互式力导向可视化。该方法通过嵌入式组件知识库来保证生成结果的物理可行性和减少幻觉。评估采用双层方法：确定性电气规则检查（ERC）引擎和LLM-as-a-judge元评估器。
AI.result: 在包含100个独特电路设计提示的数据集上，使用五种最先进的LLMs进行了评估，并部署了ERC引擎和LLM-as-a-judge元评估器来系统地评估性能和拓扑错误。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了目标性检索、确定性验证和语义验证相结合，可以将自然语言转化为结构上可行、可用于原理图设计的硬件，并实现安全的电路原型设计。
AI.translation: 从高层次的自然语言描述生成准确的电路原理图仍然是电子设计自动化（EDA）中的一个持续挑战，因为大型语言模型（LLMs）经常出现组件幻觉、违反严格的物理约束，并产生非机器可读的输出。为解决此问题，我们提出了CircuitLM，一个多智能体管道，它将用户提示转换为结构化、视觉上可解释的$\texttt{CircuitJSON}$原理图。该框架通过一个精心策划的、由嵌入驱动的组件知识库，在五个顺序阶段中实现生成接地，从而减轻了幻觉并确保了物理可行性：（i）组件识别，（ii）规范引脚检索，（iii）链式思考推理，（iv）JSON原理图合成，以及（v）交互式力导向可视化。我们使用五种最先进的LLMs在包含100个独特电路设计提示的数据集上评估了该系统。为了系统地评估性能，我们部署了一种严格的双层评估方法：一个确定性的电气规则检查（ERC）引擎按严格的严重程度（关键、主要、次要、警告）对拓扑故障进行分类，而一个LLM-as-a-judge元评估器则识别绕过标准基于规则的检查的复杂、上下文感知的設計缺陷。最终，这项工作证明了靶向检索与确定性和语义验证相结合，如何能够弥合自然语言与结构上可行、可用于原理图的硬件以及安全的电路原型设计之间的差距。我们的代码和数据将公开发布。
AI.summary: CircuitLM是一个多智能体框架，旨在解决LLM在从自然语言生成电路原理图时出现的幻觉和约束违反问题。它通过一个包含五个阶段的管道，结合嵌入式组件知识库的检索和双层验证（ERC和LLM-as-a-judge），将用户提示转化为结构化、可解释的CircuitJSON原理图。
AI.keywords: 电路图生成,大型语言模型,多智能体,电子设计自动化,知识库检索
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种多智能体框架CircuitLM，它通过结合组件知识库的检索、链式思考推理以及双层验证（确定性ERC和语义LLM-as-a-judge）来解决LLM在电路图生成中常见的幻觉和物理约束违反问题。其重要性在于为从自然语言到结构化、可验证的电路图（CircuitJSON）提供了一条可行的路径。限制在于评估是基于100个提示，其泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Distilling Feedback into Memory-as-a-Tool
summary: We propose a framework that amortizes the cost of inference-time reasoning by converting transient critiques into retrievable guidelines, through a file-based memory system and agent-controlled tool calls. We evaluate this method on the Rubric Feedback Bench, a novel dataset for rubric-based learning. Experiments demonstrate that our augmented LLMs rapidly match the performance of test-time refinement pipelines while drastically reducing inference cost.

AI.title_translation: 将反馈蒸馏为记忆作为工具
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种“记忆作为工具”的框架，它将模型在推理时收到的批评转化为可检索的文件式记忆。这使得模型能够快速学习并显著降低了后续推理的成本，性能与需要每次都进行精炼的管道相当。
AI.motivation: 通过将瞬时的推理反馈转化为可检索的指南，以分摊推理时间的推理成本。
AI.method: 通过基于文件的记忆系统和代理控制的工具调用，将瞬时的批评（transient critiques）转化为可检索的指南，从而分摊推理时间的推理成本。
AI.result: 实验证明，增强的LLM能够快速匹配测试时间精炼管道的性能，同时大幅度降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 本方法能够使增强的LLM快速匹配测试时间精炼管道的性能，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个框架，通过基于文件的记忆系统和代理控制的工具调用，将瞬时的批评转化为可检索的指南，从而分摊了推理时的推理成本。我们在一个新颖的基于评分标准的学习数据集——Rubric Feedback Bench上评估了该方法。实验证明，我们增强的LLM能够快速匹配测试时间精炼管道的性能，同时大幅度降低推理成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个框架，通过一个基于文件的记忆系统和代理控制的工具调用，将临时的反馈（critiques）转化为可检索的指南，从而分摊了推理时的推理成本。在新的Rubric Feedback Bench数据集上进行的实验表明，这种方法可以显著降低成本，同时保持与测试时精炼流水线相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 反馈蒸馏, 记忆作为工具, 推理成本摊销, 文件系统, 试题反馈基准
AI.comments: 该方法的创新之处在于将瞬时的推理反馈（critiques）转化为可检索的、基于文件的记忆（memory-as-a-tool），从而摊销了推理成本。其重要性在于显著降低了成本，同时保持了与测试时精炼管道相当的性能。抽象中未明确指出具体的局限性。

title: EVM-QuestBench: An Execution-Grounded Benchmark for Natural-Language Transaction Code Generation
summary: Large language models are increasingly applied to various development scenarios. However, in on-chain transaction scenarios, even a minor error can cause irreversible loss for users. Existing evaluations often overlook execution accuracy and safety. We introduce EVM-QuestBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for natural-language transaction-script generation on EVM-compatible chains. The benchmark employs dynamic evaluation: instructions are sampled from template pools, numeric parameters are drawn from predefined intervals, and validators verify outcomes against these instantiated values. EVM-QuestBench contains 107 tasks (62 atomic, 45 composite). Its modular architecture enables rapid task development. The runner executes scripts on a forked EVM chain with snapshot isolation; composite tasks apply step-efficiency decay. We evaluate 20 models and find large performance gaps, with split scores revealing persistent asymmetry between single-action precision and multi-step workflow completion. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bsc_quest_bench-A9CF/.

AI.title_translation: EVM-QuestBench：一个面向自然语言交易代码生成的基于执行的基准测试
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了EVM-QuestBench，一个用于评估大型语言模型在EVM链上生成交易代码的基准测试，强调了执行准确性和安全性，并发现现有模型在单动作精度和多步工作流完成之间存在性能差距。
AI.motivation: 现有针对大型语言模型在链上交易场景下的评估忽略了执行准确性和安全性，而这些在链上场景中至关重要，因为微小的错误可能导致用户无法挽回的损失。
AI.method: 提出EVM-QuestBench基准测试，采用动态评估方法：从模板库中采样指令，从预定义区间抽取数值参数，并由验证器根据实例化的值验证结果。使用分支EVM链和快照隔离执行脚本，复合任务应用步骤效率衰减。
AI.result: 对20个模型进行了评估，发现模型性能存在显著差距，并且在单动作精度和多步工作流完成之间存在持续的不对称性。
AI.conclusion: EVM-QuestBench是一个执行优先的基准测试，能够评估LLM在EVM链上生成交易脚本的能力。评估结果显示，现有模型在执行精度和安全性方面仍有很大提升空间，尤其是在处理复杂的多步交易时。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型越来越多地应用于各种开发场景。然而，在链上交易场景中，即使是微小的错误也可能给用户带来无法挽回的损失。现有的评估通常忽略了执行准确性和安全性。我们引入了EVM-QuestBench，一个用于在EVM兼容链上进行自然语言交易脚本生成的、基于执行的基准测试。该基准测试采用动态评估：指令从模板池中采样，数值参数从预定义区间中抽取，验证器根据这些实例化的值验证结果。EVM-QuestBench包含107个任务（62个原子任务，45个复合任务）。其模块化架构支持快速的任务开发。运行器在具有快照隔离的分支EVM链上执行脚本；复合任务应用步骤效率衰减。我们评估了20个模型，发现了巨大的性能差距，拆分分数显示了单动作精度和多步工作流完成之间持续存在的不对称性。代码：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/bsc_quest_bench-A9CF/。
AI.summary: EVM-QuestBench是一个新提出的、注重执行的基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型在EVM兼容链上生成自然语言交易脚本的能力。该基准测试通过动态评估和实际执行来衡量模型的准确性和安全性，解决了现有评估方法忽视执行细节的问题。评估结果揭示了模型在处理简单和复杂交易任务时存在的性能差异。
AI.keywords: EVM-QuestBench, 大型语言模型, 交易代码生成, 基准测试, 执行准确性
AI.comments: 该研究提出的EVM-QuestBench在评估LLM的交易代码生成能力方面具有重要意义，因为它强调了执行准确性和安全性，这在金融领域至关重要。动态评估和实际执行的方法比静态评估更能反映真实世界的性能。然而，基准测试的覆盖范围（107个任务）和模型数量（20个）虽然具有一定的代表性，但仍有进一步扩展的空间。未来的研究可以关注如何提升模型在复合任务上的表现，以及如何设计更鲁棒的评估指标来捕捉潜在的细微错误。

title: APEX-SWE
summary: We introduce the AI Productivity Index for Software Engineering (APEX-SWE), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier AI models can execute economically valuable software engineering work. Unlike existing evaluations that focus on narrow, well-defined tasks, APEX-SWE assesses two novel task types that reflect real-world software engineering: (1) Integration tasks (n=100), which require constructing end-to-end systems across heterogeneous cloud primitives, business applications, and infrastructure-as-code services, and (2) Observability tasks (n=100), which require debugging production failures using telemetry signals such as logs and dashboards, as well as unstructured context. We evaluated eleven frontier models for the APEX-SWE leaderboard. Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Opus 4.5 perform best, both with a Pass@1 score of 38.5%. Our analysis shows that strong performance is primarily driven by epistemic discipline, defined as the capacity to distinguish between assumptions and verified facts, combined with systematic verification prior to acting. We open-source the APEX-SWE evaluation harness and a dev set (n=50).

AI.tldr: 研究人员推出了APEX-SWE，一个更贴近现实的软件工程AI基准，包含系统集成和故障调试任务。Claude Opus系列模型以38.5%的Pass@1得分领先，表明AI的成功依赖于区分事实和假设的能力。该评估工具已开源。
AI.motivation: 现有的评估侧重于狭窄、定义明确的任务，而APEX-SWE旨在评估前沿AI模型是否能够执行具有经济价值的真实世界软件工程工作。
AI.method: 引入了两种新颖的任务类型（集成任务和可观测性任务），共计200个样本，用于评估前沿AI模型执行经济上有价值的软件工程工作的能力。评估了十一个前沿模型，并发布了评估工具包和开发集。
AI.result: Claude Opus 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.5 表现最佳，Pass@1 分数均为 38.5%。
AI.conclusion: 强大的性能主要由认知纪律（区分假设和已证实的事实的能力）和行动前的系统性验证所驱动。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了软件工程中的人工智能生产力指数（APEX-SWE），这是一个用于评估前沿人工智能模型是否能够执行具有经济价值的软件工程工作的基准。与关注狭窄、定义明确的任务的现有评估不同，APEX-SWE 评估了两种反映真实世界软件工程的新颖任务类型：（1）集成任务（n=100），要求跨越异构云原语、业务应用和基础设施即代码服务构建端到端系统；以及（2）可观测性任务（n=100），要求使用遥测信号（如日志和仪表板）以及非结构化上下文来调试生产故障。我们对十一个前沿模型进行了 APEX-SWE 排行榜的评估。Claude Opus 4.6 和 Claude Opus 4.5 表现最佳，Pass@1 得分均为 38.5%。我们的分析表明，强劲的性能主要由认知纪律（定义为区分假设和已证实事实的能力）与行动前的系统验证相结合所驱动。我们开源了 APEX-SWE 评估工具包和开发集（n=50）。
AI.summary: APEX-SWE是一个新的基准，用于评估前沿AI模型执行经济上有价值的软件工程工作的能力，它侧重于现实世界的集成和可观测性任务。评估结果显示Claude Opus 4.6和4.5以38.5%的Pass@1得分领先，且模型的出色表现主要归功于其认知纪律和系统验证能力。评估工具和开发集已开源。
AI.keywords: AI生产力指数, 软件工程, 评估基准, 系统集成, 可观测性
AI.comments: APEX-SWE的创新之处在于它评估的是更贴近真实世界、涉及异构系统集成和复杂故障调试的任务，而非传统的狭窄任务。其重要性在于为衡量前沿AI模型执行经济上有价值的软件工程工作的能力提供了一个更具挑战性和现实意义的基准。限制是只评估了11个前沿模型，且仅基于Pass@1分数。

title: RIS-Aided E2E Multi-Path Uplink Transmission Optimization for 6G Time-Sensitive Services
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication.5 pages,2 figures,journal paper
summary: The Access Traffic Steering, Switching, and Splitting (ATSSS) defined in the latest 3GPP Release 19 enables traffic flow over the multiple access paths to achieve the lower-latency End-to-end (E2E) delivery for 6G time-sensitive services. However, the existing E2E multi-path operation often falls short of more stringent QoS requirements for 6G time-sensitive services. This work proposes a Reconfigurable Intelligent Surfaces (RIS)-aided E2E multi-path uplink (UL) transmission architecture that explicitly accounts for both radio link latency and N3 backhaul latency, via the coupled designs of the UL traffic-splitting ratio, transmit power, receive combining, and RIS phase shift under practical constraints to achieve the minimum average E2E latency. We develop an alternating optimization framework that updates the above target parameters to be optimized. The simulations were conducted to compare the effectiveness of the proposed E2E optimization framework that lowers the average E2E latency up to 43% for a single user and 32% for the whole system compared with baselines in our prior work [1].
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication.5 pages,2 figures,journal paper

AI.title_translation: RIS辅助的6G时敏业务端到端多路径上行传输优化
AI.tldr: 为了满足6G时敏业务的严格服务质量要求，提出了一种结合了无线链路和N3回程延迟的RIS辅助端到端多路径上行传输架构，并通过交替优化算法最小化平均端到端延迟，仿真结果显示平均端到端延迟最多可降低43%。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端多路径操作未能满足6G时敏业务更严格的服务质量要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种RIS辅助的端到端多路径上行传输架构，通过耦合上行流量拆分比、发射功率、接收合并和RIS相位偏移的设计，并采用交替优化框架来更新这些参数，以最小化平均端到端延迟。
AI.result: 与先前工作中的基线相比，所提出的端到端优化框架可将单个用户的平均端到端延迟降低高达43%，将整个系统的平均端到端延迟降低高达32%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的RIS辅助的端到端多路径上行传输架构和交替优化框架能够有效降低6G时敏业务的平均端到端延迟，满足更严格的服务质量要求。
AI.translation: 接入流量引导、切换和拆分（ATSSS）在最新的3GPP Release 19中定义，它支持流量在多个接入路径上传输，以实现6G时敏业务的低延迟端到端（E2E）传输。然而，现有的E2E多路径操作常常无法满足6G时敏业务更严格的服务质量（QoS）要求。本研究提出了一种可重构智能表面（RIS）辅助的E2E多路径上行（UL）传输架构，通过耦合UL流量拆分比、发射功率、接收合并和RIS相位偏移的设计，并考虑实际约束，明确考虑了无线链路延迟和N3回程延迟，以实现最小的平均E2E延迟。我们开发了一个交替优化框架，用于更新上述目标参数以进行优化。仿真结果表明，与我们先前工作中[1]的基线相比，所提出的E2E优化框架可将单个用户的平均E2E延迟降低高达43%，将整个系统的平均E2E延迟降低高达32%。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的RIS辅助端到端多路径上行传输架构，用于优化6G时敏服务的传输。该架构通过联合优化流量拆分、功率、接收合并和RIS相位偏移，并采用交替优化方法，以最小化端到端延迟。仿真结果表明，与现有技术相比，该方法能显著降低延迟。
AI.keywords: RIS, E2E, 多路径传输, 时敏服务, 延迟优化
AI.comments: 该研究在RIS辅助通信和6G时敏服务优化方面取得了重要进展，通过端到端联合优化显著降低了延迟。然而，实际部署中的可扩展性和鲁棒性仍需进一步研究。

title: GIFT: Reconciling Post-Training Objectives via Finite-Temperature Gibbs Initialization
summary: The prevailing post-training paradigm for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) - Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) followed by Reinforcement Learning (RL) - suffers from an intrinsic optimization mismatch: the rigid supervision inherent in SFT induces distributional collapse, thereby exhausting the exploration space necessary for subsequent RL. In this paper, we reformulate SFT to reconcile post-training objectives and propose Gibbs Initialization with Finite Temperature (GIFT). We characterize standard SFT as a degenerate zero-temperature limit that suppresses base priors. Conversely, GIFT incorporates supervision as a finite-temperature energy potential, establishing a distributional bridge that promotes objective consistency throughout the post-training pipeline. Our experiments demonstrate that GIFT significantly outperforms standard SFT and other competitive baselines when utilized for RL initialization, providing a mathematically principled pathway to preserve exploration and align the two post-training stages. Our code is available at https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT.

AI.title_translation: GIFT：通过有限温度吉布斯初始化调和后训练目标
AI.tldr: GIFT通过将SFT视为有限温度的能量势来替代传统的零温度SFT，解决了SFT与RL之间的优化不匹配问题，使得模型在RL初始化时能更好地探索，并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的后训练范式（SFT后接RL）存在优化不匹配：SFT的刚性监督导致分布崩溃，耗尽了RL所需的探索空间。
AI.method: 将标准SFT视为零温度极限，提出用有限温度的能量势来表示监督，构建分布桥梁，从而提出有限温度吉布斯初始化（GIFT）。
AI.result: 实验证明，当用于RL初始化时，GIFT显著优于标准的SFT和其他有竞争力的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: GIFT提供了一种在后训练流水线中保持探索性和对齐两个阶段的数学上合理的途径。
AI.translation: 当前大型推理模型（LRM）的后训练范式——监督微调（SFT）后接强化学习（RL）——存在固有的优化不匹配：SFT中固有的刚性监督会引起分布崩溃，从而耗尽后续RL所需的探索空间。在本文中，我们将SFT重新表述为调和后训练目标，并提出了有限温度吉布斯初始化（GIFT）。我们将标准SFT表征为抑制基础先验的退化零温度极限。相反，GIFT将监督纳入有限温度能量势，建立了分布桥梁，促进了整个后训练流水线中的目标一致性。我们的实验证明，当用于RL初始化时，GIFT显著优于标准的SFT和其他有竞争力的基线方法，为保留探索和对齐两个后训练阶段提供了一条数学上合理的途径。我们的代码可在https://github.com/zzy1127/GIFT获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRM）后训练中SFT导致的分布崩溃问题，提出了有限温度吉布斯初始化（GIFT）。GIFT将SFT的监督视为有限温度的能量势，建立分布桥梁，以调和SFT和RL阶段的目标不一致性，从而保留了探索空间。
AI.keywords: 后训练优化, 监督微调, 强化学习, 分布式一致性, 有限温度吉布斯初始化
AI.comments: 该方法通过将SFT重新表述为有限温度的能量势，解决了SFT中固有的分布崩溃问题，为后续RL阶段保留了探索空间，具有明确的数学原理基础，是一种重要的优化策略创新。

title: PaperScout: An Autonomous Agent for Academic Paper Search with Process-Aware Sequence-Level Policy Optimization
summary: Academic paper search is a fundamental task in scientific research, yet most existing approaches rely on rigid, predefined workflows that struggle with complex, conditional queries. To address this limitation, we propose PaperScout, an autonomous agent that reformulates paper search as a sequential decision-making process. Unlike static workflows, PaperScout dynamically decides whether, when, and how to invoke search and expand tools based on accumulated retrieval context. However, training such agents presents a fundamental challenge: standard reinforcement learning methods, typically designed for single-turn tasks, suffer from a granularity mismatch when applied to multi-turn agentic tasks-where token-level optimization diverges from the granularity of sequence-level interactions-leading to noisy credit assignment and unstable training dynamics. We introduce Proximal Sequence Policy Optimization (PSPO), a process-aware, sequence-level policy optimization method that aligns optimization with agent--environment interaction. Comprehensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that PaperScout significantly outperforms strong workflow-driven and RL baselines in both recall and relevance, validating the effectiveness of our adaptive agentic framework and optimization strategy.

AI.title_translation: PaperScout：一种用于学术论文搜索的自主智能体，具有过程感知的序列级策略优化
AI.tldr: PaperScout是一个自主学术论文搜索智能体，它通过将搜索视为序列决策任务，并使用新方法PSPO（一种序列级策略优化技术）来克服传统强化学习在处理多轮任务时的训练不稳定问题，实验结果表明其性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的学术论文搜索方法依赖于僵化、预定义的工作流程，难以处理复杂、有条件的查询。
AI.method: 将论文搜索重新构建为序贯决策过程，并引入了过程感知的序列级策略优化方法——近端序列策略优化（PSPO），该方法使优化与智能体-环境交互对齐，解决了标准强化学习在多轮任务中面临的粒度不匹配问题。
AI.result: PaperScout在召回率和相关性方面显著优于强大的工作流驱动和强化学习基线。
AI.conclusion: PaperScout在合成和真实世界基准测试中，在召回率和相关性方面均显著优于强大的工作流驱动和强化学习基线，验证了其自适应智能体框架和优化策略的有效性。
AI.translation: 学术论文搜索是一项基础性的科学研究任务，但大多数现有方法依赖于僵化、预定义的工作流程，难以应对复杂、有条件的查询。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了PaperScout，一个自主智能体，它将论文搜索重新构建为序贯决策过程。与静态工作流程不同，PaperScout根据累积的检索上下文动态决定何时、何地以及如何调用搜索和扩展工具。然而，训练此类智能体提出了一个根本性挑战：标准强化学习方法通常是为单轮任务设计的，当应用于多轮智能体任务时，在粒度上存在不匹配——其中令牌级别的优化与序列级别的交互粒度相悖——导致信用分配噪声和不稳定的训练动态。我们引入了近端序列策略优化（PSPO），一种过程感知的、序列级的策略优化方法，它使优化与智能体-环境交互保持一致。在合成和真实世界基准测试上的全面实验表明，PaperScout在召回率和相关性方面均显著优于强大的工作流驱动和强化学习基线，验证了我们自适应智能体框架和优化策略的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了PaperScout，一个自主智能体，用于解决传统学术论文搜索中处理复杂条件查询的局限性。PaperScout将搜索视为序贯决策过程，并引入了过程感知的序列级策略优化方法PSPO，以解决标准强化学习在多轮任务中遇到的优化粒度不匹配问题。实验证明，PaperScout在性能上优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 自主智能体, 学术论文搜索, 序列决策, 策略优化, PSPO
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个能够处理复杂条件查询的自主智能体PaperScout，并通过引入新的序列级策略优化方法PSPO解决了传统强化学习在多轮任务中遇到的粒度不匹配问题。其重要性在于提升了学术论文检索的自动化和适应性。方法的局限性可能在于对复杂环境的泛化能力和训练效率，但摘要中未明确提及。

title: Representation-Aware Unlearning via Activation Signatures: From Suppression to Knowledge-Signature Erasure
summary: Selective knowledge erasure from LLMs is critical for GDPR compliance and model safety, yet current unlearning methods conflate behavioral suppression with true knowledge removal, allowing latent capabilities to persist beneath surface-level refusals. In this work, we address this challenge by introducing Knowledge Immunization Framework (KIF), a representation-aware architecture that distinguishes genuine erasure from obfuscation by targeting internal activation signatures rather than surface outputs. Our approach combines dynamic suppression of subject-specific representations with parameter-efficient adaptation, enabling durable unlearning without full model retraining. KIF achieves near-oracle erasure (FQ approx 0.99 vs. 1.00) while preserving utility at oracle levels (MU = 0.62), effectively breaking the stability-erasure tradeoff that has constrained all prior work. We evaluate both standard foundation models (Llama and Mistral) and reasoning-prior models (Qwen and DeepSeek) across 3B to 14B parameters. Our observation shows that standard models exhibit scale-independent true erasure (<3% utility drift), while reasoning-prior models reveal fundamental architectural divergence. Our comprehensive dual-metric evaluation protocol, combining surface-level leakage with latent trace persistence, operationalizes the obfuscation - erasure distinction and enables the first systematic diagnosis of mechanism-level forgetting behavior across model families and scales.

AI.title_translation: 通过激活签名进行表示感知的遗忘：从抑制到知识签名擦除
AI.tldr: 新的KIF框架通过关注模型内部的激活签名，而不是表面的拒绝行为，实现了对LLM中特定知识的真正且持久的擦除，同时保持了模型的整体性能，解决了现有方法中知识遗忘不彻底的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前的知识遗忘方法只实现了行为抑制而非真正的知识移除，导致潜在能力在表面拒绝的掩盖下仍然存在，这对于GDPR合规性和模型安全至关重要。
AI.method: 引入知识免疫框架（KIF），这是一个表示感知的架构，它结合了对特定主题表示的动态抑制和参数高效的适应，以内部激活签名而非表面输出来实现知识的持久遗忘。
AI.result: KIF实现了接近神谕级别的遗忘（FQ约0.99 vs 1.00），同时将效用保持在神谕水平（MU = 0.62）。标准模型表现出与规模无关的真实遗忘（效用漂移<3%），而先验推理模型则显示出根本的架构分歧。
AI.conclusion: KIF通过区分表面抑制和真正的知识擦除，实现了持久的知识遗忘，同时保持了模型效用，打破了稳定性和遗忘性之间的权衡。对于标准模型，实现了接近完美的遗忘；对于先验推理模型，揭示了架构上的根本差异。
AI.translation: 选择性知识从大型语言模型（LLMs）中擦除对于GDPR合规性和模型安全至关重要，然而，当前的遗忘方法将行为抑制与真正的知识移除混为一谈，使得潜在能力潜伏在表面拒绝之下而持续存在。在这项工作中，我们通过引入知识免疫框架（KIF）来解决这一挑战，KIF是一个表示感知的架构，它通过靶向内部激活签名而不是表面输出来区分真正的擦除和混淆。我们的方法结合了对特定主题表示的动态抑制和参数高效的适应，实现了持久的遗忘而无需完全模型重新训练。KIF实现了接近神谕级别的擦除（FQ约0.99 对 1.00），同时将效用保持在神谕水平（MU = 0.62），有效地打破了先前工作所限制的稳定-遗忘权衡。我们评估了标准基础模型（Llama和Mistral）和推理先验模型（Qwen和DeepSeek），参数范围从3B到14B。我们的观察表明，标准模型表现出与规模无关的真实遗忘（<3%效用漂移），而推理先验模型揭示了根本的架构分歧。我们综合性的双指标评估协议，结合了表面泄漏和潜在痕迹持久性，操作化了混淆-擦除的区别，并首次实现了跨模型家族和规模的机制级别遗忘行为的系统诊断。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了知识免疫框架（KIF），一种新的表示感知架构，用于解决大型语言模型（LLMs）中知识遗忘的挑战。KIF通过靶向内部激活签名而非表面输出来区分真正的知识擦除和混淆，实现了持久的遗忘，同时保持了模型效用，从而打破了稳定性和遗忘性之间的权衡。
AI.keywords: 知识遗忘, 激活签名, 知识免疫框架, 表面抑制, 效用保留
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个区分“行为抑制”和“真正知识移除”的框架（KIF），通过关注内部激活签名而非表面输出来实现持久的知识遗忘。它有效地解决了稳定性和遗忘性之间的权衡问题。限制是仅在3B到14B参数的模型上进行了评估。

title: Speculative Decoding: Performance or Illusion?
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) has become a popular technique to accelerate Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet its real-world effectiveness remains unclear as prior evaluations rely on research prototypes and unrealistically small batch sizes. We present, to our knowledge, the first systematic study of SD on a production-grade and widely deployed inference engine (vLLM), covering multiple SD variants ($n$-gram, EAGLE/EAGLE-3, Draft-Model, Multi-Token Prediction) across diverse workloads, model scales, and batch sizes. We analyze key factors governing SD performance, and quantify a theoretical upper bound on SD speedup. Our results show that verification by the target model dominates the execution, while acceptance length varies markedly across output token positions, requests, and datasets. Comparing measured performance with theoretical bounds reveals substantial gaps between observed and theoretical upper bounds, and we leverage this observation to highlight new research opportunities that our study opens up in improving SD.

AI.title_translation: 投机解码：性能还是幻觉？
AI.tldr: 对投机解码（SD）在生产级LLM推理引擎（vLLM）上的首次系统性评估显示，尽管SD被广泛采用，但其实际加速效果远低于理论上限，因为目标模型的验证步骤占主导地位，且接受长度变化大。该研究揭示了SD的局限性并指出了新的优化机会。
AI.motivation: 先前的评估依赖于研究原型和不切实际的小批量大小，因此SD在现实世界中的实际效果尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在生产级推理引擎vLLM上，系统地研究了多种SD变体（$n$-gram, EAGLE/EAGLE-3, Draft-Model, Multi-Token Prediction），涵盖了不同的工作负载、模型规模和批次大小，并量化了SD的理论加速上限。
AI.result: 结果表明，目标模型的验证占据了执行的主导地位，而接受长度在输出token位置、请求和数据集之间存在显著差异。实测性能与理论上限之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了实测性能与理论加速上限之间存在显著差距，并利用这一观察结果提出了改进SD的新研究方向。
AI.translation: 投机解码（SD）已成为加速大型语言模型（LLM）推理的热门技术，但其在现实世界中的有效性仍不清楚，因为先前的评估依赖于研究原型和不切实际的小批量大小。我们进行了首次，据我们所知，在生产级和广泛部署的推理引擎（vLLM）上对SD的系统性研究，涵盖了多种SD变体（$n$-gram、EAGLE/EAGLE-3、Draft-Model、Multi-Token Prediction）以及不同的工作负载、模型规模和批次大小。我们分析了控制SD性能的关键因素，并量化了SD加速的理论上限。我们的结果表明，目标模型的验证主导了执行，而接受长度在输出token位置、请求和数据集之间存在显著差异。将实测性能与理论上限进行比较，揭示了观测到的性能与理论上限之间存在巨大差距，我们利用这一观察结果，突出了本研究为改进SD开辟的新研究机会。
AI.summary: 本文首次在生产级推理引擎vLLM上系统地评估了各种投机解码（SD）变体的性能，以解决其在现实世界中有效性不明确的问题。研究分析了影响SD性能的关键因素并量化了理论加速上限。结果显示，目标模型的验证是主要的执行瓶颈，且实际加速与理论上限存在较大差距，这为未来改进SD指明了研究方向。
AI.keywords: 投机解码, LLM推理加速, vLLM, 理论上限, 性能评估
AI.comments: 本文对投机解码（SD）在实际生产级推理引擎上的系统性研究是其主要创新点。研究量化了理论加速上限并与实际性能进行了比较，揭示了当前SD实现的局限性，为未来的优化指明了方向。其局限性在于评估的深度可能受限于vLLM这个单一平台。

title: Global Optimization By Gradient From Hierarchical Score-Matching Spaces
comments: Correct inconsistencies in title capitalization, fix tiny error of one formula and modify it's formatting
summary: Gradient-based methods are widely used to solve various optimization problems, however, they are either constrained by local optima dilemmas, simple convex constraints, and continuous differentiability requirements, or limited to low-dimensional simple problems. This work solve these limitations and restrictions by unifying all optimization problems with various complex constraints as a general hierarchical optimization objective without constraints, which is optimized by gradient obtained through score matching. The proposed method is verified through simple-constructed and complex-practical experiments. Even more importantly, it reveals the profound connection between global optimization and diffusion based generative modeling.

AI.title_translation: 通过分层得分匹配空间中的梯度进行全局优化
AI.tldr: 提出一种新方法，通过将复杂约束优化转化为无约束分层优化，并用得分匹配梯度求解，解决了传统梯度方法的局部最优和约束限制问题，并发现了全局优化与扩散模型的新联系。
AI.motivation: 解决传统梯度方法受限于局部最优、简单的凸约束以及连续可微性要求，且仅限于低维简单问题的局限性。
AI.method: 将带有复杂约束的优化问题统一为无约束的分层优化目标，并使用通过得分匹配获得的梯度进行优化。
AI.result: 通过简单构造和复杂实践实验验证了所提方法的有效性，并揭示了全局优化与基于扩散的生成模型之间的深刻联系。
AI.translation: 基于梯度的优化方法被广泛用于解决各种优化问题，然而，它们要么受限于局部最优困境、简单的凸约束和连续可微性要求，要么仅限于低维简单问题。这项工作通过将所有具有各种复杂约束的优化问题统一为一个无约束的通用分层优化目标来解决这些局限性和限制，该目标通过通过得分匹配获得的梯度进行优化。所提出的方法通过简单构造和复杂实践实验得到了验证。更重要的是，它揭示了全局优化与基于扩散的生成模型之间的深刻联系。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的全局优化方法，通过将具有复杂约束的优化问题转化为无约束的分层优化目标，并利用得分匹配获得的梯度进行优化，从而克服了传统梯度方法的局限性。该方法在实验中得到了验证，并揭示了全局优化与扩散生成模型之间的深层联系。
AI.keywords: 全局优化, 梯度方法, 分层优化, 得分匹配, 生成模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将各种复杂约束的优化问题统一为一个无约束的通用分层优化目标，并通过得分匹配获得的梯度进行优化，这有效解决了传统梯度方法的局限性。其重要性在于揭示了全局优化与基于扩散的生成模型之间的深刻联系。论文的局限性（未在摘要中明确提及）可能是计算复杂性或收敛速度。

title: Digital FAST: An AI-Driven Multimodal Framework for Rapid and Early Stroke Screening
summary: Early identification of stroke symptoms is essential for enabling timely intervention and improving patient outcomes, particularly in prehospital settings. This study presents a fast, non-invasive multimodal deep learning framework for automatic binary stroke screening based on data collected during the F.A.S.T. assessment. The proposed approach integrates complementary information from facial expressions, speech signals, and upper-body movements to enhance diagnostic robustness. Facial dynamics are represented using landmark based features and modeled with a Transformer architecture to capture temporal dependencies. Speech signals are converted into mel spectrograms and processed using an Audio Spectrogram Transformer, while upper-body pose sequences are analyzed with an MLP-Mixer network to model spatiotemporal motion patterns. The extracted modality specific representations are combined through an attention-based fusion mechanism to effectively learn cross modal interactions. Experiments conducted on a self-collected dataset of 222 videos from 37 subjects demonstrate that the proposed multimodal model consistently outperforms unimodal baselines, achieving 95.83% accuracy and a 96.00% F1-score. The model attains a strong balance between sensitivity and specificity and successfully detects all stroke cases in the test set. These results highlight the potential of multimodal learning and transfer learning for early stroke screening, while emphasizing the need for larger, clinically representative datasets to support reliable real-world deployment.

AI.title_translation: 数字FAST：一个由人工智能驱动的多模态框架，用于快速早期卒中筛查
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个名为Digital FAST的AI驱动框架，利用面部表情、语音和上身动作等多模态数据，通过深度学习技术实现快速、无创的卒中筛查，在222个视频的实验中准确率达到95.83%，F1分数达到96.00%，显示出早期卒中筛查的潜力。
AI.motivation: 早期识别卒中症状对于及时干预和改善患者预后至关重要，尤其是在院前环境中。本研究旨在开发一种快速、无创的多模态深度学习框架，以自动进行卒中筛查。
AI.method: 该框架整合了面部表情、语音信号和上身动作的数据。面部动态使用基于地标的特征并通过Transformer架构建模；语音信号转换为声谱图并使用Audio Spectrogram Transformer处理；上身姿态序列使用MLP-Mixer网络分析。提取的模态特定表示通过基于注意力机制的融合机制进行结合。
AI.result: 在对37名受试者的222个视频进行的自我收集数据集上的实验表明，所提出的多模态模型在准确率上达到95.83%，F1分数达到96.00%，持续优于单模态基线模型，并成功检测到测试集中的所有卒中病例。
AI.conclusion: 多模态学习和迁移学习在早期卒中筛查方面具有巨大潜力，但为了实现可靠的实际应用，需要更大、更具临床代表性的数据集。
AI.translation: 早期识别卒中症状对于实现及时干预和改善患者预后至关重要，尤其是在院前环境中。本研究提出了一个快速、无创的多模态深度学习框架，用于基于F.A.S.T.评估期间收集的数据进行自动二元卒中筛查。所提出的方法整合了来自面部表情、语音信号和上身动作的互补信息，以增强诊断的稳健性。面部动态使用基于地标的特征表示，并使用Transformer架构进行建模以捕捉时间依赖性。语音信号被转换为声谱图，并使用Audio Spectrogram Transformer进行处理，同时使用MLP-Mixer网络分析上身姿态序列，以对时空运动模式进行建模。提取的模态特定表示通过基于注意力机制的融合机制进行结合，以有效地学习跨模态交互。在对37名受试者的222个视频进行的自我收集数据集上进行的实验表明，所提出的多模态模型持续优于单模态基线模型，准确率达到95.83%，F1分数达到96.00%。该模型在敏感性和特异性之间取得了良好的平衡，并成功检测到测试集中的所有卒中病例。这些结果凸显了多模态学习和迁移学习在早期卒中筛查方面的潜力，同时强调了需要更大、更具临床代表性的数据集来支持可靠的实际部署。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为Digital FAST的多模态深度学习框架，用于快速、无创的院前卒中筛查。该框架整合了面部表情、语音和上身动作信息，利用Transformer、Audio Spectrogram Transformer和MLP-Mixer等模型进行分析，并通过注意力机制融合，以提高诊断的准确性和稳健性。实验结果显示，该模型在准确率和F1分数上均表现优异，并能成功识别所有卒中病例，证明了其在早期卒中筛查中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 卒中筛查, 多模态学习, 深度学习, Digital FAST, 院前急救
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的多模态深度学习框架用于早期卒中筛查，整合了面部、语音和动作信息，提高了诊断的准确性和效率。然而，研究强调需要更大、更具临床代表性的数据集来支持实际应用，这一点非常重要。未来的工作可以关注模型的泛化能力和在真实临床环境中的部署。

title: Improving Low-Resource Machine Translation via Round-Trip Reinforcement Learning
summary: Low-resource machine translation (MT) has gained increasing attention as parallel data from low-resource language communities is collected, but many approaches for improving low-resource MT remain underexplored. We investigate a self-supervised reinforcement learning fine-tuning for translation in low-resource settings using round-trip bootstrapping with the No Language Left Behind (NLLB) family of models. Our approach translates English into a target low-resource language and then back into English, using a combination of chrF++ and BLEU as the reward function on the reconstructed English sentences. Using the NLLB-MD dataset, we evaluate both the 600M and 1.3B parameter NLLB models and observe consistent improvements for the following languages: Central Aymara, Friulian, Wolof, Dyula, Bhojpuri and Russian. Qualitative inspection of translation outputs indicates increased fluency and semantic fidelity. We argue that our method can further benefit from scale, enabling models to increasingly leverage their pretrained knowledge and continue self-improving. Code available at: https://github.com/Copticoder/MT-via-Round-Trip-RL

AI.title_translation: 通过往返强化学习改进低资源机器翻译
AI.tldr: 通过“翻译-回译”的方式，利用强化学习微调NLLB模型，显著提高了低资源机器翻译的质量。
AI.motivation: 低资源机器翻译受到越来越多的关注，但许多改进低资源MT的方法仍有待探索。
AI.method: 使用往返引导的自监督强化学习进行微调。具体操作是将英文翻译成目标低资源语言，然后再翻译回英文，并使用chrF++和BLEU的组合作为奖励函数来评估重建的英文句子。该方法基于NLLB模型家族。
AI.result: 在NLLB-MD数据集上，对600M和1.3B参数的NLLB模型进行了评估，观察到对中阿伊马拉语、弗留利语、沃洛夫语、迪乌拉语、博杰普尔语和俄语的翻译性能有了一致的提升。定性检查表明翻译的流畅性和语义保真度有所增加。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过往返引导的自监督强化学习微调，在低资源设置下，一致性地提高了NLLB模型（600M和1.3B参数）在多种语言上的翻译质量，定性分析显示翻译的流畅性和语义保真度有所提高。研究人员认为，该方法可以通过模型规模的扩大而进一步受益。
AI.translation: 低资源机器翻译（MT）由于低资源语言社区的平行数据收集工作而受到越来越多的关注，但许多改进低资源MT的方法仍有待探索。我们使用No Language Left Behind (NLLB) 模型家族的往返引导（round-trip bootstrapping）方法，研究了一种用于低资源环境下的翻译自监督强化学习微调。我们的方法将英文翻译成目标低资源语言，然后再翻译回英文，使用chrF++和BLEU的组合作为重建英文句子的奖励函数。在NLLB-MD数据集上，我们评估了600M和1.3B参数的NLLB模型，观察到以下语言的性能得到一致提升：中阿伊马拉语、弗留利语、沃洛夫语、迪乌拉语、博杰普尔语和俄语。对翻译输出的定性检查表明流畅性和语义保真度有所提高。我们认为，我们的方法可以通过规模的扩大而进一步受益，使模型能够越来越多地利用其预训练知识并持续自我改进。代码见：https://github.com/Copticoder/MT-via-Round-Trip-RL
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用往返引导（round-trip bootstrapping）的自监督强化学习微调方法，以改进低资源机器翻译（MT）。该方法将英文翻译到低资源目标语言，再翻译回英文，并利用chrF++和BLEU作为奖励函数。在NLLB模型和NLLB-MD数据集上的实验表明，该方法对多种低资源语言的翻译性能有稳定提升。
AI.keywords: 低资源机器翻译, 强化学习, 往返引导, NLLB, 自监督学习
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将自监督强化学习与往返引导（round-trip bootstrapping）结合，用于低资源机器翻译的微调，特别是利用了NLLB模型的强大预训练知识。虽然在多个低资源语言上取得了提升，但其对模型规模的依赖性可能限制了其在资源极度受限场景下的应用。未来的工作可以探索如何减轻对大规模模型的依赖。

title: YOLO26: An Analysis of NMS-Free End to End Framework for Real-Time Object Detection
summary: The ``You Only Look Once'' (YOLO) framework has long served as a standard for real-time object detection, though traditional iterations have utilized Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) post-processing, which introduces specific latency and hyperparameter variables. This paper presents a comprehensive architectural analysis of YOLO26, a model that shifts toward a native end-to-end learning strategy by eliminating NMS. This study examines the core mechanisms driving this framework: the MuSGD optimizer for backbone stabilization, Small-Target-Aware Label Assignment (STAL), and ProgLoss for dynamic supervision. To contextualize its performance, this article reviews exhaustive benchmark data from the COCO \texttt{val2017} leaderboard. This evaluation provides an objective comparison of YOLO26 across various model scales (Nano to Extra-Large) against both prior CNN lineages and contemporary Transformer-based architectures (e.g., RT-DETR, DEIM, RF-DETR), detailing the observed speed-accuracy trade-offs and parameter requirements without asserting a singular optimal model. Additionally, the analysis covers the framework's unified multi-task capabilities, including the YOLOE-26 open-vocabulary module for promptable detection. Ultimately, this paper serves to document how decoupling representation learning from heuristic post-processing impacts the "Export Gap" and deterministic latency in modern edge-based computer vision deployments.

AI.title_translation: YOLO26：一种无NMS端到端实时目标检测框架的分析
AI.tldr: YOLO26是一个创新的端到端实时目标检测框架，通过消除NMS来提高效率，并引入了MuSGD优化器、STAL标签分配和ProgLoss等新机制，在速度和精度上与现有模型（包括CNN和Transformer）进行了全面比较，并探讨了其在多任务和边缘计算中的应用。
AI.motivation: 传统的YOLO框架依赖于NMS后处理，这会引入延迟和超参数。本研究旨在分析YOLO26，一个采用原生端到端学习策略、无需NMS的模型，以解决这些问题。
AI.method: 对YOLO26的架构进行了全面的分析，重点关注其核心机制：用于骨干网络稳定的MuSGD优化器、小目标感知标签分配（STAL）和动态监督的ProgLoss。通过COCO val2017排行榜的基准数据，对YOLO26在不同模型规模下与CNN和Transformer模型的速度-精度权衡和参数需求进行了比较。此外，还研究了该框架统一的多任务能力，包括用于可提示检测的YOLOE-26开放词汇模块。
AI.result: YOLO26在COCO val2017排行榜上进行了广泛的基准测试，并与各种模型规模（Nano到Extra-Large）的先前CNN和Transformer模型进行了比较，详细说明了速度-精度权衡和参数需求。
AI.conclusion: YOLO26通过消除NMS实现了端到端的学习，这会影响“导出差距”和现代边缘部署中的确定性延迟。该模型通过引入MuSGD、STAL和ProgLoss等机制，在实时目标检测领域展现出潜力。
AI.translation: “你只看一次”（YOLO）框架长期以来一直是实时目标检测的标准，尽管传统的迭代使用了非极大值抑制（NMS）后处理，这会引入特定的延迟和超参数变量。本文对YOLO26的架构进行了全面的分析，该模型通过消除NMS转向了原生的端到端学习策略。本研究考察了驱动该框架的核心机制：用于骨干网络稳定的MuSGD优化器、小目标感知标签分配（STAL）和动态监督的ProgLoss。为了对其性能进行情境化，本文回顾了COCO val2017排行榜上详尽的基准数据。该评估在各种模型规模（Nano到Extra-Large）下，将YOLO26与之前的CNN系列和当代Transformer模型（例如RT-DETR、DEIM、RF-DETR）进行了客观比较，详细说明了观察到的速度-精度权衡和参数需求，而不主张单一的最佳模型。此外，分析还涵盖了该框架统一的多任务能力，包括用于可提示检测的YOLOE-26开放词汇模块。最终，本文旨在记录表示学习与启发式后处理分离如何影响现代边缘计算视觉部署中的“导出差距”和确定性延迟。
AI.summary: 本文分析了YOLO26，一个创新的无NMS端到端实时目标检测框架。通过引入MuSGD优化器、STAL标签分配和ProgLoss，YOLO26旨在提高效率并减少延迟。研究人员在COCO val2017基准上评估了YOLO26在不同规模下的性能，并将其与现有的CNN和Transformer模型进行了比较，同时探讨了其在多任务处理和边缘计算中的应用。
AI.keywords: YOLO26, 实时目标检测, 端到端学习, 无NMS, MuSGD
AI.comments: 该研究对YOLO26的分析很有价值，它解决了传统YOLO框架中NMS带来的延迟和超参数问题。通过采用端到端学习策略并引入新颖的优化器和损失函数，YOLO26有望在实时目标检测领域取得显著进展。然而，文中提到不主张单一的最佳模型，这可能意味着在某些特定场景下，需要根据具体需求权衡YOLO26的不同配置，或者与其他模型进行进一步的比较。

title: CARPE: Context-Aware Image Representation Prioritization via Ensemble for Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are typically trained using autoregressive language modeling objectives, which align visual representations with linguistic space. While effective for multimodal reasoning, this alignment can weaken vision-centric capabilities, causing LVLMs to underperform their base vision encoders on tasks such as image classification. To address this limitation, we propose Context-Aware Image Representation Prioritization via Ensemble (CARPE), a lightweight framework that integrates raw vision features with aligned LLM representations through vision-integration layers and a context-aware ensemble mechanism. This design enhances the model's ability to adaptively weight visual and textual modalities and enables the model to capture various aspects of image representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CARPE improves performance on both image classification and diverse vision-language benchmarks. Our results suggest that modality balancing plays a critical role in multimodal generalization by improving representation utilization within autoregressive LVLMs.

title: What Patients Really Ask: Exploring the Effect of False Assumptions in Patient Information Seeking
summary: Patients are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to seek answers to their healthcare-related questions. However, benchmarking efforts in LLMs for question answering often focus on medical exam questions, which differ significantly in style and content from the questions patients actually raise in real life. To bridge this gap, we sourced data from Google's People Also Ask feature by querying the top 200 prescribed medications in the United States, curating a dataset of medical questions people commonly ask. A considerable portion of the collected questions contains incorrect assumptions and dangerous intentions. We demonstrate that the emergence of these corrupted questions is not uniformly random and depends heavily on the degree of incorrectness in the history of questions that led to their appearance. Current LLMs that perform strongly on other benchmarks struggle to identify incorrect assumptions in everyday questions.

title: Failing on Bias Mitigation: A Case Study on the Challenges of Fairness in Government Data
summary: The potential for bias and unfairness in AI-supporting government services raises ethical and legal concerns. Using crime rate prediction with the Bristol City Council data as a case study, we examine how these issues persist. Rather than auditing real-world deployed systems, our goal is to understand why widely adopted bias mitigation techniques often fail when applied to government data. Our findings reveal that bias mitigation approaches applied to government data are not always effective -- not because of flaws in model architecture or metric selection, but due to the inherent properties of the data itself. Through comparing a set of comprehensive models and fairness methods, our experiments consistently show that the mitigation efforts cannot overcome the embedded unfairness in the data -- further reinforcing that the origin of bias lies in the structure and history of government datasets. We then explore the reasons for the mitigation failures in predictive models on government data and highlight the potential sources of unfairness posed by data distribution shifts, the accumulation of historical bias, and delays in data release. We also discover the limitations of the blind spots in fairness analysis and bias mitigation methods when only targeting a single sensitive feature through a set of intersectional fairness experiments. Although this study is limited to one city, the findings are highly suggestive, which can contribute to an early warning that biases in government data may persist even with standard mitigation methods.

title: Unifying Heterogeneous Degradations: Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Bridge Model for All-in-One Image Restoration
summary: All-in-One Image Restoration (AiOIR) faces the fundamental challenge in reconciling conflicting optimization objectives across heterogeneous degradations. Existing methods are often constrained by coarse-grained control mechanisms or fixed mapping schedules, yielding suboptimal adaptation. To address this, we propose an Uncertainty-Aware Diffusion Bridge Model (UDBM), which innovatively reformulates AiOIR as a stochastic transport problem steered by pixel-wise uncertainty. By introducing a relaxed diffusion bridge formulation which replaces the strict terminal constraint with a relaxed constraint, we model the uncertainty of degradations while theoretically resolving the drift singularity inherent in standard diffusion bridges. Furthermore, we devise a dual modulation strategy: the noise schedule aligns diverse degradations into a shared high-entropy latent space, while the path schedule adaptively regulates the transport trajectory motivated by the viscous dynamics of entropy regularization. By effectively rectifying the transport geometry and dynamics, UDBM achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse restoration tasks within a single inference step.

title: Unsupervised Decomposition and Recombination with Discriminator-Driven Diffusion Models
summary: Decomposing complex data into factorized representations can reveal reusable components and enable synthesizing new samples via component recombination. We investigate this in the context of diffusion-based models that learn factorized latent spaces without factor-level supervision. In images, factors can capture background, illumination, and object attributes; in robotic videos, they can capture reusable motion components. To improve both latent factor discovery and quality of compositional generation, we introduce an adversarial training signal via a discriminator trained to distinguish between single-source samples and those generated by recombining factors across sources. By optimizing the generator to fool this discriminator, we encourage physical and semantic consistency in the resulting recombinations. Our method outperforms implementations of prior baselines on CelebA-HQ, Virtual KITTI, CLEVR, and Falcor3D, achieving lower FID scores and better disentanglement as measured by MIG and MCC. Furthermore, we demonstrate a novel application to robotic video trajectories: by recombining learned action components, we generate diverse sequences that significantly increase state-space coverage for exploration on the LIBERO benchmark.

title: FACET: Multi-Agent AI Supporting Teachers in Scaling Differentiated Learning for Diverse Students
summary: Classrooms are becoming increasingly heterogeneous, comprising learners with diverse performance and motivation levels, language proficiencies, and learning differences such as dyslexia and ADHD. While teachers recognize the need for differentiated instruction, growing workloads create substantial barriers, making differentiated instruction an ideal that is often unrealized in practice. Current AI educational tools, which promise differentiated materials, are predominantly student-facing and performance-centric, ignoring other aspects that shape learning outcomes. We introduce FACET, a teacher-facing multi-agent framework designed to address these gaps by supporting differentiation that accounts for motivation, performance, and learning differences. Developed with educational stakeholders from the outset, the framework coordinates four specialized agents, including learner simulation, diagnostic assessment, material generation, and evaluation within a teacher-in-the-loop design. School principals (N = 30) shaped system requirements through participatory workshops, while in-service K-12 teachers (N = 70) evaluated material quality. Mixed-methods evaluation demonstrates strong perceived value for inclusive differentiation. Practitioners emphasized both the urgent need arising from classroom heterogeneity and the importance of maintaining pedagogical autonomy as a prerequisite for adoption. We discuss implications for future school deployment and outline partnerships for longitudinal classroom implementation.

title: A Flux-Correction Form of the Third-Order Edge-Based Scheme for a General Numerical Flux Function
summary: In this short note, we present a flux-correction form of the third-order edge-based scheme for the Euler equations that enables the direct use of a general flux function. The core idea is to replace, without loss of accuracy, the arithmetic average of the flux extrapolations by a general numerical flux evaluated at the edge midpoint, together with a correction term. We show that the proposed flux-correction form preserves third-order accuracy, provided that the general numerical flux is evaluated with the left and right states that are computed exactly for a quadratic function, which can be achieved effectively by the U-MUSCL scheme with κ = 1/2. Numerical results are presented to verify third-order accuracy with the HLLC and LDFSS flux functions on irregular tetrahedral grids.

title: Lyapunov Constrained Soft Actor-Critic (LC-SAC) using Koopman Operator Theory for Quadrotor Trajectory Tracking
comments: 11 pages, 7 Figures, submitted to IEEE RA-L
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in solving complex sequential decision-making problems. However, its application to safety-critical physical systems remains constrained by the lack of stability guarantees. Standard RL algorithms prioritize reward maximization, often yielding policies that may induce oscillations or unbounded state divergence. There has been significant work in incorporating Lyapunov-based stability guarantees in RL algorithms with key challenges being selecting a candidate Lyapunov function, computational complexity by using excessive function approximators and conservative policies by incorporating stability criterion in the learning process. In this work we propose a novel Lyapunov-constrained Soft Actor-Critic (LC-SAC) algorithm using Koopman operator theory. We propose use of extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD) to produce a linear approximation of the system and use this approximation to derive a closed form solution for candidate Lyapunov function. This derived Lyapunov function is incorporated in the SAC algorithm to further provide guarantees for a policy that stabilizes the nonlinear system. The results are evaluated trajectory tracking of a 2D Quadrotor environment based on safe-control-gym. The proposed algorithm shows training convergence and decaying violations for Lyapunov stability criterion compared to baseline vanilla SAC algorithm. GitHub Repository: https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/LC-SAC-Quadrotor-Trajectory-Tracking

title: Beware Untrusted Simulators -- Reward-Free Backdoor Attacks in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Simulated environments are a key piece in the success of Reinforcement Learning (RL), allowing practitioners and researchers to train decision making agents without running expensive experiments on real hardware. Simulators remain a security blind spot, however, enabling adversarial developers to alter the dynamics of their released simulators for malicious purposes. Therefore, in this work we highlight a novel threat, demonstrating how simulator dynamics can be exploited to stealthily implant action-level backdoors into RL agents. The backdoor then allows an adversary to reliably activate targeted actions in an agent upon observing a predefined ``trigger'', leading to potentially dangerous consequences. Traditional backdoor attacks are limited in their strong threat models, assuming the adversary has near full control over an agent's training pipeline, enabling them to both alter and observe agent's rewards. As these assumptions are infeasible to implement within a simulator, we propose a new attack ``Daze'' which is able to reliably and stealthily implant backdoors into RL agents trained for real world tasks without altering or even observing their rewards. We provide formal proof of Daze's effectiveness in guaranteeing attack success across general RL tasks along with extensive empirical evaluations on both discrete and continuous action space domains. We additionally provide the first example of RL backdoor attacks transferring to real, robotic hardware. These developments motivate further research into securing all components of the RL training pipeline to prevent malicious attacks.

title: PAND: Prompt-Aware Neighborhood Distillation for Lightweight Fine-Grained Visual Classification
summary: Distilling knowledge from large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into lightweight networks is crucial yet challenging in Fine-Grained Visual Classification (FGVC), due to the reliance on fixed prompts and global alignment. To address this, we propose PAND (Prompt-Aware Neighborhood Distillation), a two-stage framework that decouples semantic calibration from structural transfer. First, we incorporate Prompt-Aware Semantic Calibration to generate adaptive semantic anchors. Second, we introduce a neighborhood-aware structural distillation strategy to constrain the student's local decision structure. PAND consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on four FGVC benchmarks. Notably, our ResNet-18 student achieves 76.09% accuracy on CUB-200, surpassing the strong baseline VL2Lite by 3.4%. Code is available at https://github.com/LLLVTA/PAND.

title: Rolling Sink: Bridging Limited-Horizon Training and Open-Ended Testing in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
comments: v4: Fix some typos. Figures were compressed to 150 dpi to comply with arXiv's submission size limit. Project page: https://rolling-sink.github.io/
summary: Recently, autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have achieved remarkable performance. However, due to their limited training durations, a train-test gap emerges when testing at longer horizons, leading to rapid visual degradations. Following Self Forcing, which studies the train-test gap within the training duration, this work studies the train-test gap beyond the training duration, i.e., the gap between the limited horizons during training and open-ended horizons during testing. Since open-ended testing can extend beyond any finite training window, and long-video training is computationally expensive, we pursue a training-free solution to bridge this gap. To explore a training-free solution, we conduct a systematic analysis of AR cache maintenance. These insights lead to Rolling Sink. Built on Self Forcing (trained on only 5s clips), Rolling Sink effectively scales the AR video synthesis to ultra-long durations (e.g., 5-30 minutes at 16 FPS) at test time, with consistent subjects, stable colors, coherent structures, and smooth motions. As demonstrated by extensive experiments, Rolling Sink achieves superior long-horizon visual fidelity and temporal consistency compared to SOTA baselines. Project page: https://rolling-sink.github.io/
