title: HyPER-GAN: Hybrid Patch-Based Image-to-Image Translation for Real-Time Photorealism Enhancement
comments: This paper is under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: Generative models are widely employed to enhance the photorealism of visual synthetic data for training computer vision algorithms. However, they often introduce visual artifacts that degrade the accuracy of these algorithms and require high computational resources, limiting their applicability in real-time training or evaluation scenarios. In this paper, we propose Hybrid Patch Enhanced Realism Generative Adversarial Network (HyPER-GAN), a lightweight image-to-image translation method based on a U-Net-style generator designed for real-time inference. The model is trained using paired synthetic and photorealism-enhanced images, complemented by a hybrid training strategy that incorporates matched patches from real-world images to improve visual realism and semantic consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that HyPER-GAN outperforms state-of-the-art lightweight paired image-to-image translation methods in terms of inference latency, visual realism, and semantic robustness. Moreover, it is illustrated that the proposed hybrid training strategy indeed improves visual quality and semantic consistency compared to training the model solely with paired synthetic and photorealism-enhanced images. Code and pretrained models are publicly available for download at: https://github.com/stefanos50/HyPER-GAN
comment: This paper is under consideration at Pattern Recognition Letters

title: Just-in-Time: Training-Free Spatial Acceleration for Diffusion Transformers
comments: Accepted by CVPR2026. Project Page: https://wenhao-sun77.github.io/JiT/
summary: Diffusion Transformers have established a new state-of-the-art in image synthesis, but the high computational cost of iterative sampling severely hampers their practical deployment. While existing acceleration methods often focus on the temporal domain, they overlook the substantial spatial redundancy inherent in the generative process, where global structures emerge long before fine-grained details are formed. The uniform computational treatment of all spatial regions represents a critical inefficiency. In this paper, we introduce Just-in-Time (JiT), a novel training-free framework that addresses this challenge by acceleration in the spatial domain. JiT formulates a spatially approximated generative ordinary differential equation (ODE) that drives the full latent state evolution based on computations from a dynamically selected, sparse subset of anchor tokens. To ensure seamless transitions as new tokens are incorporated to expand the dimensions of the latent state, we propose a deterministic micro-flow, a simple and effective finite-time ODE that maintains both structural coherence and statistical correctness. Extensive experiments on the state-of-the-art FLUX.1-dev model demonstrate that JiT achieves up to a 7x speedup with nearly lossless performance, significantly outperforming existing acceleration methods and establishing a new and superior trade-off between inference speed and generation fidelity.
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026. Project Page: https://wenhao-sun77.github.io/JiT/

title: A Control-Theoretic Foundation for Agentic Systems
summary: This paper develops a control-theoretic framework for analyzing agentic systems embedded within feedback control loops, where an AI agent may adapt controller parameters, select among control strategies, invoke external tools, reconfigure decision architectures, and modify control objectives during operation. These capabilities are formalized by interpreting agency as hierarchical runtime decision authority over elements of the control architecture, leading to an augmented closed-loop representation in which physical states, internal memory, tool outputs, interaction signals, and design variables evolve as a coupled dynamical system. A five-level hierarchy of agency is defined, ranging from fixed control laws to runtime synthesis of control architectures and objectives. The analysis shows that increasing agency introduces interacting dynamical mechanisms such as time-varying adaptation, endogenous switching, decision-induced delays, and structural reconfiguration. The framework is developed in both nonlinear and linear settings, providing explicit design constraints for AI-enabled control systems in safety-critical applications.

title: Primitive-Root Determinant Densities over Prime Fields and Implications for PRIM-LWE
summary:
The PRIM-LWE problem, introduced by Sehrawat, Yeo, and Desmedt (Theoretical Computer Science, 886 (2021)), is a variant of the Learning with Errors problem in which the secret matrix is required to have a primitive-root determinant. The dimension-uniform reduction constant is $c(p)=\inf_{n\ge 1}c_n(p)$, where $c_n(p)$ is the exact density of $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_p$ with primitive-root determinant. Sehrawat, Yeo, and Desmedt asked whether $\inf_{p\text{ prime}} c(p)=0$, observing that an affirmative answer would follow from the conjectural infinitude of primorial primes. We resolve this question unconditionally using only Dirichlet's theorem and Mertens' product formula, entirely bypassing the primorial-prime hypothesis. We further establish the sharp order
  \[
  \min_{p\le x} c(p)\asymp \frac{1}{\log\log x} \qquad (x\to\infty),
  \] and show that the limiting distribution of $c(p)$ over the primes has support exactly $[0,1/2]$. We have not found this full-support statement in the literature. The law coincides with the classical shifted-prime distribution of $\varphi(p-1)/(p-1)$ via a transport lemma and is moreover continuous and purely singular. We also derive explicit lower bounds on $c(q)$ for primes of cryptographic interest, parameterized solely by the number of distinct prime factors of $q-1$. As a simple conservative explicit bound, for any prime $q>2^{30}$ the expected overhead $1/c(q)$ is at most $1.79\log q$. On the other hand, our results show that the worst-case overhead among primes $p\le x$ is of order $Θ(\log\log x)$, and in particular $1/c(q)=O(\log\log q)$ pointwise.

title: InstantHDR: Single-forward Gaussian Splatting for High Dynamic Range 3D Reconstruction
summary: High dynamic range (HDR) novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to reconstruct HDR scenes from multi-exposure low dynamic range (LDR) images. Existing HDR pipelines heavily rely on known camera poses, well-initialized dense point clouds, and time-consuming per-scene optimization. Current feed-forward alternatives overlook the HDR problem by assuming exposure-invariant appearance. To bridge this gap, we propose InstantHDR, a feed-forward network that reconstructs 3D HDR scenes from uncalibrated multi-exposure LDR collections in a single forward pass. Specifically, we design a geometry-guided appearance modeling for multi-exposure fusion, and a meta-network for generalizable scene-specific tone mapping. Due to the lack of HDR scene data, we build a pre-training dataset, called HDR-Pretrain, for generalizable feed-forward HDR models, featuring 168 Blender-rendered scenes, diverse lighting types, and multiple camera response functions. Comprehensive experiments show that our InstantHDR delivers comparable synthesis performance to the state-of-the-art optimization-based HDR methods while enjoying $\sim700\times$ and $\sim20\times$ reconstruction speed improvement with our single-forward and post-optimization settings. All code, models, and datasets will be released after the review process.

title: Meta-Reinforcement Learning with Self-Reflection for Agentic Search
summary: This paper introduces MR-Search, an in-context meta reinforcement learning (RL) formulation for agentic search with self-reflection. Instead of optimizing a policy within a single independent episode with sparse rewards, MR-Search trains a policy that conditions on past episodes and adapts its search strategy across episodes. MR-Search learns to learn a search strategy with self-reflection, allowing search agents to improve in-context exploration at test-time. Specifically, MR-Search performs cross-episode exploration by generating explicit self-reflections after each episode and leveraging them as additional context to guide subsequent attempts, thereby promoting more effective exploration during test-time. We further introduce a multi-turn RL algorithm that estimates a dense relative advantage at the turn level, enabling fine-grained credit assignment on each episode. Empirical results across various benchmarks demonstrate the advantages of MR-Search over baselines based RL, showing strong generalization and relative improvements of 9.2% to 19.3% across eight benchmarks. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/tengxiao1/MR-Search.

title: Grounding Robot Generalization in Training Data via Retrieval-Augmented VLMs
summary: Recent work on robot manipulation has advanced policy generalization to novel scenarios. However, it is often difficult to characterize how different evaluation settings actually represent generalization from the training distribution of a given policy. To work towards more precise evaluation of generalization in robotics, we propose RADAR, a scalable framework for directly comparing test-time evaluation tasks to policy training data, to determine what form of policy generalization is required. RADAR consists of a two-stage pipeline: first, retrieval using generalist policy embeddings identifies which training examples are relevant for a given evaluation task. Next, vision-language models (VLMs) analyze the evaluation task against the retrieved data, outputting interpretable analysis on how they compare along a variety of axes, and an overall classification of what type of policy generalization is required. Through controlled experiments, we demonstrate that VLMs are effective at analyzing data for generalization, and that our retrieval step effectively identifies examples needed to make accurate classifications with respect to the training data. Furthermore, we scale RADAR to large-scale datasets, where we observe agreement with human-defined benchmark conditions from prior work. We provide demonstrations at radar-analysis.github.io.

title: Disentangled Representation Learning through Unsupervised Symmetry Group Discovery
summary: Symmetry-based disentangled representation learning leverages the group structure of environment transformations to uncover the latent factors of variation. Prior approaches to symmetry-based disentanglement have required strong prior knowledge of the symmetry group's structure, or restrictive assumptions about the subgroup properties. In this work, we remove these constraints by proposing a method whereby an embodied agent autonomously discovers the group structure of its action space through unsupervised interaction with the environment. We prove the identifiability of the true symmetry group decomposition under minimal assumptions, and derive two algorithms: one for discovering the group decomposition from interaction data, and another for learning Linear Symmetry-Based Disentangled (LSBD) representations without assuming specific subgroup properties. Our method is validated on three environments exhibiting different group decompositions, where it outperforms existing LSBD approaches.

title: Multimodal Emotion Recognition via Bi-directional Cross-Attention and Temporal Modeling
summary: Expression recognition in in-the-wild video data remains challenging due to substantial variations in facial appearance, background conditions, audio noise, and the inherently dynamic nature of human affect. Relying on a single modality, such as facial expressions or speech, is often insufficient for capturing these complex emotional cues. To address this limitation, we propose a multimodal emotion recognition framework for the Expression (EXPR) task in the 10th Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild (ABAW) Challenge. Our framework builds on large-scale pre-trained models for visual and audio representation learning and integrates them in a unified multimodal architecture. To better capture temporal patterns in facial expression sequences, we incorporate temporal visual modeling over video windows. We further introduce a bi-directional cross-attention fusion module that enables visual and audio features to interact in a symmetric manner, facilitating cross-modal contextualization and complementary emotion understanding. In addition, we employ a text-guided contrastive objective to encourage semantically meaningful visual representations through alignment with emotion-related text prompts. Experimental results on the ABAW 10th EXPR benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, achieving a Macro F1 score of 0.32 compared to the baseline score of 0.25, and highlight the benefit of combining temporal visual modeling, audio representation learning, and cross-modal fusion for robust emotion recognition in unconstrained real-world environments.

title: Push, Press, Slide: Mode-Aware Planar Contact Manipulation via Reduced-Order Models
comments: 8 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE IROS 2026
summary: Non-prehensile planar manipulation, including pushing and press-and-slide, is critical for diverse robotic tasks, but notoriously challenging due to hybrid contact mechanics, under-actuation, and asymmetric friction limits that traditionally necessitate computationally expensive iterative control. In this paper, we propose a mode-aware framework for planar manipulation with one or two robotic arms based on contact topology selection and reduced-order kinematic modeling. Our core insight is that complex wrench-twist limit surface mechanics can be abstracted into a discrete library of physically intuitive models. We systematically map various single-arm and bimanual contact topologies to simple non-holonomic formulations, e.g. unicycle for simplified press-and-slide motion. By anchoring trajectory generation to these reduced-order models, our framework computes the required object wrench and distributes feasible, friction-bounded contact forces via a direct algebraic allocator. We incorporate manipulator kinematics to ensure long-horizon feasibility and demonstrate our fast, optimization-free approach in simulation across diverse single-arm and bimanual manipulation tasks. Supplementary videos and additional information are available at: https://sites.google.com/view/pushpressslide
comment: 8 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to IEEE IROS 2026

title: Coherent Human-Scene Reconstruction from Multi-Person Multi-View Video in a Single Pass
summary: Recent advances in 3D foundation models have led to growing interest in reconstructing humans and their surrounding environments. However, most existing approaches focus on monocular inputs, and extending them to multi-view settings requires additional overhead modules or preprocessed data. To this end, we present CHROMM, a unified framework that jointly estimates cameras, scene point clouds, and human meshes from multi-person multi-view videos without relying on external modules or preprocessing. We integrate strong geometric and human priors from Pi3X and Multi-HMR into a single trainable neural network architecture, and introduce a scale adjustment module to solve the scale discrepancy between humans and the scene. We also introduce a multi-view fusion strategy to aggregate per-view estimates into a single representation at test-time. Finally, we propose a geometry-based multi-person association method, which is more robust than appearance-based approaches. Experiments on EMDB, RICH, EgoHumans, and EgoExo4D show that CHROMM achieves competitive performance in global human motion and multi-view pose estimation while running over 8x faster than prior optimization-based multi-view approaches. Project page: https://nstar1125.github.io/chromm.

title: Real-World AI Evaluation: How FRAME Generates Systematic Evidence to Resolve the Decision-Maker's Dilemma
summary: The rapid expansion of AI deployments has put organizational leaders in a decision maker's dilemma: they must govern these technologies without systematic evidence of how systems behave in their own environments. Predominant evaluation methods generate scalable, abstract measures of model capabilities but smooth over the heterogeneity of real world use, while user focused testing reveals rich contextual detail yet remains small in scale and loosely coupled to the mechanisms that shape model behavior. The Forum for Real World AI Measurement and Evaluation (FRAME) addresses this gap by combining large scale trials of AI systems with structured observation of how they are used in context, the outcomes they generate, and how those outcomes arise. By tracing the path from an AI system's output through its practical use and downstream effects, FRAME turns the heterogeneity of AI in use into a measurable signal rather than a trade off for achieving scale. FRAME establishes two core assets to accomplish this: a Testing Sandbox that captures AI use under real workflows at scale and a Metrics Hub that translates those traces into actionable indicators.

title: Ethical Fairness without Demographics in Human-Centered AI
summary: Computational models are increasingly embedded in human-centered domains such as healthcare, education, workplace analytics, and digital well-being, where their predictions directly influence individual outcomes and collective welfare. In such contexts, achieving high accuracy alone is insufficient; models must also act ethically and equitably across diverse populations. However, fair AI approaches that rely on demographic attributes are impractical, as such information is often unavailable, privacy-sensitive, or restricted by regulatory frameworks. Moreover, conventional parity-based fairness approaches, while aiming for equity, can inadvertently violate core ethical principles by trading off subgroup performance or stability. To address this challenge, we present Flare (Fisher-guided LAtent-subgroup learning with do-no-harm REgularization), the first demographic-agnostic framework that aligns algorithmic fairness with ethical principles through the geometry of optimization. Flare leverages Fisher Information to regularize curvature, uncovering latent disparities in model behavior without access to demographic or sensitive attributes. By integrating representation, loss, and curvature signals, it identifies hidden performance strata and adaptively refines them through collaborative but do-no-harm optimization, enhancing each subgroup's performance while preserving global stability and ethical balance. We also introduce BHE (Beneficence-Harm Avoidance-Equity), a novel metric suite that operationalizes ethical fairness evaluation beyond statistical parity. Extensive evaluations across diverse physiological (EDA), behavioral (IHS), and clinical (OhioT1DM) datasets show that Flare consistently enhances ethical fairness compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Event-Driven Video Generation
summary: State-of-the-art text-to-video models often look realistic frame-by-frame yet fail on simple interactions: motion starts before contact, actions are not realized, objects drift after placement, and support relations break. We argue this stems from frame-first denoising, which updates latent state everywhere at every step without an explicit notion of when and where an interaction is active. We introduce Event-Driven Video Generation (EVD), a minimal DiT-compatible framework that makes sampling event-grounded: a lightweight event head predicts token-aligned event activity, event-grounded losses couple activity to state change during training, and event-gated sampling (with hysteresis and early-step scheduling) suppresses spurious updates while concentrating updates during interactions. On EVD-Bench, EVD consistently improves human preference and VBench dynamics, substantially reducing failure modes in state persistence, spatial accuracy, support relations, and contact stability without sacrificing appearance. These results indicate that explicit event grounding is a practical abstraction for reducing interaction hallucinations in video generation.

title: Spatial Transcriptomics as Images for Large-Scale Pretraining
summary: Spatial Transcriptomics (ST) profiles thousands of gene expression values at discrete spots with precise coordinates on tissue sections, preserving spatial context essential for clinical and pathological studies. With rising sequencing throughput and advancing platforms, the expanding data volumes motivate large-scale ST pretraining. However, the fundamental unit for pretraining, i.e., what constitutes a single training sample, remains ill-posed. Existing choices fall into two camps: (1) treating each spot as an independent sample, which discards spatial dependencies and collapses ST into single-cell transcriptomics; and (2) treating an entire slide as a single sample, which produces prohibitively large inputs and drastically fewer training examples, undermining effective pretraining. To address this gap, we propose treating spatial transcriptomics as croppable images. Specifically, we define a multi-channel image representation with fixed spatial size by cropping patches from raw slides, thereby preserving spatial context while substantially increasing the number of training samples. Along the channel dimension, we define gene subset selection rules to control input dimensionality and improve pretraining stability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed image-like dataset construction for ST pretraining consistently improves downstream performance, outperforming conventional pretraining schemes. Ablation studies verify that both spatial patching and channel design are necessary, establishing a unified, practical paradigm for organizing ST data and enabling large-scale pretraining.

title: SAATT Nav: a Socially Aware Autonomous Transparent Transportation Navigation Framework for Wheelchairs
comments: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, 1 algorithm. Submitted to IROS 2026
summary: While powered wheelchairs reduce physical fatigue as opposed to manual wheelchairs for individuals with mobility impairment, they demand high cognitive workload due to information processing, decision making and motor coordination. Current autonomous systems lack social awareness in navigation and transparency in decision-making, leading to decreased perceived safety and trust from the user and others in context. This work proposes Socially Aware Autonomous Transparent Transportation (SAATT) Navigation framework for wheelchairs as a potential solution. By implementing a Large Language Model (LLM) informed of user intent and capable of predicting other peoples' intent as a decision-maker for its local controller, it is able to detect and navigate social situations, such as passing pedestrians or a pair conversing. Furthermore, the LLM textually communicates its reasoning at each waypoint for transparency. In this experiment, it is compared against a standard global planner, a representative competing social navigation model, and an Ablation study in three simulated environments varied by social levels in eight metrics categorized under Safety, Social Compliance, Efficiency, and Comfort. Overall, SAATT Nav outperforms in most social situations and equivalently or only slightly worse in the remaining metrics, demonstrating the potential of a socially aware and transparent autonomous navigation system to assist wheelchair users.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables, 1 algorithm. Submitted to IROS 2026

title: REFINE-DP: Diffusion Policy Fine-tuning for Humanoid Loco-manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated high-level motion plans with stable, low-level whole-body execution under complex robot-environment dynamics and long-horizon tasks. While diffusion policies (DPs) show promise for learning from demonstrations, deploying them on humanoids poses critical challenges: the motion planner trained offline is decoupled from the low-level controller, leading to poor command tracking, compounding distribution shift, and task failures. The common approach of scaling demonstration data is prohibitively expensive for high-dimensional humanoid systems. To address this challenge, we present REFINE-DP (REinforcement learning FINE-tuning of Diffusion Policy), a hierarchical framework that jointly optimizes a DP high-level planner and an RL-based low-level loco-manipulation controller. The DP is fine-tuned via a PPO-based diffusion policy gradient to improve task success rate, while the controller is simultaneously updated to accurately track the planner's evolving command distribution, reducing the distributional mismatch that degrades motion quality. We validate REFINE-DP on a humanoid robot performing loco-manipulation tasks, including door traversal and long-horizon object transport. REFINE-DP achieves an over $90\%$ success rate in simulation, even in out-of-distribution cases not seen in the pre-trained data, and enables smooth autonomous task execution in real-world dynamic environments. Our proposed method substantially outperforms pre-trained DP baselines and demonstrates that RL fine-tuning is key to reliable humanoid loco-manipulation. https://refine-dp.github.io/REFINE-DP/

title: Bodhi VLM: Privacy-Alignment Modeling for Hierarchical Visual Representations in Vision Backbones and VLM Encoders via Bottom-Up and Top-Down Feature Search
summary: Learning systems that preserve privacy often inject noise into hierarchical visual representations; a central challenge is to \emph{model} how such perturbations align with a declared privacy budget in a way that is interpretable and applicable across vision backbones and vision--language models (VLMs). We propose \emph{Bodhi VLM}, a \emph{privacy-alignment modeling} framework for \emph{hierarchical neural representations}: it (1) links sensitive concepts to layer-wise grouping via NCP and MDAV-based clustering; (2) locates sensitive feature regions using bottom-up (BUA) and top-down (TDA) strategies over multi-scale representations (e.g., feature pyramids or vision-encoder layers); and (3) uses an Expectation-Maximization Privacy Assessment (EMPA) module to produce an interpretable \emph{budget-alignment signal} by comparing the fitted sensitive-feature distribution to an evaluator-specified reference (e.g., Laplace or Gaussian with scale $c/ε$). The output is reference-relative and is \emph{not} a formal differential-privacy estimator. We formalize BUA/TDA over hierarchical feature structures and validate the framework on object detectors (YOLO, PPDPTS, DETR) and on the \emph{visual encoders} of VLMs (CLIP, LLaVA, BLIP). BUA and TDA yield comparable deviation trends; EMPA provides a stable alignment signal under the reported setups. We compare with generic discrepancy baselines (Chi-square, K-L, MMD) and with task-relevant baselines (MomentReg, NoiseMLE, Wass-1). Results are reported as mean$\pm$std over multiple seeds with confidence intervals in the supplementary materials. This work contributes a learnable, interpretable modeling perspective for privacy-aligned hierarchical representations rather than a post hoc audit only. Source code: \href{https://github.com/mabo1215/bodhi-vlm.git}{Bodhi-VLM GitHub repository}

title: The Reasoning Bottleneck in Graph-RAG: Structured Prompting and Context Compression for Multi-Hop QA
summary: Graph-RAG systems achieve strong multi-hop question answering by indexing documents into knowledge graphs, but strong retrieval does not guarantee strong answers. Evaluating KET-RAG, a leading Graph-RAG system, on three multi-hop QA benchmarks (HotpotQA, MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA), we find that 77% to 91% of questions have the gold answer in the retrieved context, yet accuracy is only 35% to 78%, and 73% to 84% of errors are reasoning failures. We propose two augmentations: (i) SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting, which decomposes questions into triple-pattern queries aligned with the entity-relationship context, and (ii) graph-walk compression, which compresses the context by ~60% via knowledge-graph traversal with no LLM calls. SPARQL CoT improves accuracy by +2 to +14 pp; graph-walk compression adds +6 pp on average when paired with structured prompting on smaller models. Surprisingly, we show that, with question-type routing, a fully augmented budget open-weight Llama-8B model matches or exceeds the unaugmented Llama-70B baseline on all three benchmarks at ~12x lower cost. A replication on LightRAG confirms that our augmentations transfer across Graph-RAG systems.

title: "I'm Not Reading All of That": Understanding Software Engineers' Level of Cognitive Engagement with Agentic Coding Assistants
comments: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, published and presented in CHI 2026 Workshop on Tools for Thought
summary: Over-reliance on AI systems can undermine users' critical thinking and promote complacency, a risk intensified by the emergence of agentic AI systems that operate with minimal human involvement. In software engineering, agentic coding assistants (ACAs) are rapidly becoming embedded in everyday development workflows. Since software engineers (SEs) create systems deployed across diverse and high-stakes real-world contexts, these assistants must function not merely as autonomous task performers but as Tools for Thought that actively support human reasoning and sensemaking. We conducted a formative study examining software engineers' cognitive engagement and sensemaking processes when working with an ACA. Our findings reveal that cognitive engagement consistently declines as tasks progress, and that current ACA designs provide limited affordances for reflection, verification, and meaning-making. Based on these findings, we identify concrete design opportunities leveraging richer interaction modalities and cognitive-forcing mechanisms to sustain engagement and promote deeper thinking in AI-assisted programming.
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, published and presented in CHI 2026 Workshop on Tools for Thought

AI.title_translation: “我不会读完所有这些”: 理解软件工程师对代理编码助手的认知参与水平
AI.tldr: 研究发现软件工程师在使用代理编码助手时，认知参与度会随着任务进展而下降，现有设计对反思、验证和意义构建支持有限，需要改进交互模式和认知强制机制来提升深度思考。
AI.motivation: 过度依赖AI系统可能损害用户批判性思维并导致自满，代理编码助手（ACAs）作为新兴的代理AI系统，正迅速融入软件工程工作流。由于软件工程师创建的系统部署在高风险环境中，ACAs应作为支持人类推理和意义构建的“思维工具”。因此，有必要理解软件工程师在使用ACAs时的认知参与度。
AI.method: 进行了一项形成性研究，考察了软件工程师在使用代理编码助手（ACA）时的认知参与和意义构建过程。
AI.result: 研究发现，随着任务的进展，认知参与度持续下降；当前ACA设计对反思、验证和意义构建提供的支持有限。
AI.conclusion: 基于研究发现，论文提出了具体的改进设计机会，可以通过利用更丰富的交互模式和认知强制机制来维持参与度并促进AI辅助编程中的深度思考。
AI.translation:
“我不会读完所有这些”: 理解软件工程师对代理编码助手的认知参与水平

过度依赖人工智能系统会损害用户的批判性思维并助长自满，而代理人工智能系统（以最少的人类参与运行）的出现加剧了这种风险。在软件工程领域，代理编码助手（ACAs）正迅速融入日常开发工作流程。由于软件工程师（SEs）创建的系统部署在多样化且高风险的现实环境中，这些助手不仅必须作为自主任务执行者发挥作用，更应作为“思维工具”积极支持人类推理和意义构建。我们进行了一项形成性研究，考察了软件工程师在使用ACA时，其认知参与和意义构建过程。我们的研究结果表明，随着任务的进展，认知参与度持续下降，并且当前的ACA设计在反思、验证和意义构建方面提供的支持有限。基于这些发现，我们识别出具体的改进设计机会，可以利用更丰富的交互模式和认知强制机制来维持参与度，并促进AI辅助编程中的深度思考。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了软件工程师在使用代理编码助手（ACAs）时的认知参与度。研究发现，随着任务的进展，工程师的认知参与度会下降，且现有ACA设计在支持反思、验证和意义构建方面存在不足。作者基于此提出了通过改进交互模式和认知强制机制来提升AI辅助编程中深度思考的设计机会。
AI.keywords: 代理编码助手, 认知参与, 软件工程师, 人工智能辅助编程, 批判性思维
AI.comments: 这篇论文强调了在AI辅助编程中，不仅仅要关注效率，更要关注如何维持并提升软件工程师的认知参与度和批判性思维。其创新之处在于指出了代理编码助手作为“思维工具”而非单纯任务执行者的重要性，并提出了具体的改进方向，对未来人机交互设计有重要指导意义。

title: AvatarForcing: One-Step Streaming Talking Avatars via Local-Future Sliding-Window Denoising
summary: Real-time talking avatar generation requires low latency and minute-level temporal stability. Autoregressive (AR) forcing enables streaming inference but suffers from exposure bias, which causes errors to accumulate and become irreversible over long rollouts. In contrast, full-sequence diffusion transformers mitigate drift but remain computationally prohibitive for real-time long-form synthesis. We present AvatarForcing, a one-step streaming diffusion framework that denoises a fixed local-future window with heterogeneous noise levels and emits one clean block per step under constant per-step cost. To stabilize unbounded streams, the method introduces dual-anchor temporal forcing: a style anchor that re-indexes RoPE to maintain a fixed relative position with respect to the active window and applies anchor-audio zero-padding, and a temporal anchor that reuses recently emitted clean blocks to ensure smooth transitions. Real-time one-step inference is enabled by two-stage streaming distillation with offline ODE backfill and distribution matching. Experiments on standard benchmarks and a new 400-video long-form benchmark show strong visual quality and lip synchronization at 34 ms/frame using a 1.3B-parameter student model for realtime streaming. Our page is available at: https://cuiliyuan121.github.io/AvatarForcing/

AI.title_translation: AvatarForcing：通过局部未来滑动窗口去噪实现一步流式传输会说话的头像
AI.tldr: AvatarForcing是一个一步流式扩散框架，通过局部未来滑动窗口去噪和双锚点时间强制，实现实时、高质量的会说话头像生成，解决了现有方法的延迟和稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 实时会说话的头像生成需要低延迟和分钟级的时序稳定性。自回归（AR）强制推理会因曝光偏差导致错误累积，而全序列扩散Transformer计算成本高昂，不适合实时长篇合成。
AI.method: AvatarForcing是一个一步流式扩散框架，通过具有异构噪声水平的固定局部未来窗口进行去噪，并每步输出一个干净块，保持恒定的每步成本。它引入了双锚点时间强制：一个样式锚点通过重新索引RoPE和应用锚点音频零填充来维持相对于活动窗口的固定相对位置；一个时间锚点通过重用最近发出的干净块来确保平滑过渡。通过离线ODE回填和分布匹配的两阶段流式蒸馏实现实时一步推理。
AI.result: 在标准基准和新的400视频长篇基准测试中，AvatarForcing展示了强大的视觉质量和唇部同步，使用1.3B参数的学生模型可实现34毫秒/帧的实时流式传输。
AI.conclusion: AvatarForcing通过一步流式扩散框架和创新的双锚点时间强制，成功实现了实时、高质量的会说话头像生成，解决了现有方法的延迟和稳定性问题。
AI.translation: 实时会说话的头像生成需要低延迟和分钟级的时序稳定性。自回归（AR）强制推理支持流式推理，但会受到曝光偏差的影响，导致错误在长时间运行中累积且不可逆。相比之下，全序列扩散Transformer虽然能减轻漂移，但对于实时长篇合成而言，计算成本仍然过高。我们提出了AvatarForcing，一个一步流式扩散框架，它通过异构噪声水平去噪一个固定的局部未来窗口，并以恒定的每步成本每步发射一个干净块。为了稳定无界流，该方法引入了双锚点时间强制：一个样式锚点重新索引RoPE以保持相对于活动窗口的固定相对位置并应用锚点音频零填充，一个时间锚点重用最近发出的干净块以确保平滑过渡。通过离线ODE回填和分布匹配的两阶段流式蒸馏实现实时一步推理。在标准基准和新的400视频长篇基准测试上的实验表明，使用1.3B参数的学生模型可实现强大的视觉质量和唇部同步，实时流式传输速度为34毫秒/帧。我们的页面可在以下网址获取：https://cuiliyuan121.github.io/AvatarForcing/
AI.summary: AvatarForcing提出了一种一步流式扩散框架，旨在实现实时、高质量的会说话头像生成，以解决现有自回归模型中的曝光偏差和全序列扩散模型计算成本过高的问题。该方法通过在固定的局部未来窗口内进行去噪，并引入双锚点时间强制（包括样式锚点和时间锚点）来确保长时序稳定性。结合两阶段流式蒸馏技术，AvatarForcing实现了卓越的视觉质量和唇部同步，在实时流式传输中达到34毫秒/帧的速度。
AI.keywords: 会说话的头像, 流式扩散, 实时生成, 局部未来去噪, 双锚点时间强制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的AvatarForcing框架，通过一步流式扩散和独特的双锚点时间强制机制，有效解决了实时会说话头像生成中的核心挑战——延迟和长期稳定性问题。其创新点在于结合了局部未来去噪、样式和时间锚点以及两阶段蒸馏，实现了高效率和高质量的平衡。在实时性能和视觉效果上取得了显著进步，对于虚拟形象和元宇宙应用具有重要意义。

title: Predicting power grid frequency dynamics with invertible Koopman-based architectures
summary: The system frequency is a critical measure of power system stability and understanding, and modeling it are key to ensure reliable power system operations. Koopman-based autoencoders are effective at approximating complex nonlinear data patterns, with potential applications in the frequency dynamics of power systems. However, their non-invertibility can result in a distorted latent representation, leading to significant prediction errors. Invertible neural networks (INNs) in combination with the Koopman operator framework provide a promising approach to address these limitations. In this study, we analyze different INN architectures and train them on simulation datasets. We further apply extensions to the networks to address inherent limitations of INNs and evaluate their impact. We find that coupling-layer INNs achieve the best performance when used in isolation. In addition, we demonstrate that hybrid approaches can improve the performance when combined with suitable INNs, while reducing the generalization capabilities in combination with disadvantageous architectures. Overall, our results provide a clearer overview of how architectural choices influence INN performance, offering guidance for selecting and designing INNs for modeling power system frequency dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 电网频率动态预测：基于可逆Koopman的架构
AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用可逆神经网络（INNs）结合Koopman算子框架来预测电网频率动态，发现耦合层INNs表现最佳，并提供了INNs架构选择的指导。
AI.motivation: 电网系统频率是衡量稳定性的关键指标，对其进行理解和建模对于确保可靠的电力系统运行至关重要。Koopman自编码器在近似复杂非线性数据模式方面有效，但在电力系统频率动态中应用时，其不可逆性会导致潜在表示失真和显著预测误差。
AI.method: 本研究分析了不同的可逆神经网络（INN）架构，并在仿真数据集上对其进行训练。进一步对网络应用扩展以解决INNs的固有局限性，并评估其影响。
AI.result: 耦合层INNs在单独使用时表现最佳。混合方法在与合适的INNs结合时可以提高性能，但在与不利架构结合时会降低泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果清晰地概述了架构选择如何影响INN性能，为建模电力系统频率动态时选择和设计INNs提供了指导。
AI.translation: 系统频率是电力系统稳定性的关键衡量指标，对其进行理解和建模是确保电力系统可靠运行的关键。基于Koopman的自编码器在近似复杂非线性数据模式方面是有效的，在电力系统频率动态中具有潜在应用。然而，它们的不可逆性可能导致潜在表示失真，从而导致显著的预测误差。可逆神经网络（INNs）与Koopman算子框架相结合提供了一种有前景的方法来解决这些局限性。在本研究中，我们分析了不同的INN架构，并在仿真数据集上对其进行训练。我们进一步对网络应用扩展以解决INNs的固有局限性并评估其影响。我们发现，耦合层INN在单独使用时能达到最佳性能。此外，我们证明混合方法在与合适的INN结合时可以提高性能，而在与不利架构结合时会降低泛化能力。总的来说，我们的结果更清晰地概述了架构选择如何影响INN性能，为建模电力系统频率动态时选择和设计INN提供了指导。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了使用可逆神经网络（INNs）结合Koopman算子框架来预测电网频率动态，以克服传统Koopman自编码器不可逆性导致的预测误差。研究分析了不同的INN架构及其扩展，发现耦合层INNs在单独使用时性能最佳。同时，混合方法在与合适INNs结合时能提升性能，但与不利架构结合时会损害泛化能力。研究结果为选择和设计用于电力系统频率动态建模的INNs提供了指导。
AI.keywords: 电网频率动态, 可逆神经网络, Koopman算子, 预测, 耦合层INNs
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地将可逆神经网络引入到Koopman算子框架中，解决了传统Koopman自编码器在电力系统频率动态建模中存在的不可逆性问题，提高了预测准确性。其通过实验比较不同INN架构并提出混合方法，为该领域的模型选择和设计提供了宝贵的实践指导。

title: ASAP: Attention-Shift-Aware Pruning for Efficient LVLM Inference
comments: Update in V2: Added citations, refrences, and other minor rewrites
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate exceptional multi-modal capabilities, the quadratic computational cost of processing high-resolution visual tokens remains a critical bottleneck. Though recent token reduction strategies attempt to accelerate inference, such methods inadequately exploit attention values and fail to address token redundancy. More critically, they overlook the ``attention shift'' phenomenon inherent in LVLMs, which skews token attention scores. In this work, we propose ASAP, a novel training-free, KV-Cache-compatible pruning recipe that comprehensively addresses these limitations. First, we mitigate the attention shift by utilizing a dynamic bidirectional soft attention mask, ensuring the selection of genuinely informative tokens rather than naive attention-based selection. Second, we posit that high semantic redundancy within the token set degrades performance. We therefore introduce a weighted soft merging component that merges semantically similar tokens, preserving only the most feature-dense visual patches for subsequent layers. ASAP achieves virtually lossless compression of visual context, retaining 99.02% of the original LLaVA-NeXT-7B performance while aggressively slashing computational FLOPs by ~80%.

AI.title_translation: ASAP: 注意力偏移感知剪枝，实现高效LVLM推理
AI.tldr: ASAP提出了一种无需训练、兼容KV缓存的剪枝方法，通过动态双向软注意力掩码解决注意力偏移，并引入加权软合并组件处理语义冗余，从而在大幅降低LVLM计算成本（FLOPs减少约80%）的同时，几乎无损地保持性能。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）处理高分辨率视觉tokens的二次计算成本是一个关键瓶颈。现有token削减策略未能充分利用注意力值、解决token冗余，并忽视了LVLM中固有的“注意力偏移”现象，该现象会扭曲token的注意力分数。
AI.method: 本文提出了ASAP，一种新颖的、无需训练、兼容KV缓存的剪枝方法，以解决现有方法的局限性。首先，ASAP通过使用动态双向软注意力掩码来缓解注意力偏移，确保选择真正信息丰富的tokens而非简单的基于注意力的选择。其次，针对token集合中高语义冗余会降低性能的问题，ASAP引入了一个加权软合并组件，用于合并语义相似的tokens，仅保留特征最密集的视觉补丁用于后续层。
AI.result: ASAP实现了视觉上下文的几乎无损压缩，在大幅削减约80%计算FLOPs的同时，保留了99.02%的原始LLaVA-NeXT-7B性能。
AI.conclusion: ASAP通过解决注意力偏移和token冗余，显著提高了LVLM推理效率，同时保持了近乎原始的性能，为高效LVLM部署提供了有效方案。
AI.translation: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）展现出卓越的多模态能力，但处理高分辨率视觉tokens的二次计算成本仍然是一个关键瓶颈。尽管最近的token削减策略试图加速推理，但这些方法未能充分利用注意力值，也未能解决token冗余。更关键的是，它们忽视了LVLMs中固有的“注意力偏移”现象，该现象会扭曲token的注意力分数。在这项工作中，我们提出了ASAP，一种新颖的、无需训练、兼容KV缓存的剪枝方案，全面解决了这些局限性。首先，我们通过利用动态双向软注意力掩码来缓解注意力偏移，确保选择真正信息丰富的tokens，而不是简单的基于注意力的选择。其次，我们认为token集合内的高度语义冗余会降低性能。因此，我们引入了一个加权软合并组件，用于合并语义相似的tokens，仅保留特征最密集的视觉补丁用于后续层。ASAP实现了视觉上下文的几乎无损压缩，在大幅削减约80%计算FLOPs的同时，保留了99.02%的原始LLaVA-NeXT-7B性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出ASAP，一种针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的高效剪枝方法，旨在解决高分辨率视觉token处理中的计算瓶颈。ASAP通过动态双向软注意力掩码校正注意力偏移，并利用加权软合并组件消除语义冗余，从而在无需训练、兼容KV缓存的情况下，实现了视觉上下文的几乎无损压缩。实验结果表明，ASAP在保留99.02%原始性能的同时，将计算FLOPs降低了约80%。
AI.keywords: LVLM, 注意力偏移, token剪枝, 计算效率, 模型压缩
AI.comments: ASAP的创新之处在于它同时解决了LVLM推理中的两个关键问题：注意力偏移和token语义冗余。其无需训练且兼容KV缓存的特性使其具有很高的实用价值和部署潜力。通过动态注意力掩码和加权软合并，ASAP提供了一种有效且高效的视觉token剪枝方案，对未来LVLM的轻量化部署具有重要意义。

title: JobMatchAI An Intelligent Job Matching Platform Using Knowledge Graphs, Semantic Search and Explainable AI
summary: Recruiters and job seekers rely on search systems to navigate labor markets, making candidate matching engines critical for hiring outcomes. Most systems act as keyword filters, failing to handle skill synonyms and nonlinear careers, resulting in missed candidates and opaque match scores. We introduce JobMatchAI, a production-ready system integrating Transformer embeddings, skill knowledge graphs, and interpretable reranking. Our system optimizes utility across skill fit, experience, location, salary, and company preferences, providing factor-wise explanations through resume-driven search workflows. We release JobSearch-XS benchmark and a hybrid retrieval stack combining BM25, knowledge graph and semantic components to evaluate skill generalization. We assess system performance on JobSearch-XS across retrieval tasks, provide a demo video, a hosted website and installable package.

AI.title_translation: JobMatchAI：一个使用知识图谱、语义搜索和可解释AI的智能职位匹配平台
AI.tldr: JobMatchAI是一个生产就绪的智能职位匹配平台，它利用Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排序来解决传统招聘系统无法处理技能同义词和非线性职业的问题，并提供基于因素的解释。
AI.motivation: 现有的招聘系统主要作为关键词过滤器，无法有效处理技能同义词和非线性职业路径，导致错过合格候选人且匹配分数不透明。
AI.method: JobMatchAI集成了Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排序技术。它通过简历驱动的搜索工作流，优化技能匹配度、经验、地点、薪资和公司偏好等因素，并提供基于因素的解释。系统还发布了JobSearch-XS基准和结合BM25、知识图谱及语义组件的混合检索栈来评估技能泛化能力。
AI.result: JobMatchAI是一个生产就绪的系统，能够优化多维度匹配并提供解释。作者发布了JobSearch-XS基准、混合检索栈、演示视频、托管网站和可安装包。系统在JobSearch-XS的检索任务上进行了性能评估。
AI.conclusion: JobMatchAI提供了一个更智能、更透明的职位匹配解决方案，通过整合先进的AI技术，解决了传统招聘系统的局限性，并为行业提供了评估工具和资源。
AI.translation: 招聘人员和求职者依赖搜索系统来浏览劳动力市场，这使得候选人匹配引擎对招聘结果至关重要。大多数系统充当关键词过滤器，无法处理技能同义词和非线性职业，导致错过候选人并产生不透明的匹配分数。我们引入了JobMatchAI，一个集成了Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排序的生产就绪系统。我们的系统优化了技能匹配、经验、地点、薪资和公司偏好等方面的效用，通过简历驱动的搜索工作流提供基于因素的解释。我们发布了JobSearch-XS基准测试和结合了BM25、知识图谱和语义组件的混合检索栈，以评估技能泛化能力。我们评估了系统在JobSearch-XS上跨检索任务的性能，并提供了演示视频、托管网站和可安装包。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了JobMatchAI，一个智能职位匹配平台，旨在解决传统招聘系统在处理技能同义词和非线性职业方面的局限性。JobMatchAI结合了Transformer嵌入、技能知识图谱和可解释重排序技术，能优化多维度匹配并为匹配结果提供详细解释。为评估系统性能，作者发布了JobSearch-XS基准测试和混合检索栈，并提供了演示资源。
AI.keywords: 职位匹配, 知识图谱, 语义搜索, 可解释AI, Transformer嵌入
AI.comments: JobMatchAI的创新之处在于其结合了知识图谱、语义搜索和可解释AI，解决了传统招聘系统效率低下和结果不透明的问题。它不仅提高了匹配的准确性和全面性，还通过提供解释增加了系统的可信度和用户满意度。发布基准测试和混合检索栈对推动该领域的研究和应用具有重要意义。

title: Forecast-Aware Cooperative Planning on Temporal Graphs under Stochastic Adversarial Risk
summary: Cooperative multi-robot missions often require teams of robots to traverse environments where traversal risk evolves due to adversary patrols or shifting hazards with stochastic dynamics. While support coordination--where robots assist teammates in traversing risky regions--can significantly reduce mission costs, its effectiveness depends on the team's ability to anticipate future risk. Existing support-based frameworks assume static risk landscapes and therefore fail to account for predictable temporal trends in risk evolution. We propose a forecast-aware cooperative planning framework that integrates stochastic risk forecasting with anticipatory support allocation on temporal graphs. By modeling adversary dynamics as a first-order Markov stay-move process over graph edges, we propagate the resulting edge-occupancy probabilities forward in time to generate time-indexed edge-risk forecasts. These forecasts guide the proactive allocation of support positions to forecasted risky edges for effective support coordination, while also informing joint robot path planning. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces total expected team cost compared to non-anticipatory baselines, approaching the performance of an oracle planner.

AI.title_translation: 随机对抗风险下时间图上的预测感知协同规划
AI.tldr: 提出一种预测感知的多机器人协同规划框架，通过预测未来风险并提前分配支援，显著降低了随机动态风险环境下的任务成本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于支援的框架假设风险环境是静态的，未能考虑风险演变中可预测的时间趋势，因此无法有效应对因对抗巡逻或动态危险导致的随机动态风险。
AI.method: 提出一个预测感知协同规划框架，该框架将随机风险预测与时间图上的预期支援分配相结合。通过将对抗动态建模为图边缘上的一阶马尔可夫停留-移动过程，向前传播边缘占用概率以生成时间索引的边缘风险预测。这些预测指导支援位置的主动分配到预测的危险边缘，以实现有效的支援协调，并同时指导联合机器人路径规划。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与非预期基线相比，该方法持续降低了团队的总预期成本，并接近于预言者规划器的性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的预测感知协同规划框架能够有效整合随机风险预测与预期支援分配，在随机对抗风险环境中显著降低多机器人任务成本。
AI.translation:
标题: 随机对抗风险下时间图上的预测感知协同规划
摘要: 协同多机器人任务通常要求机器人团队穿越风险因对抗巡逻或具有随机动态的移动危险而演变的环境。虽然支援协调——即机器人协助队友穿越危险区域——可以显著降低任务成本，但其有效性取决于团队预测未来风险的能力。现有的基于支援的框架假设风险环境是静态的，因此未能考虑风险演变中可预测的时间趋势。我们提出了一种预测感知协同规划框架，该框架将随机风险预测与时间图上的预期支援分配相结合。通过将对抗动态建模为图边缘上的一阶马尔可夫停留-移动过程，我们向前传播由此产生的边缘占用概率，以生成时间索引的边缘风险预测。这些预测指导支援位置的主动分配到预测的危险边缘，以实现有效的支援协调，同时还指导联合机器人路径规划。实验结果表明，与非预期基线相比，我们的方法持续降低了团队的总预期成本，并接近于预言者规划器的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出一种预测感知的多机器人协同规划框架，旨在解决现有方法在随机动态风险环境中无法有效应对的问题。该框架通过将对抗动态建模为马尔可夫过程，生成时间索引的边缘风险预测，并利用这些预测指导支援位置的分配和机器人路径规划。实验证明，该方法能显著降低任务成本，优于非预期基线，并接近最优性能。
AI.keywords: 多机器人协同规划, 随机风险预测, 时间图, 支援协调, 马尔可夫过程
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入时间图和随机风险预测，解决了多机器人协同任务中风险动态演变的关键挑战。其创新点在于将马尔可夫过程应用于风险预测，并将其与主动支援分配相结合，这对于在不确定环境中执行任务的机器人系统具有重要意义。该方法有望提高多机器人系统的鲁棒性和效率。

title: Dual Quaternion Based Contact Modeling for Fast and Smooth Collision Recovery of Quadrotors
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in cluttered environments require accurate impact modeling to maintain stability post collisions. However, conventional contact models decouple linear and angular impulses, risking manifold inconsistency during rapid state transitions. This letter presents a dual quaternion reset map that resolves rigid-body impacts directly on the SE(3) manifold. By operating on the unified spatial twist (linear and angular velocities as a single dual entity), the proposed formulation is shown to be algebraically equivalent to the classical Newton impulse model while preserving manifold consistency during discrete state jumps. Building on this framework, a hybrid recovery controller is designed that couples linear and angular momentum to ensure strict energy dissipation across impacts. Hardware-in-the-loop benchmarks demonstrate a 24% reduction in execution latency compared to an optimized matrix-based implementation. High-fidelity MuJoCo simulations validate the controller's response to complex contact dynamics, with Monte Carlo trials showing a 56.3% reduction in post-impact root-mean-square error (RMSE) and a 61.1% decrease in peak kinetic energy compared to decoupled baseline controllers.

AI.title_translation: 基于对偶四元数的四旋翼飞行器快速平稳碰撞恢复接触建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对偶四元数的重置映射，用于解决四旋翼飞行器碰撞后的恢复问题，相比传统方法，它能实现更快的执行速度和更好的碰撞后稳定性。
AI.motivation: 无人机在杂乱环境中运行时，需要精确的冲击建模以在碰撞后保持稳定性。然而，传统的接触模型将线性和角冲量解耦，在快速状态转换期间存在流形不一致的风险。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种对偶四元数重置映射，可以直接在SE(3)流形上解决刚体冲击问题。该方法在统一的空间扭量（将线性和角速度作为单一对偶实体）上操作，并设计了一个混合恢复控制器，该控制器耦合线性和角动量以确保严格的能量耗散。
AI.result: 所提出的公式在代数上等效于经典的牛顿冲量模型，同时在离散状态跳跃期间保持流形一致性。硬件在环基准测试显示，执行延迟降低了24%。高保真MuJoCo模拟显示，与解耦基线控制器相比，碰撞后均方根误差（RMSE）降低了56.3%，峰值动能降低了61.1%。
AI.conclusion: 基于对偶四元数的冲击建模方法为四旋翼飞行器的碰撞恢复提供了一种更一致、更快、更稳定的解决方案。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）在杂乱环境中操作时，需要准确的冲击建模以在碰撞后保持稳定性。然而，传统的接触模型将线性和角冲量解耦，在快速状态转换期间存在流形不一致的风险。本文提出了一种对偶四元数重置映射，可以直接在SE(3)流形上解决刚体冲击问题。通过在统一的空间扭量（将线性和角速度作为单一对偶实体）上操作，所提出的公式被证明在代数上等效于经典的牛顿冲量模型，同时在离散状态跳跃期间保持流形一致性。在此框架的基础上，设计了一种混合恢复控制器，该控制器耦合线性和角动量，以确保在冲击过程中严格的能量耗散。硬件在环基准测试表明，与优化的基于矩阵的实现相比，执行延迟降低了24%。高保真MuJoCo模拟验证了控制器对复杂接触动力学的响应，蒙特卡洛试验显示，与解耦基线控制器相比，碰撞后均方根误差（RMSE）降低了56.3%，峰值动能降低了61.1%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种基于对偶四元数的四旋翼飞行器碰撞恢复方法，解决了传统接触模型在快速状态转换中流形不一致的问题。通过将线性和角速度作为统一的空间扭量在SE(3)流形上处理，该方法在代数上等效于牛顿冲量模型并保持流形一致性。研究还设计了一个用于能量耗散的混合控制器。实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，该方法显著降低了执行延迟、碰撞后均方根误差和峰值动能，从而实现了更快、更平稳的碰撞恢复。
AI.keywords: 对偶四元数, 碰撞恢复, 四旋翼飞行器, SE(3)流形, 冲击建模
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用对偶四元数直接在SE(3)流形上解决冲击问题，统一了线性和角动力学以保持一致性。这种方法显著改善了四旋翼飞行器的碰撞恢复性能，这对于在复杂环境中自主导航至关重要。

title: SemanticFace: Semantic Facial Action Estimation via Semantic Distillation in Interpretable Space
summary: Facial action estimation from a single image is often formulated as predicting or fitting parameters in compact expression spaces, which lack explicit semantic interpretability. However, many practical applications, such as avatar control and human-computer interaction, require interpretable facial actions that correspond to meaningful muscle movements. In this work, we propose SemanticFace, a framework for facial action estimation in the interpretable ARKit blendshape space that reformulates coefficient prediction as structured semantic reasoning. SemanticFace adopts a two-stage semantic distillation paradigm: it first derives structured semantic supervision from ground-truth ARKit coefficients and then distills this knowledge into a multimodal large language model to predict interpretable facial action coefficients from images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that language-aligned semantic supervision improves both coefficient accuracy and perceptual consistency, while enabling strong cross-identity generalization and robustness to large domain shifts, including cartoon faces.

AI.title_translation: SemanticFace：通过可解释空间中的语义蒸馏进行语义面部动作估计
AI.tldr: SemanticFace提出了一种通过语义蒸馏将面部动作估计到可解释的ARKit混合形状空间的方法，提高了准确性、感知一致性、泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的面部动作估计方法通常将参数拟合到紧凑的表情空间，但缺乏明确的语义可解释性，而许多实际应用需要与有意义的肌肉运动相对应的可解释面部动作。
AI.method: SemanticFace框架将系数预测重新定义为结构化语义推理，用于在可解释的ARKit混合形状空间中进行面部动作估计。它采用两阶段语义蒸馏范式：首先从真实ARKit系数中导出结构化语义监督，然后将此知识蒸馏到一个多模态大型语言模型中，以从图像中预测可解释的面部动作系数。
AI.result: 语言对齐的语义监督提高了系数准确性和感知一致性，同时实现了强大的跨身份泛化能力，并对包括卡通脸在内的大域偏移具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SemanticFace通过语义蒸馏范式，成功地将面部动作估计引入可解释的ARKit混合形状空间，显著提升了估计的准确性、可解释性、泛化性和鲁棒性，满足了实际应用中对面部动作语义理解的需求。
AI.translation: 从单张图像估计面部动作通常被表述为在紧凑表情空间中预测或拟合参数，这些空间缺乏明确的语义可解释性。然而，许多实际应用，如虚拟形象控制和人机交互，需要与有意义的肌肉运动相对应的可解释面部动作。在这项工作中，我们提出了SemanticFace，一个用于在可解释的ARKit混合形状空间中进行面部动作估计的框架，它将系数预测重新定义为结构化语义推理。SemanticFace采用两阶段语义蒸馏范式：它首先从真实ARKit系数中导出结构化语义监督，然后将此知识蒸馏到一个多模态大型语言模型中，以从图像中预测可解释的面部动作系数。广泛的实验表明，语言对齐的语义监督提高了系数准确性和感知一致性，同时实现了强大的跨身份泛化能力，并对包括卡通脸在内的大域偏移具有鲁棒性。
AI.summary: SemanticFace是一个创新的框架，旨在解决现有面部动作估计方法缺乏语义可解释性的问题。它通过两阶段语义蒸馏范式，将图像中的面部动作系数预测到可解释的ARKit混合形状空间，并利用多模态大型语言模型进行结构化语义推理。实验证明，该方法显著提高了估计的准确性、感知一致性、跨身份泛化能力以及对大域偏移的鲁棒性，特别是在需要语义理解的应用中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 面部动作估计, 语义蒸馏, ARKit混合形状, 可解释性, 多模态大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入语义蒸馏和利用多模态大型语言模型，将面部动作估计提升到语义可解释的ARKit混合形状空间，解决了传统方法可解释性差的痛点。其创新性在于将面部动作理解与语言语义对齐，显著增强了模型的泛化性和鲁棒性，对虚拟形象、人机交互等领域具有重要意义。

title: AutoMoT: A Unified Vision-Language-Action Model with Asynchronous Mixture-of-Transformers for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Integrating vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving (AD) systems has shown promise in improving scene understanding. However, existing integration strategies suffer from several limitations: they either struggle to resolve distribution misalignment between reasoning and action spaces, underexploit the general reasoning capabilities of pretrained VLMs, or incur substantial inference latency during action policy generation, which degrades driving performance. To address these challenges, we propose \OURS in this work, an end-to-end AD framework that unifies reasoning and action generation within a single vision-language-action (VLA) model. Our approach leverages a mixture-of-transformer (MoT) architecture with joint attention sharing, which preserves the general reasoning capabilities of pre-trained VLMs while enabling efficient fast-slow inference through asynchronous execution at different task frequencies. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks, under both open- and closed-loop settings, demonstrate that \OURS achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. We further investigate the functional boundary of pre-trained VLMs in AD, examining when AD-tailored fine-tuning is necessary. Our results show that pre-trained VLMs can achieve competitive multi-task scene understanding performance through semantic prompting alone, while fine-tuning remains essential for action-level tasks such as decision-making and trajectory planning. We refer to \href{https://automot-website.github.io/}{Project Page} for the demonstration videos and qualitative results.

AI.title_translation: AutoMoT：一种基于异步Transformer混合的统一视觉-语言-动作模型，用于端到端自动驾驶
AI.tldr: AutoMoT是一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型，利用异步Transformer混合架构，解决了现有VLM在端到端自动驾驶中面临的分布失调、推理能力未充分利用和推理延迟等问题，实现了高效的推理和竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有将视觉-语言模型（VLM）整合到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶（AD）系统中的策略存在局限性：它们难以解决推理和动作空间之间的分布失调，未能充分利用预训练VLM的通用推理能力，或者在动作策略生成过程中产生显著的推理延迟，从而降低了驾驶性能。
AI.method: 本文提出了AutoMoT，一个端到端AD框架，它在一个单一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中统一了推理和动作生成。该方法利用了具有联合注意力共享的Transformer混合（MoT）架构，既保留了预训练VLM的通用推理能力，又通过在不同任务频率下异步执行实现了高效的快慢推理。
AI.result: 在开放和闭环设置下的多个基准测试中，AutoMoT取得了与最先进方法相当的性能。研究还表明，预训练VLM仅通过语义提示即可实现具有竞争力的多任务场景理解性能，而对于决策和轨迹规划等动作级任务，微调仍然至关重要。
AI.conclusion: AutoMoT成功地将推理和动作生成统一在一个VLA模型中，解决了现有VLM在端到端自动驾驶中的局限性。通过异步Transformer混合架构，它在保持预训练VLM推理能力的同时实现了高效推理，并在多个基准测试中展现了竞争力。研究还明确了预训练VLM在场景理解和动作级任务中的不同适用性，强调了微调的重要性。
AI.translation: 将视觉-语言模型（VLM）集成到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶（AD）系统中已显示出改善场景理解的潜力。然而，现有的集成策略存在几个局限性：它们要么难以解决推理和动作空间之间的分布失调，要么未能充分利用预训练VLM的通用推理能力，要么在动作策略生成过程中产生显著的推理延迟，从而降低了驾驶性能。为了应对这些挑战，我们在这项工作中提出了\OURS，一个端到端AD框架，它在一个单一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中统一了推理和动作生成。我们的方法利用了具有联合注意力共享的Transformer混合（MoT）架构，既保留了预训练VLM的通用推理能力，又通过在不同任务频率下异步执行实现了高效的快慢推理。在开放和闭环设置下的多个基准测试中，广泛的实验表明\OURS与最先进的方法相比取得了具有竞争力的性能。我们进一步研究了预训练VLM在AD中的功能边界，探讨了何时需要针对AD的微调。我们的结果表明，预训练VLM仅通过语义提示即可实现具有竞争力的多任务场景理解性能，而对于决策和轨迹规划等动作级任务，微调仍然至关重要。有关演示视频和定性结果，请访问项目页面。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AutoMoT，一个用于端到端自动驾驶的统一视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。该模型旨在解决现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）在集成到自动驾驶系统时面临的分布失调、通用推理能力未充分利用和推理延迟等问题。AutoMoT采用异步Transformer混合（MoT）架构，通过联合注意力共享，在保留预训练VLM通用推理能力的同时，实现了高效的快慢推理。实验证明，AutoMoT在多项基准测试中表现出与现有SOTA方法相当的性能。研究还指出，预训练VLM仅通过语义提示即可实现场景理解，但对于决策和轨迹规划等动作级任务，微调仍是必要的。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 视觉-语言-动作模型, Transformer混合, 异步推理, 端到端
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个统一的视觉-语言-动作模型AutoMoT，通过异步Transformer混合架构有效解决了VLM在端到端自动驾驶中的核心挑战，如推理与动作空间失调和推理延迟。其对预训练VLM功能边界的探讨也具有重要意义，明确了微调在不同任务层面的必要性，为未来VLM在自动驾驶领域的应用提供了指导。

title: ViSA: Visited-State Augmentation for Generalized Goal-Space Contrastive Reinforcement Learning
summary: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (GCRL) is a framework for learning a policy that can reach arbitrarily given goals. In particular, Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) provides a framework for policy updates using an approximation of the value function estimated via contrastive learning, achieving higher sample efficiency compared to conventional methods. However, since CRL treats the visited state as a pseudo-goal during learning, it can accurately estimate the value function only for limited goals. To address this issue, we propose a novel data augmentation approach for CRL called ViSA (Visited-State Augmentation). ViSA consists of two components: 1) generating augmented state samples, with the aim of augmenting hard-to-visit state samples during on-policy exploration, and 2) learning consistent embedding space, which uses an augmented state as auxiliary information to regularize the embedding space by reformulating the objective function of the embedding space based on mutual information. We evaluate ViSA in simulation and real-world robotic tasks and show improved goal-space generalization, which permits accurate value estimation for hard-to-visit goals. Further details can be found on the project page: https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage_ViSA/

AI.title_translation: ViSA：广义目标空间对比强化学习的访问状态增强
AI.tldr: ViSA通过增强难以访问的状态样本并规范嵌入空间，提高了对比强化学习在目标空间泛化上的表现，从而能准确估计难以访问目标的价值。
AI.motivation: 现有的对比强化学习（CRL）在学习过程中将访问状态视为伪目标，这导致它只能对有限的目标准确估计价值函数，限制了其泛化能力。
AI.method: 本文提出了ViSA（Visited-State Augmentation）方法，包含两个组件：1) 生成增强状态样本，旨在增强在线策略探索中难以访问的状态样本；2) 学习一致的嵌入空间，利用增强状态作为辅助信息，通过基于互信息重新制定嵌入空间的目标函数来规范嵌入空间。
AI.result: ViSA在模拟和真实世界的机器人任务中展示了改进的目标空间泛化能力，从而可以对难以访问的目标进行准确的价值估计。
AI.conclusion: ViSA通过其访问状态增强机制，成功解决了对比强化学习在价值函数估计上的局限性，提高了对难以访问目标的泛化能力和样本效率。
AI.translation: 目标条件强化学习（GCRL）是一个学习能够达到任意给定目标的策略的框架。特别是，对比强化学习（CRL）提供了一个使用通过对比学习估计的价值函数近似进行策略更新的框架，与传统方法相比，实现了更高的样本效率。然而，由于CRL在学习过程中将访问状态视为伪目标，它只能对有限的目标准确估计价值函数。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的CRL数据增强方法，称为ViSA（访问状态增强）。ViSA由两个组件组成：1）生成增强状态样本，旨在增强在线策略探索中难以访问的状态样本；2）学习一致的嵌入空间，该组件使用增强状态作为辅助信息，通过基于互信息重新制定嵌入空间的目标函数来规范嵌入空间。我们在模拟和真实世界的机器人任务中评估了ViSA，并展示了改进的目标空间泛化能力，这允许对难以访问的目标进行准确的价值估计。更多详情请访问项目页面：https://issa-n.github.io/projectPage_ViSA/
AI.summary: 目标条件强化学习（GCRL）中的对比强化学习（CRL）在价值函数估计上存在局限性，即只能对有限目标准确估计。为解决此问题，本文提出了ViSA（Visited-State Augmentation）方法。ViSA通过生成增强状态样本来处理难以访问的状态，并利用增强状态作为辅助信息，通过基于互信息重构目标函数来学习一致的嵌入空间。实验结果表明，ViSA在模拟和真实机器人任务中均能改进目标空间泛化能力，实现对难以访问目标的准确价值估计。
AI.keywords: 对比强化学习, 目标条件强化学习, 数据增强, 访问状态增强, 目标空间泛化
AI.comments: ViSA的创新点在于其针对CRL中“难以访问状态”的问题，通过数据增强和嵌入空间规范化提供了有效的解决方案。这种方法对于提高强化学习在复杂、稀疏奖励环境中的泛化能力和样本效率具有重要意义，尤其是在机器人等需要处理大量状态空间的实际应用中。其对互信息的使用也体现了对嵌入空间质量的深入思考。

title: F2HDR: Two-Stage HDR Video Reconstruction via Flow Adapter and Physical Motion Modeling
summary: Reconstructing High Dynamic Range (HDR) videos from sequences of alternating-exposure Low Dynamic Range (LDR) frames remains highly challenging, especially under dynamic scenes where cross-exposure inconsistencies and complex motion make inter-frame alignment difficult, leading to ghosting and detail loss. Existing methods often suffer from inaccurate alignment, suboptimal feature aggregation, and degraded reconstruction quality in motion-dominated regions. To address these challenges, we propose F2HDR, a two-stage HDR video reconstruction framework that robustly perceives inter-frame motion and restores fine details in complex dynamic scenarios. The proposed framework integrates a flow adapter that adapts generic optical flow for robust cross-exposure alignment, a physical motion modeling to identify salient motion regions, and a motion-aware refinement network that aggregates complementary information while removing ghosting and noise. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2HDR achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world HDR video benchmarks, producing ghost-free and high-fidelity results under large motion and exposure variations.

AI.title_translation: F2HDR：通过流适配器和物理运动建模的两阶段HDR视频重建
AI.tldr: F2HDR是一个两阶段HDR视频重建框架，通过流适配器和物理运动建模，解决了动态场景下HDR视频重建中的对齐困难、伪影和细节丢失问题，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 从交替曝光的LDR帧序列重建HDR视频极具挑战性，尤其是在动态场景下，跨曝光不一致和复杂运动导致帧间对齐困难，从而产生伪影和细节丢失。现有方法常因对齐不准确、特征聚合不佳以及在运动主导区域重建质量下降而受影响。
AI.method: 提出F2HDR，一个两阶段HDR视频重建框架。它集成了流适配器用于鲁棒的跨曝光对齐，物理运动建模用于识别显著运动区域，以及运动感知细化网络用于聚合互补信息并去除伪影和噪声。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明F2HDR在真实世界HDR视频基准上实现了最先进的性能，在大运动和曝光变化下生成了无伪影和高保真的结果。
AI.conclusion: F2HDR通过其创新的两阶段框架，有效解决了动态场景下HDR视频重建的挑战，实现了卓越的重建质量，并生成了无伪影和高保真的HDR视频。
AI.translation: 从交替曝光的低动态范围（LDR）帧序列重建高动态范围（HDR）视频仍然极具挑战性，尤其是在动态场景下，跨曝光不一致和复杂运动使得帧间对齐变得困难，导致伪影和细节丢失。现有方法通常在运动主导区域遭受不准确的对齐、次优的特征聚合和退化的重建质量。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了F2HDR，一个两阶段的HDR视频重建框架，它能够鲁棒地感知帧间运动并在复杂动态场景中恢复精细细节。所提出的框架集成了流适配器，用于鲁棒的跨曝光对齐；物理运动建模，用于识别显著运动区域；以及运动感知细化网络，用于聚合互补信息同时去除伪影和噪声。广泛的实验表明F2HDR在真实世界HDR视频基准上取得了最先进的性能，在大运动和曝光变化下产生了无伪影和高保真的结果。
AI.summary: F2HDR是一个新颖的两阶段HDR视频重建框架，旨在解决动态场景下LDR帧序列重建HDR视频的挑战。它通过引入流适配器实现鲁棒的跨曝光对齐，利用物理运动建模识别关键运动区域，并通过运动感知细化网络聚合信息并去除伪影。实验证明，F2HDR在真实世界基准上实现了最先进的性能，生成了高质量、无伪影的HDR视频。
AI.keywords: HDR视频重建, 流适配器, 物理运动建模, 动态场景, 伪影去除
AI.comments: 该论文提出F2HDR框架，通过结合流适配器和物理运动建模，创新性地解决了动态场景下HDR视频重建中的对齐和伪影问题。其两阶段设计以及对运动的精细处理是其主要亮点，在复杂动态场景下表现出卓越性能，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Workflow-Aware Structured Layer Decomposition for Illustration Production
summary: Recent generative image editing methods adopt layered representations to mitigate the entangled nature of raster images and improve controllability, typically relying on object-based segmentation. However, such strategies may fail to capture the structural and stylized properties of human-created images, such as anime illustrations. To solve this issue, we propose a workflow-aware structured layer decomposition framework tailored to the illustration production of anime artwork. Inspired by the creation pipeline of anime production, our method decomposes the illustration into semantically meaningful production layers, including line art, flat color, shadow, and highlight. To decouple all these layers, we introduce lightweight layer semantic embeddings to provide specific task guidance for each layer. Furthermore, a set of layer-wise losses is incorporated to supervise the training process of individual layers. To overcome the lack of ground-truth layered data, we construct a high-quality illustration dataset that simulated the standard anime production workflow. Experiments demonstrate that the accurate and visually coherent layer decompositions were achieved by using our method. We believe that the resulting layered representation further enables downstream tasks such as recoloring and embedding texture, supporting content creation, and illustration editing. Code is available at: https://github.com/zty0304/Anime-layer-decomposition

AI.title_translation: 工作流感知结构化分层分解用于插画制作
AI.tldr: 针对动漫插画生产，提出一种工作流感知的结构化分层分解框架，将插画分解为线稿、平涂、阴影和高光等语义层，以提高可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有生成图像编辑方法依赖于基于对象的分割，可能无法捕捉人类创作图像（如动漫插画）的结构和风格属性，导致可控性不足。
AI.method: 提出一个工作流感知的结构化分层分解框架，专为动漫插画生产定制。该方法受动漫生产流程启发，将插画分解为线稿、平涂、阴影和高光等语义层。引入轻量级层语义嵌入为每层提供特定任务指导，并结合层级损失监督训练。为解决缺乏分层数据的问题，构建了一个高质量的模拟标准动漫生产工作流的插画数据集。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法实现了准确且视觉上连贯的层分解。
AI.conclusion: 结果分层表示能够进一步支持下游任务，如重新着色和嵌入纹理，从而支持内容创作和插画编辑。
AI.translation:
**标题：** 工作流感知结构化分层分解用于插画制作
**摘要：** 近期生成图像编辑方法采用分层表示来缓解栅格图像的纠缠性质并提高可控性，通常依赖于基于对象的分割。然而，此类策略可能无法捕捉人类创作图像，如动漫插画的结构和风格属性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出一个工作流感知的结构化分层分解框架，专为动漫艺术作品的插画制作定制。受动漫生产流程的启发，我们的方法将插画分解为语义上有意义的生产层，包括线稿、平涂、阴影和高光。为了解耦所有这些层，我们引入了轻量级层语义嵌入，为每个层提供特定的任务指导。此外，还结合了一组层级损失来监督单个层的训练过程。为了克服缺乏真实分层数据的问题，我们构建了一个模拟标准动漫生产工作流的高质量插画数据集。实验证明，使用我们的方法实现了准确且视觉上连贯的层分解。我们相信，由此产生的分层表示进一步支持下游任务，如重新着色和嵌入纹理，从而支持内容创作和插画编辑。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/zty0304/Anime-layer-decomposition
AI.summary: 本文提出一个名为“工作流感知结构化分层分解”的新框架，旨在解决现有生成图像编辑方法在动漫插画中无法有效捕捉结构和风格属性的问题。该方法模仿动漫制作流程，将插画分解为线稿、平涂、阴影和高光等语义层，并通过引入层语义嵌入和层级损失来指导分解过程。为弥补数据不足，团队构建了一个高质量的模拟动漫生产流程的数据集。实验结果显示，该方法能实现准确且视觉连贯的层分解，为后续的插画编辑和内容创作（如重新着色、纹理嵌入）提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 动漫插画, 分层分解, 工作流感知, 图像编辑, 语义层
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于其“工作流感知”的方法，将动漫制作的实际流程融入到分层分解中，从而更好地捕捉插画的结构和风格特性。通过构建高质量的模拟数据集，有效解决了真实分层数据稀缺的挑战。该方法为动漫插画的精细化编辑提供了新的途径，具有重要的应用潜力。

title: A System-Theoretic Approach to Hawkes Process Identification with Guaranteed Positivity and Stability
summary: The Hawkes process models self-exciting event streams, requiring a strictly non-negative and stable stochastic intensity. Standard identification methods enforce these properties using non-negative causal bases, yielding conservative parameter constraints and severely ill-conditioned least-squares Gram matrices at higher model orders. To overcome this, we introduce a system-theoretic identification framework utilizing the sign-indefinite orthonormal Laguerre basis, which guarantees a well-conditioned asymptotic Gram matrix independent of model order. We formulate a constrained least-squares problem enforcing the necessary and sufficient conditions for positivity and stability. By constructing the empirical Gram matrix via a Lyapunov equation and representing the constraints through a sum-of-squares trace equivalence, the proposed estimator is efficiently computed via semidefinite programming.

AI.title_translation: 霍克斯过程识别的系统理论方法，具有保证的非负性和稳定性
AI.tldr: 针对霍克斯过程识别中传统方法导致参数约束保守和高阶模型病态Gram矩阵的问题，本文提出一种基于系统理论的识别框架，利用符号不定的正交Laguerre基和半定规划，有效保证了非负性和稳定性，并解决了Gram矩阵的病态问题。
AI.motivation: 霍克斯过程模型需要严格非负和稳定的随机强度。标准识别方法使用非负因果基强制这些属性，导致参数约束保守，并且在高模型阶数时产生严重病态的最小二乘Gram矩阵。
AI.method: 引入了一个系统理论识别框架，利用符号不定的正交Laguerre基，该基保证了与模型阶数无关的良好条件渐近Gram矩阵。提出了一个约束最小二乘问题，强制执行非负性和稳定性的必要和充分条件。通过Lyapunov方程构建经验Gram矩阵，并通过平方和迹等价表示约束，通过半定规划高效计算估计器。
AI.result: 保证了良好条件的渐近Gram矩阵，且与模型阶数无关。有效地解决了传统方法中参数约束保守和Gram矩阵病态的问题。估计器可以通过半定规划高效计算。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种系统理论的霍克斯过程识别框架，通过利用符号不定的正交Laguerre基和半定规划，成功地解决了传统方法在保证非负性和稳定性方面的局限性，并提高了计算效率和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 霍克斯过程模型自激事件流，要求严格非负且稳定的随机强度。标准识别方法使用非负因果基来强制这些属性，但会导致保守的参数约束，并在较高模型阶数时产生严重病态的最小二乘Gram矩阵。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了一个系统理论识别框架，利用符号不定的正交Laguerre基，该基保证了与模型阶数无关的良好条件渐近Gram矩阵。我们提出了一个约束最小二乘问题，强制执行非负性和稳定性的必要和充分条件。通过Lyapunov方程构建经验Gram矩阵，并通过平方和迹等价表示约束，所提出的估计器可以通过半定规划高效计算。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的系统理论方法来识别霍克斯过程，以解决传统方法在保证随机强度非负性和稳定性方面的局限性，特别是保守的参数约束和高阶模型中病态的Gram矩阵。该方法利用符号不定的正交Laguerre基，确保了良好条件的Gram矩阵，并通过将非负性和稳定性条件表达为约束最小二乘问题和半定规划，实现了高效且鲁棒的估计。
AI.keywords: 霍克斯过程, 系统识别, Laguerre基, 半定规划, 非负性, 稳定性
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入系统理论方法和符号不定的正交Laguerre基，创新性地解决了霍克斯过程识别中长期存在的非负性和稳定性保证问题，并克服了传统方法中Gram矩阵病态的挑战。将约束问题转化为半定规划，显著提高了算法的实用性和计算效率。

title: SIMD-PAC-DB: Pretty Performant PAC Privacy
summary: This work presents a highly optimized implementation of PAC-DB, a recent and promising database privacy model. We prove that our SIMD-PAC-DB can compute the same privatized answer with just a single query, instead of the 128 stochastic executions against different 50% database sub-samples needed by the original PAC-DB. Our key insight is that every bit of a hashed primary key can be seen to represent membership of such a sub-sample. We present new algorithms for approximate computation of stochastic aggregates based on these hashes, which, thanks to their SIMD-friendliness, run up to 40x faster than scalar equivalents. We release an open-source DuckDB community extension which includes a rewriter that PAC-privatizes arbitrary SQL queries. Our experiments on TPC-H, Clickbench, and SQLStorm evaluate thousands of queries in terms of performance and utility, significantly advancing the ease of use and functionality of privacy-aware data systems in practice.

AI.tldr: SIMD-PAC-DB是对PAC-DB隐私模型的高度优化实现，通过利用哈希主键的位表示子样本成员身份，仅需单次查询即可获得隐私化结果，比原版快40倍，并提供了开源DuckDB扩展。
AI.motivation: 优化PAC-DB隐私模型，解决其原始实现需要128次随机执行的低效率问题，并提高隐私感知数据系统的实用性和易用性。
AI.method: 提出了SIMD-PAC-DB，利用哈希主键的每一位来表示数据库子样本的成员身份，并设计了新的基于哈希的随机聚合近似计算算法，这些算法对SIMD友好。还发布了一个开源DuckDB社区扩展，包含SQL查询重写器。
AI.result: SIMD-PAC-DB只需单次查询即可计算隐私化答案，而原版需要128次；新的算法比标量等效算法快40倍；在TPC-H、Clickbench和SQLStorm上的实验验证了其性能和实用性，显著提升了隐私感知数据系统的易用性和功能性。
AI.conclusion: SIMD-PAC-DB通过优化PAC-DB隐私模型，显著提高了隐私化查询的性能、易用性和实用性，使其在实践中更具可行性。
AI.translation: 这项工作提出了PAC-DB（一种近期有前景的数据库隐私模型）的高度优化实现。我们证明了SIMD-PAC-DB只需一次查询即可计算相同的隐私化答案，而原始PAC-DB需要对不同的50%数据库子样本进行128次随机执行。我们的关键见解是，哈希主键的每一位都可以被视为代表这样一个子样本的成员身份。我们提出了基于这些哈希的随机聚合近似计算新算法，由于其对SIMD的友好性，运行速度比标量等效算法快40倍。我们发布了一个开源的DuckDB社区扩展，其中包含一个可以将任意SQL查询进行PAC隐私化的重写器。我们在TPC-H、Clickbench和SQLStorm上进行了实验，评估了数千个查询的性能和实用性，显著提升了隐私感知数据系统在实践中的易用性和功能性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了SIMD-PAC-DB，这是对PAC-DB数据库隐私模型的高度优化实现。通过利用哈希主键位表示子样本成员身份的关键洞察，SIMD-PAC-DB仅需一次查询即可生成隐私化结果，替代了原版所需的128次随机执行。其SIMD友好的新算法将计算速度提升了40倍。该工作还发布了开源DuckDB扩展，支持任意SQL查询的PAC隐私化，并通过广泛实验验证了其在性能、实用性和易用性方面的显著进步。
AI.keywords: PAC-DB, 数据库隐私, SIMD, 隐私计算, DuckDB
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于通过巧妙地利用哈希主键的位表示和SIMD优化，将一个原本需要大量重复计算的隐私模型（PAC-DB）转换为一个高效的单次查询系统。性能提升高达40倍，并且提供了开源工具支持，极大地降低了隐私感知数据系统在实际应用中的门槛，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Training-free Detection of Generated Videos via Spatial-Temporal Likelihoods
summary: Following major advances in text and image generation, the video domain has surged, producing highly realistic and controllable sequences. Along with this progress, these models also raise serious concerns about misinformation, making reliable detection of synthetic videos increasingly crucial. Image-based detectors are fundamentally limited because they operate per frame and ignore temporal dynamics, while supervised video detectors generalize poorly to unseen generators, a critical drawback given the rapid emergence of new models. These challenges motivate zero-shot approaches, which avoid synthetic data and instead score content against real-data statistics, enabling training-free, model-agnostic detection. We introduce STALL, a simple, training-free, theoretically justified detector that provides likelihood-based scoring for videos, jointly modeling spatial and temporal evidence within a probabilistic framework. We evaluate STALL on two public benchmarks and introduce ComGenVid, a new benchmark with state-of-the-art generative models. STALL consistently outperforms prior image- and video-based baselines. Code and data are available at https://omerbenhayun.github.io/stall-video.

AI.title_translation: 通过时空似然进行训练无关的生成视频检测
AI.tldr: 提出STALL，一种新的、无需训练的视频生成检测器，它通过结合空间和时间信息来计算似然度得分，有效超越了现有技术，解决了当前高度逼真合成视频带来的虚假信息挑战。
AI.motivation: 文本和图像生成技术的进步使得视频生成也高度逼真可控，但这也引发了关于虚假信息的担忧，使得可靠的合成视频检测变得至关重要。现有方法（基于图像的忽略时间动态，监督方法泛化性差）存在局限性，因此需要零样本（zero-shot）方法来避免合成数据，并根据真实数据统计进行评分。
AI.method: STALL，一种简单、训练无关的检测器，通过概率框架联合建模空间和时间证据，提供基于似然度的视频评分。
AI.result: STALL在两个公开基准和新引入的ComGenVid基准上持续优于先前基于图像和基于视频的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: STALL在两个公开基准和引入的新基准ComGenVid上持续优于先前基于图像和基于视频的基线方法。
AI.translation: 继文本和图像生成取得重大进展之后，视频领域也蓬勃发展，产生了高度逼真且可控的序列。伴随这些进步，这些模型也引发了对虚假信息的严重担忧，使得可靠地检测合成视频变得越来越关键。基于图像的检测器存在根本性限制，因为它们逐帧操作并忽略时间动态；而监督视频检测器对未见过的生成器泛化能力差，考虑到新模型的快速出现，这是一个关键的缺点。这些挑战促使人们研究零样本方法，这些方法避免使用合成数据，而是根据真实数据统计对内容进行评分，从而实现训练无关、模型无关的检测。我们引入了STALL，一种简单、训练无关的检测器，它通过概率框架联合建模空间和时间证据，提供基于似然度的视频评分。我们在两个公开基准上评估了STALL，并引入了ComGenVid，一个包含最先进生成模型的新基准。STALL持续优于先前的基于图像和基于视频的基线方法。代码和数据可在https://omerbenhayun.github.io/stall-video获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对当前高度逼真但令人担忧的合成视频问题，提出了一种名为STALL的训练无关、理论合理的视频检测新方法。STALL通过概率框架联合建模视频的空间和时间信息，提供基于似然度的评分，有效克服了现有方法（如仅基于图像或泛化性差的监督方法）的局限性，并在多个基准测试中表现出优越的性能。
AI.keywords: 视频生成检测, 训练无关, 空间-时间似然, 零样本检测, STALL
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于提出了一种无需训练（training-free）的方法STALL，它通过联合建模空间和时间信息来评估视频的似然度，从而克服了现有方法的局限性。其理论依据和在多个基准上的优越性能是其重要贡献。其局限性可能在于，虽然是训练无关的，但其性能可能仍然依赖于“真实数据统计”的质量和适用范围。

title: Data-Driven Robust Predictive Control with Interval Matrix Uncertainty Propagation
summary: This paper presents a new data-driven robust predictive control law, for linear systems affected by unknown-but-bounded process disturbances. A sequence of input-state data is used to construct a suitable uncertainty representation based on interval matrices. Then, the effect of uncertainty along the prediction horizon is bounded through an operator leveraging matrix zonotopes. This yields a tube that is exploited within a variable-horizon optimal control problem, to guarantee robust satisfaction of state and input constraints. The resulting data-driven predictive control scheme is proven to be recursively feasible and practically stable. A numerical example shows that the proposed approach compares favorably to existing methods based on zonotopic tubes.

AI.title_translation: 基于区间矩阵不确定性传播的数据驱动鲁棒预测控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的数据驱动鲁棒预测控制律，通过区间矩阵表示不确定性并利用矩阵zonotope传播，以保证线性系统在未知有界扰动下的约束满足和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 针对受未知但有界过程扰动影响的线性系统，提出一种新的数据驱动鲁棒预测控制律。
AI.method: 使用输入-状态数据序列构建基于区间矩阵的不确定性表示。通过利用矩阵zonotope的算子来限制预测范围内的不确定性影响，形成一个管。该管被用于变 horizon 优化控制问题中，以保证状态和输入约束的鲁棒满足。
AI.result: 所提出的数据驱动预测控制方案被证明是递归可行和实际稳定的。数值例子表明，该方法优于现有的基于zonotope管的方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动预测控制方案被证明是递归可行和实际稳定的，并且在数值例子中表现优于现有方法。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新的数据驱动鲁棒预测控制律，用于受未知但有界过程扰动影响的线性系统。利用一系列输入-状态数据来构建基于区间矩阵的合适不确定性表示。然后，通过利用矩阵zonotope的算子来限制预测范围内不确定性的影响。这产生了一个管，该管在变 horizon 优化控制问题中被利用，以保证状态和输入约束的鲁棒满足。所产生的数据驱动预测控制方案被证明是递归可行和实际稳定的。数值例子表明，所提出的方法与现有基于zonotope管的方法相比具有优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对受未知有界扰动影响的线性系统的数据驱动鲁棒预测控制律。该方法利用输入-状态数据构建区间矩阵不确定性表示，并通过矩阵zonotope算子传播不确定性，形成一个用于变 horizon 优化控制问题的管，以保证鲁棒满足状态和输入约束。该方案被证明是递归可行和实际稳定的，并通过数值例子验证了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 数据驱动, 鲁棒预测控制, 区间矩阵, 矩阵zonotope, 不确定性传播
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将数据驱动方法与区间矩阵和矩阵zonotope相结合，有效地处理了线性系统中的不确定性传播问题，并保证了鲁棒性和稳定性。其在实际应用中具有潜在价值。

title: Open Biomedical Knowledge Graphs at Scale: Construction, Federation, and AI Agent Access with Samyama Graph Database
comments: 12 pages, 7 tables, open-source code and data
summary:
Biomedical knowledge is fragmented across siloed databases -- Reactome for pathways, STRING for protein interactions, ClinicalTrials.gov for study registries, DrugBank for drug vocabularies, DGIdb for drug-gene interactions, SIDER for side effects. We present three open-source biomedical knowledge graphs -- Pathways KG (118,686 nodes, 834,785 edges from 5 sources), Clinical Trials KG (7,774,446 nodes, 26,973,997 edges from 5 sources), and Drug Interactions KG (32,726 nodes, 191,970 edges from 3 sources) -- built on Samyama, a high-performance graph database written in Rust.
  Our contributions are threefold. First, we describe a reproducible ETL pattern for constructing large-scale KGs from heterogeneous public data sources, with cross-source deduplication, batch loading (Python Cypher and Rust native loaders), and portable snapshot export. Second, we demonstrate cross-KG federation: loading all three snapshots into a single graph tenant enables property-based joins across datasets. Third, we introduce schema-driven MCP server generation for LLM agent access, evaluated on a new BiomedQA benchmark (40 pharmacology questions): domain-specific MCP tools achieve 98% accuracy vs. 85% for schema-aware text-to-Cypher and 75% for standalone GPT-4o, with zero schema errors.
  All data sources are open-license. The combined federated graph (7.9M nodes, 28M edges) loads in approximately 3 minutes on commodity cloud hardware, with single-KG queries completing in 80-100ms and cross-KG federation joins in 1-4s
