AI.title_translation: 大规模开放生物医学知识图谱：基于Samyama图数据库的构建、联邦和AI代理访问
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用Samyama图数据库构建了三个大规模、开放的生物医学知识图谱，实现了跨图联邦，并开发了一种模式驱动的机制，使大型语言模型代理能够以98%的准确率高效地访问和查询这些知识，显著优于其他文本到代码或通用LLM方法。
AI.motivation: 生物医学知识分散在各种孤立的数据库中（如Reactome, STRING, ClinicalTrials.gov等），本研究旨在通过构建大规模、可互操作的知识图谱来解决这种知识碎片化的问题，并支持AI代理的访问。
AI.method: 构建了三个开放生物医学知识图谱（通路KG、临床试验KG、药物相互作用KG），使用Samyama图数据库。方法包括可复现的ETL模式（去重、批量加载）、跨KG联邦（属性连接）以及模式驱动的MCP服务器生成，用于LLM代理访问。
AI.result: 成功构建了三个知识图谱（总计约790万节点，2800万边）。跨KG联邦加载耗时约3分钟，单KG查询耗时80-100ms，跨KG联邦连接耗时1-4秒。在BiomedQA基准测试中，领域特定MCP工具达到了98%的准确率，优于Schema-aware Text-to-Cypher（85%）和独立的GPT-4o（75%）。
AI.conclusion: 论文介绍了如何使用Samyama高性能图数据库构建、联邦三个大规模开放生物医学知识图谱（通路、临床试验、药物相互作用），并展示了一种通过模式驱动的MCP服务器实现LLM代理高效访问的方法，在BiomedQA基准测试中取得了高准确率。
AI.translation: 生物医学知识分散在孤立的数据库中——Reactome用于通路，STRING用于蛋白质相互作用，ClinicalTrials.gov用于研究登记，DrugBank用于药物词汇表，DGIdb用于药物-基因相互作用，SIDER用于副作用。我们基于用Rust编写的高性能图数据库Samyama，构建了三个开源的生物医学知识图谱——通路KG（来自5个来源的118,686个节点，834,785条边）、临床试验KG（来自5个来源的7,774,446个节点，26,973,997条边）和药物相互作用KG（来自3个来源的32,726个节点，191,970条边）。我们的贡献有三方面。第一，我们描述了一种可复现的ETL模式，用于从异构公共数据源构建大规模KG，包括跨源去重、批量加载（Python Cypher和Rust原生加载器）和可移植的快照导出。第二，我们演示了跨KG联邦：将所有三个快照加载到单个图租户中，可以实现跨数据集的基于属性的连接。第三，我们引入了模式驱动的MCP服务器生成，用于LLM代理访问，并在一个新的BiomedQA基准测试（40个药理学问题）上进行了评估：领域特定的MCP工具达到98%的准确率，而模式感知的Text-to-Cypher为85%，独立的GPT-4o为75%，且模式错误为零。所有数据源均为开放许可。组合的联邦图（790万节点，2800万边）在商用云硬件上大约3分钟加载，单KG查询耗时80-100毫秒，跨KG联邦连接耗时1-4秒。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了如何利用高性能的Samyama图数据库构建、联邦和实现对大规模开放生物医学知识图谱的AI代理访问。研究人员构建了通路、临床试验和药物相互作用三个KG，并展示了可复现的ETL流程、跨图联邦能力，以及通过模式驱动的MCP服务器为LLM代理提供高效访问的机制，该机制在新的BiomedQA基准测试中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 生物医学知识图谱, 图数据库, 知识图谱联邦, LLM代理访问, Samyama
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个可扩展的、高性能的生物医学知识图谱（KG）构建、联邦和AI代理访问的整体框架。它解决了生物医学知识碎片化的问题，并展示了其在特定应用（如LLM代理访问）上的优越性能。主要的局限性可能在于其性能评估主要集中在单一的云硬件配置上，并且对于更复杂的生物医学推理任务的评估相对有限。

title: A Tutorial on ALOS2 SAR Utilization: Dataset Preparation, Self-Supervised Pretraining, and Semantic Segmentation
summary: Masked auto-encoders (MAE) and related approaches have shown promise for satellite imagery, but their application to synthetic aperture radar (SAR) remains limited due to challenges in semantic labeling and high noise levels. Building on our prior work with SAR-W-MixMAE, which adds SAR-specific intensity-weighted loss to standard MixMAE for pretraining, we also introduce SAR-W-SimMIM; a weighted variant of SimMIM applied to ALOS-2 single-channel SAR imagery. This method aims to reduce the impact of speckle and extreme intensity values during self-supervised pretraining. We evaluate its effect on semantic segmentation compared to our previous trial with SAR-W-MixMAE and random initialization, observing notable improvements. In addition, pretraining and fine-tuning models on satellite imagery pose unique challenges, particularly when developing region-specific models. Imbalanced land cover distributions such as dominant water, forest, or desert areas can introduce bias, affecting both pretraining and downstream tasks like land cover segmentation. To address this, we constructed a SAR dataset using ALOS-2 single-channel (HH polarization) imagery focused on the Japan region, marking the initial phase toward a national-scale foundation model. This dataset was used to pretrain a vision transformer-based autoencoder, with the resulting encoder fine-tuned for semantic segmentation using a task-specific decoder. Initial results demonstrate significant performance improvements compared to training from scratch with random initialization. In summary, this work provides a guide to process and prepare ALOS2 observations to create dataset so that it can be taken advantage of self-supervised pretraining of models and finetuning downstream tasks such as semantic segmentation.

AI.title_translation: ALOS2 SAR利用教程：数据集准备、自监督预训练和语义分割
AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于如何使用ALOS-2 SAR数据进行数据准备、自监督预训练（提出SAR-W-SimMIM方法）和语义分割的教程，结果显示自监督预训练能有效提高分割性能，克服了SAR数据噪声和标签稀疏性带来的挑战。
AI.motivation: Masked auto-encoders (MAE) 等方法在卫星图像中显示出潜力，但由于语义标注的挑战和高噪声水平，其在合成孔径雷达（SAR）中的应用受到限制。此外，在卫星图像上进行预训练和微调模型时，区域特定的模型会受到不平衡的土地覆盖分布引入的偏差影响。
AI.method: 引入了SAR-W-SimMIM方法，它是SimMIM的一种加权变体，应用于ALOS-2单通道SAR图像，旨在减少预训练期间斑点噪声和极端强度值的影响。此外，构建了一个基于ALOS-2单通道（HH极化）图像的日本区域数据集，用于预训练基于视觉Transformer的自编码器，然后将所得编码器微调以进行语义分割。
AI.result: 与SAR-W-MixMAE和随机初始化相比，SAR-W-SimMIM在语义分割任务上观察到了显著的改进。与从随机初始化开始训练相比，使用预训练的编码器进行微调也显示出显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了一个关于如何处理和准备ALOS2观测数据以进行自监督预训练和下游语义分割任务的指南，并展示了自监督预训练带来的显著性能提升。
AI.translation: 掩码自编码器（MAE）及相关方法在卫星图像中显示出潜力，但由于语义标注的挑战和高噪声水平，它们在合成孔径雷达（SAR）中的应用仍然有限。基于我们先前使用SAR-W-MixMAE的工作，该方法为标准的MixMAE增加了SAR特定的强度加权损失进行预训练，我们还引入了SAR-W-SimMIM；这是应用于ALOS-2单通道SAR图像的SimMIM的加权变体。该方法旨在减少自监督预训练期间斑点噪声和极端强度值的影响。我们将其对语义分割的影响与我们之前使用SAR-W-MixMAE和随机初始化的试验进行了比较，观察到显著的改进。此外，在卫星图像上进行预训练和微调模型带来了独特的挑战，特别是在开发区域特定模型时。不平衡的土地覆盖分布，如占主导地位的水域、森林或沙漠区域，可能会引入偏差，影响预训练和土地覆盖分割等下游任务。为解决此问题，我们使用ALOS-2单通道（HH极化）图像构建了一个专注于日本地区的SAR数据集，标志着向国家级基础模型迈出的第一步。该数据集用于预训练一个基于视觉Transformer的自编码器，并将所得编码器使用特定任务的解码器微调以进行语义分割。初步结果表明，与从随机初始化从头开始训练相比，性能有了显著提高。总而言之，这项工作提供了一个关于如何处理和准备ALOS2观测以创建数据集的指南，以便可以利用自监督预训练模型并在语义分割等下游任务中进行微调。
AI.summary: 本教程指导如何准备ALOS-2 SAR数据集，并介绍了一种新的自监督预训练方法SAR-W-SimMIM，以减轻SAR数据的噪声影响，并通过在日本区域构建的数据集上进行实验，证明了该方法在下游语义分割任务中相比随机初始化具有显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: ALOS-2, SAR, 自监督预训练, 语义分割, MAE
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于为ALOS-2 SAR数据引入了SAR特定的自监督预训练方法（SAR-W-SimMIM），并构建了日本区域的数据集，旨在解决SAR数据在自监督学习中的标签稀疏性和高噪声问题。其局限性可能在于仅聚焦于日本区域的数据集和HH极化，通用性有待进一步验证。

title: Next-Frame Decoding for Ultra-Low-Bitrate Image Compression with Video Diffusion Priors
summary: We present a novel paradigm for ultra-low-bitrate image compression (ULB-IC) that exploits the "temporal" evolution in generative image compression. Specifically, we define an explicit intermediate state during decoding: a compact anchor frame, which preserves the scene geometry and semantic layout while discarding high-frequency details. We then reinterpret generative decoding as a virtual temporal transition from this anchor to the final reconstructed image.To model this progression, we leverage a pretrained video diffusion model (VDM) as temporal priors: the anchor frame serves as the initial frame and the original image as the target frame, transforming the decoding process into a next-frame prediction task.In contrast to image diffusion-based ULB-IC models, our decoding proceeds from a visible, semantically faithful anchor, which improves both fidelity and realism for perceptual image compression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior objective and subjective performance. On the CLIC2020 test set, our method achieves over 50% bitrate savings across LPIPS, DISTS, FID, and KID compared to DiffC, while also delivering a significant decoding speedup of up to $\times$5. Code will be released later.

AI.title_translation: 利用视频扩散先验的超低比特率图像压缩的下一帧解码
AI.tldr: 该研究通过将超低比特率图像压缩（ULB-IC）视为一个从紧凑锚点帧到最终图像的“下一帧预测”问题，并利用视频扩散模型（VDM）作为时序先验，实现了比现有方法更低的码率和更快的解码速度，同时提高了图像的保真度和真实感。
AI.motivation: 探索利用生成式图像压缩中的“时间”演化特性，以实现超低比特率图像压缩（ULB-IC）。与现有基于图像扩散的ULB-IC模型相比，该方法从一个可见的、语义上忠实的锚点帧开始解码，以提高感知图像压缩的保真度和真实感。
AI.method: 提出了一种利用生成式图像压缩中“时间”演化的新范式。定义了一个紧凑的锚点帧作为中间状态，保留场景几何和语义布局。将生成式解码重新解释为从锚点帧到最终重建图像的虚拟时间过渡，利用预训练的视频扩散模型（VDM）作为时序先验，将解码过程转化为一个下一帧预测任务。
AI.result: 在CLIC2020测试集上，与DiffC相比，本方法在LPIPS、DISTS、FID和KID指标上实现了超过50%的码率节省，并且解码速度提升了高达$\times$5，实现了优越的客观和主观性能。
AI.conclusion: 我们的方法在CLIC2020测试集上实现了优于DiffC的客观和主观性能，在LPIPS、DISTS、FID和KID指标上实现了超过50%的码率节省，并带来了高达$\times$5的解码速度提升。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种利用生成式图像压缩中“时间”演化的超低比特率图像压缩（ULB-IC）新范式。具体来说，我们在解码过程中定义了一个明确的中间状态：一个紧凑的锚点帧，它保留了场景的几何结构和语义布局，同时丢弃了高频细节。然后，我们将生成式解码重新解释为从这个锚点到最终重建图像的虚拟时间转换。为了模拟这一过程，我们利用预训练的视频扩散模型（VDM）作为时间先验：锚点帧作为初始帧，原始图像作为目标帧，将解码过程转化为一个下一帧预测任务。与基于图像扩散的ULB-IC模型相比，我们的解码从一个可见的、语义忠实的锚点帧开始，提高了感知图像压缩的保真度和真实感。大量实验证明，我们的方法在客观和主观性能上均优于现有方法。在CLIC2020测试集上，我们的方法在LPIPS、DISTS、FID和KID指标上实现了比DiffC高出50%以上的码率节省，同时解码速度也显著提升了高达$\times$5。代码稍后发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用视频扩散模型（VDM）作为时序先验的超低比特率图像压缩（ULB-IC）新范式。该方法将解码过程视为从一个紧凑的、语义完整的“锚点帧”到最终图像的“下一帧预测”任务，从而在保证感知质量的同时，显著降低了比特率并加快了解码速度。
AI.keywords: 超低比特率图像压缩, 视频扩散模型, 锚点帧, 下一帧预测, 生成式解码
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将超低比特率图像压缩（ULB-IC）视为一个“下一帧预测”任务，利用视频扩散模型（VDM）作为时序先验，从一个紧凑的锚点帧逐步生成最终图像，有效提高了保真度和真实感。其主要优势在于利用了生成模型中的“时间”演化，同时实现了显著的码率节省和解码加速。

title: Mechanistic Foundations of Goal-Directed Control
summary: Mechanistic interpretability has transformed the analysis of transformer circuits by decomposing model behavior into competing algorithms, identifying phase transitions during training, and deriving closed-form predictions for when and why strategies shift. However, this program has remained largely confined to sequence-prediction architectures, leaving embodied control systems without comparable mechanistic accounts. Here we extend this framework to sensorimotor-cognitive development, using infant motor learning as a model system. We show that foundational inductive biases give rise to causal control circuits, with learned gating mechanisms converging toward theoretically motivated uncertainty thresholds. The resulting dynamics reveal a clean phase transition in the arbitration gate whose commitment behavior is well described by a closed-form exponential moving-average surrogate. We identify context window k as the critical parameter governing circuit formation: below a minimum threshold (k$\leq$4) the arbitration mechanism cannot form; above it (k$\geq$8), gate confidence scales asymptotically as log k. A two-dimensional phase diagram further reveals task-demand-dependent route arbitration consistent with the prediction that prospective execution becomes advantageous only when prediction error remains within the task tolerance window. Together, these results provide a mechanistic account of how reactive and prospective control strategies emerge and compete during learning. More broadly, this work sharpens mechanistic accounts of cognitive development and provides principled guidance for the design of interpretable embodied agents.

AI.title_translation: 目标导向控制的机制基础
AI.tldr: 研究人员成功地将Transformer电路分析中使用的机制可解释性方法应用于婴儿运动学习，建立了目标导向控制的机制基础。他们发现学习过程由上下文窗口k控制，并识别出一个关键的“仲裁门”的相变行为，该行为可以用一个简单的数学公式描述，从而解释了反应式和前瞻性控制策略是如何在学习中竞争和出现的。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性已在Transformer电路分析中取得成功，但该程序在很大程度上局限于序列预测架构，而具身控制系统缺乏可比拟的机制性解释。因此，有必要将该框架扩展到传感器运动-认知发展领域。
AI.method: 将机制可解释性框架扩展到婴儿运动学习这一模型系统，通过分析传感器运动-认知发展过程，展示了因果控制电路的形成，以及学习到的门控机制如何收敛到理论上的不确定性阈值。使用上下文窗口k作为关键参数，并构建了一个二维相图来揭示任务需求依赖的路径仲裁。
AI.result: 基础归纳偏置产生了因果控制电路，学习到的门控机制收敛到理论上驱动的不确定性阈值。仲裁门中出现了一个清晰的相变，其承诺行为可以用一个闭式的指数移动平均替代模型很好地描述。上下文窗口k被确定为控制电路形成的关键参数：低于最小阈值（k$\leq$4）仲裁机制无法形成；高于该阈值（k$\geq$8），门置信度按log k渐近缩放。二维相图揭示了任务需求依赖的路径仲裁，与前瞻性执行仅在预测误差保持在任务容忍窗口内才有利的预测一致。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为反应性和前瞻性控制策略在学习过程中如何出现和竞争提供了机制性解释。更广泛地说，这项工作使对认知发展的机制性解释更加清晰，并为可解释的具身智能体的设计提供了原则性指导。
AI.translation: 机制可解释性已经通过将模型行为分解为竞争性算法、识别训练过程中的相变以及推导出策略何时以及为何转变的闭式预测，彻底改变了对Transformer电路的分析。然而，这一程序在很大程度上仍局限于序列预测架构，使具身控制系统缺乏可比拟的机制性说明。在此，我们将该框架扩展到传感器运动-认知发展，使用婴儿运动学习作为模型系统。我们表明，基础的归纳偏置产生了因果控制电路，学习到的门控机制收敛于理论驱动的不确定性阈值。由此产生的动力学揭示了仲裁门中一个清晰的相变，其承诺行为可以用一个闭式的指数移动平均替代模型很好地描述。我们确定上下文窗口k为控制电路形成的关键参数：低于最小阈值（k$\leq$4）仲裁机制无法形成；高于该阈值（k$\geq$8），门置信度按log k渐近缩放。二维相图进一步揭示了任务需求依赖的路径仲裁，与前瞻性执行仅在预测误差保持在任务容忍窗口内才变得有利的预测一致。总而言之，这些结果为反应性和前瞻性控制策略在学习过程中如何出现和竞争提供了机制性解释。更广泛地说，这项工作使对认知发展的机制性解释更加清晰，并为可解释的具身智能体的设计提供了原则性指导。
AI.summary: 本文将机制可解释性框架应用于婴儿运动学习，揭示了目标导向控制的基础机制。研究发现，学习过程涉及因果控制电路的形成和基于不确定性阈值的门控机制。关键发现包括仲裁门中出现的清晰相变，以及上下文窗口k对电路形成和门置信度的决定性影响。最终，研究为反应性和前瞻性控制策略的竞争提供了机制性解释。
AI.keywords: 机制可解释性, 具身控制, 运动学习, 仲裁门, 目标导向控制
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要创新在于将对Transformer模型有效的机制可解释性框架扩展到了具身控制系统（如婴儿运动学习），填补了该领域的空白。其发现的“仲裁门”的明确相变和闭式描述（指数移动平均替代模型）是核心贡献。限制在于研究是基于婴儿运动学习这一特定模型系统，其普适性有待进一步验证。

title: NV-Bench: Benchmark of Nonverbal Vocalization Synthesis for Expressive Text-to-Speech Generation
summary: While recent text-to-speech (TTS) systems increasingly integrate nonverbal vocalizations (NVs), their evaluations lack standardized metrics and reliable ground-truth references. To bridge this gap, we propose NV-Bench, the first benchmark grounded in a functional taxonomy that treats NVs as communicative acts rather than acoustic artifacts. NV-Bench comprises 1,651 multi-lingual, in-the-wild utterances with paired human reference audio, balanced across 14 NV categories. We introduce a dual-dimensional evaluation protocol: (1) Instruction Alignment, utilizing the proposed paralinguistic character error rate (PCER) to assess controllability, (2) Acoustic Fidelity, measuring the distributional gap to real recordings to assess acoustic realism. We evaluate diverse TTS models and develop two baselines. Experimental results demonstrate a strong correlation between our objective metrics and human perception, establishing NV-Bench as a standardized evaluation framework.

AI.title_translation: NV-Bench：用于表现性文本到语音生成的非语言发声合成基准测试
AI.tldr: NV-Bench 是第一个用于评估非语言发声合成的基准，它将 NVs 视为交流行为，包含多语言真实数据和双维度评估指标（PCER 和声学分布差距），实验证明其客观评估与人类感知高度一致。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到语音 (TTS) 系统越来越多地整合非语言发声 (NVs)，但其评估缺乏标准化指标和可靠的真实参考。
AI.method: 提出 NV-Bench，包含 1,651 条多语言、真实的带有人类参考音频的语段，平衡了 14 个 NV 类别。引入双维度评估协议：使用提出的副语言错误率 (PCER) 评估“指令对齐”（可控性），使用测量到真实录音的分布差距评估“声学保真度”（声学真实性）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，提出的客观指标与人类感知之间存在很强的相关性，确立了 NV-Bench 作为一个标准化的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: NV-Bench 作为一个标准化的评估框架，通过实验结果证明了其客观指标与人类感知之间存在很强的相关性。
AI.translation: 尽管最近的文本到语音 (TTS) 系统越来越多地整合非语言发声 (NVs)，但它们的评估缺乏标准化指标和可靠的真实参考。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了 NV-Bench，这是第一个基于功能性分类的基准，该分类将 NVs 视为交流行为而非声学产物。NV-Bench 包含 1,651 条多语言、真实的、带有配对人类参考音频的语段，平衡了 14 个 NV 类别。我们引入了双维度评估协议：(1) 利用提出的副语言错误率 (PCER) 来评估可控性的“指令对齐”；(2) 测量到真实录音的分布差距以评估声学真实性的“声学保真度”。我们评估了各种 TTS 模型并开发了两个基线。实验结果证明了我们的客观指标与人类感知之间存在很强的相关性，确立了 NV-Bench 作为一个标准化的评估框架。
AI.summary: 为解决当前文本到语音系统中非语言发声 (NVs) 评估缺乏标准化的难题，本文提出了 NV-Bench，这是首个基于功能性分类的基准，包含 1,651 条多语言真实语段。该基准采用双维度评估协议（指令对齐和声学保真度），并通过实验证明了其客观指标与人类感知的强相关性。
AI.keywords: 非语言发声, 文本到语音, 基准测试, 指令对齐, 声学保真度
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个基于功能性分类的基准（NV-Bench），将非语言发声（NVs）视为交流行为而非声学产物。其重要性在于填补了当前NV合成评估缺乏标准化指标和可靠参考的空白。局限性未在摘要中明确提及，但可以推测其对“在野外”（in-the-wild）数据的依赖可能引入环境噪声的复杂性。

title: NavThinker: Action-Conditioned World Models for Coupled Prediction and Planning in Social Navigation
summary: Social navigation requires robots to act safely in dynamic human environments. Effective behavior demands thinking ahead: reasoning about how the scene and pedestrians evolve under different robot actions rather than reacting to current observations alone. This creates a coupled prediction-planning challenge, where robot actions and human motion mutually influence each other. To address this challenge, we propose NavThinker, a future-aware framework that couples an action-conditioned world model with on-policy reinforcement learning. The world model operates in the Depth Anything V2 patch feature space and performs autoregressive prediction of future scene geometry and human motion; multi-head decoders then produce future depth maps and human trajectories, yielding a future-aware state aligned with traversability and interaction risk. Crucially, we train the policy with DD-PPO while injecting world-model think-ahead signals via: (i) action-conditioned future features fused into the current observation embedding and (ii) social reward shaping from predicted human trajectories. Experiments on single- and multi-robot Social-HM3D show state-of-the-art navigation success, with zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D and real-world deployment on a Unitree Go2, validating generalization and practical applicability. Webpage: https://hutslib.github.io/NavThinker.

AI.title_translation: NavThinker：用于社会导航中耦合预测与规划的行动条件世界模型
AI.tldr: NavThinker通过一个能预测未来场景和行人运动的“世界模型”来指导机器人的导航决策，将其与强化学习（DD-PPO）结合，解决了机器人行动和行人运动相互影响的复杂问题，并在真实和仿真环境中取得了最佳导航效果。
AI.motivation: 社会导航要求机器人在动态的人类环境中安全行动。有效的行为需要提前思考：推理在不同机器人动作下场景和行人如何演变，而不是仅仅对当前观测做出反应。这造成了一个耦合的预测-规划挑战，其中机器人动作和行人运动相互影响。
AI.method: 提出NavThinker框架，它将一个行动条件的世界模型与在线策略强化学习相结合。世界模型在Depth Anything V2的patch特征空间中工作，自回归地预测未来的场景几何和行人运动。多头解码器生成未来的深度图和行人轨迹，产生与可通行性和交互风险对齐的未来感知状态。策略使用DD-PPO进行训练，通过(i)将行动条件化的未来特征融合到当前观测嵌入中和(ii)从预测的行人轨迹中进行社会奖励塑形来注入世界模型的“预见信号”。
AI.result: 在单机器人和多机器人Social-HM3D上的实验显示了最先进的导航成功率，在Social-MP3D上实现了零样本迁移，并在Unitree Go2上进行了实际部署。
AI.conclusion: NavThinker通过将行动条件的世界模型与强化学习相结合，实现了在单/多机器人Social-HM3D数据集上的最先进导航成功率，并成功地在Social-MP3D上进行零样本迁移和在Unitree Go2机器人上进行实际部署，验证了其泛化能力和实际应用价值。
AI.translation: 社会导航要求机器人在动态的人类环境中安全行动。有效的行为需要提前思考：推理在不同机器人动作下场景和行人如何演变，而不是仅仅对当前观测做出反应。这造成了一个耦合的预测-规划挑战，其中机器人动作和行人运动相互影响。为了解决这个挑战，我们提出了NavThinker，一个将行动条件世界模型与在线策略强化学习耦合的前瞻性框架。该世界模型在Depth Anything V2的patch特征空间中运行，自回归地预测未来的场景几何和行人运动；多头解码器随后生成未来的深度图和行人轨迹，产生与可通行性和交互风险对齐的未来感知状态。至关重要的是，我们使用DD-PPO训练策略，并通过以下方式注入世界模型的预见信号：(i)将行动条件化的未来特征融合到当前的观测嵌入中和(ii)从预测的行人轨迹中进行社会奖励塑形。在单机和多机Social-HM3D上的实验显示了最先进的导航成功率，实现了向Social-MP3D的零样本迁移，并在Unitree Go2上进行了实际部署，验证了其泛化能力和实际应用性。网页：https://hutslib.github.io/NavThinker。
AI.summary: NavThinker是一个前瞻性的框架，通过将行动条件的世界模型与在线策略强化学习耦合，解决了社会导航中预测和规划相互影响的难题。该世界模型预测未来的场景几何和行人运动，并将这些预测信号（如未来特征和奖励塑形）注入到DD-PPO策略训练中，从而实现了在复杂动态环境中的高成功率导航和强大的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 社会导航, 世界模型, 行动条件, 预测与规划, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将行动条件的世界模型与强化学习相结合，解决了社会导航中预测与规划的耦合难题。它利用世界模型预测未来的场景几何和行人运动，并将这些“预见信号”有效地融入到策略训练中，实现了在复杂动态环境中的先进导航性能和良好的泛化能力。方法的关键在于使用Depth Anything V2特征空间进行预测。

title: Deep learning and the rate of approximation by flows
summary: We investigate the dependence of the approximation capacity of deep residual networks on its depth in a continuous dynamical systems setting. This can be formulated as the general problem of quantifying the minimal time-horizon required to approximate a diffeomorphism by flows driven by a given family $\mathcal F$ of vector fields. We show that this minimal time can be identified as a geodesic distance on a sub-Finsler manifold of diffeomorphisms, where the local geometry is characterised by a variational principle involving $\mathcal F$. This connects the learning efficiency of target relationships to their compatibility with the learning architectural choice. Further, the results suggest that the key approximation mechanism in deep learning, namely the approximation of functions by composition or dynamics, differs in a fundamental way from linear approximation theory, where linear spaces and norm-based rate estimates are replaced by manifolds and geodesic distances.

AI.title_translation: 深度学习与逼近的速率
AI.tldr: 通过将深度学习的近似能力视为连续动力学中的时间问题，论文发现深度网络逼近一个微分同胚所需的最小时间对应于一个几何结构（子Finsler流形上的测地线距离），这表明学习效率取决于架构选择，且与基于范数的线性逼近理论有本质区别。
AI.motivation: 研究深度残差网络的深度对其近似能力的影响，并将其置于连续动力学系统的背景下进行探讨。
AI.method: 将深度残差网络的近似能力问题转化为在由给定向量场族 $\mathcal F$ 驱动的流中逼近一个微分同胚所需的最小时间范围问题，并将其识别为微分同胚子Finsler流形上的测地线距离。
AI.result: 最小时间范围可以被识别为微分同胚子Finsler流形上的一个测地线距离，其中局部几何由涉及 $\mathcal F$ 的变分原理来表征，这表明学习效率与目标关系与学习架构选择的兼容性相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，深度学习中的关键逼近机制——通过组合或动力学逼近函数——与线性逼近理论有着根本性的不同，其中线性空间和基于范数的速率估计被流形和测地线距离所取代。
AI.translation: 我们研究了深度残差网络近似能力对深度的依赖性在连续动力学系统设置中的表现。这可以表述为量化由给定向量场族 $\mathcal F$ 驱动的流逼近一个微分同胚所需的最小时间范围的一般问题。我们证明了这个最小时间可以被识别为微分同胚子Finsler流形上的一个测地线距离，其局部几何由涉及 $\mathcal F$ 的变分原理所表征。这会将目标关系的学习效率与其与学习架构选择的兼容性联系起来。此外，结果表明深度学习中的关键近似机制，即通过组合或动力学逼近函数，与线性逼近理论有着根本性的不同，在线性逼近理论中，线性空间和基于范数的速率估计被流形和测地线距离所取代。
AI.summary: 本文研究了深度残差网络深度对近似能力的影响，将其置于连续动力学系统框架下，量化了逼近一个微分同胚所需的最小时间范围。该时间范围被确定为微分同胚子Finsler流形上的一个测地线距离，揭示了深度学习的效率与学习架构的兼容性之间的联系，并强调了其与传统线性逼近理论的根本区别。
AI.keywords: 深度残差网络, 连续动力学系统, 近似能力, 测地线距离, Finsler流形
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将深度残差网络的近似能力与连续动力学系统中的时间范围联系起来，并将其表述为微分同胚子Finsler流形上的测地线距离问题，这为理解深度学习的效率提供了新的几何视角。重要性在于它将函数逼近与动力学联系起来，并与传统的线性逼近理论区分开来。摘要中未明确提及局限性。

title: The Comprehension-Gated Agent Economy: A Robustness-First Architecture for AI Economic Agency
summary: AI agents are increasingly granted economic agency (executing trades, managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and spawning sub-agents), yet current frameworks gate this agency on capability benchmarks that are empirically uncorrelated with operational robustness. We introduce the Comprehension-Gated Agent Economy (CGAE), a formal architecture in which an agent's economic permissions are upper-bounded by a verified comprehension function derived from adversarial robustness audits. The gating mechanism operates over three orthogonal robustness dimensions: constraint compliance (measured by CDCT), epistemic integrity (measured by DDFT), and behavioral alignment (measured by AGT), with intrinsic hallucination rates serving as a cross-cutting diagnostic. We define a weakest-link gate function that maps robustness vectors to discrete economic tiers, and prove three properties of the resulting system: (1) bounded economic exposure, ensuring maximum financial liability is a function of verified robustness; (2) incentive-compatible robustness investment, showing rational agents maximize profit by improving robustness rather than scaling capability alone; and (3) monotonic safety scaling, demonstrating that aggregate system safety does not decrease as the economy grows. The architecture includes temporal decay and stochastic re-auditing mechanisms that prevent post-certification drift. CGAE provides the first formal bridge between empirical AI robustness evaluation and economic governance, transforming safety from a regulatory burden into a competitive advantage.

AI.title_translation: 理解门控代理经济：一种面向鲁棒性的AI经济代理架构
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了理解门控代理经济（CGAE）架构，将AI的经济代理权限与其经过验证的理解能力挂钩，而不是依赖于与实际操作鲁棒性无关的能力基准。该架构通过三个维度（约束合规性、认知完整性和行为对齐性）的对抗性鲁棒性审计来衡量理解能力，并证明了该系统具有经济敞口限制、激励兼容的鲁棒性投资以及单调的安全扩展性。CGAE将AI鲁棒性评估与经济治理相结合，使安全成为竞争优势。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理的经济活动（如交易、预算管理、合同谈判和子代理生成）受限于与其操作鲁棒性无关的能力基准，缺乏对实际操作鲁棒性的保障。
AI.method: 提出理解门控代理经济（CGAE）架构，其中代理的经济权限由对抗性鲁棒性审计产生的经验证的理解函数界定。该门控机制基于三个独立的鲁棒性维度：约束合规性（CDCT）、认知完整性（DDFT）和行为对齐性（AGT），并以固有幻觉率为跨维度诊断。定义了一个最弱链门函数，将鲁棒性向量映射到离散的经济层级，并证明了系统的三个特性：有界经济敞口、激励兼容的鲁棒性投资和单调的安全扩展性。架构还包含时间衰减和随机再审计机制以防止认证漂移。
AI.result: 证明了CGAE系统的三个关键特性：（1）有界经济敞口，确保最大财务责任是经验证鲁棒性的函数；（2）激励兼容的鲁棒性投资，表明理性代理通过提高鲁棒性而非仅扩大能力来最大化利润；（3）单调的安全扩展性，证明随着经济增长，整体系统安全性不会下降。
AI.conclusion: CGAE架构首次在经验性AI鲁棒性评估与经济治理之间建立了正式的桥梁，将安全从监管负担转变为竞争优势。
AI.translation: AI代理日益获得经济代理权（执行交易、管理预算、谈判合同和生成子代理），然而当前的框架将此代理权与能力基准挂钩，而这些基准在经验上与操作鲁棒性无关。我们引入了理解门控代理经济（CGAE），这是一种正式的架构，其中代理的经济权限由从对抗性鲁棒性审计得出的经验证的理解函数设定上限。门控机制作用于三个独立的鲁棒性维度：约束合规性（由CDCT衡量）、认知完整性（由DDFT衡量）和行为对齐性（由AGT衡量），以固有的幻觉率为跨维度诊断。我们定义了一个最弱链门函数，将鲁棒性向量映射到离散的经济层级，并证明了由此产生的系统的三个特性：（1）有界经济敞口，确保最大财务责任是经验证鲁棒性的函数；（2）激励兼容的鲁棒性投资，表明理性代理通过提高鲁棒性而非仅扩大能力来最大化利润；（3）单调的安全扩展性，证明随着经济增长，整体系统安全性不会下降。该架构包含时间衰减和随机再审计机制，以防止认证后的漂移。CGAE首次在经验性AI鲁棒性评估与经济治理之间建立了正式的桥梁，将安全从监管负担转变为竞争优势。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了理解门控代理经济（CGAE）架构，该架构将AI的经济代理权限与其经过验证的理解能力挂钩，以解决当前框架依赖于与操作鲁棒性无关的能力基准的问题。CGAE通过对抗性鲁棒性审计衡量三个维度（约束合规性、认知完整性、行为对齐性）的理解能力，并证明了该系统具有有界经济敞口、激励兼容的鲁棒性投资和单调的安全扩展性等特性。该架构通过时间衰减和随机再审计机制防止认证后漂移，旨在将AI安全从监管负担转化为竞争优势。
AI.keywords: AI经济代理, 鲁棒性, 理解门控, 对抗性审计, 经济治理
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的AI经济代理架构（CGAE），通过将经济权限与经验证的鲁棒性挂钩，解决了当前AI代理经济活动中存在的安全性和可靠性问题。其核心创新在于将AI的“理解能力”量化并作为经济权限的“门控”机制，这与传统的仅关注能力表现的基准不同，更侧重于AI的实际操作稳健性。论文提出的三个数学证明（有界经济敞口、激励兼容的鲁棒性投资、单调的安全扩展性）为该架构的理论基础提供了有力支持。此外，文中提到的时间衰减和随机再审计机制也体现了对AI系统动态性和长期稳定性的考量。该研究的重要意义在于为AI的经济治理提供了新的思路，将AI安全从被动的合规要求转变为主动的竞争优势，具有重要的理论和实践价值。然而，实际应用中如何准确、高效地进行鲁棒性审计，以及如何设定合理的经济层级和激励机制，仍是未来研究和实践中需要关注和解决的问题。

title: I Know What I Don't Know: Latent Posterior Factor Models for Multi-Evidence Probabilistic Reasoning
comments: 202 pages, 52 figures, 105 tables. Comprehensive presentation of the Latent Posterior Factors (LPF) framework for multi-evidence probabilistic reasoning, including theoretical analysis, algorithmic design, and extensive empirical evaluation across synthetic and real-world benchmarks
summary:
Real-world decision-making, from tax compliance assessment to medical diagnosis, requires aggregating multiple noisy and potentially contradictory evidence sources. Existing approaches either lack explicit uncertainty quantification (neural aggregation methods) or rely on manually engineered discrete predicates (probabilistic logic frameworks), limiting scalability to unstructured data.
  We introduce Latent Posterior Factors (LPF), a framework that transforms Variational Autoencoder (VAE) latent posteriors into soft likelihood factors for Sum-Product Network (SPN) inference, enabling tractable probabilistic reasoning over unstructured evidence while preserving calibrated uncertainty estimates. We instantiate LPF as LPF-SPN (structured factor-based inference) and LPF-Learned (end-to-end learned aggregation), enabling a principled comparison between explicit probabilistic reasoning and learned aggregation under a shared uncertainty representation.
  Across eight domains (seven synthetic and the FEVER benchmark), LPF-SPN achieves high accuracy (up to 97.8%), low calibration error (ECE 1.4%), and strong probabilistic fit, substantially outperforming evidential deep learning, LLMs and graph-based baselines over 15 random seeds.
  Contributions: (1) A framework bridging latent uncertainty representations with structured probabilistic reasoning. (2) Dual architectures enabling controlled comparison of reasoning paradigms. (3) Reproducible training methodology with seed selection. (4) Evaluation against EDL, BERT, R-GCN, and large language model baselines. (5) Cross-domain validation. (6) Formal guarantees in a companion paper.
comment: 202 pages, 52 figures, 105 tables. Comprehensive presentation of the Latent Posterior Factors (LPF) framework for multi-evidence probabilistic reasoning, including theoretical analysis, algorithmic design, and extensive empirical evaluation across synthetic and real-world benchmarks

AI.title_translation: 我知道我不知道什么：用于多证据概率推理的潜在后验因子模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了潜在后验因子（LPF）框架，将VAE的潜在后验转化为SPN的软似然因子，实现了对非结构化证据的概率推理和不确定性估计，并在多个领域（包括FEVER基准）上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的决策需要整合多个嘈杂且可能相互矛盾的证据来源，而现有方法要么缺乏明确的不确定性量化，要么依赖于手动设计的离散谓词，这限制了它们处理非结构化数据的能力。
AI.method: 提出潜在后验因子（LPF）框架，将变分自编码器（VAE）的潜在后验转化为用于和积网络（SPN）推理的软似然因子。通过LPF-SPN和LPF-Learned两种架构实现。
AI.result: LPF-SPN在八个领域（包括FEVER基准）取得了高准确率（高达97.8%）、低校准误差（ECE 1.4%），并具有良好的概率拟合性，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LPF框架成功地弥合了潜在不确定性表示与结构化概率推理之间的差距，并为处理多证据不确定性推理提供了一种可扩展且准确的方法。
AI.translation:
现实世界的决策，从税务合规评估到医疗诊断，都需要整合多个嘈杂且可能相互矛盾的证据来源。现有方法要么缺乏明确的不确定性量化（神经聚合方法），要么依赖于手动设计的离散谓词（概率逻辑框架），这限制了它们在非结构化数据上的可扩展性。
我们引入了潜在后验因子（LPF）框架，该框架将变分自编码器（VAE）的潜在后验转化为和积网络（SPN）推理的软似然因子，从而能够对非结构化证据进行可处理的概率推理，同时保持校准的不确定性估计。我们将LPF实例化为LPF-SPN（结构化因子推理）和LPF-Learned（端到端学习的聚合），从而能够在共享的不确定性表示下，对显式概率推理和学习聚合进行原则性的比较。
在八个领域（七个合成领域和FEVER基准）中，LPF-SPN取得了高准确率（高达97.8%）、低校准误差（ECE 1.4%）以及良好的概率拟合性，在15个随机种子下显著优于证据深度学习、LLM和基于图的基线。
贡献：（1）一个连接潜在不确定性表示与结构化概率推理的框架。（2）支持对推理范式进行受控比较的双重架构。（3）具有种子选择的可复现训练方法。（4）针对EDL、BERT、R-GCN和大型语言模型基线的评估。（5）跨领域验证。（6）在姊妹论文中提供形式化保证。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了潜在后验因子（LPF）框架，一种将VAE潜在后验转化为SPN推理软似然因子的新方法，以解决多证据概率推理的挑战。该框架实现了对非结构化证据的可处理推理和校准的不确定性估计。通过LPF-SPN和LPF-Learned两种架构的实现，研究在多个领域进行了评估，结果表明LPF-SPN在准确率和校准方面显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 潜在后验因子, 概率推理, 和积网络, 不确定性量化, 证据聚合
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架（LPF），有效地结合了深度学习中的潜在不确定性表示和概率图模型中的结构化推理能力。通过将VAE的后验分布转化为SPN的因子，实现了对非结构化数据的概率推理，并保持了良好的不确定性校准。LPF-SPN在多个基准测试中的优异表现，证明了该方法的有效性。该研究的贡献在于提供了一个统一的框架来比较不同的推理范式，并为处理复杂、多证据的不确定性问题提供了一个有前途的解决方案。未来的工作可以探索LPF在更广泛的实际应用中的潜力，以及进一步优化其计算效率。

title: Theoretical Foundations of Latent Posterior Factors: Formal Guarantees for Multi-Evidence Reasoning
comments: 30 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Theoretical characterization of the Latent Posterior Factors (LPF) framework for multi-evidence probabilistic reasoning, with formal guarantees and empirical validation
summary:
We present a complete theoretical characterization of Latent Posterior Factors (LPF), a principled framework for aggregating multiple heterogeneous evidence items in probabilistic prediction tasks. Multi-evidence reasoning arises pervasively in high-stakes domains including healthcare diagnosis, financial risk assessment, legal case analysis, and regulatory compliance, yet existing approaches either lack formal guarantees or fail to handle multi-evidence scenarios architecturally. LPF encodes each evidence item into a Gaussian latent posterior via a variational autoencoder, converting posteriors to soft factors through Monte Carlo marginalization, and aggregating factors via exact Sum-Product Network inference (LPF-SPN) or a learned neural aggregator (LPF-Learned).
  We prove seven formal guarantees spanning the key desiderata for trustworthy AI: Calibration Preservation (ECE <= epsilon + C/sqrt(K_eff)); Monte Carlo Error decaying as O(1/sqrt(M)); a non-vacuous PAC-Bayes bound with train-test gap of 0.0085 at N=4200; operation within 1.12x of the information-theoretic lower bound; graceful degradation as O(epsilon*delta*sqrt(K)) under corruption, maintaining 88% performance with half of evidence adversarially replaced; O(1/sqrt(K)) calibration decay with R^2=0.849; and exact epistemic-aleatoric uncertainty decomposition with error below 0.002%. All theorems are empirically validated on controlled datasets spanning up to 4,200 training examples. Our theoretical framework establishes LPF as a foundation for trustworthy multi-evidence AI in safety-critical applications.
comment: 30 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Theoretical characterization of the Latent Posterior Factors (LPF) framework for multi-evidence probabilistic reasoning, with formal guarantees and empirical validation

AI.title_translation: 潜后验因子的理论基础：多证据推理的形式化保证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了潜后验因子（LPF）框架，用于可靠地聚合来自不同来源的证据。它使用VAE和SPN（或学习聚合器）来处理证据，并提供了七个严格的数学保证，证明了其在校准、误差和鲁棒性方面的优越性，使其成为高风险AI应用的基础。
AI.motivation: 多证据推理在医疗诊断、金融风险评估、法律案例分析和监管合规等高风险领域普遍存在，但现有方法要么缺乏形式保证，要么在架构上无法处理多证据场景。
AI.method: 通过变分自编码器将每个证据项编码为高斯潜后验；通过蒙特卡洛边缘化将后验转换为软因子；通过精确和积网络推理（LPF-SPN）或学习的神经聚合器（LPF-Learned）聚合因子。
AI.result: 证明了涵盖校准保持、蒙特卡洛误差衰减、PAC-贝叶斯界限、接近信息论下限、腐败下的优雅退化、校准衰减和精确的认知-偶然不确定性分解等七项形式保证。所有定理在最多4200个训练样本的受控数据集上得到实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 该理论框架将潜后验因子（LPF）确立为安全关键应用中可信赖的多证据人工智能的基础。
AI.translation: 我们提出了潜后验因子（LPF）的完整理论刻画，这是一个用于在概率预测任务中聚合多个异构证据项的原则性框架。多证据推理在高风险领域（包括医疗诊断、金融风险评估、法律案例分析和监管合规）中普遍存在，但现有方法要么缺乏形式保证，要么在架构上无法处理多证据场景。LPF通过变分自编码器将每个证据项编码为高斯潜后验，通过蒙特卡洛边缘化将后验转换为软因子，并通过精确和积网络推理（LPF-SPN）或学习的神经聚合器（LPF-Learned）聚合因子。我们证明了跨越可信赖人工智能关键要求的七项形式保证：校准保持（ECE <= epsilon + C/sqrt(K_eff)）；蒙特卡洛误差衰减为O(1/sqrt(M))；具有N=4200时训练-测试差距为0.0085的非空洞PAC-贝叶斯界限；在信息论下限的1.12倍以内运行；在腐败下作为O(epsilon*delta*sqrt(K))的优雅退化，保持一半证据被对抗性替换时的88%性能；R^2=0.849的O(1/sqrt(K))校准衰减；以及误差低于0.002%的精确认知-偶然不确定性分解。所有定理都在跨越多达4200个训练样本的受控数据集上得到实证验证。我们的理论框架将LPF确立为安全关键应用中可信赖多证据人工智能的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了潜后验因子（LPF）的完整理论刻画，这是一个用于在概率预测任务中聚合多个异构证据项的原则性框架。LPF通过变分自编码器将证据编码为高斯潜后验，并通过边缘化转换为软因子，然后使用和积网络或学习聚合器进行聚合。论文证明了七项关键的可信赖人工智能指标的形式化保证，并在受控数据集上进行了实证验证，确立了LPF作为安全关键应用中可信赖多证据AI的基础。
AI.keywords: 潜后验因子, 多证据推理, 可信赖人工智能, 形式保证, 和积网络
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于为多证据推理提供了一个具有严格形式化保证的理论框架（LPF）。其重要性在于解决了高风险领域中现有方法缺乏形式保证或架构上无法处理多证据聚合的问题。局限性在于其理论分析主要基于高斯潜变量模型和SPN/学习聚合器，可能限制了其在更复杂非高斯或高度非结构化证据场景下的直接适用性。

title: A Framework and Prototype for a Navigable Map of Datasets in Engineering Design and Systems Engineering
comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to ASME IDETC 2026-DAC22
summary: The proliferation of data across the system lifecycle presents both a significant opportunity and a challenge for Engineering Design and Systems Engineering (EDSE). While this "digital thread" has the potential to drive innovation, the fragmented and inaccessible nature of existing datasets hinders method validation, limits reproducibility, and slows research progress. Unlike fields such as computer vision and natural language processing, which benefit from established benchmark ecosystems, engineering design research often relies on small, proprietary, or ad-hoc datasets. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing a systematic framework for a "Map of Datasets in EDSE." The framework is built upon a multi-dimensional taxonomy designed to classify engineering datasets by domain, lifecycle stage, data type, and format, enabling faceted discovery. An architecture for an interactive discovery tool is detailed and demonstrated through a working prototype, employing a knowledge graph data model to capture rich semantic relationships between datasets, tools, and publications. An analysis of the current data landscape reveals underrepresented areas ("data deserts") in early-stage design and system architecture, as well as relatively well-represented areas ("data oases") in predictive maintenance and autonomous systems. The paper identifies key challenges in curation and sustainability and proposes mitigation strategies, laying the groundwork for a dynamic, community-driven resource to accelerate data-centric engineering research.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to ASME IDETC 2026-DAC22

AI.title_translation: 工程设计和系统工程中数据集可导航地图的框架和原型
AI.tldr: 本文针对工程设计和系统工程中数据集分散的难题，创建了一个用于分类和导航数据集的“地图”框架和原型工具（基于知识图谱），以期加速数据驱动的研究，并指出了当前数据资源的分布热点和冷点。
AI.motivation: 工程设计和系统工程（EDSE）中数据的激增带来了机遇，但现有数据集的碎片化和不可访问性阻碍了方法验证、限制了再现性并减缓了研究进展，缺乏类似计算机视觉领域的基准数据集生态系统。
AI.method: 提出一个基于多维分类法的系统性框架来对工程数据集进行分类（按领域、生命周期阶段、数据类型和格式），并设计了一个交互式发现工具的架构，该工具采用知识图谱数据模型来捕获数据集、工具和出版物之间的语义关系。
AI.result: 提出了一种“EDSE数据集地图”的系统性框架，并展示了一个工作原型，该原型使用知识图谱模型。分析结果揭示了早期设计和系统架构中数据不足的“数据沙漠”区域，以及预测性维护和自主系统中数据相对丰富的“数据绿洲”区域。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一个用于EDSE数据集的“数据集地图”的系统性框架，并展示了一个基于知识图谱的原型，旨在促进数据驱动的工程研究。它还揭示了当前数据分布的空白区域，并提出了应对数据策展和可持续性挑战的策略。
AI.translation: 系统生命周期中数据的激增为工程设计和系统工程（EDSE）既带来了重大的机遇，也带来了挑战。虽然这种“数字主线”有潜力推动创新，但现有数据集的碎片化和不可访问性阻碍了方法验证，限制了再现性，并减缓了研究进展。与计算机视觉和自然语言处理等领域受益于成熟的基准生态系统不同，工程设计研究通常依赖于小型、专有或临时的（ad-hoc）数据集。本文通过提出一个系统性的“EDSE数据集地图”框架来应对这一挑战。该框架建立在多维分类法之上，旨在根据领域、生命周期阶段、数据类型和格式对工程数据集进行分类，从而实现分面发现。本文详细介绍了一种交互式发现工具的架构，并通过一个工作原型进行了演示，该原型采用知识图谱数据模型来捕获数据集、工具和出版物之间丰富的语义关系。对当前数据景观的分析揭示了早期设计和系统架构中代表性不足的区域（“数据沙漠”），以及预测性维护和自主系统中相对代表性较好的区域（“数据绿洲”）。本文确定了策展和可持续性的关键挑战，并提出了缓解策略，为加速数据驱动的工程研究奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 为应对工程设计和系统工程（EDSE）中数据集碎片化和难以获取的挑战，本文提出了一个“EDSE数据集地图”的系统性框架，该框架基于多维分类法。同时，本文演示了一个利用知识图谱数据模型的交互式发现工具原型，并分析了当前数据景观，指出了数据沙漠和数据绿洲，为建立动态的、社区驱动的资源奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 数据集地图, 工程设计, 系统工程, 数据科学, 知识图谱
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个系统性的框架和原型，用于对工程设计和系统工程（EDSE）中的数据集进行分类和导航，以解决当前数据集的碎片化问题。其重要性在于为工程领域建立类似计算机视觉领域的基准数据集生态系统奠定基础。局限性在于，该工作是基于一个原型，其实际的社区驱动和长期可持续性仍有待验证。

title: OMNIFLOW: A Physics-Grounded Multimodal Agent for Generalized Scientific Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional logical reasoning capabilities but frequently struggle with the continuous spatiotemporal dynamics governed by Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), often resulting in non-physical hallucinations. Existing approaches typically resort to costly, domain-specific fine-tuning, which severely limits cross-domain generalization and interpretability. To bridge this gap, we propose OMNIFLOW, a neuro-symbolic architecture designed to ground frozen multimodal LLMs in fundamental physical laws without requiring domain-specific parameter updates. OMNIFLOW introduces a novel \textit{Semantic-Symbolic Alignment} mechanism that projects high-dimensional flow tensors into topological linguistic descriptors, enabling the model to perceive physical structures rather than raw pixel values. Furthermore, we construct a Physics-Guided Chain-of-Thought (PG-CoT) workflow that orchestrates reasoning through dynamic constraint injection (e.g., mass conservation) and iterative reflexive verification. We evaluate OMNIFLOW on a comprehensive benchmark spanning microscopic turbulence, theoretical Navier-Stokes equations, and macroscopic global weather forecasting. Empirical results demonstrate that OMNIFLOW significantly outperforms traditional deep learning baselines in zero-shot generalization and few-shot adaptation tasks. Crucially, it offers transparent, physically consistent reasoning reports, marking a paradigm shift from black-box fitting to interpretable scientific reasoning.

AI.title_translation: OMNIFLOW：一个用于通用科学推理的物理基础多模态智能体
AI.tldr: 提出OMNIFLOW，一种无需微调即可将LLM与物理定律结合的神经符号模型，通过将物理数据转换为可解释的语言描述符并使用物理约束进行推理，实现了比传统方法更强的泛化能力和透明度。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理由偏微分方程（PDEs）控制的连续时空动态时，经常出现非物理的幻觉。现有方法依赖于昂贵、领域特定的微调，这严重限制了跨领域泛化和可解释性。目标是弥合这种差距。
AI.method: OMNIFLOW采用神经符号架构，引入了“语义-符号对齐”机制，将高维流张量投影到拓扑语言描述符中。此外，它构建了一个“物理引导思维链”（PG-CoT）工作流，通过动态约束注入（如质量守恒）和迭代反射验证来编排推理。该方法旨在冻结多模态LLM，无需领域特定参数更新。
AI.result: OMNIFLOW在涵盖微观湍流、理论纳维-斯托克斯方程和宏观全球天气预报的综合基准测试中，显著优于传统深度学习基线，特别是在零样本泛化和少样本适应任务中。
AI.conclusion: OMNIFLOW在跨领域泛化和少样本适应任务中显著优于传统深度学习基线，并提供了透明、物理一致的推理报告，标志着从黑箱拟合到可解释科学推理的范式转变。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已展示出卓越的逻辑推理能力，但在受偏微分方程（PDEs）控制的连续时空动态方面经常遇到困难，通常导致非物理的幻觉。现有方法通常诉诸于昂贵、特定领域的微调，这严重限制了跨域泛化和可解释性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了OMNIFLOW，一种旨在将冻结的多模态LLM与基本物理定律相结合的神经符号架构，而无需进行领域特定的参数更新。OMNIFLOW引入了一种新颖的*语义-符号对齐*机制，将高维流张量投影到拓扑语言描述符中，使模型能够感知物理结构而不是原始像素值。此外，我们构建了一个*物理引导思维链*（PG-CoT）工作流，通过动态约束注入（例如质量守恒）和迭代反射验证来编排推理。我们在涵盖微观湍流、理论纳维-斯托克斯方程和宏观全球天气预报的综合基准上评估了OMNIFLOW。实证结果表明，OMNIFLOW在零样本泛化和少样本适应任务中显著优于传统的深度学习基线。至关重要的是，它提供了透明、物理一致的推理报告，标志着从黑箱拟合到可解释科学推理的范式转变。
AI.summary: OMNIFLOW是一个新颖的神经符号架构，旨在将冻结的多模态大型语言模型（LLMs）与基本物理定律相结合，而无需进行参数更新。它通过语义-符号对齐机制感知物理结构，并通过物理引导的思维链（PG-CoT）进行可解释的推理。实验证明其在各种物理任务上具有卓越的零样本泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 神经符号架构, 物理接地, 语义-符号对齐, 物理引导思维链, 科学推理
AI.comments: OMNIFLOW的创新之处在于其神经符号架构，它在不更新LLM参数的情况下，通过语义-符号对齐和物理引导的思维链（PG-CoT）将LLM与物理定律相结合。这解决了现有方法需要昂贵且限制泛化的领域特定微调的问题。其重要性在于实现了可解释的、物理一致的科学推理。局限性方面，摘要未明确提及，但依赖于“拓扑语言描述符”的有效性可能是一个潜在的挑战。

title: PhasorFlow: A Python Library for Unit Circle Based Computing
summary: We present PhasorFlow, an open-source Python library introducing a computational paradigm operating on the $S^1$ unit circle. Inputs are encoded as complex phasors $z = e^{iθ}$ on the $N$-Torus ($\mathbb{T}^N$). As computation proceeds via unitary wave interference gates, global norm is preserved while individual components drift into $\mathbb{C}^N$, allowing algorithms to natively leverage continuous geometric gradients for predictive learning. PhasorFlow provides three core contributions. First, we formalize the Phasor Circuit model ($N$ unit circle threads, $M$ gates) and introduce a 22-gate library covering Standard Unitary, Non-Linear, Neuromorphic, and Encoding operations with full matrix algebra simulation. Second, we present the Variational Phasor Circuit (VPC), analogous to Variational Quantum Circuits (VQC), enabling optimization of continuous phase parameters for classical machine learning tasks. Third, we introduce the Phasor Transformer, replacing expensive $QK^TV$ attention with a parameter-free, DFT-based token mixing layer inspired by FNet. We validate PhasorFlow on non-linear spatial classification, time-series prediction, financial volatility detection, and neuromorphic tasks including neural binding and oscillatory associative memory. Our results establish unit circle computing as a deterministic, lightweight, and mathematically principled alternative to classical neural networks and quantum circuits. It operates on classical hardware while sharing quantum mechanics' unitary foundations. PhasorFlow is available at https://github.com/mindverse-computing/phasorflow.

title: CTG-DB: An Ontology-Based Transformation of ClinicalTrials.gov to Enable Cross-Trial Drug Safety Analyses
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to the 2026 AMIA Annual Symposium
summary: ClinicalTrials .gov (CT .gov) is the largest publicly accessible registry of clinical studies, yet its registry-oriented architecture and heterogeneous adverse event (AE) terminology limit systematic pharmacovigilance (PV) analytics. AEs are typically recorded as investigator-reported text rather than standardized identifiers, requiring manual reconciliation to identify coherent safety concepts. We present the ClinicalTrials .gov Transformation Database (CTG-DB), an open-source pipeline that ingests the complete CT .gov XML archive and produces a relational database aligned to standardized AE terminology using the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA). CTG-DB preserves arm-level denominators, represents placebo and comparator arms, and normalizes AE terminology using deterministic exact and fuzzy matching to ensure transparent and reproducible mappings. This framework enables concept-level retrieval and cross-trial aggregation for scalable placebo-referenced safety analyses and integration of clinical trial evidence into downstream PV signal detection.

title: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Histopathology Foundation Models for Kidney Digital Pathology Images
comments: 31 Pages, 14 Tables, 12 figures, Co-correspondence to jhodgin@med.umich.edu and pinaki.sarder@ufl.edu
summary: Histopathology foundation models (HFMs), pretrained on large-scale cancer datasets, have advanced computational pathology. However, their applicability to non-cancerous chronic kidney disease remains underexplored, despite coexistence of renal pathology with malignancies such as renal cell and urothelial carcinoma. We systematically evaluate 11 publicly available HFMs across 11 kidney-specific downstream tasks spanning multiple stains (PAS, H&E, PASM, and IHC), spatial scales (tile and slide-level), task types (classification, regression, and copy detection), and clinical objectives, including detection, diagnosis, and prognosis. Tile-level performance is assessed using repeated stratified group cross-validation, while slide-level tasks are evaluated using repeated nested stratified cross-validation. Statistical significance is examined using Friedman test followed by pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank testing with Holm-Bonferroni correction and compact letter display visualization. To promote reproducibility, we release an open-source Python package, kidney-hfm-eval, available at https://pypi.org/project/kidney-hfm-eval/ , that reproduces the evaluation pipelines. Results show moderate to strong performance on tasks driven by coarse meso-scale renal morphology, including diagnostic classification and detection of prominent structural alterations. In contrast, performance consistently declines for tasks requiring fine-grained microstructural discrimination, complex biological phenotypes, or slide-level prognostic inference, largely independent of stain type. Overall, current HFMs appear to encode predominantly static meso-scale representations and may have limited capacity to capture subtle renal pathology or prognosis-related signals. Our results highlight the need for kidney-specific, multi-stain, and multimodal foundation models to support clinically reliable decision-making in nephrology.

title: 100x Cost & Latency Reduction: Performance Analysis of AI Query Approximation using Lightweight Proxy Models
summary: Several data warehouse and database providers have recently introduced extensions to SQL called AI Queries, enabling users to specify functions and conditions in SQL that are evaluated by LLMs, thereby broadening significantly the kinds of queries one can express over the combination of structured and unstructured data. LLMs offer remarkable semantic reasoning capabilities, making them an essential tool for complex and nuanced queries that blend structured and unstructured data. While extremely powerful, these AI queries can become prohibitively costly when invoked thousands of times. This paper provides an extensive evaluation of a recent AI query approximation approach that enables low cost analytics and database applications to benefit from AI queries. The approach delivers >100x cost and latency reduction for the semantic filter ($AI.IF$) operator and also important gains for semantic ranking ($AI.RANK$). The cost and performance gains come from utilizing cheap and accurate proxy models over embedding vectors. We show that despite the massive gains in latency and cost, these proxy models preserve accuracy and occasionally improve accuracy across various benchmark datasets, including the extended Amazon reviews benchmark that has 10M rows. We present an OLAP-friendly architecture within Google BigQuery for this approach for purely online (ad hoc) queries, and a low-latency HTAP database-friendly architecture in AlloyDB that could further improve the latency by moving the proxy model training offline. We present techniques that accelerate the proxy model training.

title: Safety Case Patterns for VLA-based driving systems: Insights from SimLingo
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA)-based driving systems represent a significant paradigm shift in autonomous driving since, by combining traffic scene understanding, linguistic interpretation, and action generation, these systems enable more flexible, adaptive, and instruction-responsive driving behaviors. However, despite their growing adoption and potential to support socially responsible autonomous driving as well as understanding high-level human instructions, VLA-based driving systems may exhibit new types of hazardous behaviors. For instance, the integration of open-ended natural language inputs (e.g., user or navigation instructions) into the multimodal control loop, may lead to unpredictable and unsafe behaviors that could endanger vehicle occupants and pedestrians. Hence, assuring the safety of these systems is crucial to help build trust in their operations. To support this, we propose a novel safety case design approach called RAISE. Our approach introduces novel patterns tailored to instruction-based driving systems such as VLA-based driving systems, an extension of Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) detailing safe scenarios and their outcomes, and a design technique to create the safety cases of VLA-based driving systems. A case study on SimLingo illustrates how our approach can be used to construct rigorous, evidence-based safety claims for this emerging class of autonomous driving systems.

title: Interpretable Context Methodology: Folder Structure as Agentic Architecture
summary: Current approaches to AI agent orchestration typically involve building multi-agent frameworks that manage context passing, memory, error handling, and step coordination through code. These frameworks work well for complex, concurrent systems. But for sequential workflows where a human reviews output at each step, they introduce engineering overhead that the problem does not require. This paper presents Model Workspace Protocol (MWP), a method that replaces framework-level orchestration with filesystem structure. Numbered folders represent stages. Plain markdown files carry the prompts and context that tell a single AI agent what role to play at each step. Local scripts handle the mechanical work that does not need AI at all. The result is a system where one agent, reading the right files at the right moment, does the work that would otherwise require a multi-agent framework. This approach applies ideas from Unix pipeline design, modular decomposition, multi-pass compilation, and literate programming to the specific problem of structuring context for AI agents. The protocol is open source under the MIT license.

title: Resource Consumption Threats in Large Language Models
summary: Given limited and costly computational infrastructure, resource efficiency is a key requirement for large language models (LLMs). Efficient LLMs increase service capacity for providers and reduce latency and API costs for users. Recent resource consumption threats induce excessive generation, degrading model efficiency and harming both service availability and economic sustainability. This survey presents a systematic review of threats to resource consumption in LLMs. We further establish a unified view of this emerging area by clarifying its scope and examining the problem along the full pipeline from threat induction to mechanism understanding and mitigation. Our goal is to clarify the problem landscape for this emerging area, thereby providing a clearer foundation for characterization and mitigation.

title: S-VAM: Shortcut Video-Action Model by Self-Distilling Geometric and Semantic Foresight
summary: Video action models (VAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot learning, owing to their powerful visual foresight for complex manipulation tasks. However, current VAMs, typically relying on either slow multi-step video generation or noisy one-step feature extraction, cannot simultaneously guarantee real-time inference and high-fidelity foresight. To address this limitation, we propose S-VAM, a shortcut video-action model that foresees coherent geometric and semantic representations via a single forward pass. Serving as a stable blueprint, these foreseen representations significantly simplify the action prediction. To enable this efficient shortcut, we introduce a novel self-distillation strategy that condenses structured generative priors of multi-step denoising into one-step inference. Specifically, vision foundation model (VFM) representations extracted from the diffusion model's own multi-step generated videos provide teacher targets. Lightweight decouplers, as students, learn to directly map noisy one-step features to these targets. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that our S-VAM outperforms state-of-the-art methods, enabling efficient and precise manipulation in complex environments. Our project page is https://haodong-yan.github.io/S-VAM/

title: Neural Pushforward Samplers for the Fokker-Planck Equation on Embedded Riemannian Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we extend the Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method to the Fokker--Planck equation on compact embedded Riemannian manifolds. The method represents the solution as a probability distribution via a neural pushforward map that is constrained to the manifold by a retraction layer, enforcing manifold membership and probability conservation by construction. Training is guided by a weak adversarial objective using ambient plane-wave test functions, whose intrinsic differential operators are derived in closed form from the geometry of the embedding, yielding a fully mesh-free and chart-free algorithm. Both steady-state and time-dependent formulations are developed, and numerical results on a double-well problem on the two-sphere demonstrate the capability of the method in capturing multimodal invariant distributions on curved spaces.

title: Synergizing Deep Learning and Biological Heuristics for Extreme Long-Tail White Blood Cell Classification
summary: Automated white blood cell (WBC) classification is essential for leukemia screening but remains challenged by extreme class imbalance, long-tail distributions, and domain shift, leading deep models to overfit dominant classes and fail on rare subtypes. We propose a hybrid framework for rare-class generalization that integrates a generative Pix2Pix-based restoration module for artifact removal, a Swin Transformer ensemble with MedSigLIP contrastive embeddings for robust representation learning, and a biologically-inspired refinement step using geometric spikiness and Mahalanobis-based morphological constraints to recover out-of-distribution predictions. Evaluated on the WBCBench 2026 challenge, our method achieves a Macro-F1 of 0.77139 on the private leaderboard, demonstrating strong performance under severe imbalance and highlighting the value of incorporating biological priors into deep learning for hematological image analysis.

title: MG-Grasp: Metric-Scale Geometric 6-DoF Grasping Framework with Sparse RGB Observations
summary: Single-view RGB-D grasp detection remains a common choice in 6-DoF robotic grasping systems, which typically requires a depth sensor. While RGB-only 6-DoF grasp methods has been studied recently, their inaccurate geometric representation is not directly suitable for physically reliable robotic manipulation, thereby hindering reliable grasp generation. To address these limitations, we propose MG-Grasp, a novel depth-free 6-DoF grasping framework that achieves high-quality object grasping. Leveraging two-view 3D foundation model with camera intrinsic/extrinsic, our method reconstructs metric-scale and multi-view consistent dense point clouds from sparse RGB images and generates stable 6-DoF grasp. Experiments on GraspNet-1Billion dataset and real world demonstrate that MG-Grasp achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) grasp performance among RGB-based 6-DoF grasping methods.

title: Rotatable Antenna-Enabled Mobile Edge Computing
comments: Submitted to IEEE Wireless Communications Letters on February 5, 2026
summary: In the evolving landscape of mobile edge computing (MEC), enhancing communication reliability and computation efficiency to support increasingly stringent low-latency services remains a fundamental challenge. Rotatable antenna (RA) is a promising technology that introduces new spatial degrees of freedom (DoFs) to tackle this challenge. In this letter, we investigate an RA-enabled MEC system where antenna boresight directions can be independently adjusted to proactively improve wireless channel conditions for latency-critical users. We aim to minimize the maximum computation latency by jointly optimizing the MEC server computing resource allocation, receive beamforming, and the deflection angles of all RAs. To address the resulting non-convex problem, we develop an efficient alternating optimization (AO) framework. Specifically, the optimal edge computing resource allocation is derived based on the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions. Given the computing resources, the receive beamforming is optimized using semidefinite relaxation (SDR) combined with a bisection search. Furthermore, the RA deflection angles are optimized via fractional programming (FP) and successive convex approximation (SCA). Simulation results verify that the proposed RA-enabled MEC scheme significantly reduces the maximum computation latency compared with conventional benchmark methods.

title: VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents
summary: The rapid advancement of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) has enabled browsing agents to acquire and reason over multimodal information in the real world. But existing benchmarks suffer from two limitations: insufficient evaluation of visual reasoning ability and the neglect of native visual information of web pages in the reasoning chains. To address these challenges, we introduce a new benchmark for visual-native search, VisBrowse-Bench. It contains 169 VQA instances covering multiple domains and evaluates the models' visual reasoning capabilities during the search process through multimodal evidence cross-validation via text-image retrieval and joint reasoning. These data were constructed by human experts using a multi-stage pipeline and underwent rigorous manual verification. We additionally propose an agent workflow that can effectively drive the browsing agent to actively collect and reason over visual information during the search process. We comprehensively evaluated both open-source and closed-source models in this workflow. Experimental results show that even the best-performing model, Claude-4.6-Opus only achieves an accuracy of 47.6%, while the proprietary Deep Research model, o3-deep-research only achieves an accuracy of 41.1%. The code and data can be accessed at: https://github.com/ZhengboZhang/VisBrowse-Bench

title: Attention-guided Evidence Grounding for Spoken Question Answering
summary: Spoken Question Answering (Spoken QA) presents a challenging cross-modal problem: effectively aligning acoustic queries with textual knowledge while avoiding the latency and error propagation inherent in cascaded ASR-based systems. In this paper, we introduce Attention-guided Evidence Grounding (AEG), a novel end-to-end framework that leverages the internal cross-modal attention of Speech Large Language Models (SpeechLLMs) to explicitly locate and ground key evidence in the model's latent space. To address the diffuse attention distribution in pre-trained models, we propose Learning to Focus on Evidence (LFE), a supervised fine-tuning paradigm that calibrates the model's attention mechanism to distinguish query-relevant segments from irrelevant context. Experiments on SQuAD, HotpotQA, and MuSiQue demonstrate that AEG reduces hallucinations and achieves strong efficiency gains, outperforming large-scale cascaded baselines (Whisper-Large-v3 + Reranker) while reducing inference latency by approximately 62%.

title: OGScene3D: Incremental Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussian Scene Graph Mapping for Scene Understanding
summary: Open-vocabulary scene understanding is crucial for robotic applications, enabling robots to comprehend complex 3D environmental contexts and supporting various downstream tasks such as navigation and manipulation. However, existing methods require pre-built complete 3D semantic maps to construct scene graphs for scene understanding, which limits their applicability in robotic scenarios where environments are explored incrementally. To address this challenge, we propose OGScene3D, an open-vocabulary scene understanding system that achieves accurate 3D semantic mapping and scene graph construction incrementally. Our system employs a confidence-based Gaussian semantic representation that jointly models semantic predictions and their reliability, enabling robust scene modeling. Building on this representation, we introduce a hierarchical 3D semantic optimization strategy that achieves semantic consistency through local correspondence establishment and global refinement, thereby constructing globally consistent semantic maps. Moreover, we design a long-term global optimization method that leverages temporal memory of historical observations to enhance semantic predictions. By integrating 2D-3D semantic consistency with Gaussian rendering contribution, this method continuously refines the semantic understanding of the entire scene. Furthermore, we develop a progressive graph construction approach that dynamically creates and updates both nodes and semantic relationships, allowing continuous updating of the 3D scene graphs. Extensive experiments on widely used datasets and real-world scenes demonstrate the effectiveness of our OGScene3D on open-vocabulary scene understanding.

title: Omnilingual MT: Machine Translation for 1,600 Languages
summary:
High-quality machine translation (MT) can scale to hundreds of languages, setting a high bar for multilingual systems. However, compared to the world's 7,000 languages, current systems still offer only limited coverage: about 200 languages on the target side, and maybe a few hundreds more on the source side, supported due to cross-lingual transfer. And even these numbers have been hard to evaluate due to the lack of reliable benchmarks and metrics.
  We present Omnilingual Machine Translation (OMT), the first MT system supporting more than 1,600 languages. This scale is enabled by a comprehensive data strategy that integrates large public multilingual corpora with newly created datasets, including manually curated MeDLEY bitext.
  We explore two ways of specializing a Large Language model (LLM) for machine translation: as a decoder-only model (OMT-LLaMA) or as a module in an encoder-decoder architecture (OMT-NLLB). Notably, all our 1B to 8B parameter models match or exceed the MT performance of a 70B LLM baseline, revealing a clear specialization advantage and enabling strong translation quality in low-compute settings. Moreover, our evaluation of English-to-1,600 translations further shows that while baseline models can interpret undersupported languages, they frequently fail to generate them with meaningful fidelity; OMT-LLaMA models substantially expand the set of languages for which coherent generation is feasible. Additionally, OMT models improve in cross-lingual transfer, being close to solving the "understanding" part of the puzzle in MT for the 1,600 evaluated. Our leaderboard and main human-created evaluation datasets (BOUQuET and Met-BOUQuET) are dynamically evolving towards Omnilinguality and freely available.

title: HGP-Mamba: Integrating Histology and Generated Protein Features for Mamba-based Multimodal Survival Risk Prediction
comments: Accepted at IEEE ICME 2026. This arXiv version includes additional supplementary experiments and extended discussions beyond the conference version
summary: Recent advances in multimodal learning have significantly improved cancer survival risk prediction. However, the joint prognostic potential of protein markers and histopathology images remains underexplored, largely due to the high cost and limited availability of protein expression profiling. To address this challenge, we propose HGP-Mamba, a Mamba-based multimodal framework that efficiently integrates histological with generated protein features for survival risk prediction. Specifically, we introduce a protein feature extractor (PFE) that leverages pretrained foundation models to derive high-throughput protein embeddings directly from Whole Slide Images (WSIs), enabling data-efficient incorporation of molecular information. Together with histology embeddings that capture morphological patterns, we further introduce the Local Interaction-aware Mamba (LiAM) for fine-grained feature interaction and the Global Interaction-enhanced Mamba (GiEM) to promote holistic modality fusion at the slide level, thus capture complex cross-modal dependencies. Experiments on four public cancer datasets demonstrate that HGP-Mamba achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining superior computational efficiency compared with existing methods. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Daijing-ai/HGP-Mamba.git.

title: EngGPT2: Sovereign, Efficient and Open Intelligence
summary: EngGPT2-16B-A3B is the latest iteration of Engineering Group's Italian LLM and it's built to be a Sovereign, Efficient and Open model. EngGPT2 is trained on 2.5 trillion tokens - less than Qwen3's 36T or Llama3's 15T - and delivers performance on key benchmarks, including MMLU-Pro, GSM8K, IFEval and HumanEval, comparable to dense models in the 8B-16B range, while requiring one-fifth to half of the inference power, and between one-tenth to one-sixth of the training data and consequent needed training power. Designed as a trained-from-scratch Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, EngGPT2 features 16 billion parameters with 3 billion active per inference, with expert sizes positioned between those used in GPT-OSS and Qwen3. Approximately 25% of its training corpus consists of Italian-language data, to deliver strong capabilities for European and Italian NLP tasks among models of similar scale. This efficiency aims to position EngGPT2 as a key contributor to the growing portfolio of open-weight European models, combining performance and efficiency with full alignment to the EU AI Act. EngGPT2 is also a single model capable of multiple reasoning modes: non-reasoning, reasoning in Italian or English, and turbo-reasoning (a concise, bullet-point style reasoning available in both languages designed for real-time reasoning use cases). EngGPT2 aims to set a new standard for resource-conscious, high-performance LLMs tailored to European and Italian contexts.

title: TRUST-SQL: Tool-Integrated Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL over Unknown Schemas
summary: Text-to-SQL parsing has achieved remarkable progress under the Full Schema Assumption. However, this premise fails in real-world enterprise environments where databases contain hundreds of tables with massive noisy metadata. Rather than injecting the full schema upfront, an agent must actively identify and verify only the relevant subset, giving rise to the Unknown Schema scenario we study in this work. To address this, we propose TRUST-SQL (Truthful Reasoning with Unknown Schema via Tools). We formulate the task as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process where our autonomous agent employs a structured four-phase protocol to ground reasoning in verified metadata. Crucially, this protocol provides a structural boundary for our novel Dual-Track GRPO strategy. By applying token-level masked advantages, this strategy isolates exploration rewards from execution outcomes to resolve credit assignment, yielding a 9.9% relative improvement over standard GRPO. Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that TRUST-SQL achieves an average absolute improvement of 30.6% and 16.6% for the 4B and 8B variants respectively over their base models. Remarkably, despite operating entirely without pre-loaded metadata, our framework consistently matches or surpasses strong baselines that rely on schema prefilling.

title: ETM2: Empowering Traditional Memory Bandwidth Regulation using ETM
comments: Extended version of the paper to appear at IEEE Real-Time and Embedded Technology and Applications Symposium (RTAS) 2026
summary: The Embedded Trace Macrocell (ETM) is a standard component of Arm's CoreSight architecture, present in a wide range of platforms and primarily designed for tracing and debugging. In this work, we demonstrate that it can be repurposed to implement a novel hardware-assisted memory bandwidth regulator, providing a portable and effective solution to mitigate memory interference in real-time multicore systems. ETM2 requires minimal software intervention and bridges the gap between the fine-grained microsecond resolution of MemPol and the portability and reaction time of interrupt-based solutions, such as MemGuard. We assess the effectiveness and portability of our design with an evaluation on a large number of 64-bit Arm boards, and we compare ETM2 with previous works using a setup based on the San Diego Vision Benchmark Suite on the AMD Zynq UltraScale+. Our results show the scalability of the approach and highlight the design trade-offs it enables. ETM2 is effective in enforcing per-core memory bandwidth regulation and unlocks new regulation options that were infeasible under MemGuard and MemPol.
